DECLARE @ID VARCHAR(13) DECLARE @REFER_DOCUMENT_TYPE VARCHAR(2) DECLARE @REFER_DOCUMENT_NUMBER VARCHAR(13) DECLARE @SERIE VARCHAR(10) DECLARE @CONTADOR INT DECLARE @NUM_VOUCHER VARCHAR(13)
SET @CONTADOR=1
DECLARE CURSORA CURSOR FOR SELECT ID, REFER_DOCUMENT_TYPE, REFER_DOCUMENT_NUMBER, SERIE FROM dbo.PURCHASE_FACT_SUPPLIER WHERE YEAR(PROMISE_DATE)=@ANIO AND MONTH(PROMISE_DATE)=@MES OPEN CURSORA FETCH NEXT FROM CURSORA INTO @ID, @REFER_DOCUMENT_TYPE, @REFER_DOCUMENT_NUMBER, @SERIE WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN SET @NUM_VOUCHER=@MES+'-'+DBO.FormateaconCeros(@CONTADOR,7)
UPDATE dbo.PURCHASE_FACT_SUPPLIER SET ID=@NUM_VOUCHER WHERE ID=@ID AND REFER_DOCUMENT_TYPE=@REFER_DOCUMENT_TYPE AND REFER_DOCUMENT_NUMBER=@REFER_DOCUMENT_NUMBER AND SERIE=@SERIE UPDATE dbo.PURCHASE_FACT_SUPPLIER_L SET ID=@NUM_VOUCHER WHERE ID=@ID
SET @CONTADOR=@CONTADOR+1
FETCH NEXT FROM CURSORA INTO @ID, @REFER_DOCUMENT_TYPE, @REFER_DOCUMENT_NUMBER, @SERIE END CLOSE CURSORA DEALLOCATE CURSORA

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value: --===================================================================== -- 1. CREAR TABLA TEMPORAL DE DATOS FILTRADOS (INGRESOS) --===================================================================== IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM DBO.SYSOBJECTS WHERE ID = OBJECT_ID(N'[DBO].[TABI]') AND OBJECTPROPERTY(ID, N'ISTABLE') = 1) DROP TABLE [DBO].[TABI] CREATE TABLE TABI ( WAREHOUSE_ID VARCHAR(30) NULL, ID VARCHAR(30) NULL, NUMBER_LOT VARCHAR(30) NULL, QTY DECIMAL(22,9)) --===================================================================== -- 2. CREAR TABLA TEMPORAL DE DATOS FILTRADOS (SALIDAS) --===================================================================== IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM DBO.SYSOBJECTS WHERE ID = OBJECT_ID(N'[DBO].[TABS]') AND OBJECTPROPERTY(ID, N'ISTABLE') = 1) DROP TABLE [DBO].[TABS] CREATE TABLE TABS (WAREHOUSE_ID VARCHAR(30) NULL, ID VARCHAR(30) NULL, NUMBER_LOT VARCHAR(30) NULL, QTY DECIMAL(22,9)) --===================================================================== -- CASO 1: INCERTAR DATOS DE INGRESO EN LA TABLAS DE INGRESOS --===================================================================== INSERT INTO TABI ( WAREHOUSE_ID, ID, NUMBER_LOT, QTY ) SELECT WT.WAREHOUSE_ID , P.ID , WL.NUMBER_LOT, SUM(WL.QTY) AS QTY FROM WAREHOUSE_TRANS WT INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE WL ON WT.WAREHOUSE_ID=WL.WAREHOUSE_ID AND WT.DOCUMENT_ID=WL.DOCUMENT_ID AND WT.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=WL.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN PART P ON P.ID=WL.PART_ID WHERE WT.TYPE_TRANS='I' AND P.IS_LOT='S' AND WT.WAREHOUSE_ID=@ALMACEN AND WT.TRANS_ID<>'GF' AND WT.STATUS_GUIA<>'A' GROUP BY WT.WAREHOUSE_ID , P.ID ,WL.NUMBER_LOT ORDER BY WL.NUMBER_LOT --===================================================================== -- CASO 2: INCERTAR DATOS DE SALIDA EN LA TABLA DE SALIDAS --===================================================================== INSERT INTO TABS ( WAREHOUSE_ID, ID, NUMBER_LOT, QTY ) SELECT WT.WAREHOUSE_ID , P.ID , WL.NUMBER_LOT, SUM(WL.QTY) AS QTY FROM WAREHOUSE_TRANS WT INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE WL ON WT.WAREHOUSE_ID=WL.WAREHOUSE_ID AND WT.DOCUMENT_ID=WL.DOCUMENT_ID AND WT.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=WL.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN PART P ON P.ID=WL.PART_ID WHERE WT.TYPE_TRANS='S' AND P.IS_LOT='S' AND WT.WAREHOUSE_ID=@ALMACEN AND WT.TRANS_ID<>'GF' AND WT.STATUS_GUIA<>'A' GROUP BY WT.WAREHOUSE_ID , P.ID ,WL.NUMBER_LOT ORDER BY WL.NUMBER_LOT --===================================================================== -- 3. CREAR TABLA DE RESULTADOS --===================================================================== IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM DBO.SYSOBJECTS WHERE ID = OBJECT_ID(N'[DBO].[TAB2]') AND OBJECTPROPERTY(ID, N'ISTABLE') = 1) DROP TABLE [DBO].[TAB2] CREATE TABLE TAB2 ( WAREHOUSE_ID VARCHAR(30) NULL, ID VARCHAR(30) NULL, NUMBER_LOT VARCHAR(30) NULL, QTY DECIMAL(22,9)) --===================================================================== -- INSERTAR CALCULO DE CANTIDADES INGRESO-SALIDA --===================================================================== INSERT INTO TAB2 ( WAREHOUSE_ID, ID, NUMBER_LOT, QTY ) SELECT I.WAREHOUSE_ID, I.ID, I.NUMBER_LOT, (I.QTY-S.QTY)AS QTY FROM TABI I INNER JOIN TABS S ON I.WAREHOUSE_ID= S.WAREHOUSE_ID AND S.ID=I.ID AND I.NUMBER_LOT=S.NUMBER_LOT --===================================================================== -- INSERTO DATOS QUE SOLO EXISTEN EN INGREOS --===================================================================== INSERT INTO TAB2 ( WAREHOUSE_ID, ID, NUMBER_LOT, QTY ) SELECT I.WAREHOUSE_ID, I.ID, I.NUMBER_LOT, I.QTY FROM TABI I LEFT JOIN TABS S ON I.WAREHOUSE_ID= S.WAREHOUSE_ID AND S.ID=I.ID AND I.NUMBER_LOT=S.NUMBER_LOT WHERE S.WAREHOUSE_ID IS NULL AND S.ID IS NULL AND S.NUMBER_LOT IS NULL --===================================================================== --ACTUALIZO LA TABLA LOT CON LOS DATOS DE TAB2 (TABLA RESULTADOS) --===================================================================== UPDATE LOT SET QTY_ON_HAND= T.QTY FROM TAB2 T INNER JOIN LOT L ON T.WAREHOUSE_ID=L.WHO_ID AND T.ID=L.PART_ID AND T.NUMBER_LOT=L.LOT_ID WHERE T.WAREHOUSE_ID=L.WHO_ID AND T.ID=L.PART_ID AND T.NUMBER_LOT=L.LOT_ID

DECLARE @PNUM_ALMACEN VARCHAR(2)
UPDATE dbo.PART_QTY SET QTY_ON_HAND=0
DECLARE RECORRE_ALMACEN CURSOR FOR SELECT ID FROM WAREHOUSE ORDER BY ID OPEN RECORRE_ALMACEN FETCH NEXT FROM RECORRE_ALMACEN INTO @PNUM_ALMACEN WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN --===================================================================== -- 1. CREAR TABLA TEMPORAL DE DATOS FILTRADOS (INGRESOS) --===================================================================== IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM DBO.SYSOBJECTS WHERE ID = OBJECT_ID(N'[DBO].[TABI]') AND OBJECTPROPERTY(ID, N'ISTABLE') = 1) DROP TABLE [DBO].[TABI] CREATE TABLE TABI ( WAREHOUSE_ID VARCHAR(30) NULL, ID VARCHAR(30) NULL, NUMBER_LOT VARCHAR(30) NULL, QTY DECIMAL(22,9)) --===================================================================== -- 2. CREAR TABLA TEMPORAL DE DATOS FILTRADOS (SALIDAS) --===================================================================== IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM DBO.SYSOBJECTS WHERE ID = OBJECT_ID(N'[DBO].[TABS]') AND OBJECTPROPERTY(ID, N'ISTABLE') = 1) DROP TABLE [DBO].[TABS] CREATE TABLE TABS (WAREHOUSE_ID VARCHAR(30) NULL, ID VARCHAR(30) NULL, NUMBER_LOT VARCHAR(30) NULL, QTY DECIMAL(22,9)) --===================================================================== -- CASO 1: INCERTAR DATOS DE INGRESO EN LA TABLAS DE INGRESOS --===================================================================== INSERT INTO TABI ( WAREHOUSE_ID, ID, NUMBER_LOT, QTY ) SELECT WT.WAREHOUSE_ID , P.ID , '', SUM(WL.QTY) AS QTY FROM WAREHOUSE_TRANS WT INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE WL ON WT.WAREHOUSE_ID=WL.WAREHOUSE_ID AND WT.DOCUMENT_ID=WL.DOCUMENT_ID AND WT.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=WL.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN PART P ON P.ID=WL.PART_ID WHERE WT.TYPE_TRANS='I' AND WT.WAREHOUSE_ID=@PNUM_ALMACEN AND WT.TRANS_ID<>'GF' AND WT.STATUS_GUIA<>'A' GROUP BY WT.WAREHOUSE_ID , P.ID ORDER BY p.ID --===================================================================== -- CASO 2: INCERTAR DATOS DE SALIDA EN LA TABLA DE SALIDAS --===================================================================== INSERT INTO TABS ( WAREHOUSE_ID, ID, NUMBER_LOT, QTY ) SELECT WT.WAREHOUSE_ID , P.ID , '', SUM(WL.QTY) AS QTY FROM WAREHOUSE_TRANS WT INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE WL ON WT.WAREHOUSE_ID=WL.WAREHOUSE_ID AND WT.DOCUMENT_ID=WL.DOCUMENT_ID AND WT.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=WL.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN PART P ON P.ID=WL.PART_ID WHERE WT.TYPE_TRANS='S' AND WT.WAREHOUSE_ID=@PNUM_ALMACEN AND WT.TRANS_ID<>'GF' AND WT.STATUS_GUIA<>'A' GROUP BY WT.WAREHOUSE_ID , P.ID ORDER BY p.ID --===================================================================== -- 3. CREAR TABLA DE RESULTADOS --===================================================================== IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM DBO.SYSOBJECTS WHERE ID = OBJECT_ID(N'[DBO].[TAB2]') AND OBJECTPROPERTY(ID, N'ISTABLE') = 1) DROP TABLE [DBO].[TAB2] CREATE TABLE TAB2 ( WAREHOUSE_ID VARCHAR(30) NULL, ID VARCHAR(30) NULL, NUMBER_LOT VARCHAR(30) NULL, QTY DECIMAL(22,9)) --===================================================================== -- INSERTAR CALCULO DE CANTIDADES INGRESO-SALIDA --===================================================================== INSERT INTO TAB2 ( WAREHOUSE_ID, ID, NUMBER_LOT, QTY ) SELECT I.WAREHOUSE_ID, I.ID, I.NUMBER_LOT, ((I.QTY)-(S.QTY)) AS QTY FROM TABI I RIGHT JOIN TABS S ON I.WAREHOUSE_ID= S.WAREHOUSE_ID AND S.ID=I.ID AND I.NUMBER_LOT=S.NUMBER_LOT --===================================================================== --ACTUALIZO LA TABLA PART_QTY CON LOS DATOS DE TAB2 (TABLA RESULTADOS) --===================================================================== UPDATE DBO.PART_QTY SET QTY_ON_HAND= T.QTY FROM TAB2 T INNER JOIN PART_QTY L ON T.WAREHOUSE_ID=L.WAREHOUSE_ID AND T.ID=L.PART_ID WHERE T.WAREHOUSE_ID=L.WAREHOUSE_ID AND T.ID=L.PART_ID --===================================================================== --INSERTO SOLO DATOS DE INGRESOS A LA TAB2 Y ACTUALIZO PART_QTY --===================================================================== DELETE FROM dbo.TAB2 INSERT INTO TAB2 ( WAREHOUSE_ID, ID, NUMBER_LOT, QTY ) SELECT I.WAREHOUSE_ID, I.ID, I.NUMBER_LOT, I.QTY FROM TABI I WHERE I.ID NOT IN (SELECT S.ID FROM dbo.TABS S)
UPDATE DBO.PART_QTY SET QTY_ON_HAND= T.QTY FROM TAB2 T INNER JOIN PART_QTY L ON T.WAREHOUSE_ID=L.WAREHOUSE_ID AND T.ID=L.PART_ID WHERE T.WAREHOUSE_ID=L.WAREHOUSE_ID AND T.ID=L.PART_ID --===================================================================== --INSERTO SOLO DATOS DE SALIDAS A LA TAB2 Y ACTUALIZO PART_QTY --===================================================================== DELETE FROM dbo.TAB2 INSERT INTO TAB2 ( WAREHOUSE_ID, ID, NUMBER_LOT, QTY ) SELECT S.WAREHOUSE_ID, S.ID, S.NUMBER_LOT, S.QTY*-1 FROM TABS S WHERE S.ID NOT IN (SELECT I.ID FROM dbo.TABI I)
UPDATE DBO.PART_QTY SET QTY_ON_HAND= T.QTY FROM TAB2 T INNER JOIN PART_QTY L ON T.WAREHOUSE_ID=L.WAREHOUSE_ID AND T.ID=L.PART_ID WHERE T.WAREHOUSE_ID=L.WAREHOUSE_ID AND T.ID=L.PART_ID
FETCH NEXT FROM RECORRE_ALMACEN INTO @PNUM_ALMACEN
END CLOSE RECORRE_ALMACEN DEALLOCATE RECORRE_ALMACEN

INTO TAB2 ( WAREHOUSE_ID, ID, NUMBER_LOT, QTY ) SELECT I.WAREHOUSE_ID, I.ID, I.NUMBER_LOT, (I.QTY-S.QTY)AS QTY FROM TABI I INNER JOIN TABS S ON I.WAREHOUSE_ID= S.WAREHOUSE_ID AND S.ID=I.ID AND NUMERIC(15,6)
DECLARE ACTUALIZA CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT PART_ID FROM LOT WHERE WHO_ID=@ALMACEN ORDER BY PART_ID OPEN ACTUALIZA FETCH NEXT FROM ACTUALIZA INTO @PARTICULO WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN
SELECT @PSUMA_ARTICULO=SUM(QTY_ON_HAND) FROM LOT WHERE WHO_ID=@ALMACEN AND PART_ID=@PARTICULO
UPDATE PART_QTY SET QTY_ON_HAND=@PSUMA_ARTICULO WHERE PART_ID=@PARTICULO AND WAREHOUSE_ID=@ALMACEN
FETCH NEXT FROM ACTUALIZA INTO @PARTICULO END CLOSE ACTUALIZA DEALLOCATE ACTUALIZA

DECLARE @NUMBER_DOCUMENT VARCHAR(15)
DECLARE JULIO CURSOR FOR
SELECT NUMBER_DOCUMENT FROM RECEIVABLE_PRUEBA WHERE STATUS<>'A' AND DOCUMENT_DATE>='01/03/2010' AND DOCUMENT_DATE<='31/03/2010' ORDER BY DOCUMENT_DATE
OPEN JULIO FETCH NEXT FROM JULIO INTO @NUMBER_DOCUMENT WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN INSERT INTO JULIO SELECT NUMBER_DOCUMENT,AMOUNT,AMOUNT_TAX FROM RECEIVABLE_PRUEBA WHERE NUMBER_DOCUMENT=@NUMBER_DOCUMENT INSERT INTO JULIO_RL SELECT NUMBER_DOCUMENT,SUM(AMOUNT)AS AMOUNT,SUM(AMOUNT_TAX)AS AMOUNT_TAX FROM RECEIVABLE_LINE_PRUEBA WHERE NUMBER_DOCUMENT=@NUMBER_DOCUMENT GROUP BY NUMBER_DOCUMENT FETCH NEXT FROM JULIO INTO @NUMBER_DOCUMENT END CLOSE JULIO DEALLOCATE JULIO

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
DECLARE @FAMILY_ID VARCHAR(30) DECLARE @ID VARCHAR(30) DECLARE @NAME VARCHAR(50)
DECLARE ACTU CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT * FROM LINES ORDER BY ID OPEN ACTU FETCH NEXT FROM ACTU INTO @FAMILY_ID,@ID,@NAME
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN UPDATE PART SET DESCRIPTION_OPT=@NAME WHERE MODEL=@ID AND FAMILY=@FAMILY_ID FETCH NEXT FROM ACTU INTO @FAMILY_ID,@ID,@NAME END CLOSE ACTU DEALLOCATE ACTU

Property.Name: HeaderContents
Property.Value: CREATE PROCEDURE ACTUALIZA_PART AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
DECLARE @NUMBER_DOCUMENT VARCHAR(15) DECLARE @ITEM VARCHAR(2) DECLARE @QTY NUMERIC(22,9) DECLARE @AMOUNT_TAX NUMERIC(22,9) DECLARE @PRICE_ORI NUMERIC(22,9) DECLARE @IGV NUMERIC(22,9) DECLARE @POSICION INT DECLARE @EXTRA_AMOUNT_TAX VARCHAR(10) DECLARE @POSICION_IGV INT DECLARE @EXTRA_IGV VARCHAR(10) DECLARE @IGV_OFICIAL NUMERIC(22,9) DECLARE ACTUALIZA CURSOR FOR
select RL.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,RL.ITEM,RL.QTY,RL.AMOUNT_TAX,RL.PRICE_ORI from receivable_LINE RL INNER JOIN RECEIVABLE R ON R.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=RL.NUMBER_DOCUMENT Where RL.STATUS <> 'A' and RL.PART_ID<>'TEXTO' AND YEAR(R.DOCUMENT_DATE)='2010' AND MONTH(R.DOCUMENT_DATE)>='03' ORDER BY R.NUMBER_DOCUMENT
OPEN ACTUALIZA FETCH NEXT FROM ACTUALIZA INTO @NUMBER_DOCUMENT,@ITEM,@QTY,@AMOUNT_TAX,@PRICE_ORI WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN SET @IGV=@QTY*@PRICE_ORI SET @POSICION=CHARINDEX('.',CONVERT(VARCHAR,@AMOUNT_TAX)) SET @EXTRA_AMOUNT_TAX=SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,@AMOUNT_TAX),1,@POSICION-1) SET @POSICION_IGV=CHARINDEX('.',CONVERT(VARCHAR,@IGV)) SET @EXTRA_IGV=SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,@IGV),1,@POSICION_IGV-1)
IF @EXTRA_AMOUNT_TAX=@EXTRA_IGV BEGIN SET @IGV_OFICIAL=@AMOUNT_TAX*0.19 UPDATE RECEIVABLE_LINE SET AMOUNT_TAX=@IGV_OFICIAL WHERE NUMBER_DOCUMENT=@NUMBER_DOCUMENT AND ITEM=@ITEM END FETCH NEXT FROM ACTUALIZA INTO @NUMBER_DOCUMENT,@ITEM,@QTY,@AMOUNT_TAX,@PRICE_ORI END CLOSE ACTUALIZA DEALLOCATE ACTUALIZA

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
DECLARE @NUMBER_DOCUMENT VARCHAR(15) DECLARE @AMOUNT_TAX NUMERIC(22,9) DECLARE @IGV NUMERIC(22,9) DECLARE @CONTADOR INT SET @CONTADOR=0 DECLARE @INDICE INT DECLARE @INDICEDOS INT DECLARE @EXTRA_UNO VARCHAR(15) DECLARE @EXTRA_DOS VARCHAR(15)
DECLARE ACTUALIZADOR CURSOR FOR
SELECT NUMBER_DOCUMENT,AMOUNT_TAX FROM RECEIVABLE WHERE YEAR(DOCUMENT_DATE)='2010' AND MONTH(DOCUMENT_DATE)>='03' AND STATUS<>'A' ORDER BY NUMBER_DOCUMENT
OPEN ACTUALIZADOR FETCH NEXT FROM ACTUALIZADOR INTO @NUMBER_DOCUMENT,@AMOUNT_TAX WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN SELECT @IGV=ROUND(SUM(AMOUNT_TAX),2) FROM RECEIVABLE_LINE WHERE NUMBER_DOCUMENT=@NUMBER_DOCUMENT
SET @INDICE=CHARINDEX('.',CONVERT(VARCHAR,@IGV)) SET @INDICEDOS=CHARINDEX('.',CONVERT(VARCHAR,@AMOUNT_TAX)) SET @EXTRA_UNO=SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,@IGV),1,@INDICE-1) SET @EXTRA_DOS=SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,@AMOUNT_TAX),1,@INDICEDOS-1)
IF @EXTRA_UNO<>@EXTRA_DOS BEGIN PRINT @NUMBER_DOCUMENT END FETCH NEXT FROM ACTUALIZADOR INTO @NUMBER_DOCUMENT,@AMOUNT_TAX END CLOSE ACTUALIZADOR DEALLOCATE ACTUALIZADOR

Property.Name: HeaderContents
CheckExpressionScript
Property.Value: [IS_STATUS] = 0 or [IS_STATUS] = 1

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value: EXEC('SELECT DISTINCT DOCUMENT_TYPE_ID AS TIP_DOC, DOCUMENT_SERIE AS SERIE, DOCUMENT_NUMBER AS NUMERO, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),C.DOCUMENT_DATE,103)AS FECHA_DOC, CONVERT(NUMERIC(22,3),(ISNULL(A.AMOUNT_CR,0)-(ISNULL(A.AMOUNT_CR,0)*L.TAX_PERCENT/100))) AS MONTO, CONVERT(NUMERIC(22,3),ISNULL(L.COMISION,0)) AS PCTJ_COMISION, CONVERT(NUMERIC(22,3),(((ISNULL(A.AMOUNT_CR,0)-(ISNULL(A.AMOUNT_CR,0)*L.TAX_PERCENT/100))* ISNULL(L.COMISION,0))/100)) AS MONT_COMISION, C.SALES_REP_ID, S.NAME, C.CUSTOMER_NAME AS ADICIONAL, ISNULL(A.AMOUNT_CR,0) AS ADICIONAL1 FROM ACTIVITY_LINE A INNER JOIN '+@TABLA+'.dbo.RECEIVABLE C ON A.DOCUMENT_TYPE_ID=DOCUMENT_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_SERIE=NUMBER_SERIE AND A.DOCUMENT_NUMBER=NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN '+@TABLA+'.dbo.RECEIVABLE_LINE L ON C.DOCUMENT_ID=L.DOCUMENT_ID AND C.NUMBER_SERIE=L.NUMBER_SERIE AND C.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=L.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN '+@TABLA+'.dbo.SALES_REP S ON S.ID=C.SALES_REP_ID WHERE A.CURRENCY_DOCUMENT=''1'' AND A.OPE_TYPE_DESCRIPTION=''Ingreso'' AND C.DOCUMENT_DATE BETWEEN '''+@FECINI+''' AND '''+@FECFIN +''' AND C.SALES_REP_ID='''+@SALES_REP_ID+''' ')

SELECT AD_IDCAB,AD_SECUENCIA,AD_CUENTA,AD_TANEXO,AD_IDANEXO,AD_TDOC,AD_SDOC,AD_NDOC, CONVERT (CHAR(10), AD_FDOC, 103) AS 'AD_FDOC', CONVERT (CHAR(10), AD_VDOC, 103) AS 'AD_VDOC', AD_DEBE,AD_HABER,AD_TCAM,AD_SEC_ORI_DES,AD_IDCC,AD_ES_DESTINO,AD_IDMEDIOPAGO,AD_MONTO_ORI,AD_PORCE_DESTINO, AD_ES_CONCI,AD_ANHO_CONI,AD_MES_CONCI,AD_ES_INAFECTO,AD_IDMONEDA,AD_TDOC_REF,AD_SDOC_REF,AD_NDOC_REF, CONVERT (CHAR(10), AD_FDOC_REF, 103) AS 'AD_FDOC_REF', CONVERT (CHAR(10), AD_VDOC_REF, 103) AS 'AD_VDOC_REF', B.PC_DES_CTA ,AD_GLOSA FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET A INNER JOIN CO_TB_PLANCTAS B ON A.AD_CUENTA = B.PC_NUM_CTA WHERE AD_IDCAB = @P_ID AND B.PC_PERIODO = @P_ANHO ORDER BY AD_SECUENCIA

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
IF @P_MES = 1 BEGIN
DECLARE @PSUBDIARIO_APE VARCHAR(2) set @PSUBDIARIO_APE =(SELECT SD_ID FROM CO_TB_SUBDIARIO SCTS WHERE SD_ES_APER = 1 AND SD_ISTATUS = 1)
INSERT INTO CO_TB_TMP_SALDO_CUENTA(SC_IDCUENTA,SC_SALDO_D,SC_SALDO_H,SC_PC) SELECT @P_IDCUENTA,
ISNULL(SUM( (case when AD_DEBE > 0 then (case when @P_MONEDA = 1 then AD_DEBE else --(case when AD_TCAM = 0 then AD_DEBE / TC_VENTA else AD_MONTO_ORI end) AD_MONTO_ORI end) else 0 end)),0),
ISNULL(SUM( (case when AD_haber > 0 then (case when @P_MONEDA = 1 then AD_HABER else --(case when AD_TCAM = 0 then AD_HABER / TC_VENTA else AD_MONTO_ORI end) AD_MONTO_ORI end) else 0 end)),0),@P_PC
FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB a INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET b ON a.AC_ID = b.AD_IDCAB INNER JOIN (select * from CO_TB_PLANCTAS where pc_periodo = @P_ANHO) AS p ON b.AD_CUENTA = p.PC_NUM_CTA WHERE AC_ANHO = @P_ANHO AND AC_MES = @P_MES AND AD_CUENTA = @P_IDCUENTA AND AC_IDSUBDIARIO = @PSUBDIARIO_APE AND AC_ESTADO = 1
END ELSE BEGIN
INSERT INTO CO_TB_TMP_SALDO_CUENTA(SC_IDCUENTA,SC_SALDO_D,SC_SALDO_H,SC_PC) SELECT @P_IDCUENTA,
ISNULL(SUM( (case when AD_DEBE > 0 then (case when @P_MONEDA = 1 then AD_DEBE else AD_MONTO_ORI end) else 0 end)),0),
ISNULL(SUM( (case when AD_haber > 0 then (case when @P_MONEDA = 1 then AD_HABER else AD_MONTO_ORI end) else 0 end)),0),
@P_PC FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB SCTAC INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET SCTAD ON SCTAD.AD_IDCAB = SCTAC.AC_ID INNER JOIN (select * from CO_TB_PLANCTAS where pc_periodo = @P_ANHO ) AS A ON SCTAD.AD_CUENTA = A.PC_NUM_CTA --LEFT JOIN (select * from SG_CO_TB_TIPOCAMBIO where TC_IDEMPRESA = @P_IDEMPRESA ) tc on SCTAC.AC_FEC_VOUCHER = tc.TC_FECHA WHERE SCTAC.AC_ANHO = @P_ANHO AND SCTAC.AC_MES < @P_MES AND SCTAD.AD_CUENTA = @P_IDCUENTA and ac_estado = 1
END

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
IF @P_PENDIENTES = 1 BEGIN
if @P_ANEXO1 = '' begin
SELECT AD_CUENTA,AD_IDANEXO,'' as 'AN_DESCRIPCION',AD_TDOC,left(NAME,4) as 'DO_DESCRIPCION',AD_SDOC,AD_NDOC,AC_FEC_VOUCHER,AC_IDSUBDIARIO,AC_GLOSA_VOU, (CASE WHEN AD_IDMONEDA = 2 THEN AD_MONTO_ORI ELSE 0 END) as 'DOLARES', AD_DEBE,AD_HABER,0 AS 'SALDO',AC_NUM_VOUCHER ,'' as 'AN_NUM_DOC' FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB A INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET B ON A.AC_ID = B.AD_IDCAB left join (SELECT TYPE_ID,NAME FROM DOCUMENT_TYPE ) c on b.AD_TDOC = c.TYPE_ID
WHERE A.AC_ANHO = @P_ANHO AND a.AC_FEC_VOUCHER >= @P_FECHA1 AND a.AC_FEC_VOUCHER <= @P_FECHA2 AND b.AD_CUENTA >= @P_CUENTA1 AND b.AD_CUENTA <= @P_CUENTA2 AND AD_IDANEXO +isnull(AD_TDOC,'')+isnull(AD_SDOC,'')+isnull(AD_NDOC,'') IN
(/**/ SELECT AD_IDANEXO +isnull(AD_TDOC,'')+isnull(AD_SDOC,'')+isnull(AD_NDOC,'') FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET A INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB B ON A.AD_IDCAB = B.AC_ID WHERE AC_ANHO = @P_ANHO AND A.AD_CUENTA >= @P_CUENTA1 AND A.AD_CUENTA <= @P_CUENTA2 GROUP BY AD_IDANEXO,isnull(AD_TDOC,''),AD_SDOC,AD_NDOC HAVING SUM(AD_DEBE)-SUM(AD_HABER) <> 0 ) ORDER BY AD_IDANEXO,isnull(AD_TDOC,''),AD_SDOC,AD_NDOC,AC_FEC_VOUCHER
end else begin --@P_ANEXO1
SELECT AD_CUENTA,AD_IDANEXO,'' as 'AN_DESCRIPCION',AD_TDOC,left(NAME,4) as DO_DESCRIPCION,AD_SDOC,AD_NDOC,AC_FEC_VOUCHER,AC_IDSUBDIARIO,AC_GLOSA_VOU, (CASE WHEN AD_IDMONEDA = 2 THEN AD_MONTO_ORI ELSE 0 END)DOLARES, AD_DEBE,AD_HABER,0 AS SALDO,AC_NUM_VOUCHER ,'' as 'AN_NUM_DOC' FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB A INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET B ON A.AC_ID = B.AD_IDCAB left join (SELECT TYPE_ID,NAME FROM DOCUMENT_TYPE) c on b.AD_TDOC = c.TYPE_ID --inner join sg_co_tb_anexo d on b.AD_IDANEXO = d.AN_IDANEXO WHERE A.AC_ANHO = @P_ANHO AND a.AC_FEC_VOUCHER >= @P_FECHA1 AND a.AC_FEC_VOUCHER <= @P_FECHA2 AND b.AD_CUENTA >= @P_CUENTA1 AND b.AD_CUENTA <= @P_CUENTA2 AND AD_IDANEXO +isnull(AD_TDOC,'')+isnull(AD_SDOC,'')+isnull(AD_NDOC,'') IN ( SELECT AD_IDANEXO +isnull(AD_TDOC,'')+isnull(AD_SDOC,'')+isnull(AD_NDOC,'') FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET A INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB B ON A.AD_IDCAB = B.AC_ID WHERE AC_ANHO = @P_ANHO AND AD_IDANEXO BETWEEN @P_ANEXO1 AND @P_ANEXO2 AND A.AD_CUENTA >= @P_CUENTA1 AND A.AD_CUENTA <= @P_CUENTA2 GROUP BY AD_IDANEXO,isnull(AD_TDOC,''),AD_SDOC,AD_NDOC HAVING SUM(AD_DEBE)-SUM(AD_HABER) <> 0 ) ORDER BY AD_IDANEXO,isnull(AD_TDOC,''),AD_SDOC,AD_NDOC,AC_FEC_VOUCHER
end END ELSE BEGIN --@P_PENDIENTES
if @P_ANEXO1 = '' begin
SELECT AD_CUENTA,AD_IDANEXO,'' as 'AN_DESCRIPCION',AD_TDOC,left(NAME,4)as DO_DESCRIPCION,AD_SDOC,AD_NDOC,AC_FEC_VOUCHER,AC_IDSUBDIARIO,AC_GLOSA_VOU, (CASE WHEN AD_IDMONEDA = 2 THEN AD_MONTO_ORI ELSE 0 END)DOLARES, AD_DEBE,AD_HABER,0 AS SALDO,AC_NUM_VOUCHER ,'' as 'AN_NUM_DOC' FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB A INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET B ON A.AC_ID = B.AD_IDCAB left join (SELECT TYPE_ID,NAME FROM DOCUMENT_TYPE) c on b.AD_TDOC = c.TYPE_ID --inner join sg_co_tb_anexo d on b.AD_IDANEXO = d.AN_IDANEXO WHERE A.AC_ANHO = @P_ANHO AND B.AD_CUENTA >= @P_CUENTA1 AND B.AD_CUENTA <= @P_CUENTA2 AND AD_IDANEXO+isnull(AD_TDOC,'')+isnull(AD_SDOC,'')+isnull(AD_NDOC,'') IN ( SELECT AD_IDANEXO +isnull(AD_TDOC,'')+isnull(AD_SDOC,'')+isnull(AD_NDOC,'') FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET A INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB B ON A.AD_IDCAB = B.AC_ID WHERE AC_ANHO = @P_ANHO AND A.AD_CUENTA >= @P_CUENTA1 AND A.AD_CUENTA <= @P_CUENTA2 AND B.AC_FEC_VOUCHER >= @P_FECHA1 AND B.AC_FEC_VOUCHER <= @P_FECHA2 GROUP BY AD_IDANEXO,isnull(AD_TDOC,''),AD_SDOC,AD_NDOC
) ORDER BY AD_IDANEXO,isnull(AD_TDOC,''),AD_SDOC,AD_NDOC,AC_FEC_VOUCHER
end else begin
SELECT AD_CUENTA,AD_IDANEXO,'' as 'AN_DESCRIPCION',AD_TDOC,left(NAME,4)as DO_DESCRIPCION,AD_SDOC,AD_NDOC,AC_FEC_VOUCHER,AC_IDSUBDIARIO,AC_GLOSA_VOU, (CASE WHEN AD_IDMONEDA = 2 THEN AD_MONTO_ORI ELSE 0 END)DOLARES, AD_DEBE,AD_HABER,0 AS SALDO,AC_NUM_VOUCHER ,'' as 'AN_NUM_DOC' FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB A INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET B ON A.AC_ID = B.AD_IDCAB left join (SELECT TYPE_ID,NAME FROM DOCUMENT_TYPE) c on b.AD_TDOC = c.TYPE_ID --inner join sg_co_tb_anexo d on b.AD_IDANEXO = d.AN_IDANEXO WHERE A.AC_ANHO = @P_ANHO AND b.AD_CUENTA >= @P_CUENTA1 AND b.AD_CUENTA <= @P_CUENTA2
AND AD_IDANEXO +isnull(AD_TDOC,'')+isnull(AD_SDOC,'')+isnull(AD_NDOC,'') IN ( SELECT AD_IDANEXO +isnull(AD_TDOC,'')+isnull(AD_SDOC,'')+isnull(AD_NDOC,'') FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET A INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB B ON A.AD_IDCAB = B.AC_ID WHERE AD_IDANEXO BETWEEN @P_ANEXO1 AND @P_ANEXO2 AND A.AD_CUENTA >= @P_CUENTA1 AND A.AD_CUENTA <= @P_CUENTA2 and AC_ANHO = @P_ANHO AND B.AC_FEC_VOUCHER >= @P_FECHA1 AND B.AC_FEC_VOUCHER <= @P_FECHA2 GROUP BY AD_IDANEXO,isnull(AD_TDOC,''),AD_SDOC,AD_NDOC --HAVING SUM(AD_DEBE)-SUM(AD_HABER) <> 0 ) ORDER BY AD_IDANEXO,isnull(AD_TDOC,''),AD_SDOC,AD_NDOC,AC_FEC_VOUCHER
end END

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
declare @num_dig_cta int set @num_dig_cta = 8
IF @ACUMULADO = 1 BEGIN
IF @CON_CTAS_TIT = 0 BEGIN
SELECT C.PC_NUM_CTA AS CUENTA,C.PC_DES_CTA AS DESCRIPCION, R.DEBE,R.HABER,R.SALDO_DEUDOR,R.SALDO_ACREEDOR FROM CO_TB_PLANCTAS C INNER JOIN ( SELECT
LEFT(AD_CUENTA,@num_dig_cta) AS 'AD_CUENTA',SUM(AD_DEBE)AS DEBE,SUM(AD_HABER) AS HABER, (CASE WHEN SUM(AD_DEBE) - SUM(AD_HABER) > 0 THEN ABS(SUM(AD_DEBE) - SUM(AD_HABER)) ELSE 0 END) AS SALDO_DEUDOR, (CASE WHEN SUM(AD_DEBE) - SUM(AD_HABER) < 0 THEN ABS(SUM(AD_DEBE) - SUM(AD_HABER)) ELSE 0 END) AS SALDO_ACREEDOR
FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB A INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET B ON A.AC_ID=B.AD_IDCAB WHERE AC_ANHO = @PANHO AND AC_MES <= @PMES GROUP BY LEFT(AD_CUENTA,@num_dig_cta) ) R ON left(C.PC_NUM_CTA,@num_dig_cta) = left(R.AD_CUENTA,@num_dig_cta) WHERE C.PC_PERIODO = @PANHO ORDER BY CUENTA
END ELSE BEGIN --DE DIGITOS ___________________________
SELECT C.PC_NUM_CTA AS CUENTA,C.PC_DES_CTA AS DESCRIPCION, R.DEBE,R.HABER,R.SALDO_DEUDOR,R.SALDO_ACREEDOR FROM CO_TB_PLANCTAS C INNER JOIN ( SELECT
LEFT(AD_CUENTA,@num_dig_cta) AS 'AD_CUENTA',SUM(AD_DEBE)AS DEBE,SUM(AD_HABER) AS HABER, (CASE WHEN SUM(AD_DEBE) - SUM(AD_HABER) > 0 THEN ABS(SUM(AD_DEBE) - SUM(AD_HABER)) ELSE 0 END) AS SALDO_DEUDOR, (CASE WHEN SUM(AD_DEBE) - SUM(AD_HABER) < 0 THEN ABS(SUM(AD_DEBE) - SUM(AD_HABER)) ELSE 0 END) AS SALDO_ACREEDOR
FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB A INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET B ON A.AC_ID=B.AD_IDCAB WHERE AC_ANHO = @PANHO AND AC_MES <= @PMES
GROUP BY LEFT(AD_CUENTA,@num_dig_cta) ) R ON left(C.PC_NUM_CTA,@num_dig_cta) = left(R.AD_CUENTA,@num_dig_cta) WHERE C.PC_PERIODO = @PANHO UNION SELECT C.PC_NUM_CTA AS CUENTA,C.PC_DES_CTA AS DESCRIPCION, R.DEBE,R.HABER,R.SALDO_DEUDOR,R.SALDO_ACREEDOR FROM CO_TB_PLANCTAS C INNER JOIN ( SELECT LEFT(AD_CUENTA,@DIGITOS) AS 'AD_CUENTA',SUM(AD_DEBE)AS DEBE,SUM(AD_HABER) AS HABER, (CASE WHEN SUM(AD_DEBE) - SUM(AD_HABER) > 0 THEN ABS(SUM(AD_DEBE) - SUM(AD_HABER)) ELSE 0 END) AS SALDO_DEUDOR, (CASE WHEN SUM(AD_DEBE) - SUM(AD_HABER) < 0 THEN ABS(SUM(AD_DEBE) - SUM(AD_HABER)) ELSE 0 END) AS SALDO_ACREEDOR FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB A INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET B ON A.AC_ID=B.AD_IDCAB WHERE AC_ANHO = @PANHO AND AC_MES <= @PMES GROUP BY LEFT(AD_CUENTA,@DIGITOS) ) R ON C.PC_NUM_CTA = R.AD_CUENTA WHERE C.PC_PERIODO = @PANHO ORDER BY CUENTA END
END --DE @ACUMULADO
IF @ACUMULADO = 0 BEGIN --PRINT @ACUMULADO IF @CON_CTAS_TIT = 0 BEGIN
SELECT C.PC_NUM_CTA AS CUENTA,C.PC_DES_CTA AS DESCRIPCION, R.DEBE,R.HABER,R.SALDO_DEUDOR,R.SALDO_ACREEDOR FROM CO_TB_PLANCTAS C INNER JOIN ( SELECT LEFT(AD_CUENTA,@num_dig_cta) AS 'AD_CUENTA',SUM(AD_DEBE)AS DEBE,SUM(AD_HABER) AS HABER, (CASE WHEN SUM(AD_DEBE) - SUM(AD_HABER) > 0 THEN ABS(SUM(AD_DEBE) - SUM(AD_HABER)) ELSE 0 END) AS SALDO_DEUDOR, (CASE WHEN SUM(AD_DEBE) - SUM(AD_HABER) < 0 THEN ABS(SUM(AD_DEBE) - SUM(AD_HABER)) ELSE 0 END) AS SALDO_ACREEDOR FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB A INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET B ON A.AC_ID = B.AD_IDCAB WHERE AC_ANHO = @PANHO AND AC_MES = @PMES
GROUP BY LEFT(AD_CUENTA,@num_dig_cta) ) R ON left(C.PC_NUM_CTA,@num_dig_cta) = left(R.AD_CUENTA,@num_dig_cta) WHERE C.PC_PERIODO = @PANHO ORDER BY CUENTA
END ELSE BEGIN
SELECT C.PC_NUM_CTA AS CUENTA,C.PC_DES_CTA AS DESCRIPCION, R.DEBE,R.HABER,R.SALDO_DEUDOR,R.SALDO_ACREEDOR FROM CO_TB_PLANCTAS C INNER JOIN ( SELECT LEFT(AD_CUENTA,@num_dig_cta) AS 'AD_CUENTA',SUM(AD_DEBE)AS DEBE,SUM(AD_HABER) AS HABER, (CASE WHEN SUM(AD_DEBE) - SUM(AD_HABER) > 0 THEN ABS(SUM(AD_DEBE) - SUM(AD_HABER)) ELSE 0 END) AS SALDO_DEUDOR, (CASE WHEN SUM(AD_DEBE) - SUM(AD_HABER) < 0 THEN ABS(SUM(AD_DEBE) - SUM(AD_HABER)) ELSE 0 END) AS SALDO_ACREEDOR FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB A INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET B ON A.AC_ID=B.AD_IDCAB WHERE AC_ANHO = @PANHO AND AC_MES = @PMES GROUP BY LEFT(AD_CUENTA,@num_dig_cta) ) R ON left(C.PC_NUM_CTA,@num_dig_cta) = left(R.AD_CUENTA,@num_dig_cta) WHERE C.PC_PERIODO = @PANHO UNION SELECT C.PC_NUM_CTA AS CUENTA,C.PC_DES_CTA AS DESCRIPCION, R.DEBE,R.HABER,R.SALDO_DEUDOR,R.SALDO_ACREEDOR FROM CO_TB_PLANCTAS C INNER JOIN (SELECT LEFT(AD_CUENTA,@DIGITOS) AS 'AD_CUENTA',SUM(AD_DEBE)AS DEBE,SUM(AD_HABER) AS HABER, (CASE WHEN SUM(AD_DEBE) - SUM(AD_HABER) > 0 THEN ABS(SUM(AD_DEBE) - SUM(AD_HABER)) ELSE 0 END) AS SALDO_DEUDOR, (CASE WHEN SUM(AD_DEBE) - SUM(AD_HABER) < 0 THEN ABS(SUM(AD_DEBE) - SUM(AD_HABER)) ELSE 0 END) AS SALDO_ACREEDOR FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB A INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET B ON A.AC_ID=B.AD_IDCAB WHERE AC_ANHO = @PANHO AND AC_MES = @PMES GROUP BY LEFT(AD_CUENTA,@DIGITOS) ) R ON C.PC_NUM_CTA = R.AD_CUENTA WHERE C.PC_PERIODO = @PANHO ORDER BY CUENTA
END END

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
--BUSCAMOS EL SUBDIARIO DE APERTURA DECLARE @PSUBDIARIO_APE VARCHAR(2) set @PSUBDIARIO_APE= (SELECT SD_ID FROM CO_TB_SUBDIARIO WHERE SD_ES_APER = 1 AND SD_ISTATUS = 1)
SELECT AC_IDSUBDIARIO+'-'+ cast(AC_NUM_VOUCHER as varchar(5)) as 'AC_NUM_VOUCHER', SCTAC.AC_FEC_VOUCHER, SCTAD.AD_IDMEDIOPAGO, SCTAC.AC_GLOSA_VOU, SCTAD.AD_NDOC, '' AS RAZON,
(case when SCTAD.AD_DEBE > 0 then (case when @P_MONEDA = 1 then SCTAD.AD_DEBE else --(case when SCTAD.AD_TCAM = 0 then AD_DEBE / TC_VENTA else AD_MONTO_ORI end) AD_MONTO_ORI end) else 0 end)as 'AD_DEBE',
(case when SCTAD.AD_haber > 0 then (case when @P_MONEDA = 1 then SCTAD.AD_HABER else --(case when SCTAD.AD_TCAM = 0 then AD_HABER / TC_VENTA else AD_MONTO_ORI end) AD_MONTO_ORI end) else 0 end) as 'AD_HABER',
SCTTSC.SC_SALDO_D, SCTTSC.SC_SALDO_H,
ban.name as 'BA_NOMBRE', SCTAD.AD_CUENTA, ban.ACCOUNT_BANK_ID , ban.ACCOUNT_BANK_DES
FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB SCTAC INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET SCTAD ON SCTAD.AD_IDCAB = SCTAC.AC_ID INNER JOIN (select PC_NUM_CTA,PC_DES_CTA from CO_TB_PLANCTAS where pc_periodo = @P_ANHO ) AS A ON SCTAD.AD_CUENTA = A.PC_NUM_CTA INNER JOIN CO_TB_TMP_SALDO_CUENTA SCTTSC ON SCTAD.AD_CUENTA = SCTTSC.SC_IDCUENTA INNER JOIN (SELECT A.*,B.* FROM BANK A inner join account_bank b on a.ID = b.bank_id ) ban on SCTAD.AD_CUENTA = ban.number_account --INNER JOIN SG_CO_TB_BANCO SCTB ON SCTB.BA_ID = SCTBC.BC_IDBANCO --INNER JOIN SG_CO_TB_BANCO_CTACTE SCTBC ON SCTAD.AD_CUENTA = SCTBC.BC_NUM_CTA_CONTA --LEFT JOIN (select * from SG_CO_TB_TIPOCAMBIO where TC_IDEMPRESA = 1 ) tc on SCTAC.AC_FEC_VOUCHER = tc.TC_FECHA WHERE SCTAC.AC_ANHO = @P_ANHO AND SCTAC.AC_MES = @P_MES AND SCTTSC.SC_PC = @P_PC AND SCTAD.AD_CUENTA IN ( SELECT CODIGO FROM CO_TB_CODIGOS_TMP WHERE PC = @P_PC) AND SCTAC.AC_IDSUBDIARIO <> (CASE WHEN @P_MES = 1 THEN @PSUBDIARIO_APE ELSE '' END) AND SCTAC.AC_IDSUBDIARIO <> (CASE WHEN @P_MONEDA = 2 THEN '17' ELSE '' END)

DECLARE @IMPOR NUMERIC(20,2) DECLARE @NOM_CLASE VARCHAR(100) DECLARE @NOM_GRUPO VARCHAR(100) DECLARE @NOM_CUENTA VARCHAR(100) DECLARE @TIT_MOV VARCHAR(100)
IF @PMENSUAL = 1 BEGIN
SELECT @IMPOR =(CASE WHEN @PIDCLASE BETWEEN 1 AND 1 THEN SUM(B.AD_DEBE)-SUM(B.AD_HABER) ELSE SUM(B.AD_HABER)-SUM(B.AD_DEBE) END) FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB A INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET B ON A.AC_ID = B.AD_IDCAB WHERE A.AC_ANHO = @PANHO AND AC_MES = @PMES AND LEFT(AD_CUENTA,LEN(@PCUENTA))= @PCUENTA GROUP BY LEFT(AD_CUENTA,LEN(@PCUENTA))
END ELSE BEGIN
SELECT @IMPOR =(CASE WHEN @PIDCLASE BETWEEN 1 AND 1 THEN SUM(B.AD_DEBE)-SUM(B.AD_HABER) ELSE SUM(B.AD_HABER)-SUM(B.AD_DEBE) END) FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB A INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET B ON A.AC_ID = B.AD_IDCAB WHERE A.AC_ANHO = @PANHO AND AC_MES <= @PMES AND LEFT(AD_CUENTA,LEN(@PCUENTA))= @PCUENTA GROUP BY LEFT(AD_CUENTA,LEN(@PCUENTA))
END
SET @NOM_CLASE = (SELECT CBG_DESCRIPCION FROM CO_TB_CLASES_BG WHERE CBG_ID = @PIDCLASE) SET @NOM_GRUPO = (SELECT GBG_DESCRIPCION FROM CO_TB_GRUPOS_BG WHERE GBG_ID = @PIDGRUPO) SET @NOM_CUENTA = (SELECT PC_DES_CTA FROM CO_TB_PLANCTAS WHERE PC_NUM_CTA = @PCUENTA AND PC_PERIODO = @PANHO)
IF @PIDCLASE = 1 BEGIN SET @TIT_MOV = 'TOTAL DEL ACTIVO' END IF @PIDCLASE = 2 BEGIN SET @TIT_MOV = 'TOTAL DEL PASIVO' END IF @PIDCLASE = 3 BEGIN SET @TIT_MOV = 'TOTAL DEL PATRIMONIO' END
INSERT INTO CO_TB_REP_BG10(RB_IDAREA,RB_NOAREA,RB_IDMOD,RB_NOMOD,RB_NUCUENTA,RB_NOCUENTA,RB_IMPORTE,RB_TIT_MOV) VALUES(@PIDCLASE,@NOM_CLASE,@PIDGRUPO,@NOM_GRUPO, @PCUENTA,@NOM_CUENTA,ISNULL(@IMPOR,0),@TIT_MOV)

WHERE AC_ANHO = @P_PERIODO --AND AC_IDEMPRESA = @P_EMPRESA AND AC_ESTADO = 1 AND C.TYPE = 1 AND AD_CUENTA LIKE '12%' GROUP BY AD_CUENTA,C.BUSINESS,C.VAT_REGISTRATION,C.NAME HAVING SUM(AD_DEBE) <> SUM(AD_HABER) ORDER BY 1

--BUSCAMOS EL SUBDIARIO DE APERTURA DECLARE @PSUBDIARIO_APE VARCHAR(2) set @PSUBDIARIO_APE= (SELECT SD_ID FROM CO_TB_SUBDIARIO WHERE SD_ES_APER = 1 AND SD_ISTATUS = 1)
SELECT AC_IDSUBDIARIO+'-'+ cast(AC_NUM_VOUCHER as varchar(5)) as 'AC_NUM_VOUCHER', AC_FEC_VOUCHER, AC_GLOSA_VOU, (case when @P_MONEDA = 1 then AD_DEBE else (case when AD_TCAM = 0 then AD_DEBE / AD_TCAM else AD_MONTO_ORI end) end) as 'AD_DEBE',
(case when @P_MONEDA = 1 then b.AD_HABER else (case when b.AD_TCAM = 0 then AD_HABER / AD_TCAM else AD_MONTO_ORI end) end) as 'AD_HABER',
SCTTSC.SC_SALDO_D, SCTTSC.SC_SALDO_H, AD_CUENTA, PC_DES_CTA FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB a INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET b ON b.AD_IDCAB = a.AC_ID INNER JOIN CO_TB_PLANCTAS c ON b.AD_CUENTA = c.PC_NUM_CTA INNER JOIN CO_TB_TMP_SALDO_CUENTA SCTTSC ON b.AD_CUENTA = SCTTSC.SC_IDCUENTA --LEFT JOIN (select * from SG_CO_TB_TIPOCAMBIO where TC_IDEMPRESA = 1 ) tc on a.AC_FEC_VOUCHER = tc.TC_FECHA
WHERE a.AC_ANHO = @P_ANHO AND a.AC_MES = @P_MES AND SCTTSC.SC_PC = @P_PC AND b.AD_CUENTA IN ( SELECT CODIGO FROM CO_TB_CODIGOS_TMP WHERE PC = @P_PC) AND a.AC_IDSUBDIARIO <> (CASE WHEN @P_MES = 1 THEN @PSUBDIARIO_APE ELSE '' END)

CREATE PROC [dbo].[CO_SP_S_CLASES_BG]
AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value: SELECT VENDOR_ID,REFER_DOCUMENT_TYPE,SERIE,REFER_DOCUMENT_NUMBER,DOCUMENT_DATE,EXPIRATION_DATE, (CASE WHEN CURRENCY_TYPE = 'MN' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END) AS 'CURRENCY_TYPE', AMOUNT,AMOUNT_TAX,AMOUNT_SALES ,SELL_RATE,NAME_FACT,a.ID , ISNULL(ACCOUNT_LOCAL,'') AS 'CTA42_SOLES' , ISNULL(ACCOUNT_EXTERNAL,'') AS 'CTA42_DOLAR' FROM PURCHASE_FACT_SUPPLIER a inner join vendor b on a.VENDOR_ID = b.id WHERE YEAR(DOCUMENT_DATE)= @P_AYO AND MONTH(DOCUMENT_DATE)= @P_MES ORDER BY DOCUMENT_DATE,REFER_DOCUMENT_NUMBER

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
SELECT DOCUMENT_ID,NUMBER_SERIE,NUMBER_DOCUMENT,DOCUMENT_DATE,CADUCATE_DATE,CUSTOMER_ID, ABS(AMOUNT) AS 'AMOUNT',SELL_RATE, (CASE WHEN CURRENCY_ID='MN' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END) AS 'CURRENCY_ID', A.COMMENT,ABS(AMOUNT_TAX) AS 'AMOUNT_TAX', A.STATUS,CUSTOMER_NAME ,CAST(0 AS BIT ) AS 'CONTA', ISNULL(ACCOUNT_LOCAL,'') AS 'CTA12_SOLES' , ISNULL(ACCOUNT_EXTERNAL,'') AS 'CTA12_DOLAR' ,isnull(ISC,0) as 'ISC'
FROM RECEIVABLE A INNER JOIN CUSTOMER B ON A.CUSTOMER_ID = B.ID WHERE YEAR(DOCUMENT_DATE)= @P_AYO AND MONTH(DOCUMENT_DATE)= @P_MES ORDER BY DOCUMENT_DATE,NUMBER_DOCUMENT

Property.Name: HeaderContents
Property.Value: CREATE PROC [dbo].[CO_SP_S_CTA_IGV] AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value: SELECT ISNULL(AD_CUENTA,'') AS 'RESULTADO' FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB A INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET B ON A.AC_ID = B.AD_IDCAB WHERE AD_TDOC = @P_TD AND AD_SDOC = @P_SD AND AD_NDOC = @P_ND AND AD_IDANEXO = @P_RUC AND AC_IDSUBDIARIO = @P_SUBDIARIO

Property.Name: DefaultExpressionScript
Property.Value: 'FT'

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value: SELECT PC_NUM_CTA FROM CO_TB_PLANCTAS WHERE PC_NUM_CTA LIKE '10%' AND PC_IDTIPO_MOV = 2 AND PC_PERIODO = @P_PERIODO

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value: SELECT PC_NUM_CTA,PC_DES_CTA FROM CO_TB_PLANCTAS WHERE PC_IDMONEDA = 2 AND PC_ES_CTA = 1 AND PC_PERIODO = @P_AYO

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
IF @P_TIPO = 1 BEGIN --COMPRAS
SELECT AD_IDANEXO,'DESCRIP PROVEEDOR' AS 'AN_DESCRIPCION',AD_TDOC,AD_SDOC,AD_NDOC,AD_FDOC, AC_IDSUBDIARIO +'-'+RIGHT('00'+ CAST(AC_MES AS VARCHAR(2)),2)+ '-'+CAST(AC_NUM_VOUCHER AS VARCHAR(10))AS 'AC_NUM_VOUCHER' , ROUND(((AD_DEBE + AD_HABER)/1.18),2) * (case when AD_TDOC = 'NC' then -1 else 1 end) AS 'BASE', ROUND((AD_DEBE + AD_HABER) - (((AD_DEBE + AD_HABER)/1.18)),2) * (case when AD_TDOC = 'NC' then -1 else 1 end) AS 'IGV', (AD_DEBE + AD_HABER) * (case when AD_TDOC = 'NC' then -1 else 1 end) AS 'TOTAL' FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB A INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET B ON A.AC_ID = B.AD_IDCAB WHERE AD_TANEXO = 2 AND AC_ANHO = @P_ANHO AND AC_IDSUBDIARIO = '01' AND AD_IDANEXO IN ( SELECT AD_IDANEXO FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB A INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET B ON A.AC_ID = B.AD_IDCAB WHERE AD_TANEXO = 2 AND AC_ANHO = @P_ANHO AND AC_IDSUBDIARIO = '01' GROUP BY AD_IDANEXO HAVING SUM(ROUND(((AD_HABER - AD_DEBE )/1.18),2)) > @P_TOPE )
END ELSE BEGIN
SELECT AD_IDANEXO,'DESCRIP CLIENTE' AS 'AN_DESCRIPCION',AD_TDOC,AD_SDOC,AD_NDOC,AD_FDOC, AC_IDSUBDIARIO +'-'+RIGHT('00'+ CAST(AC_MES AS VARCHAR(2)),2)+ '-'+CAST(AC_NUM_VOUCHER AS VARCHAR(10))AS 'AC_NUM_VOUCHER' , ROUND(((AD_DEBE + AD_HABER)/1.18),2) * (case when AD_TDOC = 'NC' then -1 else 1 end) AS 'BASE', ROUND((AD_DEBE + AD_HABER) - (((AD_DEBE + AD_HABER)/1.18)),2) * (case when AD_TDOC = 'NC' then -1 else 1 end) AS 'IGV', (AD_DEBE + AD_HABER) * (case when AD_TDOC = 'NC' then -1 else 1 end) AS 'TOTAL' FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB A INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET B ON A.AC_ID = B.AD_IDCAB WHERE AD_TANEXO = 1 AND AC_ANHO = @P_ANHO AND AC_IDSUBDIARIO = '02' AND AD_IDANEXO IN ( SELECT AD_IDANEXO FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB A INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET B ON A.AC_ID = B.AD_IDCAB WHERE AD_TANEXO = 1 AND AC_ANHO = @P_ANHO AND AC_IDSUBDIARIO = '02' GROUP BY AD_IDANEXO HAVING SUM(ROUND(((AD_DEBE - AD_HABER)/1.18),2)) > @P_TOPE )
END

--BUSCAMOS EL SUBDIARIO DE APERTURA DECLARE @PSUBDIARIO_APE VARCHAR(2) SET @PSUBDIARIO_APE = (SELECT SD_ID FROM CO_TB_SUBDIARIO SCTS WHERE SD_ES_APER = 1 AND SD_ISTATUS = 1)
SELECT SC_IDCUENTA AS 'AD_CUENTA',PC_DES_CTA, AC_FEC_VOUCHER, AC_IDSUBDIARIO + '-'+cast(AC_NUM_VOUCHER as varchar(5))as 'AC_NUM_VOUCHER', AC_GLOSA_VOU, ISNULL(AD_DEBE,0) AS 'AD_DEBE', ISNULL(AD_HABER,0) AS 'AD_HABER', SC_SALDO_D, SC_SALDO_H
FROM (SELECT * FROM CO_TB_TMP_SALDO_CUENTA WHERE SC_PC = @P_PC) S LEFT JOIN ( SELECT AC_IDSUBDIARIO,AC_FEC_VOUCHER,AC_NUM_VOUCHER,AC_GLOSA_VOU,B.* FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB A INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET B ON A.AC_ID = B.AD_IDCAB WHERE AC_ANHO = @P_ANHO AND AC_MES = @P_MES AND AD_CUENTA IN (SELECT CODIGO FROM CO_TB_CODIGOS_TMP WHERE PC = @P_PC) AND AC_IDSUBDIARIO <> (CASE WHEN @P_MES = 1 THEN @PSUBDIARIO_APE ELSE '' END) ) D ON S.SC_IDCUENTA = D.AD_CUENTA
INNER JOIN (SELECT PC_NUM_CTA,PC_DES_CTA FROM CO_TB_PLANCTAS WHERE PC_PERIODO = @P_ANHO AND PC_NUM_CTA IN (SELECT CA_CTA FROM CO_TB_CTAS_ANT_MES_TMP WHERE CA_PC = @P_PC )
)AS P ON SC_IDCUENTA = PC_NUM_CTA

END) AS MONEDA,AD_TCAM AS TC, (CASE WHEN AD_TCAM > 0 THEN A.AD_MONTO_ORI ELSE 0 END) AS DOL, A.AD_DEBE,A.AD_HABER FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET A INNER JOIN CO_TB_PLANCTAS B ON A.AD_CUENTA = B.PC_NUM_CTA WHERE A.AD_IDCAB = @P_IDCAB AND PC_PERIODO = @P_PERIODO order by AD_SECUENCIA

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
DECLARE @SALDO NUMERIC(20,2)
IF @P_ACUMULADO = 1 BEGIN
SET @SALDO = (SELECT SUM(B.AD_DEBE)-SUM(B.AD_HABER) FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB A INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET B ON A.AC_ID = B.AD_IDCAB WHERE A.AC_ANHO = @P_PERIODO AND AC_MES <= @P_MES AND AD_CUENTA = @P_CUENTA ) END ELSE BEGIN
SET @SALDO = (SELECT SUM(B.AD_DEBE)-SUM(B.AD_HABER) FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB A INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET B ON A.AC_ID = B.AD_IDCAB WHERE A.AC_ANHO = @P_PERIODO AND AC_MES = @P_MES AND AD_CUENTA = @P_CUENTA )
END
IF @SALDO < 0 BEGIN if @P_CUENTA like '104%' begin UPDATE CO_TB_REP_BG10 SET RB_IMPORTE = isnull(RB_IMPORTE,0) + ABS(isnull(@SALDO,0)) WHERE RB_IDAREA = 2 AND RB_IDMOD=3 AND RB_NUCUENTA = 10 end else begin UPDATE CO_TB_REP_BG10 SET RB_IMPORTE = isnull(RB_IMPORTE,0) + isnull(@SALDO,0) WHERE RB_IDAREA = 1 AND RB_IDMOD=1 AND RB_NUCUENTA = 10 end
END ELSE BEGIN UPDATE CO_TB_REP_BG10 SET RB_IMPORTE = isnull(RB_IMPORTE,0) + ABS(isnull(@SALDO,0)) WHERE RB_IDAREA = 1 AND RB_IDMOD=1 AND RB_NUCUENTA = 10 END

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
--CREAMOS SUNA TABLA TEMPORAL(VARIABLE TIPO TABLA) DECLARE @RESULTADO TABLE(CUENTA VARCHAR(10), DOCUMENTO VARCHAR(20), ANEXO VARCHAR(200), GANANCIA FLOAT,PERDIDA FLOAT,ANEXOID INT)
DECLARE @P_ID_DET INT
--_________________________________________ DECLARE C_DOCPEN CURSOR FOR SELECT
min(cast(AD_IDCAB as varchar(10))+ AD_IDANEXO+AD_TDOC+AD_SDOC+AD_NDOC)
FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET A INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB B ON A.AD_IDCAB = B.AC_ID WHERE AC_ANHO = @P_AYO AND AD_TCAM > 0 AND AC_IDSUBDIARIO NOT IN ('04','05') AND A.AD_CUENTA IN( SELECT PC_NUM_CTA FROM CO_TB_PLANCTAS WHERE PC_PERIODO = @P_AYO AND PC_IDTIPO_ANEXO = 2) GROUP BY AD_IDANEXO,AD_TDOC,AD_SDOC,AD_NDOC HAVING SUM(AD_DEBE)-SUM(AD_HABER)<>0
OPEN C_DOCPEN FETCH NEXT FROM C_DOCPEN INTO @P_ID_DET WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
--DATOS DE CALCULO DECLARE @IMPORTE_PROVI_DOL FLOAT DECLARE @IMPORTE_PROVI_SOL FLOAT DECLARE @IMPORTE_ACTUAL_SOL FLOAT DECLARE @DIFERENCIA FLOAT
SET @IMPORTE_PROVI_DOL = (SELECT AD_MONTO_ORI FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET WHERE cast(AD_IDCAB as varchar(10))+ AD_IDANEXO+AD_TDOC+AD_SDOC+AD_NDOC = @P_ID_DET) SET @IMPORTE_PROVI_SOL = (SELECT (CASE WHEN AD_DEBE > 0 THEN AD_DEBE ELSE AD_HABER END) FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET WHERE cast(AD_IDCAB as varchar(10))+ AD_IDANEXO+AD_TDOC+AD_SDOC+AD_NDOC = @P_ID_DET) SET @IMPORTE_ACTUAL_SOL = ROUND(@IMPORTE_PROVI_DOL * @P_TC_FINMES,2)
SET @DIFERENCIA =ROUND( @IMPORTE_PROVI_SOL - @IMPORTE_ACTUAL_SOL,2)
--DATOS DEL DETALLE
DECLARE @CUENTA VARCHAR(10) DECLARE @DOCUMENTO VARCHAR(20) DECLARE @ANEXO VARCHAR(100) DECLARE @ANEXOID INT
SET @CUENTA = (SELECT AD_CUENTA FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET WHERE cast(AD_IDCAB as varchar(10))+ AD_IDANEXO+AD_TDOC+AD_SDOC+AD_NDOC = @P_ID_DET) SET @DOCUMENTO = (SELECT AD_TDOC+' - '+AD_SDOC+' - '+AD_NDOC FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET WHERE cast(AD_IDCAB as varchar(10))+ AD_IDANEXO+AD_TDOC+AD_SDOC+AD_NDOC = @P_ID_DET) SET @ANEXOID = (SELECT AD_IDANEXO FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET WHERE cast(AD_IDCAB as varchar(10))+ AD_IDANEXO+AD_TDOC+AD_SDOC+AD_NDOC = @P_ID_DET) SET @ANEXO = (SELECT ID+' - '+NAME FROM VENDOR WHERE ID = @ANEXOID)
INSERT INTO @RESULTADO SELECT @CUENTA,@DOCUMENTO,@ANEXO,ABS((CASE WHEN @DIFERENCIA > 0 THEN @DIFERENCIA ELSE 0 END)), ABS((CASE WHEN @DIFERENCIA < 0 THEN @DIFERENCIA ELSE 0 END)),@ANEXOID
--PRINT @P_ID_DET
FETCH NEXT FROM C_DOCPEN INTO @P_ID_DET END CLOSE C_DOCPEN DEALLOCATE C_DOCPEN
SELECT * FROM @RESULTADO ORDER BY DOCUMENTO

declare @number_doc varchar(15) declare @a int declare cursor1 cursor for
SELECT number_doc FROM drog_prueba.dbo.LETTER_EXCHANGE_LINE l inner join receivable r on l.number_doc=r.number_serie+r.number_document where document_date>='01/08/2010' order by document_date open cursor1 fetch next from cursor1 into @number_doc while @@fetch_status=0 begin select @a=number_doc from LETTER_EXCHANGE_LINE where number_doc=@number_doc if @a is null begin insert into LETTER_EXCHANGE_LINE select * from drog_prueba.dbo.LETTER_EXCHANGE_LINE where number_doc=@number_doc end fetch next from cursor1 into @number_doc end close cursor1 deallocate cursor1

Property.Name: HeaderContents
Property.Value: CREATE PROCEDURE copia_leatrs AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
DECLARE @NUMBER_DOCUMENT VARCHAR(10) DECLARE @DOCUMENT_ID VARCHAR(5) DECLARE @WAREHOUSE_ID VARCHAR(2) DECLARE @NUMBER_REF VARCHAR(10) DECLARE @DOCUMENT_ID_DOS VARCHAR(5) DECLARE @WAREHOUSE_ID_DOS VARCHAR(2) DECLARE @N FLOAT
DECLARE CURSOR1 CURSOR FOR SELECT DOCUMENT_ID,NUMBER_DOCUMENT,WAREHOUSE_ID FROM RECEIVABLE_LINE WHERE COMISION IS NULL OPEN CURSOR1 FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR1 INTO @DOCUMENT_ID,@NUMBER_DOCUMENT,@WAREHOUSE_ID WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN SELECT TOP 1 @N=(COMISION) FROM RECEIVABLE_LINE WHERE NUMBER_DOCUMENT=@NUMBER_DOCUMENT AND WAREHOUSE_ID=@WAREHOUSE_ID AND COMISION IS NOT NULL AND DOCUMENT_ID=@DOCUMENT_ID IF @N IS NOT NULL BEGIN INSERT INTO NUM_DOC_ELIMINADOS(DOCUMENT_ID,NUMBER_DOCUMENT) VALUES(@DOCUMENT_ID,@NUMBER_DOCUMENT) UPDATE RECEIVABLE_LINE SET COMISION=@N WHERE NUMBER_DOCUMENT=@NUMBER_DOCUMENT AND WAREHOUSE_ID=@WAREHOUSE_ID AND COMISION IS NULL AND DOCUMENT_ID=@DOCUMENT_ID END ELSE BEGIN SELECT @NUMBER_REF=NUMBER_REF,@DOCUMENT_ID_DOS=DOCUMENT_ID,@WAREHOUSE_ID_DOS=WAREHOUSE_ID FROM RECEIVABLE WHERE NUMBER_DOCUMENT=@NUMBER_DOCUMENT AND WAREHOUSE_ID=@WAREHOUSE_ID AND DOCUMENT_ID=@DOCUMENT_ID SELECT TOP 1 @N=COMISION FROM RECEIVABLE_LINE WHERE NUMBER_DOCUMENT=@NUMBER_REF AND WAREHOUSE_ID=@WAREHOUSE_ID_DOS AND DOCUMENT_ID=@DOCUMENT_ID_DOS INSERT INTO NUM_DOC_ELIMINADOS(DOCUMENT_ID,NUMBER_DOCUMENT) VALUES(@DOCUMENT_ID,@NUMBER_DOCUMENT) UPDATE RECEIVABLE_LINE SET COMISION=@N WHERE NUMBER_DOCUMENT=@NUMBER_DOCUMENT AND WAREHOUSE_ID=@WAREHOUSE_ID AND COMISION IS NULL AND DOCUMENT_ID=@DOCUMENT_ID END FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR1 INTO @DOCUMENT_ID,@NUMBER_DOCUMENT,@WAREHOUSE_ID END CLOSE CURSOR1 DEALLOCATE CURSOR1

Property.Name: HeaderContents
Property.Value: CREATE PROCEDURE CORREGIR_DOCUMENTOS_EN_RECEIVABLE_LINE AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
DECLARE @NUMBER_DOCUMENT VARCHAR(10) DECLARE @NUMBER_REF VARCHAR(10) DECLARE @N FLOAT
DECLARE CURSOR1 CURSOR FOR SELECT NUMBER_DOCUMENT FROM RECEIVABLE_LINE WHERE DOCUMENT_ID='NC' AND WAREHOUSE_ID=@ALMACEN AND COMISION IS NULL OPEN CURSOR1 FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR1 INTO @NUMBER_DOCUMENT WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN SELECT TOP 1 @N=(COMISION) FROM RECEIVABLE_LINE WHERE NUMBER_DOCUMENT=@NUMBER_DOCUMENT AND WAREHOUSE_ID=@ALMACEN AND COMISION IS NOT NULL IF @N IS NOT NULL BEGIN UPDATE RECEIVABLE_LINE SET COMISION=@N WHERE NUMBER_DOCUMENT=@NUMBER_DOCUMENT AND WAREHOUSE_ID=@ALMACEN AND COMISION IS NULL END ELSE BEGIN SELECT @NUMBER_REF=NUMBER_REF FROM RECEIVABLE WHERE NUMBER_DOCUMENT=@NUMBER_DOCUMENT AND WAREHOUSE_ID=@ALMACEN SELECT TOP 1 @N=COMISION FROM RECEIVABLE_LINE WHERE NUMBER_DOCUMENT=@NUMBER_REF AND WAREHOUSE_ID=@ALMACEN UPDATE RECEIVABLE_LINE SET COMISION=@N WHERE NUMBER_DOCUMENT=@NUMBER_DOCUMENT AND WAREHOUSE_ID=@ALMACEN AND COMISION IS NULL END FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR1 INTO @NUMBER_DOCUMENT END CLOSE CURSOR1 DEALLOCATE CURSOR1

DELETE FROM DOC_PENDIENTES
DECLARE @DOCUMENT_ID VARCHAR(2) DECLARE @NUMBER_DOC VARCHAR(15) DECLARE @NUM VARCHAR(10)
DECLARE CURSOR1 CURSOR FOR Select DOCUMENT_ID,NUMBER_DOC From CUSTOMER_BALANCE Where CUSTOMER_ID = @CUSTOMER_ID And Not(AMOUNT_BALANCE = 0) OPEN CURSOR1 FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR1 INTO @DOCUMENT_ID,@NUMBER_DOC WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN SET @NUM=RIGHT(@NUMBER_DOC,7) INSERT INTO DOC_PENDIENTES SELECT (R.DOCUMENT_ID+' '+R.NUMBER_SERIE+'-'+R.NUMBER_DOCUMENT)AS NUM_DOC,CONVERT(VARCHAR,R.DOCUMENT_DATE,103), R.CUSTOMER_NAME,RL.PART_DESCRIPTION,RL.QTY,RL.PRICE_SALES,RL.AMOUNT FROM RECEIVABLE R INNER JOIN RECEIVABLE_LINE RL ON R.DOCUMENT_ID=RL.DOCUMENT_ID AND R.NUMBER_SERIE=RL.NUMBER_SERIE AND R.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=RL.NUMBER_DOCUMENT WHERE R.DOCUMENT_ID=@DOCUMENT_ID AND R.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=@NUM
FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR1 INTO @DOCUMENT_ID,@NUMBER_DOC END CLOSE CURSOR1 DEALLOCATE CURSOR1
SELECT * FROM DOC_PENDIENTES

declare @inicio int declare @fin int declare @mes varchar(2) declare @anyo varchar(4) declare @fecha_find varchar(10)
set @mes=right(replicate('0',2) + cast(month(@fec_inicio) as varchar(2)),2) set @anyo=cast(year(@fec_inicio) as varchar(4))
set @inicio=CAST(LEFT(@fec_inicio,2) as INT) set @fin=CAST(LEFT(@fec_final,2) as INT)
if exists(select * from tempdb.dbo.sysobjects WHERE NAME='STOCK_DIARIO_TEMP'+@PC) EXEC('drop table [tempdb].dbo.STOCK_DIARIO_TEMP'+@PC+'')
exec('create table [tempdb].dbo.STOCK_DIARIO_TEMP'+@PC+' (COD_OPER varchar(10), COD_MAYOR int, COD_OSINERG varchar(10), FECHA varchar(10), COD_PRODUCTO varchar(20), DES_PRODUCTO varchar(64), COD_ALMACEN varchar(2), CANT_INGRESO numeric(15,6), CANT_SALIDA numeric(15,6), SALDO numeric(15,6), VOLUMEN_FONDOS varchar(1), FACTOR numeric(15,6) )')
WHILE @inicio<=@fin BEGIN set @fecha_find=right(replicate('0',2) + cast(@inicio as varchar (2)),2) + '/' + @mes + '/' + @anyo --Calculo el stock diario del producto set quoted_identifier off exec('insert into [tempdb].dbo.STOCK_DIARIO_TEMP'+@PC+' (COD_OPER,COD_MAYOR,COD_OSINERG,FECHA,COD_PRODUCTO,DES_PRODUCTO,COD_ALMACEN,CANT_INGRESO,CANT_SALIDA, SALDO,VOLUMEN_FONDOS,FACTOR) select AO.COD_OPER,'+@COD_DMAY+' as COD_MAYOR,PO.COD_OSINERG,'''+@fecha_find+''' as FECHA,B.PART_ID,C.DESCRIPTION,B.WAREHOUSE_ID, sum(case when A.TYPE_TRANS=''I'' then B.QTY else 0 END)AS INGRESO, sum(case when A.TYPE_TRANS=''S'' then B.QTY else 0 END)as SALIDA, (sum(case when A.TYPE_TRANS=''I'' then B.QTY else 0 END)-sum(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS=''S'' THEN B.QTY else 0 END)) / PO.FACTOR AS SALDOMOV, 0 as VOLUMEN_FONDOS,PO.FACTOR from WAREHOUSE_TRANS A inner join WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID=B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID=B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT inner join PART C ON B.PART_ID=C.ID inner join PRODUCTOS_OSINERG PO on B.PART_ID=PO.COD_PRODUCTO inner join ALMACEN_OSINERG AO on AO.COD_DMAY='+@COD_DMAY+' and AO.COD_ALMACEN=A.WAREHOUSE_ID AND AO.TIPO_ALMACEN=''F'' where A.STATUS_GUIA<>''A'' and not (A.DOCUMENT_ID=''GS'' and A.TRANS_ID=''GF'' and A.STATUS_GUIA=''F'') and not (C.IS_STOCKED=''N'' and C.SERIES=''N'' and C.IS_LOT=''N'') and (B.PART_ID<>''TEXTO'') and A.DATE_DOCUMENT<'''+@fecha_find+''' group by AO.COD_OPER,PO.COD_OSINERG,B.PART_ID,C.DESCRIPTION,B.WAREHOUSE_ID,PO.FACTOR order by B.PART_ID asc') set @inicio=@inicio + 1 END

declare @inicio int declare @fin int declare @mes varchar(2) declare @anyo varchar(4) declare @fecha_find varchar(10)
set @mes=right(replicate('0',2) + cast(month(@fec_inicio) as varchar(2)),2) set @anyo=cast(year(@fec_inicio) as varchar(4))
set @inicio=cast(left(@fec_inicio,2) as int) set @fin=cast(left(@fec_final,2) as int)
if exists(select * from tempdb.dbo.sysobjects WHERE NAME='STOCK_DIARIO'+@PC) EXEC('drop table [tempdb].dbo.STOCK_DIARIO'+@PC+'')
exec('create table [tempdb].dbo.STOCK_DIARIO'+@PC+' (COD_OPER varchar(10), COD_MAYOR int, COD_OSINERG varchar(10), FECHA varchar(10), COD_PRODUCTO varchar(20), DES_PRODUCTO varchar(64), COD_ALMACEN varchar(2), CANT_INGRESO numeric(15,6), CANT_SALIDA numeric(15,6), SALDO numeric(15,6), VOLUMEN_FONDOS varchar(1), FACTOR numeric(15,6) )')
WHILE @inicio<=@fin BEGIN set @fecha_find=right(replicate('0',2) + cast(@inicio as varchar (2)),2) + '/' + @mes + '/' + @anyo --Calculo el stock diario del producto set quoted_identifier off exec('insert into [tempdb].dbo.STOCK_DIARIO'+@PC+' (COD_OPER,COD_MAYOR,COD_OSINERG,FECHA,COD_PRODUCTO,DES_PRODUCTO,COD_ALMACEN,CANT_INGRESO,CANT_SALIDA, SALDO,VOLUMEN_FONDOS,FACTOR) select AO.COD_OPER,'+@COD_DMAY+' as COD_MAYOR,PO.COD_OSINERG,'''+@fecha_find+''' as FECHA,B.PART_ID,C.DESCRIPTION,B.WAREHOUSE_ID, sum(case when A.TYPE_TRANS=''I'' then B.QTY else 0 END)AS INGRESO, sum(case when A.TYPE_TRANS=''S'' then B.QTY else 0 END)as SALIDA, (sum(case when A.TYPE_TRANS=''I'' then B.QTY else 0 END)-sum(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS=''S'' THEN B.QTY else 0 END)) / PO.FACTOR AS SALDOMOV, 0 as VOLUMEN_FONDOS,PO.FACTOR from WAREHOUSE_TRANS A inner join WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID=B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID=B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT inner join PART C ON B.PART_ID=C.ID inner join PRODUCTOS_OSINERG PO on B.PART_ID=PO.COD_PRODUCTO inner join ALMACEN_OSINERG AO on AO.COD_DMAY='+@COD_DMAY+' and AO.COD_ALMACEN=A.WAREHOUSE_ID AND AO.TIPO_ALMACEN=''C'' where A.STATUS_GUIA<>''A'' and not (A.DOCUMENT_ID=''GS'' and A.TRANS_ID=''GF'' and A.STATUS_GUIA=''F'') and not (C.IS_STOCKED=''N'' and C.SERIES=''N'' and C.IS_LOT=''N'') and (B.PART_ID<>''TEXTO'') and A.DATE_DOCUMENT<'''+@fecha_find+''' group by AO.COD_OPER,PO.COD_OSINERG,B.PART_ID,C.DESCRIPTION,B.WAREHOUSE_ID,PO.FACTOR order by B.PART_ID asc') set @inicio=@inicio + 1 END

declare @inicio int declare @fin int declare @mes varchar(2) declare @anyo varchar(4) declare @fecha_find varchar(10)
set @mes=right(replicate('0',2) + cast(month(@fec_inicio) as varchar(2)),2) set @anyo=cast(year(@fec_inicio) as varchar(4))

if exists(select * from tempdb.dbo.sysobjects WHERE NAME='STOCK_DIARIO_MEDIA'+@PC) EXEC('drop table [tempdb].dbo.STOCK_DIARIO_MEDIA'+@PC+'')
exec('create table [tempdb].dbo.STOCK_DIARIO_MEDIA'+@PC+' (COD_OPER varchar(10), COD_MAYOR int, COD_OSINERG varchar(10), FECHA varchar(10), COD_PRODUCTO varchar(20), DES_PRODUCTO varchar(64), COD_ALMACEN varchar(2), CANT_INGRESO numeric(15,6), CANT_SALIDA numeric(15,6), SALDO numeric(15,6), VOLUMEN_FONDOS varchar(1), FACTOR numeric(15,6) )')
WHILE @inicio<=@fin BEGIN set @fecha_find=right(replicate('0',2) + cast(@inicio as varchar (2)),2) + '/' + @mes + '/' + @anyo --Calculo el stock diario del producto set quoted_identifier off exec('insert into [tempdb].dbo.STOCK_DIARIO_MEDIA'+@PC+' (COD_OPER,COD_MAYOR,COD_OSINERG,FECHA,COD_PRODUCTO,DES_PRODUCTO,COD_ALMACEN,CANT_INGRESO,CANT_SALIDA, SALDO,VOLUMEN_FONDOS,FACTOR) select AO.COD_OPER,'+@COD_DMAY+' as COD_MAYOR,PO.COD_OSINERG,'''+@fecha_find+''' as FECHA,B.PART_ID,C.DESCRIPTION,B.WAREHOUSE_ID, sum(case when A.TYPE_TRANS=''I'' then B.QTY else 0 END)AS INGRESO, sum(case when A.TYPE_TRANS=''S'' then B.QTY else 0 END)as SALIDA, (sum(case when A.TYPE_TRANS=''I'' then B.QTY else 0 END)-sum(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS=''S'' THEN B.QTY else 0 END)) / PO.FACTOR AS SALDOMOV, 0 as VOLUMEN_FONDOS,PO.FACTOR from WAREHOUSE_TRANS A inner join WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID=B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID=B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT inner join PART C ON B.PART_ID=C.ID inner join PRODUCTOS_OSINERG PO on B.PART_ID=PO.COD_PRODUCTO inner join ALMACEN_OSINERG AO on AO.COD_DMAY='+@COD_DMAY+' and AO.COD_ALMACEN=A.WAREHOUSE_ID AND AO.TIPO_ALMACEN=''C'' where A.STATUS_GUIA<>''A'' and not (A.DOCUMENT_ID=''GS'' and A.TRANS_ID=''GF'' and A.STATUS_GUIA=''F'') and not (C.IS_STOCKED=''N'' and C.SERIES=''N'' and C.IS_LOT=''N'') and (B.PART_ID<>''TEXTO'') and A.DATE_DOCUMENT<'''+@fecha_find+''' group by AO.COD_OPER,PO.COD_OSINERG,B.PART_ID,C.DESCRIPTION,B.WAREHOUSE_ID,PO.FACTOR order by B.PART_ID asc')
exec('insert into [tempdb].dbo.STOCK_DIARIO_MEDIA'+@PC+' (COD_OPER,COD_MAYOR,COD_OSINERG,FECHA,COD_PRODUCTO,DES_PRODUCTO,COD_ALMACEN,CANT_INGRESO,CANT_SALIDA, SALDO,VOLUMEN_FONDOS,FACTOR) select AO.COD_OPER,'+@COD_DMAY+' as COD_MAYOR,PO.COD_OSINERG,'''+@fecha_find+''' as FECHA,B.PART_ID,C.DESCRIPTION,B.WAREHOUSE_ID, sum(case when A.TYPE_TRANS=''I'' then B.QTY else 0 END)AS INGRESO, sum(case when A.TYPE_TRANS=''S'' then B.QTY else 0 END)as SALIDA, (sum(case when A.TYPE_TRANS=''I'' then B.QTY else 0 END)-sum(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS=''S'' THEN B.QTY else 0 END)) / PO.FACTOR AS SALDOMOV, 0 as VOLUMEN_FONDOS,PO.FACTOR from WAREHOUSE_TRANS A inner join WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID=B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID=B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT inner join PART C ON B.PART_ID=C.ID inner join PRODUCTOS_OSINERG PO on B.PART_ID=PO.COD_PRODUCTO inner join ALMACEN_OSINERG AO on AO.COD_DMAY='+@COD_DMAY+' and AO.COD_ALMACEN=A.WAREHOUSE_ID AND AO.TIPO_ALMACEN=''F'' where A.STATUS_GUIA<>''A'' and not (A.DOCUMENT_ID=''GS'' and A.TRANS_ID=''GF'' and A.STATUS_GUIA=''F'') and not (C.IS_STOCKED=''N'' and C.SERIES=''N'' and C.IS_LOT=''N'') and (B.PART_ID<>''TEXTO'') and A.DATE_DOCUMENT<'''+@fecha_find+''' group by AO.COD_OPER,PO.COD_OSINERG,B.PART_ID,C.DESCRIPTION,B.WAREHOUSE_ID,PO.FACTOR order by B.PART_ID asc')
set @inicio=@inicio + 1 END /*LISTO!!! */

--HSP_MUESTRA_DETALLE
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[HSP_MUESTRA_DETALLE] @EMP VARCHAR(3),@CODPRO VARCHAR(20) AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
--SET @FECHAINI='01/01/2007' --SET @FECHAFIN='01/01/2007'
DECLARE @STRcadena NVARCHAR(2000) declare @STRG nvarchar(2) declare @STRGF nvarchar(2) set @STRG='GS' set @STRGF='GF'
set @STRcadena='SELECT FC.DOCUMENT_ID,FC.NUMBER_SERIE,FC.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,FC.DOCUMENT_DATE AS FECHAFAC,FC.NUMBER_ORDER, FC.DOCUMENT_REF,FC.SERIE_REF,FC.NUMBER_REF,PC.ID,PC.ORDER_DATE AS FECHAPED, T.DATE_DOCUMENT AS FECHAGUIA,MD.PART_ID,MD.PART_DESCRIPTION,MD.QTY,MD.AMOUNT_SALES,PC.CUSTOMER_NAME,PC.CUSTOMER_ID,PC.USER_ID, PC.CADUCATE_DATE AS FECHAENT, DATEDIFF(dd, (PC.CADUCATE_DATE), (FC.DOCUMENT_DATE)) AS FECHADIF FROM RECEIVABLE FC INNER JOIN ORDERS PC ON FC.NUMBER_ORDER=PC.ID INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS MC ON FC.DOCUMENT_ID=MC.DOCUMENT_ID AND FC.NUMBER_SERIE=LEFT(MC.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,3) AND FC.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=SUBSTRING(MC.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,4,LEN(MC.NUMBER_DOCUMENT)) INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE MD ON MC.WAREHOUSE_ID=MD.WAREHOUSE_ID AND MC.DOCUMENT_ID=MD.DOCUMENT_ID AND MC.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=MD.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN (SELECT M.* FROM RECEIVABLE F INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS M ON F.DOCUMENT_REF=M.DOCUMENT_ID AND F.SERIE_REF=LEFT(M.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,3) AND F.NUMBER_REF=SUBSTRING(M.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,4,LEN(M.NUMBER_DOCUMENT)) WHERE M.DOCUMENT_ID=@STRG AND M.TRANS_ID=@STRGF) AS T ON FC.DOCUMENT_REF=T.DOCUMENT_ID AND FC.SERIE_REF=LEFT(T.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,3) AND FC.NUMBER_REF=SUBSTRING(T.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,4,LEN(T.NUMBER_DOCUMENT)) WHERE PC.ORDER_DATE >=@FECHAINI AND PC.ORDER_DATE<=@FECHAFIN AND MD.PART_ID<>''TEXTO'''
execute sp_executesql @STRcadena,N'@FECHAINI as VARCHAR(10),@FECHAFIN as VARCHAR(10), @STRG as nvarchar(2),@STRGF as nvarchar(2)',@FECHAINI,@FECHAFIN,@STRG,@STRGF

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value: exec('set QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON SELECT AO.COD_OPER,' + @COD_DMAY + ' as COD_MAYOR,PO.COD_OSINERG, B.QTY/PO.FACTOR AS VOLUMEN, A.DATE_DOCUMENT,PS.CODIGO_SPIC as COD_PROVE_SPIC, M.NUMBER_REGISTRATION AS PLACA_TRACTO,TDG.PLACA,'''' AS OTRO_TRANS, TDG.DGH AS REG_DGH,A.WAREHOUSE_ID,B.PART_ID,PO.FACTOR,M.ID,A.VENDOR_ID FROM WAREHOUSE_TRANS A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID=B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID=B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN ALMACEN_OSINERG AO ON AO.COD_DMAY=' + @COD_DMAY + ' AND AO.COD_ALMACEN=A.WAREHOUSE_ID and AO.TIPO_ALMACEN=''F'' LEFT JOIN CARRIER M ON M.ID=A.CARRIER_ID INNER JOIN PRODUCTOS_OSINERG PO ON PO.COD_PRODUCTO=B.PART_ID LEFT JOIN TRANS_DGH TDG on TDG.CODIGO=M.ID LEFT JOIN PROVSPIC PS ON A.VENDOR_ID=PS.CODPRO WHERE A.DATE_DOCUMENT BETWEEN '''+ @FEC_INICIO + ''' AND ''' + @FEC_FINAL + ''' AND A.TYPE_TRANS=''I'' AND (A.TRANS_ID=''CI'') AND B.PART_ID<>''TEXTO'' GROUP BY AO.COD_OPER,PO.COD_OSINERG,B.QTY,PO.FACTOR,A.DATE_DOCUMENT,PS.CODIGO_SPIC,M.NUMBER_REGISTRATION, TDG.PLACA,TDG.DGH,A.WAREHOUSE_ID,B.PART_ID,M.ID,A.VENDOR_ID ORDER BY A.DATE_DOCUMENT')

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value: exec('set QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON SELECT AO.COD_OPER,' + @COD_DMAY + ' as COD_MAYOR,PO.COD_OSINERG, B.QTY/PO.FACTOR AS VOLUMEN, A.DATE_DOCUMENT,PS.CODIGO_SPIC as COD_PROVE_SPIC, M.NUMBER_REGISTRATION AS PLACA_TRACTO,TDG.PLACA,'''' AS OTRO_TRANS, TDG.DGH AS REG_DGH,A.WAREHOUSE_ID,B.PART_ID,PO.FACTOR,M.ID,A.VENDOR_ID FROM WAREHOUSE_TRANS A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID=B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID=B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN ALMACEN_OSINERG AO ON AO.COD_DMAY=' + @COD_DMAY + ' AND AO.COD_ALMACEN=A.WAREHOUSE_ID and AO.TIPO_ALMACEN=''C'' LEFT JOIN CARRIER M ON M.ID=A.CARRIER_ID INNER JOIN PRODUCTOS_OSINERG PO ON PO.COD_PRODUCTO=B.PART_ID LEFT JOIN TRANS_DGH TDG on TDG.CODIGO=M.ID INNER JOIN PROVSPIC PS ON A.VENDOR_ID=PS.CODPRO WHERE A.DATE_DOCUMENT BETWEEN '''+ @FEC_INICIO + ''' AND ''' + @FEC_FINAL + ''' AND A.TYPE_TRANS=''I'' AND (A.TRANS_ID=''CL'') AND B.PART_ID<>''TEXTO'' GROUP BY AO.COD_OPER,PO.COD_OSINERG,B.QTY,PO.FACTOR,A.DATE_DOCUMENT,PS.CODIGO_SPIC,M.NUMBER_REGISTRATION, TDG.PLACA,TDG.DGH,A.WAREHOUSE_ID,B.PART_ID,M.ID,A.VENDOR_ID ORDER BY A.DATE_DOCUMENT') /*LISTO !!!*/

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
exec('set QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON SELECT T.COD_OPER,T.COD_OSINERG,'+@COD_DMAY + ' AS COD_MAYOR, SUM(T.VOLUMEN_I) AS INGRESO,SUM(T.VOLUMEN_S) AS SALIDA, SUM(T.VOLUMEN_I - T.VOLUMEN_S) AS SALDO,'''+ @FEC_FINAL +''' AS FECHA FROM ( (SELECT AO.COD_OPER,PO.COD_OSINERG, SUM(B.QTY/PO.FACTOR) AS VOLUMEN_I,0 AS VOLUMEN_S FROM WAREHOUSE_TRANS A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID=B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID=B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN ALMACEN_OSINERG AO ON AO.COD_DMAY='+ @COD_DMAY +' AND AO.COD_ALMACEN=A.WAREHOUSE_ID and AO.TIPO_ALMACEN=''C'' INNER JOIN PRODUCTOS_OSINERG PO ON PO.COD_PRODUCTO=B.PART_ID WHERE A.DATE_DOCUMENT BETWEEN '''+@FEC_INICIO + ''' AND ''' + @FEC_FINAL + ''' AND A.DOCUMENT_ID=''NI'' AND (A.TRANS_ID=''AJ'' OR A.TRANS_ID=''IL'' OR A.TRANS_ID=''EI'' OR A.TRANS_ID=''IA'' OR A.TRANS_ID=''IM'') AND B.PART_ID<>''TEXTO'' GROUP BY AO.COD_OPER,PO.COD_OSINERG)
UNION
(SELECT AO.COD_OPER,PO.COD_OSINERG, 0 AS VOLUMEN_S,SUM(B.QTY/PO.FACTOR) AS VOLUMEN FROM WAREHOUSE_TRANS A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID=B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID=B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN ALMACEN_OSINERG AO ON AO.COD_DMAY='+@COD_DMAY+ ' AND AO.COD_ALMACEN=A.WAREHOUSE_ID and AO.TIPO_ALMACEN=''C'' INNER JOIN PRODUCTOS_OSINERG PO ON PO.COD_PRODUCTO=B.PART_ID WHERE A.DATE_DOCUMENT BETWEEN ''' + @FEC_INICIO + ''' AND '''+ @FEC_FINAL + ''' AND A.DOCUMENT_ID=''NS'' AND (A.TRANS_ID=''AJ'' OR A.TRANS_ID=''SL'' OR A.TRANS_ID=''SA'' OR A.TRANS_ID=''SF'' OR A.TRANS_ID=''SM'') AND B.PART_ID<>''TEXTO'' GROUP BY AO.COD_OPER,PO.COD_OSINERG) ) AS T GROUP BY T.COD_OPER,T.COD_OSINERG')

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript

IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tempdb.dbo.sysobjects WHERE NAME='COSTOS'+@PC) EXEC('DROP TABLE [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+'')
IF @OPC='0' EXEC ('SELECT FD.PART_ID,FD.PART_DESCRIPTION,FC.DOCUMENT_ID ,FC.NUMBER_SERIE ,FC.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,FC.CUSTOMER_ID,FC.CUSTOMER_NAME, FC.DOCUMENT_DATE,FD.QTY,FD.UNIT,FC.CURRENCY_ID,FD.PRICE_ORI, FD.PART_TAX,FC.SELL_RATE,FD.DISCOUNT,FD.DISCOUNT_CUSTOMER,FD.DISCOUNT_SP, FC.IS_GUIA_REC,V.ID,V.NAME, DOCUMENT_REF,SERIE_REF,NUMBER_REF INTO [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' FROM RECEIVABLE FC INNER JOIN SALES_REP V ON FC.SALES_REP_ID=V.ID INNER JOIN RECEIVABLE_LINE FD ON FC.DOCUMENT_ID=FD.DOCUMENT_ID INNER JOIN PART MA ON MA.ID=FD.PART_ID AND FC.NUMBER_SERIE=FD.NUMBER_SERIE AND FC.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=FD.NUMBER_DOCUMENT WHERE FD.PART_ID>=''' + @ARTINI + ''' AND FD.PART_ID<=''' + @ARTFIN + ''' AND FC.DOCUMENT_DATE>=''' + @FECHAINI + ''' AND FC.DOCUMENT_DATE<=''' + @FECHAFIN + ''' AND (FC.CUSTOMER_ID>=''' + @CLIINI + ''' AND FC.CUSTOMER_ID<=''' + @CLIFIN + ''') AND V.ID>=''' + @INI + ''' AND V.ID<=''' + @FIN + ''' AND NOT(MA.IS_STOCKED=''N'' AND MA.SERIES=''N'' AND MA.IS_LOT=''N'') AND FC.STATUS<>''A'' AND FD.PART_ID<>''CILIN '' ORDER BY FD.PART_ID ')
IF @OPC='1' EXEC ('SELECT FD.PART_ID,FD.PART_DESCRIPTION,FC.DOCUMENT_ID ,FC.NUMBER_SERIE ,FC.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,FC.CUSTOMER_ID,FC.CUSTOMER_NAME, FC.DOCUMENT_DATE,FD.QTY,FD.UNIT,FC.CURRENCY_ID,FD.PRICE_ORI, FD.PART_TAX,TC.SELL_RATE,FD.DISCOUNT,FD.DISCOUNT_CUSTOMER,FD.DISCOUNT_SP, FC.IS_GUIA_REC,V.ID,V.NAME, DOCUMENT_REF,SERIE_REF,NUMBER_REF INTO [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' FROM RECEIVABLE FC INNER JOIN SALES_REP V ON FC.SALES_REP_ID=V.ID INNER JOIN RECEIVABLE_LINE FD ON FC.DOCUMENT_ID=FD.DOCUMENT_ID INNER JOIN CURRENCY_EXCHANGE TC ON TC.CURRENCY_DATE=FC.DOCUMENT_DATE INNER JOIN PART MA ON MA.ID=FD.PART_ID AND FC.NUMBER_SERIE=FD.NUMBER_SERIE AND FC.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=FD.NUMBER_DOCUMENT WHERE FD.PART_ID>=''' + @ARTINI + ''' AND FD.PART_ID<=''' + @ARTFIN + ''' AND FC.DOCUMENT_DATE>=''' + @FECHAINI + ''' AND FC.DOCUMENT_DATE<=''' + @FECHAFIN + ''' AND (FC.CUSTOMER_ID>=''' + @CLIINI + ''' AND FC.CUSTOMER_ID<=''' + @CLIFIN + ''') AND V.ID>=''' + @INI + ''' AND V.ID<=''' + @FIN + ''' AND NOT(MA.IS_STOCKED=''N'' AND MA.SERIES=''N'' AND MA.IS_LOT=''N'') AND FC.STATUS<>''A'' AND FD.PART_ID<>''CILIN '' ORDER BY FD.PART_ID ')
EXEC ('ALTER TABLE [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' ADD COSTOMN numeric(15,9)') EXEC ('ALTER TABLE [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' ADD COSTOME numeric(15,9)') EXEC ('ALTER TABLE [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' ADD COSTOMN_REAL numeric(15,9)')
EXEC ('UPDATE C SET C.COSTOMN = (CASE WHEN C.CURRENCY_ID=''MN'' THEN MD.AVERAGE_COST ELSE MD.AVERAGE_COST * C.SELL_RATE END), C.COSTOME = (CASE WHEN C.CURRENCY_ID=''ME'' THEN MD.AVERAGE_COST ELSE MD.AVERAGE_COST / C.SELL_RATE END) FROM [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' C INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE MD ON C.PART_ID=MD.PART_ID AND C.DOCUMENT_ID=MD.DOCUMENT_ID AND C.NUMBER_SERIE=LEFT(MD.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,3) AND C.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=RIGHT(MD.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,7) WHERE C.IS_GUIA_REC IS NULL OR C.IS_GUIA_REC<>''S'' OR C.IS_GUIA_REC='''' OR C.IS_GUIA_REC='' ''')
EXEC ('UPDATE C SET C.COSTOMN = (CASE WHEN C.CURRENCY_ID=''MN'' THEN MD.AVERAGE_COST ELSE MD.AVERAGE_COST * C.SELL_RATE END), C.COSTOME = (CASE WHEN C.CURRENCY_ID=''ME'' THEN MD.AVERAGE_COST ELSE MD.AVERAGE_COST / C.SELL_RATE END) FROM [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' C INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS MC INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE MD ON MC.DOCUMENT_ID=MD.DOCUMENT_ID AND MC.WAREHOUSE_ID=MD.WAREHOUSE_ID AND MC.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=MD.NUMBER_DOCUMENT ON C.DOCUMENT_ID=MC.DOC_ID_REF AND C.NUMBER_SERIE=LEFT(MC.NUM_ID_REF,3) AND C.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=RIGHT(MC.NUM_ID_REF,7) WHERE C.PART_ID=MD.PART_ID AND C.IS_GUIA_REC=''S''')
EXEC ('UPDATE [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' SET QTY=(CASE WHEN QTY IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE QTY END), PRICE_ORI=(CASE WHEN PRICE_ORI IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE PRICE_ORI END), PART_TAX=(CASE WHEN PART_TAX IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE PART_TAX END), SELL_RATE=(CASE WHEN SELL_RATE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE SELL_RATE END), DISCOUNT=(CASE WHEN DISCOUNT IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE DISCOUNT END), DISCOUNT_CUSTOMER=(CASE WHEN DISCOUNT_CUSTOMER IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE DISCOUNT_CUSTOMER END), DISCOUNT_SP=(CASE WHEN DISCOUNT_SP IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE DISCOUNT_SP END), IS_GUIA_REC=(CASE WHEN IS_GUIA_REC IS NULL THEN '''' ELSE IS_GUIA_REC END), COSTOMN=(CASE WHEN COSTOMN IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE COSTOMN END), COSTOME=(CASE WHEN COSTOME IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE COSTOME END)')
--ACTUALIZO EL COSTO REAL EN SOLES EXEC('UPDATE C SET COSTOMN_REAL=I.AVERAGE_COST FROM [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' C LEFT JOIN INVENTORY I ON C.DOCUMENT_ID=I.TYPE_DOC AND C.NUMBER_SERIE+C.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=I.NUMBER_DOC AND C.PART_ID=I.PART_ID')
--NUEVA ACTUALIZACION PARA CASO DE GUIAS EXEC(' UPDATE C SET COSTOMN_REAL=I.AVERAGE_COST FROM [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' C INNER JOIN INVENTORY I ON C.DOCUMENT_REF=I.TYPE_DOC AND C.SERIE_REF+C.NUMBER_REF=I.NUMBER_DOC AND C.PART_ID=I.PART_ID AND IS_GUIA_REC=''S'' ')

--CREO MI TABLA TEMPORAL IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tempdb.dbo.sysobjects WHERE NAME='COSTITO'+@PC) EXEC('DROP TABLE [tempdb].dbo.COSTITO'+@PC+'') EXEC('CREATE TABLE [tempdb].dbo.COSTITO' + @PC + ' (CODIGO VARCHAR(20) ,DESCRIPCION VARCHAR(64),COSTOME NUMERIC(15,6),COSTOMN NUMERIC(15,6), PRECIOME NUMERIC(15,6),PRECIOMN NUMERIC(15,6),CANTIDAD NUMERIC(15,6))')
EXEC(' INSERT INTO [tempdb].dbo.COSTITO'+@PC+' select CODIGO_PRO,DESCRIPCION,0,0,0,0,0 from ['+@EMP+'].dbo.ESTADO_PRODUCTO WHERE CODIGO_PRO NOT IN (SELECT DFCODIGO FROM [tempdb].dbo.COSTOSAGRUP'+@PC+') AND ESTADO=''1'' ORDER BY CODIGO_PRO ')
--AHORA CRUZO MI TEMPORAL CONTRA LA BD HAKAN PARA HACER LAS AGRUPACIONES
--DECLARE @SUMACOSTOMN NUMERIC(15,6),@SUMACOSTOME NUMERIC(15,6) DECLARE @SUMACOSTOMN varchar(50),@SUMACOSTOME varchar(1000) DECLARE @SUMACANT varchar(50) DECLARE @INSERTA VARCHAR(1000) DECLARE @COD VARCHAR(20) DECLARE @DESCRI VARCHAR(64)
DECLARE AGRUPA CURSOR FOR SELECT CODIGO_PRO,DESCRIPCION FROM ESTADO_PRODUCTO E WHERE E.ESTADO=1 GROUP BY CODIGO_PRO,DESCRIPCION ORDER BY E.CODIGO_PRO
OPEN AGRUPA FETCH NEXT FROM AGRUPA INTO @COD,@DESCRI
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN SET @INSERTA='INSERT INTO [tempdb].dbo.COSTITO'+@PC+'(CODIGO,DESCRIPCION,COSTOME,COSTOMN,PRECIOME,PRECIOMN,CANTIDAD) SELECT DFCODIGO,DFDESCRI,SUM(COSTOME*DFCANTID) AS COSTOME,SUM(COSTOMN_REAL*DFCANTID) AS COSTOMN,' SET @INSERTA=@INSERTA + '(CASE WHEN CFCODMON=''ME'' THEN SUM(DFPREC_ORI*DFCANTID) ELSE SUM((DFPREC_ORI/CFTIPCAM)*DFCANTID) END) AS PRECIOME,' SET @INSERTA=@INSERTA + '(CASE WHEN CFCODMON=''MN'' THEN SUM(DFPREC_ORI*DFCANTID) ELSE SUM((DFPREC_ORI*CFTIPCAM)*DFCANTID) END) AS PRECIOMN,' SET @INSERTA=@INSERTA + 'SUM(DFCANTID) AS CANTIDAD' SET @INSERTA=@INSERTA+' FROM [tempdb].dbo.COSTOSAGRUP'+@PC+' WHERE DFCODIGO='''+@COD+'''' SET @INSERTA=@INSERTA+' GROUP BY DFCODIGO,DFDESCRI,CFCODMON' EXEC(@INSERTA)
DECLARE @CODIGODET VARCHAR(20) DECLARE @ACTUALIZA VARCHAR(1000)
DECLARE SUMADETALLE CURSOR FOR SELECT COD_PRO_SEC FROM [HAKAN].dbo.DETALLE_PRODUCTO WHERE COD_PRO_PRIN=@COD
OPEN SUMADETALLE FETCH NEXT FROM SUMADETALLE INTO @CODIGODET
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN SET @ACTUALIZA='UPDATE [tempdb].dbo.COSTITO'+@PC+' SET COSTOME=COSTOME+ISNULL((SELECT SUM(COSTOME*QTY)' SET @ACTUALIZA=@ACTUALIZA + ' FROM [tempdb].dbo.COSTOSAGRUP'+@PC+' WHERE PART_ID='''+@CODIGODET+'''),0),' SET @ACTUALIZA=@ACTUALIZA + ' COSTOMN=COSTOMN+ISNULL((SELECT ROUND(SUM(COSTOMN_REAL*QTY),2)' SET @ACTUALIZA=@ACTUALIZA + ' FROM [tempdb].dbo.COSTOSAGRUP'+@PC+' WHERE PART_ID='''+@CODIGODET+'''),0),' SET @ACTUALIZA=@ACTUALIZA + ' PRECIOME=PRECIOME+ISNULL((SELECT (CASE WHEN CURRENCY_ID=''ME'' THEN SUM(PRICE_ORI*QTY) ELSE SUM((PRICE_ORI/SELL_RATE)*QTY) END)AS PRECIOME' SET @ACTUALIZA=@ACTUALIZA + ' FROM [tempdb].dbo.COSTOSAGRUP'+@PC+' WHERE PART_ID='''+@CODIGODET+''' GROUP BY CURRENCY_ID),0),' SET @ACTUALIZA=@ACTUALIZA + ' PRECIOMN=PRECIOMN+ISNULL((SELECT (CASE WHEN CURRENCY_ID=''MN'' THEN SUM(PRICE_ORI*QTY) ELSE SUM((PRICE_ORI*SELL_RATE)*QTY) END)AS PRECIOMN' SET @ACTUALIZA=@ACTUALIZA + ' FROM [tempdb].dbo.COSTOSAGRUP'+@PC+' WHERE PART_ID='''+@CODIGODET+''' GROUP BY CURRENCY_ID),0),' SET @ACTUALIZA=@ACTUALIZA + ' CANTIDAD=CANTIDAD + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(QTY) FROM [tempdb].dbo.COSTOSAGRUP'+@PC+' WHERE PART_ID='''+@CODIGODET+'''),0)' SET @ACTUALIZA=@ACTUALIZA + ' WHERE CODIGO='''+@COD+''''
EXEC(@ACTUALIZA)
FETCH NEXT FROM SUMADETALLE INTO @CODIGODET END CLOSE SUMADETALLE DEALLOCATE SUMADETALLE
FETCH NEXT FROM AGRUPA INTO @COD,@DESCRI
END CLOSE AGRUPA DEALLOCATE AGRUPA
--ELIMINO DONDE TODO SEA CERO EXEC('DELETE FROM [tempdb].dbo.COSTITO'+@PC+' WHERE COSTOME=0 AND COSTOMN=0 AND PRECIOME=0 AND PRECIOMN=0
')
--HAGO SELECT A TEMPORAL EXEC('SELECT CODIGO,DESCRIPCION,SUM(COSTOME) AS COSTOME,SUM(COSTOMN) AS COSTOMN,SUM(PRECIOME) AS PRECIOME,SUM(PRECIOMN) AS PRECIOMN,SUM(CANTIDAD) AS CANTIDAD FROM [tempdb].dbo.COSTITO'+@PC+' GROUP BY CODIGO,DESCRIPCION')

IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tempdb.dbo.sysobjects WHERE NAME='COSTOS'+@PC) EXEC('DROP TABLE [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+'')
DECLARE @CADENA VARCHAR(100) IF @OPCION='1' SET @CADENA='AND FC.CUSTOMER_ID>=''' + @INI + ''' AND FC.CUSTOMER_ID<=''' + @FIN + ''''
IF @OPCION='2' SET @CADENA='WHERE FD.PART_ID>=''' + @INI + ''' AND FD.PART_ID<=''' + @FIN + ''''
IF @OPT='0' EXEC ('SELECT FD.PART_ID,FD.PART_DESCRIPTION,FC.DOCUMENT_ID ,FC.NUMBER_SERIE ,FC.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,FC.CUSTOMER_ID,FC.CUSTOMER_NAME, FC.DOCUMENT_DATE,FD.QTY,FD.UNIT,FC.CURRENCY_ID,FD.PRICE_ORI, FD.PART_TAX,FC.SELL_RATE,FD.DISCOUNT,FD.DISCOUNT_CUSTOMER,FD.DISCOUNT_SP, FC.IS_GUIA_REC,V.ID,V.NAME INTO [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' FROM RECEIVABLE FC INNER JOIN SALES_REP V ON FC.SALES_REP_ID=V.ID INNER JOIN RECEIVABLE_LINE FD ON FC.DOCUMENT_ID=FD.DOCUMENT_ID INNER JOIN PART MA ON MA.ID=FD.PART_ID AND FC.NUMBER_SERIE=FD.NUMBER_SERIE AND FC.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=FD.NUMBER_DOCUMENT ' + @CADENA + ' AND FC.DOCUMENT_DATE>=''' + @FECHAINI + ''' AND FC.DOCUMENT_DATE<=''' + @FECHAFIN + ''' AND NOT(MA.IS_STOCKED=''N'' AND MA.SERIES=''N'' AND MA.IS_LOT=''N'') AND FC.STATUS<>''A'' AND FD.PART_ID<>''CILIN '' ORDER BY FD.PART_ID ')
IF @OPT='1'
EXEC ('SELECT FD.PART_ID,FD.PART_DESCRIPTION,FC.DOCUMENT_ID ,FC.NUMBER_SERIE ,FC.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,FC.CUSTOMER_ID,FC.CUSTOMER_NAME, FC.DOCUMENT_DATE,FD.QTY,FD.UNIT,FC.CURRENCY_ID,FD.PRICE_ORI, FD.PART_TAX,TC.SELL_RATE,FD.DISCOUNT,FD.DISCOUNT_CUSTOMER,FD.DISCOUNT_SP, FC.IS_GUIA_REC,V.ID,V.NAME INTO [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' FROM RECEIVABLE FC INNER JOIN SALES_REP V ON FC.SALES_REP_ID=V.ID INNER JOIN RECEIVABLE_LINE FD ON FC.DOCUMENT_ID=FD.DOCUMENT_ID INNER JOIN CURRENCY_EXCHANGE TC ON TC.CURRENCY_DATE=FC.DOCUMENT_DATE INNER JOIN PART MA ON MA.ID=FD.PART_ID AND FC.NUMBER_SERIE=FD.NUMBER_SERIE AND FC.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=FD.NUMBER_DOCUMENT ' + @CADENA + ' AND FC.DOCUMENT_DATE>=''' + @FECHAINI + ''' AND FC.DOCUMENT_DATE<=''' + @FECHAFIN + ''' AND NOT(MA.IS_STOCKED=''N'' AND MA.SERIES=''N'' AND MA.IS_LOT=''N'') AND FC.STATUS<>''A'' AND FD.PART_ID<>''CILIN '' ORDER BY FD.PART_ID ')
--WHERE FD.DFCODIGO>=''' + @ARTINI + ''' AND FD.DFCODIGO<=''' + @ARTFIN + ''' --AND (FC.CFCODCLI>=''' + @CLIINI + ''' AND FC.CFCODCLI<=''' + @CLIFIN + ''') --AND V.COD_VEN>=''' + @INI + ''' AND V.COD_VEN<=''' + @FIN + '''
EXEC ('ALTER TABLE [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' ADD COSTOMN numeric(15,9)') EXEC ('ALTER TABLE [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' ADD COSTOME numeric(15,9)') EXEC ('ALTER TABLE [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' ADD COSTOMN_REAL numeric(15,9)')
EXEC ('UPDATE C SET C.COSTOMN = (CASE WHEN C.CURRENCY_ID=''MN'' THEN MD.AVERAGE_COST ELSE MD.AVERAGE_COST * SELL_RATE END), C.COSTOME = (CASE WHEN C.CURRENCY_ID=''ME'' THEN MD.AVERAGE_COST ELSE MD.AVERAGE_COST / SELL_RATE END) FROM [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' C INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE MD ON C.PART_ID=MD.PART_ID AND C.DOCUMENT_ID=MD.DOCUMENT_ID AND C.NUMBER_SERIE=LEFT(MD.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,3) AND C.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=RIGHT(MD.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,7) WHERE C.IS_GUIA_REC IS NULL OR C.IS_GUIA_REC<>''S'' OR C.IS_GUIA_REC='''' OR C.IS_GUIA_REC='' ''')
EXEC ('UPDATE C SET C.COSTOMN = (CASE WHEN C.CURRENCY_ID=''MN'' THEN MD.AVERAGE_COST ELSE MD.AVERAGE_COST * SELL_RATE END), C.COSTOME = (CASE WHEN C.CURRENCY_ID=''ME'' THEN MD.AVERAGE_COST ELSE MD.AVERAGE_COST / SELL_RATE END) FROM [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' C INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS MC INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE MD ON MC.DOCUMENT_ID=MD.DOCUMENT_ID AND MC.WAREHOUSE_ID=MD.WAREHOUSE_ID AND MC.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=MD.NUMBER_DOCUMENT ON C.DOCUMENT_ID=MC.DOC_ID_REF AND C.NUMBER_SERIE=LEFT(MC.NUM_ID_REF,3) AND C.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=RIGHT(MC.NUM_ID_REF,7) WHERE C.PART_ID=MD.ITEM AND C.IS_GUIA_REC=''S''')
EXEC ('UPDATE [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' SET QTY=(CASE WHEN QTY IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE QTY END), PRICE_ORI=(CASE WHEN PRICE_ORI IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE PRICE_ORI END), PART_TAX=(CASE WHEN PART_TAX IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE PART_TAX END), SELL_RATE=(CASE WHEN SELL_RATE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE SELL_RATE END), DISCOUNT=(CASE WHEN DISCOUNT IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE DISCOUNT END), DISCOUNT_CUSTOMER=(CASE WHEN DISCOUNT_CUSTOMER IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE DISCOUNT_CUSTOMER END), DISCOUNT_SP=(CASE WHEN DISCOUNT_SP IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE DISCOUNT_SP END), IS_GUIA_REC=(CASE WHEN IS_GUIA_REC IS NULL THEN '''' ELSE IS_GUIA_REC END), COSTOMN=(CASE WHEN COSTOMN IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE COSTOMN END), COSTOME=(CASE WHEN COSTOME IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE COSTOME END)')
--ACTUALIZO CAMPO COSTOMN_REAL EXEC('UPDATE C SET COSTOMN_REAL=I.AVERAGE_COST FROM [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' C LEFT JOIN INVENTORY I ON C.DOCUMENT_ID=I.TYPE_DOC AND C.NUMBER_SERIE+C.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=I.NUMBER_DOC AND C.PART_ID=I.PART_ID')
--HAGO SELECT A TEMPORAL
IF @OPCION='1' --Agrupado por clientes EXEC(' SELECT CUSTOMER_ID,CUSTOMER_NAME, SUM((CASE WHEN CURRENCY_ID=''ME'' THEN PRICE_ORI*QTY ELSE (PRICE_ORI/SELL_RATE)*QTY END)) AS TOTALME, SUM(COSTOME*QTY) AS COSTO_ME, SUM((CASE WHEN CURRENCY_ID=''ME'' THEN (PRICE_ORI*SELL_RATE)*QTY ELSE PRICE_ORI*QTY END)) AS TOTALMN, SUM(COSTOMN_REAL*QTY) AS COSTO_MN FROM [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID,CUSTOMER_NAME')
IF @OPCION='2' --Agrupado por producto EXEC(' SELECT PART_ID,PART_DESCRIPTION, SUM((CASE WHEN CURRENCY_ID=''ME'' THEN PRICE_ORI*QTY ELSE (PRICE_ORI/SELL_RATE)*QTY END)) AS TOTALME, SUM(COSTOME*QTY) AS COSTO_ME, SUM((CASE WHEN CURRENCY_ID=''ME'' THEN (PRICE_ORI*SELL_RATE)*QTY ELSE PRICE_ORI*QTY END)) AS TOTALMN, SUM(COSTOMN_REAL*QTY) AS COSTO_MN, SUM(QTY) AS CANTIDAD FROM [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' GROUP BY PART_ID,PART_DESCRIPTION')

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value: exec('set QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON SELECT AO.COD_OPER,' + @COD_DMAY + ' as COD_MAYOR,PO.COD_OSINERG, B.QTY/PO.FACTOR AS VOLUMEN, A.DATE_DOCUMENT, M.NUMBER_REGISTRATION AS PLACA_TRACTO,TDG.PLACA,'''' AS OTRO_TRANS, TDG.DGH AS REG_DGH,A.WAREHOUSE_ID,AOD.COD_OPER as COD_OPER_H,AOD.COD_DMAY as COD_MAYOR_H ,A.WAREHOUSE_REF,B.PART_ID,PO.FACTOR,M.ID,A.VENDOR_ID,A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT FROM WAREHOUSE_TRANS A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID=B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID=B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN ALMACEN_OSINERG AO ON AO.COD_DMAY=' + @COD_DMAY + ' AND AO.COD_ALMACEN=A.WAREHOUSE_ID and AO.TIPO_ALMACEN=''F'' inner join ALMACEN_OSINERG AOD ON AOD.COD_ALMACEN=A.WAREHOUSE_REF and AOD.TIPO_ALMACEN=''C'' LEFT JOIN CARRIER M ON M.ID=A.CARRIER_ID INNER JOIN PRODUCTOS_OSINERG PO ON PO.COD_PRODUCTO=B.PART_ID LEFT JOIN TRANS_DGH TDG on TDG.CODIGO=M.ID WHERE A.DATE_DOCUMENT BETWEEN '''+ @FEC_INICIO + ''' AND ''' + @FEC_FINAL + ''' AND A.DOCUMENT_ID=''NS'' AND (A.TRANS_ID=''TD'') AND B.PART_ID<>''TEXTO'' GROUP BY AO.COD_OPER,PO.COD_OSINERG,B.QTY,PO.FACTOR,A.DATE_DOCUMENT,M.NUMBER_REGISTRATION, TDG.PLACA,TDG.DGH,A.WAREHOUSE_ID,AOD.COD_OPER,AOD.COD_DMAY,A.WAREHOUSE_REF,B.PART_ID,M.ID,A.VENDOR_ID,A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT ORDER BY A.DATE_DOCUMENT')

declare @STRquery nvarchar(1000) declare @criterio nvarchar(1000) SET @criterio=N' WHERE 1=1' if len(@codigo)>0 set @criterio=@criterio + N' and P.MOV_ID=@codigo and TYPE_ID=@tipo '
if len(@tipo)>0 set @criterio=@criterio + N' and TYPE_ID=@tipo'
if @opcion='0' --Buscar si existe el código del tipo de transaccion set @STRquery='SELECT ID FROM TRANSACTION_TYPE P'
if @opcion='1' -- Editar datos del tipo de transacción set @STRquery='SELECT * FROM TRANSACTION_TYPE P'
if @opcion='2' -- Mostrar datos para el GRID set @STRquery='SELECT (case when TYPE_ID=''I'' then ''Ingreso'' else ''Salida'' end) as TipoMov, MOV_ID, NAME, (case when IS_VALUED=''V'' then ''Valorizado'' else ''No valorizado'' end) as Valorizado, IS_VALUED,IS_VENDOR, IS_DOC_REF, IS_AUTHORIZED, IS_CCOST, IS_ORDER_PURCHASE, IS_COMMENT, IS_WHO, IS_CUSTOMER, IS_ORDER_MANUFACT, IS_POST, IS_ACCOUNT FROM TRANSACTION_TYPE P '
