Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value: declare @STRquery nvarchar(800) set @STRquery='SELECT TYPE_ID,ID,DESCRIPTION,CADUCATE_DAYS,NIVEL,CREATE_DATE, HOUR,IS_MINUS,IS_VALUE,IS_FOB FROM MASTER_HELP where TYPE_ID=@tipo_ayuda' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@tipo_ayuda varchar(3)',@tipo_ayuda

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
SET NOCOUNT ON DECLARE @MORESMES VARCHAR(6) SET @MORESMES=@anoActual+@mesActual
IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tempdb.dbo.SYSOBJECTS WHERE XTYPE='U' AND NAME=''+@IDE+'TMPNOSALDOLOTE') BEGIN EXEC('DROP TABLE TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'TMPNOSALDOLOTE') END EXEC ('CREATE TABLE TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'TMPNOSALDOLOTE (ALMACEN VARCHAR(2),DECODIGO VARCHAR(20), SMMESPRO VARCHAR(6),LOTE VARCHAR(20),INGRESO NUMERIC(15,6),SALIDA NUMERIC(15,6),SALDO NUMERIC(15,6))')
exec ('set quoted_identifier off INSERT INTO TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'TMPNOSALDOLOTE SELECT B.WAREHOUSE_ID,B.PART_ID,"'+@MORESMES+'",B.NUMBER_LOT,SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END)AS INGRESO, SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END)as SALIDA, SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END)-SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS SALDO from WAREHOUSE_TRANS A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID=B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID = B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT = B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN PART C ON B.PART_ID=C.ID WHERE B.WAREHOUSE_ID in('+@alma+') AND A.STATUS_GUIA<>"A" AND NOT (A.DOCUMENT_ID="GS" AND A.TRANS_ID="GF" AND A.STATUS_GUIA="F") AND NOT (C.IS_STOCKED="N" AND C.SERIES="N" AND C.IS_LOT="N")AND (B.PART_ID<>"TEXTO")AND C.IS_LOT="S" and A.DATE_DOCUMENT<"01/"+"'+@mesActual+'"+"/"+"'+@anoActual+'" GROUP BY B.PART_ID,B.WAREHOUSE_ID,B.NUMBER_LOT ORDER BY B.PART_ID ASC')
declare @@cuenta2 int SET @@cuenta2=0 exec INV_EXISTEMORESMESLOT @MORESMES,@@cuenta2 output if @@cuenta2=0 BEGIN EXEC ('set quoted_identifier off insert into MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE_LOT(WAREHOUSE_ID,PART_ID,YEAR_MONTH,LOT_ID,QTY_ENTER,QTY_OUT,QTY_INITIAL, AMOUNT_US,AMOUNT,AMOUNT_PREVIOUS_US,AMOUNT_PREVIOUS,LAST_MOVE,QTY_ACT,GROUP_PART_ID,FAMILY_PART_ID,LINE_PART_ID,TYPE) select ALMACEN,DECODIGO,SMMESPRO,LOTE,0.000000,0.000000,SALDO,0.000000,0.000000,0.000000,0.000000,0.000000, 0.000000,"","","","" from TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'TMPNOSALDOLOTE') END ELSE BEGIN
exec ('set quoted_identifier off DELETE FROM MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE_LOT WHERE YEAR_MONTH="'+@MORESMES+'"') exec('set quoted_identifier off insert into MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE_LOT(WAREHOUSE_ID,PART_ID,YEAR_MONTH,LOT_ID,QTY_ENTER,QTY_OUT,QTY_INITIAL, AMOUNT_US,AMOUNT,AMOUNT_PREVIOUS_US,AMOUNT_PREVIOUS,LAST_MOVE,QTY_ACT,GROUP_PART_ID,FAMILY_PART_ID,LINE_PART_ID,TYPE) select ALMACEN,DECODIGO,SMMESPRO,LOTE,0.000000,0.000000,SALDO,0.000000,0.000000,0.000000,0.000000,0.000000, 0.000000,"","","","" from TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'TMPNOSALDOLOTE') END
IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tempdb.dbo.SYSOBJECTS WHERE XTYPE='U' AND NAME=''+@IDE+'RECALCULO_STOCK_LOTE')
BEGIN EXEC('set quoted_identifier off DROP TABLE tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'RECALCULO_STOCK_LOTE') END EXEC ('set quoted_identifier off CREATE TABLE tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'RECALCULO_STOCK_LOTE (ALMACEN VARCHAR(2),DECODIGO VARCHAR(20), SMMESPRO VARCHAR(6),LOTE VARCHAR(20),Ingresos NUMERIC(15,6),Salida NUMERIC(15,6),SALDO NUMERIC(15,6))')
EXEC ('set quoted_identifier off INSERT INTO tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'RECALCULO_STOCK_LOTE select B.WAREHOUSE_ID,B.PART_ID,"'+@MORESMES+'",B.NUMBER_LOT, SUM((CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END)) AS Ingresos, SUM((CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END)) AS Salida, SUM((CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END))-SUM((CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END))AS SALDO FROM (WAREHOUSE_TRANS A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON (A.WAREHOUSE_ID = B.WAREHOUSE_ID) AND (A.DOCUMENT_ID = B.DOCUMENT_ID) AND (A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT = B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT)) INNER JOIN PART C ON B.PART_ID = C.ID WHERE B.WAREHOUSE_ID IN('+@alma+') AND A.STATUS_GUIA<>"A" AND C.IS_LOT="S" AND NOT (A.DOCUMENT_ID="GS" AND A.TRANS_ID="GF" AND A.STATUS_GUIA="F") AND NOT (C.IS_STOCKED="N" AND C.SERIES="N" AND C.IS_LOT="N")AND (B.PART_ID<>"TEXTO") AND REPLICATE("0",2-LEN(MONTH(A.DATE_DOCUMENT)))+cast(MONTH(A.DATE_DOCUMENT) as varchar(2))='+@mesActual+' and year(A.DATE_DOCUMENT)='+@anoActual+' GROUP BY B.PART_ID,B.WAREHOUSE_ID,B.NUMBER_LOT')
IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tempdb.dbo.SYSOBJECTS WHERE XTYPE='U' AND NAME=''+@IDE+'XXX') BEGIN EXEC('set quoted_identifier off DROP TABLE TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'XXX') END EXEC ('set quoted_identifier off SELECT L.ALMACEN,L.DECODIGO,L.SMMESPRO,L.LOTE,L.Ingresos,L.Salida INTO TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'XXX FROM TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'RECALCULO_STOCK_LOTE L LEFT JOIN MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE_LOT M ON L.ALMACEN=M.WAREHOUSE_ID AND DECODIGO=M.PART_ID AND L.SMMESPRO=M.YEAR_MONTH AND LOTE=M.LOT_ID WHERE M.LOT_ID IS NULL')
EXEC ('set quoted_identifier off update M set M.QTY_ENTER=ISNULL(Ingresos,0.000000),M.QTY_OUT=ISNULL(Salida,0.000000) FROM MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE_LOT M INNER JOIN TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'RECALCULO_STOCK_LOTE t ON M.WAREHOUSE_ID=T.ALMACEN AND M.PART_ID=T.DECODIGO AND M.LOT_ID=T.LOTE WHERE M.YEAR_MONTH="'+@MORESMES+'"')
EXEC ('set quoted_identifier off INSERT INTO MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE_LOT SELECT ALMACEN,DECODIGO,SMMESPRO,LOTE,0.000000, 0.000000,0.000000,0.000000,0.000000,INGRESOs,SALIDA,0.000000,0.000000,"","","","",0.000000 from TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'XXX')

Property.Value: declare @STRquery nvarchar(200) set @STRquery='select ID,NAME from PART_TYPE order by ID' exec sp_executesql @STRquery

Property.Name: HeaderContents
Property.Value: create procedure [dbo].[INV_PART_TYPE] as

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
SET NOCOUNT ON DECLARE @Arti AS VARCHAR(20) DECLARE @Ing As numeric(15,6) DECLARE @Sal AS numeric(15,6) DECLARE @Ingchar as VARCHAR(30) DECLARE @Salchar as VARCHAR(30) DECLARE @IngRef AS numeric(15,6) DECLARE @SalRef AS numeric(15,6) DECLARE @TotalMes as VARCHAR(30) DECLARE @ARTICULOS AS VARCHAR(70) DECLARE @ARTICULOS2 AS VARCHAR(70) DECLARE @MORES AS VARCHAR(6) DECLARE @TEXTO AS VARCHAR(1000) declare @estilo as int declare @saldomoresme as varchar(30) DECLARE @ALMACEN AS VARCHAR(20) DECLARE @ALMA2 AS VARCHAR(2) DECLARE @mesSiguiente as varchar(2) DECLARE @ALMAMOR AS VARCHAR(2) DECLARE @CODIGOMORES AS int
SET @ARTICULOS=CASE WHEN @TODOS=1 THEN 'AND B.PART_ID>="'+@ART1+'" AND B.PART_ID<="'+@ART2+'" ' WHEN @TODOS=0 THEN ' ' END SET @ARTICULOS2=CASE WHEN @TODOS=1 THEN 'AND S.PART_ID>="'+@ART1+'" AND S.PART_ID<="'+@ART2+'" ' WHEN @TODOS=0 THEN ' ' END
IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tempdb.dbo.SYSOBJECTS WHERE XTYPE='U' AND NAME=''+@IDE+'TMPMORESMES')
BEGIN EXEC('DROP TABLE TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'TMPMORESMES') END
/* EXEC('set quoted_identifier off DECLARE RECALC_MORESMES1 CURSOR FOR SELECT YEAR_MONTH FROM MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE where YEAR_MONTH="'+@anoActual+@mesActual+'"') */ set quoted_identifier off DECLARE RECALC_MORESMES1 CURSOR FOR SELECT YEAR_MONTH FROM MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE where YEAR_MONTH=''+@anoActual+@mesActual+''
set @estilo=0
OPEN RECALC_MORESMES1 FETCH NEXT FROM RECALC_MORESMES1 INTO @MORES
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN set @estilo=1 FETCH NEXT FROM RECALC_MORESMES1 INTO @MORES END CLOSE RECALC_MORESMES1 DEALLOCATE RECALC_MORESMES1 if @estilo=0 begin EXEC('set quoted_identifier off select * into tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'TMPMORESMES from MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE where YEAR_MONTH="'+@anoAnt+@mesAnt+'" and WAREHOUSE_ID in('+@alma+')') EXEC('set quoted_identifier off update tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'tmpmoresmes set YEAR_MONTH="'+@anoActual+@mesActual+'", QTY_INITIAL=(QTY_INITIAL+QTY_ENTER)-QTY_OUT,QTY_ENTER=0.000000,QTY_OUT=0.000000 WHERE YEAR_MONTH="'+@anoAnt+@mesAnt+'"') EXEC('set quoted_identifier off insert into MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE select * from tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'TMPMORESMES')
EXEC('set quoted_identifier off update S set QTY_ON_HAND=ISNULL((QTY_INITIAL+QTY_ENTER)-QTY_OUT,0.000000) from PART_QTY s inner join MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE m on s.PART_ID=m.PART_ID and s.WAREHOUSE_ID=m.WAREHOUSE_ID inner join PART a on s.PART_ID=a.ID WHERE M.YEAR_MONTH="'+@anoAnt+@mesAnt+'" '+@ARTICULOS2+' and A.IS_STOCKED="S" and M.WAREHOUSE_ID in('+@alma+')') end ELSE BEGIN exec('set quoted_identifier off update S set QTY_ON_HAND=0 FROM PART_QTY S INNER JOIN PART M ON S.PART_ID=M.ID WHERE M.IS_STOCKED="S" '+@ARTICULOS2+' and S.WAREHOUSE_ID in ('+@alma+')')
IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tempdb.dbo.SYSOBJECTS WHERE XTYPE='U' AND NAME=''+@IDE+'TMPNOSALDO')
BEGIN EXEC('DROP TABLE tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'TMPNOSALDO') END EXEC('CREATE TABLE tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'TMPNOSALDO (DECODIGO VARCHAR(20),ALMACEN VARCHAR(2), INGRESO NUMERIC(15,6),SALIDA NUMERIC(15,6))')
EXEC('set quoted_identifier off INSERT INTO tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'TMPNOSALDO SELECT B.PART_ID,B.WAREHOUSE_ID,SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END)AS INGRESO, SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END)as SALIDA from WAREHOUSE_TRANS A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID = B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID = B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT = B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN PART C ON B.PART_ID = C.ID WHERE C.IS_STOCKED="S" and B.WAREHOUSE_ID in('+@alma+') AND A.STATUS_GUIA<>"A" AND NOT (A.DOCUMENT_ID="GS" AND A.TRANS_ID="GF" AND A.STATUS_GUIA="F") AND NOT (C.IS_STOCKED="N" AND C.IS_STOCKED="N" AND C.IS_LOT="N")AND (B.PART_ID<>"TEXTO") AND (cast(MONTH(A.DATE_DOCUMENT)as varchar(2))+cast(year(A.DATE_DOCUMENT)as varchar(4)))<'+@mesActual+@anoAnt+' GROUP BY B.PART_ID,B.WAREHOUSE_ID ORDER BY B.PART_ID ASC')
EXEC('set quoted_identifier off update s set QTY_ON_HAND=ISNULL(INGRESO-SALIDA,0) from PART_QTY s inner join tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'TMPNOSALDO t on s.PART_ID=t.DECODIGO and s.WAREHOUSE_ID=t.ALMACEN')
END
IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tempdb.dbo.SYSOBJECTS WHERE XTYPE='U' AND NAME=''+@IDE+'RECALCULO_STOCK')
BEGIN EXEC('DROP TABLE tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'RECALCULO_STOCK') END EXEC('CREATE TABLE tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'RECALCULO_STOCK (DECODIGO VARCHAR(20),ALMACEN VARCHAR(2), Ingresos NUMERIC(15,6),Salida NUMERIC(15,6),IngresosRef NUMERIC(15,6),SalidasRef NUMERIC(15,6))')
EXEC('set quoted_identifier off INSERT INTO TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'RECALCULO_STOCK select B.PART_ID,B.WAREHOUSE_ID, SUM((CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END)) AS Ingresos, SUM((CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END)) AS Salida, SUM((CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END))IngresosRef, SUM((CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END))SalidasRef FROM (WAREHOUSE_TRANS A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON (A.WAREHOUSE_ID = B.WAREHOUSE_ID) AND (A.DOCUMENT_ID = B.DOCUMENT_ID) AND (A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT = B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT)) INNER JOIN PART C ON B.PART_ID = C.ID WHERE C.IS_STOCKED="S" and B.WAREHOUSE_ID IN('+@alma+') AND A.STATUS_GUIA<>"A" '+@ARTICULOS+' AND NOT (A.DOCUMENT_ID="GS" AND A.TRANS_ID="GF" AND A.STATUS_GUIA="F") AND NOT (C.IS_STOCKED="N" AND C.SERIES="N" AND C.IS_LOT="N")AND (B.PART_ID<>"TEXTO") AND REPLICATE("0",2-LEN(MONTH(A.DATE_DOCUMENT)))+MONTH(A.DATE_DOCUMENT)='+@mesActual+' and year(A.DATE_DOCUMENT)='+@anoActual+' GROUP BY B.PART_ID,B.WAREHOUSE_ID')
EXEC('set quoted_identifier off UPDATE S set QTY_ON_HAND=ISNULL((QTY_ON_HAND+Ingresos)-Salida,0.000000) FROM PART_QTY s inner join tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'RECALCULO_STOCK T ON S.PART_ID=T.DECODIGO AND S.WAREHOUSE_ID=T.ALMACEN')
if @estilo=0 begin EXEC('set quoted_identifier off update m set QTY_INITIAL=(QTY_INITIAL+QTY_ENTER)-QTY_OUT FROM MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE M INNER JOIN tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'RECALCULO_STOCK T ON M.WAREHOUSE_ID=T.ALMACEN AND M.PART_ID=T.DECODIGO WHERE YEAR_MONTH="'+@anoActual+@mesActual+'"') end
/*EXEC('set quoted_identifier off DECLARE RECALC_MORESMES2 CURSOR FOR SELECT YEAR_MONTH FROM MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE where YEAR_MONTH="'+@anoAnt+@mesAnt+'"')*/ set quoted_identifier off DECLARE RECALC_MORESMES2 CURSOR FOR SELECT YEAR_MONTH FROM MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE where YEAR_MONTH=''+@anoAnt+@mesAnt+''
set @CODIGOMORES=0
OPEN RECALC_MORESMES2 FETCH NEXT FROM RECALC_MORESMES2 INTO @MORES
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN set @CODIGOMORES=1 FETCH NEXT FROM RECALC_MORESMES2 INTO @MORES END CLOSE RECALC_MORESMES2 DEALLOCATE RECALC_MORESMES2
if @CODIGOMORES=0 begin EXEC('set quoted_identifier off UPDATE M SET QTY_ENTER=Ingresos,QTY_OUT=Salida FROM MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE M INNER JOIN tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'RECALCULO_STOCK T ON M.WAREHOUSE_ID=T.ALMACEN AND M.PART_ID=T.DECODIGO WHERE YEAR_MONTH="'+@anoActual+@mesActual+'"') end else begin IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tempdb.dbo.SYSOBJECTS WHERE XTYPE='U' AND NAME=''+@IDE+'saldo')
BEGIN EXEC('DROP TABLE TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'saldo') END EXEC('create TABLE tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'saldo (SALDO NUMERIC(15,6),ALMACEN varchar(2),DECODIGO varchar(20))') EXEC ('set quoted_identifier off INSERT INTO tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'saldo SELECT (QTY_INITIAL+QTY_ENTER)-QTY_OUT,WAREHOUSE_ID,PART_ID FROM MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE M INNER JOIN tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'RECALCULO_STOCK T ON M.WAREHOUSE_ID=T.ALMACEN AND M.PART_ID=T.DECODIGO WHERE YEAR_MONTH="'+@anoAnt+@mesAnt+'"')
EXEC('set quoted_identifier off UPDATE M SET QTY_ENTER=Ingresos,QTY_OUT=Salida FROM MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE M INNER JOIN tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'RECALCULO_STOCK T ON M.WAREHOUSE_ID=T.ALMACEN AND M.PART_ID=T.DECODIGO WHERE YEAR_MONTH="'+@anoActual+@mesActual+'"')
EXEC('set quoted_identifier off UPDATE M SET QTY_INITIAL=SALDO FROM MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE M INNER JOIN tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'saldo s ON M.WAREHOUSE_ID=s.ALMACEN AND M.PART_ID=s.DECODIGO inner join tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'RECALCULO_STOCK T ON M.WAREHOUSE_ID=T.ALMACEN AND M.PART_ID=T.DECODIGO where YEAR_MONTH="'+@anoActual+@mesActual+'"')
end

Property.Name: HeaderContents
Property.Value: CREATE procedure [dbo].[INV_RECALCULO_STOCK] --DECLARE @IDE AS VARCHAR(80), @alma AS VARCHAR(250),@mesAnt AS VARCHAR(2),@anoAnt AS VARCHAR(4), @mesActual AS VARCHAR(2),@anoActual AS VARCHAR(4),@ART1 AS VARCHAR(20), @ART2 AS VARCHAR(20),@TODOS AS VARCHAR(1) --SET @BASE='008BDCOMUN' --SET @IDE='PC_D05' --SET @alma='"01"' --SET @mesAnt='08' --SET @anoAnt='2004' --SET @mesActual='09' --SET @anoActual='2004' --SET @ART1='' --SET @ART2='' --SET @TODOS='0' ---WITH ENCRYPTION AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
SET NOCOUNT ON SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER off
DECLARE @Arti AS VARCHAR(20) DECLARE @Ing AS numeric(15,6) DECLARE @Sal AS numeric(15,6) DECLARE @LOT AS VARCHAR(20) DECLARE @TOTSTK AS VARCHAR(30) DECLARE @ALMACEN AS VARCHAR(500) DECLARE @IngRef AS numeric(15,6) DECLARE @SalRef AS numeric(15,6) DECLARE @TOTSTKREF AS VARCHAR(30)
EXEC ('set quoted_identifier off update PART_QTY set QTY_ON_HAND=0,QTY_REFERENCE=0 where WAREHOUSE_ID in ('+@alma+')') /* EXEC ('set quoted_identifier off DECLARE RECALC_STOCK_STKART CURSOR FOR SELECT B.PART_ID,B.WAREHOUSE_ID,SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END)AS INGRESO, SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END)as SALIDA, SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END)AS INGRESOREF, SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END)AS SALIDAREF
from WAREHOUSE_TRANS A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID = B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID = B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT = B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN PART C ON B.PART_ID= C.ID WHERE A.WAREHOUSE_ID in('+@alma+') AND A.STATUS_GUIA<>"A" AND NOT (A.DOCUMENT_ID="GS" AND A.TRANS_ID="GF" AND A.STATUS_GUIA="F") AND NOT (C.IS_STOCKED="N" AND C.SERIES="N" AND C.IS_LOT="N")AND (B.PART_ID<>"TEXTO") and A.DATE_DOCUMENT<"01/"+"'+@mesPOST+'"+"/"+"'+@anoPOST+'" GROUP BY B.PART_ID,B.WAREHOUSE_ID ORDER BY B.PART_ID ASC') */ set quoted_identifier off DECLARE RECALC_STOCK_STKART CURSOR FOR SELECT B.PART_ID,B.WAREHOUSE_ID,SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS='I' THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END)AS INGRESO, SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS='S' THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END)as SALIDA, SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS='I' THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END)AS INGRESOREF, SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS='S' THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END)AS SALIDAREF
from WAREHOUSE_TRANS A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID = B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID = B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT = B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN PART C ON B.PART_ID= C.ID WHERE --A.WAREHOUSE_ID in(''+@alma+'') AND A.STATUS_GUIA<>'A' AND NOT (A.DOCUMENT_ID='GS' AND A.TRANS_ID='GF' AND A.STATUS_GUIA='F') AND NOT (C.IS_STOCKED='N' AND C.SERIES='N' AND C.IS_LOT='N')AND (B.PART_ID<>'TEXTO') and A.DATE_DOCUMENT<'01/'+''+@mesPOST+''+'/'+''+@anoPOST+'' GROUP BY B.PART_ID,B.WAREHOUSE_ID ORDER BY B.PART_ID ASC
OPEN RECALC_STOCK_STKART FETCH NEXT FROM RECALC_STOCK_STKART INTO @Arti,@ALMACEN,@Ing,@Sal,@IngRef,@SalRef
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS =0 BEGIN
SET @TOTSTK= @Ing - @Sal SET @TOTSTKREF=@IngRef - @SalRef
declare @cuenta int declare @cuenta2 int
exec INV_STKART @ALMACEN,@Arti,@cuenta2 output if @cuenta2=0 begin EXEC ('set quoted_identifier off insert into PART_QTY(WAREHOUSE_ID,PART_ID,QTY_ON_HAND,QTY_REFERENCE)values("'+@ALMACEN+'","'+@Arti+'",'+@TOTSTK+','+@TOTSTKREF+')') end else begin EXEC ('set quoted_identifier off UPDATE PART_QTY SET QTY_ON_HAND=QTY_ON_HAND+'+@TOTSTK+',QTY_REFERENCE=QTY_REFERENCE+'+@TOTSTKREF+' where PART_ID="'+@Arti+'" and WAREHOUSE_ID="'+@ALMACEN+'"') end
FETCH NEXT FROM RECALC_STOCK_STKART INTO @Arti,@ALMACEN,@Ing,@Sal,@IngRef,@SalRef END
CLOSE RECALC_STOCK_STKART DEALLOCATE RECALC_STOCK_STKART

Property.Name: HeaderContents
Property.Value: CREATE procedure [dbo].[INV_RECALCULO_STOCK_ARTICULOS] --DECLARE @alma AS VARCHAR(500),@mesPOST AS VARCHAR(10),@anoPOST AS VARCHAR(10) /* SET @alma='"01","02","03"' SET @mesPOST='07' SET @anoPOST='2005'*/ AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
SET NOCOUNT ON DECLARE @Arti AS VARCHAR(20) DECLARE @Ing AS numeric(15,6) DECLARE @Sal AS numeric(15,6) DECLARE @LOT AS VARCHAR(20) DECLARE @TOTSTK AS VARCHAR(30) DECLARE @ALMACEN AS VARCHAR(500)
EXEC('set quoted_identifier off update S set S.QTY_ON_HAND=0 from WAREHOUSE_TRANS A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID = B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID = B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT = B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN PART C ON B.PART_ID = C.ID inner join PART_QTY S ON S.PART_ID=B.PART_ID AND S.WAREHOUSE_ID=B.WAREHOUSE_ID where B.WAREHOUSE_ID in('+@alma+') AND A.STATUS_GUIA<>"A" AND NOT (A.DOCUMENT_ID="GS" AND A.TRANS_ID="GF" AND A.STATUS_GUIA="F") AND NOT (C.IS_STOCKED="N" AND C.SERIES="N" AND C.IS_LOT="N")AND (B.PART_ID<>"TEXTO")AND C.IS_LOT="S" and A.DATE_DOCUMENT<"01/"+"'+@mesPOST+'"+"/"+"'+@anoPOST+'"')
exec('set quoted_identifier off update S set S.QTY_ON_HAND=0 from WAREHOUSE_TRANS A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID = B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID = B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT = B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN PART C ON B.PART_ID = C.ID inner join PART_QTY S ON S.PART_ID=B.PART_ID AND S.WAREHOUSE_ID=B.WAREHOUSE_ID where B.WAREHOUSE_ID in('+@alma+') AND A.STATUS_GUIA<>"A" AND NOT (A.DOCUMENT_ID="GS" AND A.TRANS_ID="GF" AND A.STATUS_GUIA="F") AND NOT (C.IS_STOCKED="N" AND C.SERIES="N" AND C.IS_LOT="N")AND (B.PART_ID<>"TEXTO")AND C.IS_LOT="S" and A.DATE_DOCUMENT<"01/"+"'+@mesPOST+'"+"/"+"'+@anoPOST+'"')
/*exec('set quoted_identifier off DECLARE RECALC_STOCK_L CURSOR FOR SELECT B.PART_ID,B.WAREHOUSE_ID,B.NUMBER_LOT,SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END)AS INGRESO, SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END)as SALIDA from WAREHOUSE_TRANS A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID=B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID=B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN PART C ON B.PART_ID=C.ID WHERE B.WAREHOUSE_ID in('+@alma+') AND A.STATUS_GUIA<>"A" AND NOT (A.DOCUMENT_ID="GS" AND A.TRANS_ID="GF" AND A.STATUS_GUIA="F") AND NOT (C.IS_STOCKED="N" AND C.SERIES="N" AND C.IS_LOT="N")AND (B.PART_ID<>"TEXTO")AND C.IS_LOT="S" and A.DATE_DOCUMENT<"01/"+"'+@mesPOST+'"+"/"+"'+@anoPOST+'" GROUP BY B.PART_ID,B.WAREHOUSE_ID,B.NUMBER_LOT ORDER BY B.PART_ID ASC') */ set quoted_identifier off DECLARE RECALC_STOCK_L CURSOR FOR SELECT B.PART_ID,B.WAREHOUSE_ID,B.NUMBER_LOT,SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS='I' THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END)AS INGRESO, SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS='S' THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END)as SALIDA from WAREHOUSE_TRANS A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID=B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID=B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN PART C ON B.PART_ID=C.ID WHERE --B.WAREHOUSE_ID in(''+ @alma +'') AND A.STATUS_GUIA<>'A' AND NOT (A.DOCUMENT_ID='GS' AND A.TRANS_ID='GF' AND A.STATUS_GUIA='F') AND NOT (C.IS_STOCKED='N' AND C.SERIES='N' AND C.IS_LOT='N')AND (B.PART_ID<>'TEXTO')AND C.IS_LOT='S' and A.DATE_DOCUMENT<'01/'+@mesPOST+'/'+@anoPOST+'' GROUP BY B.PART_ID,B.WAREHOUSE_ID,B.NUMBER_LOT ORDER BY B.PART_ID ASC
OPEN RECALC_STOCK_L FETCH NEXT FROM RECALC_STOCK_L INTO @Arti,@ALMACEN,@LOT,@Ing,@Sal
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS =0 BEGIN
SET @TOTSTK=@Ing-@Sal declare @cuenta int declare @cuenta2 int
exec INV_STKLOTE @ALMACEN,@Arti,@LOT,@cuenta output if @cuenta=0 begin exec('set quoted_identifier off insert into LOT(WHO_ID,PART_ID,LOT_ID,QTY_ON_HAND)values("'+@ALMACEN+'","'+@Arti+'","'+@LOT+'","'+@TOTSTK+'")') end else begin exec('set quoted_identifier off UPDATE LOT SET QTY_ON_HAND=QTY_ON_HAND+'+@TOTSTK+' where WHO_ID="'+@ALMACEN+'" and PART_ID="'+@Arti+'" and LOT_ID="'+@LOT+'"') end
exec INV_STKART @ALMACEN,@Arti,@cuenta2 output if @cuenta2=0 begin exec('set quoted_identifier off insert into PART_QTY(WAREHOUSE_ID,PART_ID,QTY_ON_HAND)values("'+@ALMACEN+'","'+@Arti+'","'+@TOTSTK+'")') end else begin exec('set quoted_identifier off UPDATE PART_QTY SET QTY_ON_HAND=QTY_ON_HAND+'+@TOTSTK+' where PART_ID="'+@Arti+'" and WAREHOUSE_ID="'+@ALMACEN+'"') end
FETCH NEXT FROM RECALC_STOCK_L INTO @Arti,@ALMACEN,@LOT,@Ing,@Sal END
CLOSE RECALC_STOCK_L DEALLOCATE RECALC_STOCK_L

CREATE procedure [dbo].[INV_RECALCULO_STOCK_LOTE] --DECLARE @alma AS VARCHAR(500),@mesPOST AS VARCHAR(2),@anoPOST AS VARCHAR(4)
/*SET @alma='"01","02"' SET @mesPOST='05' SET @anoPOST='2007' --*/AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
SET NOCOUNT ON DECLARE @Arti AS VARCHAR(20) DECLARE @Ing AS numeric(15,6) DECLARE @Sal AS numeric(15,6) DECLARE @IngRef AS numeric(15,6) DECLARE @SalRef AS numeric(15,6) DECLARE @TotalMes as VARCHAR(20) DECLARE @ARTICULOS AS VARCHAR(100) DECLARE @SER AS VARCHAR(20) DECLARE @CODSER AS VARCHAR(20) DECLARE @TOTSTK AS VARCHAR(30) DECLARE @ALMACEN AS VARCHAR(2) declare @STRquery nvarchar(2300) declare @table_variable_name varchar(200)
IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tempdb.dbo.SYSOBJECTS WHERE XTYPE='U' AND NAME=''+@IDE+'RECALCULO_SERIE') BEGIN EXEC('set quoted_identifier off DROP TABLE tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'RECALCULO_SERIE') END EXEC('set quoted_identifier off CREATE TABLE tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'RECALCULO_SERIE(DECODIGO VARCHAR(20),DELOTE VARCHAR(20), DESERIE VARCHAR(20),DEALMA VARCHAR(2),Ingresos NUMERIC(15,6),IngresosRef NUMERIC(15,6))')
EXEC('set quoted_identifier off INSERT INTO tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'RECALCULO_SERIE select B.PART_ID,B.NUMBER_LOT,B.NUMBER_SERIE,B.WAREHOUSE_ID, SUM((CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END))-SUM((CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END)) AS Ingresos, SUM((CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END))-SUM((CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END))AS IngresosRef FROM (WAREHOUSE_TRANS A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON (A.WAREHOUSE_ID=B.WAREHOUSE_ID) AND (A.DOCUMENT_ID=B.DOCUMENT_ID) AND (A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT)) INNER JOIN PART C ON B.PART_ID=C.ID WHERE B.WAREHOUSE_ID IN ('+@alma+') AND A.STATUS_GUIA<>"A" AND C.SERIES="S" AND NOT (A.DOCUMENT_ID="GS" AND A.TRANS_ID="GF" AND A.STATUS_GUIA="F") AND B.PART_ID<>"TEXTO" GROUP BY B.PART_ID,B.NUMBER_LOT,B.NUMBER_SERIE,B.WAREHOUSE_ID ORDER BY B.PART_ID ASC')
set @table_variable_name='tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'RECALCULO_SERIE'
exec ('set quoted_identifier off DECLARE @Arti AS VARCHAR(20) DECLARE @Ing AS numeric(15,6) DECLARE @TOTSTK AS VARCHAR(30) DECLARE @ALMACEN AS VARCHAR(2) DECLARE RECALC_STOCK_S CURSOR FOR SELECT DECODIGO,DEALMA,SUM(Ingresos)AS INGRESO FROM '+@table_variable_name+' WHERE Ingresos=1 GROUP BY DECODIGO,DEALMA
OPEN RECALC_STOCK_S FETCH NEXT FROM RECALC_STOCK_S INTO @Arti,@ALMACEN,@ing
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS =0 BEGIN exec(''set quoted_identifier off update PART_QTY set QTY_ON_HAND=0 where PART_ID="'+@Arti+'" and WAREHOUSE_ID="'+@ALMACEN+'"'') exec(''set quoted_identifier off update STOCK_SERIE SET QTY_ON_HAND=0 WHERE PART_ID="'+@Arti+'" AND WAREHOUSE_ID="'+@ALMACEN+'"'')
set @TOTSTK=@ing exec(''set quoted_identifier off UPDATE PART_QTY SET QTY_ON_HAND='+@TOTSTK+' where PART_ID="'+@Arti+'" and WAREHOUSE_ID="'+@ALMACEN+'"'')
exec(''set quoted_identifier off UPDATE STOCK_SERIE SET QTY_ON_HAND=1 WHERE SERIE IN(SELECT DESERIE FROM tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'RECALCULO_SERIE WHERE Ingresos=1)'')
FETCH NEXT FROM RECALC_STOCK_S INTO @Arti,@ALMACEN,@ing END
CLOSE RECALC_STOCK_S DEALLOCATE RECALC_STOCK_S ')

Property.Name: BodyScript

declare @tabla nvarchar(100) declare @tabla1 nvarchar(100) declare @tabla2 nvarchar(100) declare @STRquery nvarchar(2000) begin set @tabla=N'[tempdb].dbo.'+@pc+'MOVI_ANALISIS' set @tabla1=N'[tempdb].dbo.'+@pc+'SALINI_FAM' set @tabla2=N'[tempdb].dbo.'+@pc+'SALINIXFAM' end set @STRquery='select F.ID,F.NAME,M.FAMILY,M.type_trans,M.TRANS_ID,M.CURRENCY_TYPE,M.DOCUMENT_ID, M.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,M.DATE_DOCUMENT,M.PART_ID,M.QTY,M.AMOUNT,M.AMOUNT_US, SF.SALDOCANT as SALDOCANT_SF,SF.SALDOMN as SALDOMN_SF,SF.SALDOME as SALDOME_SF, S.SALDOCANT,S.SALDOMN,S.SALDOME, T.NAME as NAME_T from FAMILY F inner join '+@tabla+ ' M on F.ID=M.FAMILY left join '+@tabla1+ ' sf on SF.FAMILY=M.FAMILY left join '+@tabla2+ ' s on M.FAMILY=S.FAMILY and M.TYPE_TRANS=S.TYPE_TRANS and M.TRANS_ID=S.TRANS_ID inner join TRANSACTION_TYPE T on M.TYPE_TRANS=T.TYPE_ID and M.TRANS_ID=T.MOV_ID'
exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@pc nvarchar(80)',@pc

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value: declare @tabla nvarchar(100) declare @tabla1 nvarchar(100) declare @STRquery nvarchar(2000) begin set @tabla=N'[tempdb].dbo.'+@pc+'RPTANALISFAM' set @tabla1=N'[tempdb].dbo.'+@pc+'SALINIXFAM' end set @STRquery='select F.ID,F.NAME,A.FAMILIA,A.TIPMOV,A.COD_MOV,A.INGRESOSMN, A.SALIDASMN,A.INGRESOSME,A.SALIDASME, A.INGRESOSCANT,A.SALIDASCANT,A.DESTRANSA, S.SALDOCANT,S.SALDOMN,S.SALDOME from FAMILY F inner join '+@tabla+ ' A on F.ID=A.FAMILIA left join '+@tabla1+ ' S on A.FAMILIA=S.FAMILY and A.TIPMOV=S.TYPE_TRANS and A.COD_MOV=S.TRANS_ID' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@pc nvarchar(80)',@pc

declare @STRquery nvarchar(2000) declare @STRorden nvarchar(200) set @STRorden=N' ' if @orden=0 set @STRorden=@STRorden + N' order by ID' if @orden=1 set @STRorden=@STRorden + N' order by DESCRIPTION' if @orden=2 set @STRorden=@STRorden + N' order by CREATE_DATE'
if @opcion=0 set @STRquery='select ID,ID_FAB,DESCRIPTION,DESCRIPTION_OPT,FAMILY, MODEL,UNIT_OF_MEASUREMENT,GROUP_ID,ACCOUNT, SERIES,UNIT_PRICE,DISCOUNT,PRICE_BUY,VENDOR_ID_PART, convert(varchar(10),CREATE_DATE,103) as CREATE_DATE,LOCATION,IS_STOCKED,CREATE_USER,STATUS, DATE_CADUCATE,CURRENCY_ID,TYPE_PART,COMMENT,IS_LOT, WEIGHT,CST_POR,VAT_POR,HOUR_UPDATE,IS_FREE_PRICE, IS_PRICE_VAT,COMMISSION_SALES,IS_VAT,COLOR,MARK, PICTURE,HEIGHT,REFERENCE,ID_AUTONUMERIC,LAST_DATE_BUY from PART where(FAMILY is null or len(FAMILY)=0) and CREATE_DATE>=@fecini and CREATE_DATE<=@fecfin and ID in(select distinct(PART_ID) from WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE )' + @STRorden if @opcion=1 set @STRquery='select ID,ID_FAB,DESCRIPTION,DESCRIPTION_OPT,FAMILY, MODEL,UNIT_OF_MEASUREMENT,GROUP_ID,ACCOUNT, SERIES,UNIT_PRICE,DISCOUNT,PRICE_BUY,VENDOR_ID_PART, convert(varchar(10),CREATE_DATE,103) as CREATE_DATE,LOCATION,IS_STOCKED,CREATE_USER,STATUS, DATE_CADUCATE,CURRENCY_ID,TYPE_PART,COMMENT,IS_LOT, WEIGHT,CST_POR,VAT_POR,HOUR_UPDATE,IS_FREE_PRICE, IS_PRICE_VAT,COMMISSION_SALES,IS_VAT,COLOR,MARK, PICTURE,HEIGHT,REFERENCE,ID_AUTONUMERIC,LAST_DATE_BUY from PART where (FAMILY is null or len(FAMILY)=0) and CREATE_DATE>=@fecini and CREATE_DATE<=@fecfin and ID not in(select distinct(PART_ID) from WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE )'+ @STRorden if @opcion=2 set @STRquery='select ID,ID_FAB,DESCRIPTION,DESCRIPTION_OPT,FAMILY, MODEL,UNIT_OF_MEASUREMENT,GROUP_ID,ACCOUNT, SERIES,UNIT_PRICE,DISCOUNT,PRICE_BUY,VENDOR_ID_PART, convert(varchar(10),CREATE_DATE,103) as CREATE_DATE,LOCATION,IS_STOCKED,CREATE_USER,STATUS, DATE_CADUCATE,CURRENCY_ID,TYPE_PART,COMMENT,IS_LOT, WEIGHT,CST_POR,VAT_POR,HOUR_UPDATE,IS_FREE_PRICE, IS_PRICE_VAT,COMMISSION_SALES,IS_VAT,COLOR,MARK, PICTURE,HEIGHT,REFERENCE,ID_AUTONUMERIC,LAST_DATE_BUY from PART where (FAMILY is null or len(FAMILY)=0) and CREATE_DATE>=@fecini and CREATE_DATE<=@fecfin'+ @STRorden
exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@fecini int,@fecfin int,@opcion char(1), @orden char(1)',@fecini,@fecfin,@opcion,@orden

Property.Name: HeaderContents
Property.Value: CREATE procedure [dbo].[INV_RPT_CARRIER] --DECLARE @orden char(1) as

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
declare @STRquery nvarchar(2500) declare @tabla nvarchar(80) declare @staanul char(1),@guiasal char(2),@guiafac char(2) declare @stafac char(1),@isno char(1),@texto char(5) declare @filtro nvarchar(200)
if @opcion='0' --crea temporal begin if exists(select * from tempdb.dbo.sysobjects where name=@pc) begin set @tabla=N'[tempdb].dbo.'+@pc set @STRquery='drop table '+ @tabla exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@pc nvarchar(80),@opcion char(1)', @pc,@opcion end set @tabla='[tempdb].dbo.'+@pc set @STRquery='create table '+@tabla+ '(ITEM int,PART_ID varchar(20),DOCUMENT_DATE smalldatetime, TIME varchar(8),IS_IN_OUT varchar(1),TRANS_ID varchar(2), TYPE_DOC varchar(2),WAREHOUSE_ID varchar(2), NUMBER_DOC varchar(20),QTY_INITIAL float default 0.00,QTY_IN float, QTY_OUT float,QTY_BALANCE float, UNIT_PRICE float,INIT_VALUE float,IN_VALUE float, OUT_VALUE float,END_VALUE float, AVERAGE_COST float,IS_VALUE bit default(0))' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@pc nvarchar(80),@opcion char(1)', @pc,@opcion end
if @opcion='1' --consulta begin set @staanul='A' set @guiasal='GS' set @guiafac='GF' set @stafac='F' set @isno='N' set @texto='TEXTO'
if len(@tipoart)>0 set @filtro= N' AND M.TYPE_PART=@tipoart order by A.PART_ID,B.DATE_DOCUMENT,B.TYPE_TRANS,B.TRANS_ID,B.WAREHOUSE_ID, B.DOCUMENT_ID,B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,A.ITEM' else set @filtro= N' order by A.PART_ID,B.DATE_DOCUMENT,B.TYPE_TRANS,B.TRANS_ID,B.WAREHOUSE_ID, B.DOCUMENT_ID,B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,A.ITEM'
set @STRquery='select A.*,B.* from WAREHOUSE_TRANS B inner join (WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE A left join PART M on A.PART_ID=M.ID ) on B.WAREHOUSE_ID = A.WAREHOUSE_ID AND B.DOCUMENT_ID=A.DOCUMENT_ID AND B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT where month(B.DATE_DOCUMENT) =@mes and year(B.DATE_DOCUMENT) =@anyo and B.STATUS_GUIA<>@staanul and not (B.DOCUMENT_ID=@guiasal and B.TRANS_ID=@guiafac and B.STATUS_GUIA=@stafac) and not (M.IS_STOCKED=@isno and M.SERIES=@isno and M.IS_LOT=@isno) and (A.PART_ID>=@codini and A.PART_ID<=@codfin) and (A.PART_ID<>@texto)' + @filtro exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@opcion char(1), @mes char(2),@anyo char(4),@codini char(20),@codfin char(20),@tipoart char(4), @staanul char(1),@guiasal char(2),@guiafac char(2),@stafac char(1), @isno char(1),@texto char(5)', @opcion,@mes,@anyo,@codini,@codfin,@tipoart, @staanul,@guiasal,@guiafac,@stafac,@isno,@texto end
if @opcion='2' --consulta agrupada moresmes begin set @STRquery='select PART_ID,YEAR_MONTH,AMOUNT,AMOUNT_US, sum(QTY_INITIAL) as QTY_INITIAL, sum(QTY_ENTER) as QTY_ENTER, sum(QTY_OUT) as QTY_OUT from MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE where YEAR_MONTH >=@anyomesant AND YEAR_MONTH <=@anyomes AND (PART_ID>=@codini AND PART_ID<=@codfin) group by PART_ID,YEAR_MONTH,AMOUNT,AMOUNT_US order by YEAR_MONTH' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@opcion char(1), @anyomesant char(6),@anyomes char(6),@codini char(20),@codfin char(20)', @opcion,@anyomesant,@anyomes,@codini,@codfin end
if @opcion='3' --consulta moresmes begin set @STRquery='select * from MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE where YEAR_MONTH >=@anyomesant AND YEAR_MONTH <=@anyomes AND (PART_ID>=@codini AND PART_ID<=@codfin) ORDER BY YEAR_MONTH' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@opcion char(1), @anyomesant char(6),@anyomes char(6),@codini char(20),@codfin char(20)', @opcion,@anyomesant,@anyomes,@codini,@codfin end
if @opcion='4' --Consulta stock y partes begin if len(@tipoart)>0 set @filtro=N' AND B.TYPE_PART=@tipoart' else set @filtro=N''
set @STRquery='select distinct(A.PART_ID) from PART_QTY A inner join PART B on A.PART_ID=B.ID where (A.PART_ID>=@codini and A.PART_ID<=@codfin)' + @filtro exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@opcion char(1), @codini char(20),@codfin char(20),@tipoart char(4)', @opcion,@codini,@codfin,@tipoart end
if @opcion='5' --Consulta para armar el reporte begin set @tabla=N'[tempdb].dbo.'+@pc set @STRquery='select I.ITEM,I.PART_ID,I.DOCUMENT_DATE,I.TIME,I.IS_IN_OUT,I.TRANS_ID, I.TYPE_DOC,I.WAREHOUSE_ID,I.NUMBER_DOC,I.QTY_INITIAL,I.QTY_IN, I.QTY_OUT,I.QTY_BALANCE,I.UNIT_PRICE,I.INIT_VALUE,I.IN_VALUE, I.OUT_VALUE,I.END_VALUE,I.AVERAGE_COST,I.IS_VALUE, P.DESCRIPTION,P.UNIT_OF_MEASUREMENT,W.CURRENCY_EXCHANGE from '+ @tabla +' I inner join PART P on I.PART_ID=P.ID left join WAREHOUSE_TRANS W on W.WAREHOUSE_ID=I.WAREHOUSE_ID and I.TYPE_DOC=W.DOCUMENT_ID AND I.NUMBER_DOC=W.NUMBER_DOCUMENT WHERE PART_ID<>''N0005'' ORDER BY IS_IN_OUT,NUMBER_DOC' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@pc nvarchar(80),@opcion char(1)', @pc,@opcion end --select * from tempdb.dbo.DEVELOPER03INVENTORY --exec dbo.INV_RPT_INVENTARIO_VAL_MENSUAL 'DEVELOPER03INVENTORY', '5', ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', --' ', ' ', ' ' --select * from inventory where part_id='R0001' --select * from inventory where part_id='E0001'

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
SET NOCOUNT ON SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER off
DECLARE @ARTICULOS AS VARCHAR(70) DECLARE @ARTICULOS2 AS VARCHAR(70) DECLARE @anomesAnt AS VARCHAR(6) DECLARE @Arti AS VARCHAR(20) DECLARE @Arti2 AS VARCHAR(20) DECLARE @DESCRI AS VARCHAR(64) DECLARE @ALMACEN AS VARCHAR(2) DECLARE @ing AS NUMERIC(15,6) DECLARE @SAL AS NUMERIC(15,6) DECLARE @INGREF AS NUMERIC(15,6) DECLARE @SALREF AS NUMERIC(15,6) DECLARE @SALDO AS varchar(30) DECLARE @SALDOREF AS varchar(30) declare @fecha1 AS varchar(10) declare @fecha2 AS varchar(10)
set @fecha1=str(@fechaINI) set @fecha2=str(@fechaFIN)
SET @ARTICULOS=CASE WHEN @TODOS=1 THEN 'AND B.PART_ID>="'+@ART1+'" AND B.PART_ID<="'+@ART2+'" ' WHEN @TODOS=0 THEN ' ' END SET @ARTICULOS2=CASE WHEN @TODOS=1 THEN 'AND SMCODIGO>="'+@ART1+'" AND SMCODIGO<="'+@ART2+'" ' WHEN @TODOS=0 THEN ' ' END
IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tempdb.dbo.SYSOBJECTS WHERE XTYPE='U' AND NAME=''+@IDE+'KARDEXSQL') BEGIN EXEC('DROP TABLE TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'KARDEXSQL') END
EXEC ('CREATE TABLE TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'KARDEXSQL(CODIGO VARCHAR(20),DESCRIPCION VARCHAR(64)NULL, UNIDAD VARCHAR(6)NULL,UMREFERENCIA VARCHAR(6)NULL,CAFECDOC datetime,CAALMA VARCHAR(2)NULL,CATD VARCHAR(2)NULL,CANUMDOC VARCHAR(10)NULL, CATIPMOV VARCHAR(1)NULL,CACODMOV VARCHAR(2)NULL,CARFTDOC VARCHAR(2)NULL,CARFNDOC VARCHAR(10)NULL,CANOMPRO VARCHAR(100)NULL, CANOMCLI VARCHAR(100)NULL,CACODCLI VARCHAR(11)NULL,DECENCOS VARCHAR(10)NULL,DEORDFAB VARCHAR(10)NULL, DELOTE VARCHAR(20)NULL,DESERIE VARCHAR(20)NULL,SALDO NUMERIC(15,6)DEFAULT(0),ENTRADA NUMERIC(15,6)DEFAULT(0), SALIDA NUMERIC(15,6)DEFAULT(0),SALDOREF NUMERIC(15,6)DEFAULT(0),ENTRADAREF NUMERIC(15,6)DEFAULT(0),SALIDAREF NUMERIC(15,6)DEFAULT(0))')
IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tempdb.dbo.sysobjects WHERE XTYPE='U' AND NAME=''+@IDE+'saldo') BEGIN EXEC('DROP TABLE TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'saldo') END EXEC (' SELECT B.PART_ID,C.DESCRIPTION,B.WAREHOUSE_ID,SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END)AS INGRESO, SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END)as SALIDA, SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END)AS INGRESOREF, SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END)AS SALIDAREF, SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END)-SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS SALDOMOV, SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END)-SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END) AS SALDOREF into tempdb.dbo.'+@ide+'saldo from WAREHOUSE_TRANS A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID=B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID=B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN PART C ON B.PART_ID=C.ID WHERE A.WAREHOUSE_ID in("'+@alma+'") AND A.STATUS_GUIA<>"A" AND NOT (A.DOCUMENT_ID="GS" AND A.TRANS_ID="GF" AND A.STATUS_GUIA="F") AND NOT (C.IS_STOCKED="N" AND C.SERIES="N" AND C.IS_LOT="N")AND (B.PART_ID<>"TEXTO")'+@ARTICULOS+' and A.DATE_DOCUMENT<'+@fecha1+' GROUP BY B.PART_ID,C.DESCRIPTION,B.WAREHOUSE_ID ORDER BY B.PART_ID ASC')
EXEC ('DECLARE RECORRE_CODIGOS CURSOR FOR select B.PART_ID from WAREHOUSE_TRANS A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID=B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID=B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN PART C ON B.PART_ID=C.ID WHERE A.WAREHOUSE_ID in("'+@alma+'") AND A.STATUS_GUIA<>"A" AND NOT (A.DOCUMENT_ID="GS" AND A.TRANS_ID="GF" AND A.STATUS_GUIA="F") AND NOT (C.IS_STOCKED="N" AND C.SERIES="N" AND C.IS_LOT="N")AND (B.PART_ID<>"TEXTO")'+@ARTICULOS+' GROUP BY B.PART_ID,C.DESCRIPTION,B.WAREHOUSE_ID ORDER BY B.PART_ID ASC')
OPEN RECORRE_CODIGOS FETCH NEXT FROM RECORRE_CODIGOS INTO @Arti
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS =0 BEGIN EXEC ('INSERT INTO tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'KARDEXSQL (CODIGO,DESCRIPCION,SALDO,SALDOREF) select PART_ID,DESCRIPTION,SALDOMOV,SALDOREF from tempdb.dbo.'+@ide+'saldo where PART_ID="'+@Arti+'" AND(saldomov<>0)')
EXEC ('INSERT INTO tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'KARDEXSQL (CODIGO,DESCRIPCION,UNIDAD,UMREFERENCIA,CAFECDOC,CAALMA,CATD,CANUMDOC,CATIPMOV, CACODMOV,CARFTDOC,CARFNDOC,CANOMPRO,CANOMCLI,CACODCLI,DECENCOS,DEORDFAB,DELOTE,DESERIE,SALDO, ENTRADA,SALIDA,SALDOREF,ENTRADAREF,SALIDAREF)
SELECT B.PART_ID,C.DESCRIPTION,C.UNIT_OF_MEASUREMENT,C.REFERENCE,A.DATE_DOCUMENT,A.WAREHOUSE_ID,A.DOCUMENT_ID,A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,A.TYPE_TRANS, A.TRANS_ID,A.DOC_ID_REF,A.NUM_ID_REF,(CASE WHEN A.DOCUMENT_ID="TD" THEN "ALMACEN"+" "+A.WAREHOUSE_ID ELSE (CASE WHEN B.CCOST_ID<>"" THEN "C.C. "+B.CCOST_ID ELSE (CASE WHEN B.ORDER_MANUFACT_ID<>"" THEN "O.F. "+B.ORDER_MANUFACT_ID ELSE (SELECT NAME FROM VENDOR P WHERE A.VENDOR_ID=P.ID) END) END) END)AS CANOMPROV,M.NAME,A.CUSTOMER_ID,B.CCOST_ID,B.ORDER_MANUFACT_ID,B.NUMBER_LOT,B.NUMBER_SERIE,0, (CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END), (CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END),0, (CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END), (CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END) from WAREHOUSE_TRANS A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID=B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID=B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN PART C ON B.PART_ID=C.ID LEFT JOIN CUSTOMER M ON A.CUSTOMER_ID=M.ID WHERE A.WAREHOUSE_ID in("'+@alma+'") AND A.STATUS_GUIA<>"A" AND NOT (A.DOCUMENT_ID="GS" AND A.TRANS_ID="GF" AND A.STATUS_GUIA="F") AND NOT (C.IS_STOCKED="N" AND C.SERIES="N" AND C.IS_LOT="N")AND (B.PART_ID<>"TEXTO") and B.PART_ID="'+@Arti+'" and A.DATE_DOCUMENT>='+@fecha1+' AND A.DATE_DOCUMENT<='+@fecha2+' AND (B.QTY>0)ORDER BY B.PART_ID,A.DATE_DOCUMENT,A.TYPE_TRANS,A.DOCUMENT_ID,A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT ASC')
FETCH NEXT FROM RECORRE_CODIGOS INTO @Arti END
CLOSE RECORRE_CODIGOS DEALLOCATE RECORRE_CODIGOS
IF @TODOSMOV=1 BEGIN EXEC ('INSERT INTO tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'KARDEXSQL (CODIGO,DESCRIPCION,UNIDAD,ENTRADA,SALIDA,ENTRADAREF,SALIDAREF) SELECT B.PART_ID,B.PART_DESCRIPTION,B.UNIT_PART,(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END), (CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END), (CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END), (CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END) from WAREHOUSE_TRANS A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID=B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID=B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN PART_QTY C ON B.PART_ID=C.PART_ID WHERE A.WAREHOUSE_ID in("'+@alma+'") AND A.STATUS_GUIA<>"A" and B.PART_ID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT CODIGO FROM tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'KARDEXSQL) and A.DATE_DOCUMENT>="01/"+"'+@mesActual+'"+"/"+"'+@anoAct+'" AND A.DATE_DOCUMENT<='+@fecha1+' ORDER BY B.PART_ID,A.DATE_DOCUMENT,A.TYPE_TRANS,A.DOCUMENT_ID,A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT ASC') END
declare @STRquery nvarchar(1500) declare @tabla nvarchar(80) set @tabla=N'[tempdb].dbo.'+@IDE+'KARDEXSQL' SET @STRquery='select CODIGO,DESCRIPCION,UNIDAD,UMREFERENCIA,convert(varchar(10),CAFECDOC,103) as CAFECDOC, CAALMA,CATD,CANUMDOC,CATIPMOV,CACODMOV,CARFTDOC, CARFNDOC,CANOMPRO,CANOMCLI,CACODCLI,DECENCOS, DEORDFAB,DELOTE,DESERIE,SALDO,ENTRADA,SALIDA, SALDOREF,ENTRADAREF,SALIDAREF from '+@tabla exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@IDE AS varchar(80)',@IDE

CREATE procedure [dbo].[INV_RPT_KARDEX] --DECLARE @IDE AS VARCHAR(80), @alma AS VARCHAR(10),@fechaINI int, @fechaFIN int,@ART1 AS VARCHAR(70),@ART2 AS VARCHAR(70), @TODOSMOV AS VARCHAR(1),@TODOS AS VARCHAR(1), @mesAnt AS VARCHAR(2),@anoAnt AS VARCHAR(4),@mesActual AS VARCHAR(2), @anoAct AS VARCHAR(4) /* SET @IDE='ACONTABLE02' SET @alma='01' SET @fechaINI=39917 SET @fechaFIN=39978 SET @ART1='A0001' SET @ART2='V0002' SET @TODOSMOV='0' set @TODOS='0' SET @mesAnt='03' SET @anoAnt='2009' SET @mesActual='04' set @anoAct='2009'
--*/as

SET NOCOUNT ON SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER off
DECLARE @ARTICULOS AS VARCHAR(70) DECLARE @ARTICULOS2 AS VARCHAR(70) DECLARE @anomesAnt AS VARCHAR(6) DECLARE @Arti AS VARCHAR(20) DECLARE @Arti2 AS VARCHAR(20) DECLARE @DESCRI AS VARCHAR(64) DECLARE @ALMACEN AS VARCHAR(2) DECLARE @ing AS NUMERIC(15,6) DECLARE @SAL AS NUMERIC(15,6) DECLARE @INGREF AS NUMERIC(15,6) DECLARE @SALREF AS NUMERIC(15,6) DECLARE @SALDO AS varchar(30) DECLARE @SALDOREF AS varchar(30) declare @fecha1 AS varchar(10) declare @fecha2 AS varchar(10) DECLARE @UF VARCHAR(5) declare @STRquery nvarchar(1500) declare @tabla nvarchar(80)
set @fecha1=str(@fechaINI) set @fecha2=str(@fechaFIN)
SET @ARTICULOS=CASE WHEN @TODOS=1 THEN ' AND B.PART_ID>="'+@ART1+'" AND B.PART_ID<="'+@ART2+'" ' WHEN @TODOS=0 THEN ' ' END SET @ARTICULOS2=CASE WHEN @TODOS=1 THEN 'AND SMCODIGO>="'+@ART1+'" AND SMCODIGO<="'+@ART2+'" ' WHEN @TODOS=0 THEN ' ' END
SET @ALMA=SUBSTRING(@ALMA,1,2) IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tempdb.dbo.SYSOBJECTS WHERE XTYPE='U' AND NAME=''+@IDE+'KARDEXSQL') BEGIN EXEC('DROP TABLE TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'KARDEXSQL') END
EXEC ('CREATE TABLE TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'KARDEXSQL(CODIGO VARCHAR(20),DESCRIPCION VARCHAR(64)NULL, UNIDAD VARCHAR(6)NULL,UMREFERENCIA VARCHAR(6)NULL,CAFECDOC datetime,CAALMA VARCHAR(2)NULL,CATD VARCHAR(2)NULL,CANUMDOC VARCHAR(10)NULL, CATIPMOV VARCHAR(1)NULL,CACODMOV VARCHAR(2)NULL,CARFTDOC VARCHAR(2)NULL,CARFNDOC VARCHAR(10)NULL,CANOMPRO VARCHAR(100)NULL, CANOMCLI VARCHAR(100)NULL,CACODCLI VARCHAR(11)NULL,DECENCOS VARCHAR(10)NULL,DEORDFAB VARCHAR(10)NULL, DELOTE VARCHAR(20)NULL,DESERIE VARCHAR(20)NULL,SALDO NUMERIC(15,6)DEFAULT(0),ENTRADA NUMERIC(15,6)DEFAULT(0), SALIDA NUMERIC(15,6)DEFAULT(0),SALDOREF NUMERIC(15,6)DEFAULT(0),ENTRADAREF NUMERIC(15,6)DEFAULT(0),SALIDAREF NUMERIC(15,6)DEFAULT(0),TYPE_PART VARCHAR(2)NULL)')
IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tempdb.dbo.sysobjects WHERE XTYPE='U' AND NAME=''+@IDE+'saldo') BEGIN EXEC('DROP TABLE TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'saldo') END EXEC (' SELECT B.PART_ID,C.DESCRIPTION,B.WAREHOUSE_ID,SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END)AS INGRESO, SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END)as SALIDA, SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END)AS INGRESOREF, SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END)AS SALIDAREF, SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END)-SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS SALDOMOV, SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END)-SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END) AS SALDOREF,C.TYPE_PART into tempdb.dbo.'+@ide+'saldo from WAREHOUSE_TRANS A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID=B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID=B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN PART C ON B.PART_ID=C.ID WHERE A.WAREHOUSE_ID in("'+@alma+'") AND A.STATUS_GUIA<>"A" AND B.NUMBER_LOT="'+@LOTE+'" AND NOT (A.DOCUMENT_ID="GS" AND A.TRANS_ID="GF" AND A.STATUS_GUIA="F") AND NOT (C.IS_STOCKED="N" AND C.SERIES="N" AND C.IS_LOT="N")AND (B.PART_ID<>"TEXTO")'+@ARTICULOS+' and A.DATE_DOCUMENT<'+@fecha1+' GROUP BY B.PART_ID,C.DESCRIPTION,B.WAREHOUSE_ID,C.TYPE_PART ORDER BY B.PART_ID ASC')
EXEC ('DECLARE RECORRE_CODIGOS CURSOR FOR select B.PART_ID from WAREHOUSE_TRANS A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID=B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID=B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN PART C ON B.PART_ID=C.ID WHERE A.WAREHOUSE_ID in("'+@alma+'") AND B.NUMBER_LOT="'+@LOTE+'" AND A.STATUS_GUIA<>"A" AND NOT (A.DOCUMENT_ID="GS" AND A.TRANS_ID="GF" AND A.STATUS_GUIA="F") AND NOT (C.IS_STOCKED="N" AND C.SERIES="N" AND C.IS_LOT="N")AND (B.PART_ID<>"TEXTO")'+@ARTICULOS+' GROUP BY B.PART_ID,C.DESCRIPTION,B.WAREHOUSE_ID ORDER BY B.PART_ID ASC')
OPEN RECORRE_CODIGOS FETCH NEXT FROM RECORRE_CODIGOS INTO @Arti
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS =0 BEGIN EXEC ('INSERT INTO tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'KARDEXSQL (CODIGO,DESCRIPCION,SALDO,SALDOREF,TYPE_PART) select PART_ID,DESCRIPTION,SALDOMOV,SALDOREF,TYPE_PART from tempdb.dbo.'+@ide+'saldo where PART_ID="'+@Arti+'" AND(saldomov<>0)')
EXEC ('INSERT INTO tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'KARDEXSQL (CODIGO,DESCRIPCION,UNIDAD,UMREFERENCIA,CAFECDOC,CAALMA,CATD,CANUMDOC,CATIPMOV, CACODMOV,CARFTDOC,CARFNDOC,CANOMPRO,CANOMCLI,CACODCLI,DECENCOS,DEORDFAB,DELOTE,DESERIE,SALDO, ENTRADA,SALIDA,SALDOREF,ENTRADAREF,SALIDAREF,TYPE_PART)
SELECT B.PART_ID,C.DESCRIPTION,C.UNIT_OF_MEASUREMENT,C.REFERENCE,A.DATE_DOCUMENT,A.WAREHOUSE_ID,A.DOCUMENT_ID,A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,A.TYPE_TRANS, A.TRANS_ID,A.DOC_ID_REF,A.NUM_ID_REF,(CASE WHEN A.DOCUMENT_ID="TD" THEN "ALMACEN"+" "+A.WAREHOUSE_ID ELSE (CASE WHEN B.CCOST_ID<>"" THEN "C.C. "+B.CCOST_ID ELSE (CASE WHEN B.ORDER_MANUFACT_ID<>"" THEN "O.F. "+B.ORDER_MANUFACT_ID ELSE (SELECT NAME FROM VENDOR P WHERE A.VENDOR_ID=P.ID) END) END) END)AS CANOMPROV,M.NAME,A.CUSTOMER_ID,B.CCOST_ID,B.ORDER_MANUFACT_ID,B.NUMBER_LOT,B.NUMBER_SERIE,0, (CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END), (CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END),0, (CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END), (CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END),C.TYPE_PART from WAREHOUSE_TRANS A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID=B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID=B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN PART C ON B.PART_ID=C.ID LEFT JOIN CUSTOMER M ON A.CUSTOMER_ID=M.ID WHERE A.WAREHOUSE_ID in("'+@alma+'") AND B.NUMBER_LOT="'+@LOTE+'" AND A.STATUS_GUIA<>"A" AND NOT (A.DOCUMENT_ID="GS" AND A.TRANS_ID="GF" AND A.STATUS_GUIA="F") AND NOT (C.IS_STOCKED="N" AND C.SERIES="N" AND C.IS_LOT="N")AND (B.PART_ID<>"TEXTO") and B.PART_ID="'+@Arti+'" and A.DATE_DOCUMENT>='+@fecha1+' AND A.DATE_DOCUMENT<='+@fecha2+' AND (B.QTY>0)ORDER BY B.PART_ID,A.DATE_DOCUMENT,A.TYPE_TRANS,A.DOCUMENT_ID,A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT ASC')
FETCH NEXT FROM RECORRE_CODIGOS INTO @Arti END
CLOSE RECORRE_CODIGOS DEALLOCATE RECORRE_CODIGOS
IF @TODOSMOV=1 BEGIN EXEC ('INSERT INTO tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'KARDEXSQL (CODIGO,DESCRIPCION,UNIDAD,ENTRADA,SALIDA,ENTRADAREF,SALIDAREF,TYPE_PART) SELECT B.PART_ID,B.PART_DESCRIPTION,B.UNIT_PART,(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END), (CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END), (CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END), (CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END) ,D.TYPE_PART from WAREHOUSE_TRANS A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID=B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID=B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN PART_QTY C ON B.PART_ID=C.PART_ID INNER JOIN PART D C.PART_ID=D.ID WHERE A.WAREHOUSE_ID in("'+@alma+'") AND B.NUMBER_LOT="'+@LOTE+'" AND A.STATUS_GUIA<>"A" and B.PART_ID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT CODIGO FROM tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'KARDEXSQL) and A.DATE_DOCUMENT>="01/"+"'+@mesActual+'"+"/"+"'+@anoAct+'" AND A.DATE_DOCUMENT<='+@fecha1+' ORDER BY B.PART_ID,A.DATE_DOCUMENT,A.TYPE_TRANS,A.DOCUMENT_ID,A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT ASC') END
set @tabla=N'[tempdb].dbo.'+@IDE+'KARDEXSQL' SET @STRquery='select CODIGO,DESCRIPCION,UNIDAD,UMREFERENCIA,convert(varchar(10),CAFECDOC,103) as CAFECDOC, CAALMA,CATD,CANUMDOC,CATIPMOV,CACODMOV,CARFTDOC, CARFNDOC,CANOMPRO,CANOMCLI,CACODCLI,DECENCOS, DEORDFAB,DELOTE,DESERIE,SALDO,ENTRADA,SALIDA, SALDOREF,ENTRADAREF,SALIDAREF,TYPE_PART from '+@tabla exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@IDE AS varchar(80)',@IDE
--***************************************************************************************************************************************

CREATE procedure INV_RPT_KARDEX_CON_LOTES --DECLARE @IDE AS VARCHAR(80), @alma AS VARCHAR(10),@fechaINI int, @fechaFIN int,@ART1 AS VARCHAR(70),@ART2 AS VARCHAR(70), @TODOSMOV AS VARCHAR(1),@TODOS AS VARCHAR(1), @mesAnt AS VARCHAR(2),@anoAnt AS VARCHAR(4),@mesActual AS VARCHAR(2), @anoAct AS VARCHAR(4),@LOTE VARCHAR(10) /* SET @IDE='ACONTABLE02' SET @alma='01' SET @fechaINI=39917 SET @fechaFIN=39978 SET @ART1='A0001' SET @ART2='V0002' SET @TODOSMOV='0' set @TODOS='0' SET @mesAnt='03' SET @anoAnt='2009' SET @mesActual='04' set @anoAct='2009'

declare @tabla nvarchar(100) declare @STRquery nvarchar(2000) begin set @tabla=N'[tempdb].dbo.'+@pc+'KARDEXAUX' end
set @STRquery='select K.c1, K.c2, K.c3, K.c4,K.c5, K.c6, K.c7, K.c8, K.c9, K.c10, K.c11, K.c12, K.TIPDOCRF, K.NUMDOCRF, K.NOMREFE,K.CATIPMOV, M.DESCRIPTION, M.UNIT_OF_MEASUREMENT FROM '+@tabla+' K, PART M where K.c1 = M.ID ORDER BY K.c1 ASC,K.c3 ASC,K.c2 ASC,K.c5 ASC,K.c11 ASC' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@pc nvarchar(80)',@pc

BodyScript
Property.Value:
declare @STRquery nvarchar(2500) declare @tabla nvarchar(80) declare @staanul char(1),@guiasal char(2),@guiafac char(2) declare @stafac char(1),@isno char(1),@texto char(5) declare @filtro nvarchar(200)
if @opcion='0' --crea temporal begin if exists(select * from tempdb.dbo.sysobjects where name=@pc) begin set @tabla=N'[tempdb].dbo.'+@pc set @STRquery='drop table '+ @tabla exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@pc nvarchar(80),@opcion char(1)', @pc,@opcion end set @tabla='[tempdb].dbo.'+@pc set @STRquery='create table '+@tabla+ '(PART_ID varchar(20), DOCUMENT_DATE smalldatetime,HOUR varchar(8), TRANS_ID varchar(2),TYPE_TRANS varchar(2),NUMBER_DOC varchar(20),QTY float, UNIT_PRICE float,AVERAGE_COST float,STOCK_BALANCE float,FAMILY_ID varchar(10), IS_SER_LOT varchar(20),IS_POST bit default(0),IN_OUT varchar(20), WAREHOUSE_ID varchar(2),ITEM int)' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@pc nvarchar(80),@opcion char(1)', @pc,@opcion end
if @opcion='1' --consulta begin set @staanul='A' set @guiasal='GS' set @guiafac='GF' set @stafac='F' set @isno='N' set @texto='TEXTO'
if len(@tipoart)>0 set @filtro= N' AND M.TYPE_PART=@tipoart order by A.PART_ID,B.DATE_DOCUMENT,B.TYPE_TRANS,B.TRANS_ID,B.WAREHOUSE_ID, B.DOCUMENT_ID,B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,A.ITEM' else set @filtro= N' order by A.PART_ID,B.DATE_DOCUMENT,B.TYPE_TRANS,B.TRANS_ID,B.WAREHOUSE_ID, B.DOCUMENT_ID,B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,A.ITEM'
set @STRquery='select A.*,B.* from WAREHOUSE_TRANS B inner join (WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE A left join PART M on A.PART_ID=M.ID ) on B.WAREHOUSE_ID = A.WAREHOUSE_ID AND B.DOCUMENT_ID=A.DOCUMENT_ID AND B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT where month(B.DATE_DOCUMENT) =@mes and year(B.DATE_DOCUMENT) =@anyo and B.STATUS_GUIA<>@staanul and not (B.DOCUMENT_ID=@guiasal and B.TRANS_ID=@guiafac and B.STATUS_GUIA=@stafac) and not (M.IS_STOCKED=@isno and M.SERIES=@isno and M.IS_LOT=@isno) and (A.PART_ID>=@codini and A.PART_ID<=@codfin) and (A.PART_ID<>@texto)' + @filtro exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@opcion char(1), @mes char(2),@anyo char(4),@codini char(20),@codfin char(20),@tipoart char(4), @staanul char(1),@guiasal char(2),@guiafac char(2),@stafac char(1), @isno char(1),@texto char(5)', @opcion,@mes,@anyo,@codini,@codfin,@tipoart, @staanul,@guiasal,@guiafac,@stafac,@isno,@texto end
if @opcion='2' --consulta agrupada moresmes begin set @STRquery='select PART_ID,YEAR_MONTH,AMOUNT,AMOUNT_US, sum(QTY_INITIAL) as QTY_INITIAL, sum(QTY_ENTER) as QTY_ENTER, sum(QTY_OUT) as QTY_OUT from MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE where YEAR_MONTH >=@anyomesant AND YEAR_MONTH <=@anyomes AND (PART_ID>=@codini AND PART_ID<=@codfin) group by PART_ID,YEAR_MONTH,AMOUNT,AMOUNT_US order by YEAR_MONTH' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@opcion char(1), @anyomesant char(6),@anyomes char(6),@codini char(20),@codfin char(20)', @opcion,@anyomesant,@anyomes,@codini,@codfin end
if @opcion='3' --consulta moresmes begin set @STRquery='select * from MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE where YEAR_MONTH >=@anyomesant AND YEAR_MONTH <=@anyomes AND (PART_ID>=@codini AND PART_ID<=@codfin) ORDER BY YEAR_MONTH' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@opcion char(1), @anyomesant char(6),@anyomes char(6),@codini char(20),@codfin char(20)', @opcion,@anyomesant,@anyomes,@codini,@codfin end
if @opcion='4' --Consulta stock y partes begin if len(@tipoart)>0 set @filtro=N' AND B.TYPE_PART=@tipoart' else set @filtro=N''
set @STRquery='select distinct(A.PART_ID) from PART_QTY A inner join PART B on A.PART_ID=B.ID where (A.PART_ID>=@codini and A.PART_ID<=@codfin)' + @filtro exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@opcion char(1), @codini char(20),@codfin char(20),@tipoart char(4)', @opcion,@codini,@codfin,@tipoart end
if @opcion='5' begin set @tabla=N'[tempdb].dbo.'+@pc set @STRquery='select K.PART_ID,K.DOCUMENT_DATE,K.HOUR,K.TRANS_ID,K.TYPE_TRANS, K.NUMBER_DOC,K.QTY,K.UNIT_PRICE,K.AVERAGE_COST, K.STOCK_BALANCE,K.FAMILY_ID,K.IS_SER_LOT,K.IS_POST, K.IN_OUT,K.WAREHOUSE_ID,K.ITEM,P.DESCRIPTION,W.CURRENCY_EXCHANGE from '+@tabla+ ' K inner join PART P on K.PART_ID=P.ID inner join WAREHOUSE_TRANS W ON K.WAREHOUSE_ID=W.WAREHOUSE_ID and K.TYPE_TRANS=W.DOCUMENT_ID and K.NUMBER_DOC=W.NUMBER_DOCUMENT' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@pc nvarchar(80),@opcion char(1)', @pc,@opcion end
if @opcion='6' begin set @tabla=N'[tempdb].dbo.'+@pc set @STRquery='select K.PART_ID,K.DOCUMENT_DATE,K.HOUR,K.TRANS_ID,K.TYPE_TRANS, K.NUMBER_DOC,K.QTY,K.UNIT_PRICE,K.AVERAGE_COST,K.STOCK_BALANCE, K.FAMILY_ID,K.IS_SER_LOT,K.IS_POST,K.IN_OUT,K.WAREHOUSE_ID,K.ITEM, P.DESCRIPTION,P.UNIT_OF_MEASUREMENT from '+@tabla+ ' K inner join PART P on K.PART_ID=P.ID' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@pc nvarchar(80),@opcion char(1)', @pc,@opcion end

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
declare @STRquery nvarchar(2000) declare @tabla nvarchar(80) declare @STRfiltro nvarchar(1000) declare @staanul char(1),@guiasal char(2),@guiafac char(2) declare @stafac char(1),@isno char(1),@texto char(5)
if @opcion='0' --crea temporal begin if exists(select * from tempdb.dbo.sysobjects where name=@pc) begin set @tabla=N'[tempdb].dbo.'+@pc set @STRquery='drop table '+ @tabla exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@pc nvarchar(80),@opcion char(1)', @pc,@opcion end set @tabla='[tempdb].dbo.'+@pc set @STRquery='create table '+@tabla+ '(PART_ID varchar(20), DOCUMENT_DATE smalldatetime,HOUR varchar(8), TRANS_ID varchar(2),TYPE_TRANS varchar(2),NUMBER_DOC varchar(20),QTY float, UNIT_PRICE float,AVERAGE_COST float,STOCK_BALANCE float,FAMILY_ID varchar(10), IS_SER_LOT varchar(20),IS_POST bit default(0),IN_OUT varchar(20), WAREHOUSE_ID varchar(2),ITEM int)' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@pc nvarchar(80),@opcion char(1)', @pc,@opcion end
if @opcion='1' begin if @orden='0' set @STRfiltro=N' order by P.ID asc' else set @STRfiltro=N' order by P.ID desc'
set @STRquery='select top 1 P.ID,P.DESCRIPTION,P.UNIT_OF_MEASUREMENT,P.ID_FAB from PART P, PART_QTY N where P.ID= N.PART_ID and N.WAREHOUSE_ID=@almacen ' + @STRfiltro
exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@opcion char(1),@almacen char(3), @orden char(1)',@opcion,@almacen,@orden end
if @opcion='2' begin set @staanul='A' set @guiasal='GS' set @guiafac='GF' set @stafac='F' set @isno='N' set @texto='TEXTO'
if len(@partini)>0 set @STRfiltro=N' and (A.PART_ID>=@partini and A.PART_ID<=@partfin) order by A.PART_ID,B.DATE_DOCUMENT,B.TYPE_TRANS,B.TRANS_ID,B.WAREHOUSE_ID,B.DOCUMENT_ID,B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,A.ITEM' if len(@partini)=0 set @STRfiltro=N' order by A.PART_ID,B.DATE_DOCUMENT,B.TYPE_TRANS,B.TRANS_ID,B.WAREHOUSE_ID,B.DOCUMENT_ID,B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,A.ITEM'
set @STRquery='select A.* , B.* from WAREHOUSE_TRANS B inner join (WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE A left join PART M on A.PART_ID=M.ID) on B.WAREHOUSE_ID=A.WAREHOUSE_ID and B.DOCUMENT_ID=A.DOCUMENT_ID and B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT where month(B.DATE_DOCUMENT)=@mes and year(B.DATE_DOCUMENT)=@anyo and B.STATUS_GUIA<>@staanul and not (B.DOCUMENT_ID=@guiasal and B.TRANS_ID=@guiafac and B.STATUS_GUIA=@stafac) and not(M.IS_STOCKED=@isno and M.SERIES=@isno and M.IS_LOT=@isno) and (A.PART_ID<>@texto) '+@STRfiltro exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@opcion char(1),@partini char(20),@partfin char(20), @mes char(2),@anyo char(4),@staanul char(1),@guiasal char(2),@guiafac char(2),@stafac char(1),@isno char(1),@texto char(5)', @opcion,@partini,@partfin,@mes,@anyo,@staanul,@guiasal,@guiafac,@stafac,@isno,@texto end
if @opcion='3' begin set @STRquery='select PART_ID,YEAR_MONTH,AMOUNT_US,AMOUNT, sum(QTY_INITIAL) as QTY_INITIAL,sum(QTY_ENTER) as QTY_ENTER, sum(QTY_OUT) as QTY_OUT from MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE where YEAR_MONTH >=@anyomesant group by PART_ID,YEAR_MONTH,AMOUNT_US,AMOUNT order by YEAR_MONTH' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@opcion char(1),@anyomesant char(6)', @opcion,@anyomesant end
if @opcion='4' begin set @STRquery='select * from MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE where YEAR_MONTH >=@anyomesant order by YEAR_MONTH' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@opcion char(1),@anyomesant char(6)', @opcion,@anyomesant end
if @opcion='5' begin if len(@partini)=0 and len(@partfin)=0 set @STRfiltro=N'' else set @STRfiltro=N' AND (P.PART_ID>=@partini AND P.PART_ID<=@partfin)'
set @STRquery='SELECT P.WAREHOUSE_ID, P.PART_ID, P.QTY_ON_HAND FROM PART_QTY P WHERE P.WAREHOUSE_ID=@almacen '+ @STRfiltro
exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@opcion char(1),@partini char(20),@partfin char(20), @almacen char(3)',@opcion,@partini,@partfin,@almacen end
if @opcion='6' begin set @tabla=N'[tempdb].dbo.'+@pc set @STRquery='SELECT K.PART_ID,K.DOCUMENT_DATE,K.HOUR,K.TRANS_ID, K.TYPE_TRANS,K.NUMBER_DOC, K.QTY,UNIT_PRICE,K.AVERAGE_COST,K.STOCK_BALANCE,K.FAMILY_ID, K.IS_SER_LOT,K.IS_POST,K.IN_OUT,K.WAREHOUSE_ID,K.ITEM, P.DESCRIPTION FROM @tabla K inner join PART P on K.PART_ID=P.ID' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@opcion char(1),@pc nvarchar(80)', @pc,@opcion end

BodyScript
Property.Value:
declare @STRquery nvarchar(1000) declare @criterio nvarchar(1000) SET @criterio=N' WHERE 1=1'
if not len(@codini)=0 and not len(@codfin)=0 set @criterio=@criterio + N' and P.ID between @codini and @codfin order by P.ID'
if not len(@descripcion)=0 set @criterio=@criterio + N' order by P.DESCRIPTION'
if not len(@famini)=0 and not len(@famfin)=0 set @criterio=@criterio + N' and F.ID between @famini and @famfin order by P.ID'
if not len(@codfabini)=0 and not len(@codfabfin)=0 set @criterio=@criterio + N' and P.ID_FAB between @codfabini and @codfabfin order by P.ID'
if not len(@tippart)=0 set @criterio=@criterio + N' and P.TYPE_PART=@tippart'
--Armo select simple set @STRquery='Select P.ID,P.ID_FAB,P.DESCRIPTION,P.DESCRIPTION_OPT,P.FAMILY,P.MODEL ,P.UNIT_OF_MEASUREMENT,P.GROUP_ID,P.ACCOUNT,P.SERIES,P.UNIT_PRICE,P.LOCATION ,P.IS_STOCKED,P.STATUS,P.CURRENCY_ID,P.TYPE_PART,P.COMMENT,P.IS_LOT from PART P' --Armo el select, solo hace un inner caso sea familia if not len(@famini)=0 and not len(@famfin)=0 set @STRquery='Select P.ID,P.ID_FAB,P.DESCRIPTION,P.DESCRIPTION_OPT,P.FAMILY,P.MODEL ,P.UNIT_OF_MEASUREMENT,P.GROUP_ID,P.ACCOUNT,P.SERIES,P.UNIT_PRICE,P.LOCATION ,P.IS_STOCKED,P.STATUS,P.CURRENCY_ID,P.TYPE_PART,P.COMMENT,P.IS_LOT,F.NAME AS NOMFAMILIA, L.NAME AS NOMLINEA,G.NAME AS NOMGROUP from PART P inner join FAMILY F on P.FAMILY=F.ID left join LINES L on P.MODEL=L.ID and F.ID=L.FAMILY_ID left join GROUPS G ON P.GROUP_ID=G.ID and P.FAMILY=G.FAMILY_ID and P.MODEL=G.LINE_ID'
--Armo el select, solo hace un inner caso sea por tipo de artículo if not len(@tippart)=0 set @STRquery='Select P.ID,P.ID_FAB,P.DESCRIPTION,P.DESCRIPTION_OPT,P.FAMILY,P.MODEL ,P.UNIT_OF_MEASUREMENT,P.GROUP_ID,P.ACCOUNT,P.SERIES,P.UNIT_PRICE,P.LOCATION ,P.IS_STOCKED,P.STATUS,P.CURRENCY_ID,P.TYPE_PART,P.COMMENT,P.IS_LOT,PT.NAME from PART P inner join PART_TYPE PT on P.TYPE_PART=PT.ID'
--Concateno segun filtro de criterio set @STRquery=@STRquery + @criterio exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@codini varchar(20),@codfin varchar(20),@descripcion char(1), @famini varchar(8),@famfin varchar(8),@codfabini varchar(40), @codfabfin varchar(40),@tippart varchar(2)', @codini,@codfin,@descripcion,@famini,@famfin, @codfabini,@codfabfin,@tippart

Property.Value:
declare @STRquery nvarchar(4000) set @STRquery='select D.WAREHOUSE_ID,D.DOCUMENT_ID,D.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,D.ITEM, D.PART_ID,D.REF_ID,D.QTY,D.QTY_DLV,D.QTY_REF,D.QTY_INVOICED,D.NUM_ORDER,D.UNIT_PRICE,D.AVERAGE_COST,D.AMOUNT_SALES,D.DISCOUNT,D.STOCK,D.AMOUNT_TAX, D.AMOUNT,D.AMOUNT_US,D.NUMBER_SERIE,D.STATUS_DOC,convert(varchar(10),D.DATE_DOC,103) as DATE_DOC, D.CCOST_ID,D.WAREHOUSE_REF,D.TEXT_COMMENT,D.STATUS,D.TRANS_ID,D.VAL_AMOUNT,D.NUM_VOUCHER, D.CURRENCY_ID,D.TYPE,D.TYPE_EXCHANGE,D.PRICE_SALES,D.TOTAL_SALES, D.DATE_CADUCATE,D.RETURN_AMOUNT,D.AUTHORIZED,D.PART_DESCRIPTION, D.DISCOUNT_PERCENT,D.TAX_PERCENT,D.DISCOUNT_CUST,D.DISCOUNT_SP, D.NUMBER_INVOICE,D.NUMBER_LOT,D.UNIT_PART,D.QTY_BRUTE,D.DISCOUNT_PER_QTY, D.FREIGTH, D.ITEMI, D.COMMENT, D.STATUS_VALUE, D.UNIT_REFERENCE, D.QTY_REFERENCE, C.WAREHOUSE_ID as ALMACEN,C.DOCUMENT_ID AS DOCUMENTO, C.NUMBER_DOCUMENT AS NUMERO,convert(varchar(10),C.DATE_DOCUMENT,103) as DATE_DOCUMENT,C.TYPE_TRANS,C.TRANS_ID, C.DOCUMENT_STATUS,C.DOC_ID_REF,C.NUM_ID_REF,C.AUTORIZED_ID,C.DATE_RETURN, C.VENDOR_ID,C.CCOST_ID,C.WAREHOUSE_REF,C.COMMENT as COMENTARIO,C.UPDATE_DATE, C.HOUR,C.USER_ID,C.CUSTOMER_ID,C.VAT_REGISTRATION,C.CUSTOMER_NAME, C.SALES_TERM,C.CURRENCY_TYPE,C.SALES_ID,C.CURRENCY_EXCHANGE,C.TYPE_GUIA, C.STATUS_GUIA,C.RECEIVABLE_GUIA,C.ADDR_DLV,C.CARRIER_ID,C.NUMBER_PURCHASE, C.IS_GUIA_RETURN,C.VENDOR_NAME,C.NUMBER_ORDER,C.NUMBER_ESTIMATING, C.DISCOUNT_PER_CUST,C.DISCOUNT_PER_SP,C.AMOUNT,C.CARRIER_NAME,C.CARRIER_ADDR, C.CARRIER_VAT,C.NUMBER_REGISTRATION,C.NUMBER_IMPORT,C.NUMBER_LIQ, C.PRINTER_STATUS,C.STATUS_CLOSE,C.TYPE_SHIPPER,C.ZONE_FREIGHT,C.IS_GUIA, C.IS_POST,C.FREIGHT,C.ORDER_REF,C.COST, T.NAME,P.NAME as NOMPROVE, M.ID as CODCLI,M.NAME as NOMCLI,tt.NAME as NAMETRANS, A.DESCRIPTION as NOMPARTE,A.ID_FAB,A.DESCRIPTION_OPT, A.UNIT_OF_MEASUREMENT,A.WEIGHT,A.REFERENCE as UMR,S.ID as CODCENCOS, S.NAME as NOMCENCOS,T1.NAME AS ALMACENOPT,D.ACCOUNT ,PJ.ID AS COD_PRO,PJ.DESCRIPTION AS DES_PRO,D.PROJECT_ID,LT.CADUCATE_DATE AS FEC_VEN_LOT, cr.VAT_REGISTRATION as tran_ruc, cr.NUMBER_DOCUMENT as tran_dni, cr.NAME_CARRIER as tran_nombre, cr.ADDR as tran_dir,cr.PHONE as tran_telefo, cr.NUMBER_REGISTRATION as tran_placa, cr.NUMBER_LICENsE as tran_brevete, cr.MODEL_VEH as tran_modelo, cr.NUMBER_INSCRIP as tran_num_inscrip,cr.NAME as tran_razon_social, cr.vat_registration_comp as tran_Empruc, cr.addr_comp as tran_Empdir, cr.phone_comp as tran_Emptelefono, tr.description as alm_tramo_des, c.addr_dlv as alm_clidirEntrega, m.addr as cli_direccion, m.addr_dlv as cli_direEntrega, vh.placa, vh.marca, vh.modelo, vh.capacidad, et.razon_social, et.ruc from WAREHOUSE_TRANS C inner join WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE D on C.WAREHOUSE_ID=D.WAREHOUSE_ID and C.DOCUMENT_ID=D.DOCUMENT_ID and C.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=D.NUMBER_DOCUMENT inner join WAREHOUSE T on C.WAREHOUSE_ID=T.ID left join WAREHOUSE T1 on C.WAREHOUSE_REF=T1.ID inner join TRANSACTION_TYPE TT on C.TYPE_TRANS=TT.TYPE_ID and C.TRANS_ID=TT.MOV_ID left join CUSTOMER M on c.CUSTOMER_ID=M.ID inner join PART A on D.PART_ID=A.ID left join VENDOR P on C.VENDOR_ID=P.ID left JOIN CCOST S ON D.CCOST_ID=S.ID LEFT JOIN PROYECT PJ ON PJ.ID=C.PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN LOT LT ON LT.PART_ID=D.PART_ID AND LT.WHO_ID=D.WAREHOUSE_ID AND LT.LOT_ID=D.NUMBER_LOT left join carrier cr on cr.id=c.carrier_id left join tramas tr on c.trama_id=tr.id left join vehiculos vh on c.VEHICULO_ID=vh.codigo left join emp_Transporte et on c.EMPTRA_ID=et.codigo
where C.WAREHOUSE_ID=@almacen and C.DOCUMENT_ID=@tipo and C.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=@numero' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@almacen char(2),@tipo char(2),@numero char(10)',@almacen,@tipo,@numero print @STRquery

BodyScript
Property.Value: declare @STRquery nvarchar(3000) set @STRquery='select D.WAREHOUSE_ID,D.DOCUMENT_ID,D.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,D.ITEM, D.PART_ID,D.REF_ID,D.QTY,D.QTY_DLV,D.QTY_REF,D.QTY_INVOICED,D.NUM_ORDER, D.CCOST_ID,D.WAREHOUSE_REF,D.TEXT_COMMENT,D.STATUS,D.TRANS_ID,D.VAL_AMOUNT,D.NUM_VOUCHER, D.CURRENCY_ID,D.TYPE,D.TYPE_EXCHANGE,D.PRICE_SALES,D.TOTAL_SALES, D.DATE_CADUCATE,D.RETURN_AMOUNT,D.AUTHORIZED,D.PART_DESCRIPTION, D.DISCOUNT_PERCENT,D.TAX_PERCENT,D.DISCOUNT_CUST,D.DISCOUNT_SP, D.NUMBER_INVOICE,D.NUMBER_LOT,D.UNIT_PART,D.QTY_BRUTE,D.DISCOUNT_PER_QTY, D.FREIGTH, D.ITEMI, D.COMMENT, D.STATUS_VALUE, D.UNIT_REFERENCE, D.QTY_REFERENCE, C.WAREHOUSE_ID as ALMACEN,C.DOCUMENT_ID AS DOCUMENTO, C.NUMBER_DOCUMENT AS NUMERO,convert(varchar(10),C.DATE_DOCUMENT,103) as DATE_DOCUMENT,C.TYPE_TRANS,C.TRANS_ID, C.DOCUMENT_STATUS,C.DOC_ID_REF,C.NUM_ID_REF,C.AUTORIZED_ID,C.DATE_RETURN, C.VENDOR_ID,C.CCOST_ID,C.WAREHOUSE_REF,C.COMMENT as COMENTARIO,C.UPDATE_DATE, C.HOUR,C.USER_ID,C.CUSTOMER_ID,C.VAT_REGISTRATION,C.CUSTOMER_NAME, C.SALES_TERM,C.CURRENCY_TYPE,C.SALES_ID,C.CURRENCY_EXCHANGE,C.TYPE_GUIA, C.STATUS_GUIA,C.RECEIVABLE_GUIA,C.ADDR_DLV,C.CARRIER_ID,C.NUMBER_PURCHASE, C.IS_GUIA_RETURN,C.VENDOR_NAME,C.NUMBER_ORDER,C.NUMBER_ESTIMATING, C.DISCOUNT_PER_CUST,C.DISCOUNT_PER_SP,C.AMOUNT,C.CARRIER_NAME,C.CARRIER_ADDR, C.CARRIER_VAT,C.NUMBER_REGISTRATION,C.NUMBER_IMPORT,C.NUMBER_LIQ, C.PRINTER_STATUS,C.STATUS_CLOSE,C.TYPE_SHIPPER,C.ZONE_FREIGHT,C.IS_GUIA, C.IS_POST,C.FREIGHT,C.ORDER_REF,C.COST, T.NAME,P.NAME as NOMPROVE, M.ID as CODCLI,M.NAME as NOMCLI,tt.NAME as NAMETRANS, A.DESCRIPTION as NOMPARTE,A.ID_FAB,A.DESCRIPTION_OPT, A.UNIT_OF_MEASUREMENT,A.WEIGHT,A.REFERENCE as UMR,S.ID as CODCENCOS, S.NAME as NOMCENCOS,T1.NAME AS ALMACENOPT,D.ACCOUNT ,PJ.ID AS COD_PRO,PJ.DESCRIPTION AS DES_PRO,D.PROJECT_ID from WAREHOUSE_TRANS C inner join WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE D on C.WAREHOUSE_ID=D.WAREHOUSE_ID and C.DOCUMENT_ID=D.DOCUMENT_ID and C.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=D.NUMBER_DOCUMENT inner join WAREHOUSE T on C.WAREHOUSE_ID=T.ID left join WAREHOUSE T1 on C.WAREHOUSE_REF=T1.ID inner join TRANSACTION_TYPE TT on C.TYPE_TRANS=TT.TYPE_ID and C.TRANS_ID=TT.MOV_ID left join CUSTOMER M on c.CUSTOMER_ID=M.ID inner join PART A on D.PART_ID=A.ID left join VENDOR P on C.VENDOR_ID=P.ID left JOIN CCOST S ON D.CCOST_ID=S.ID LEFT JOIN PROYECT PJ ON PJ.ID=C.PROJECT_ID where c.project_id=@PROJECT_ID ' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@PROJECT_ID varchar(20)',@PROJECT_ID print @STRquery

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
declare @STRquery nvarchar(2000) declare @estado char(1) declare @tipodocu char(2)
set @estado='A' set @tipodocu='NI'
set @STRquery='select A.AVERAGE_COST,B.CURRENCY_TYPE,B.CURRENCY_EXCHANGE from WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE as A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS as B on (B.WAREHOUSE_ID = A.WAREHOUSE_ID) AND (B.DOCUMENT_ID=A.DOCUMENT_ID) AND (B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT =A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT) where B.STATUS_GUIA<>@estado and B.DOCUMENT_ID=@tipodocu and A.PART_ID=@codigo and A.AVERAGE_COST<>0 and A.STATUS_VALUE=1 AND B.DATE_DOCUMENT=(SELECT max(B.DATE_DOCUMENT) from WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE as A inner join WAREHOUSE_TRANS as B ON (B.WAREHOUSE_ID = A.WAREHOUSE_ID) and (B.DOCUMENT_ID = A.DOCUMENT_ID) and (B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT) where B.STATUS_GUIA<>@estado and A.AVERAGE_COST<>0 and B.DOCUMENT_ID=@tipodocu and A.PART_ID=@codigo AND A.AVERAGE_COST=1)' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@codigo char(20),@estado char(1),@tipodocu char(2)',@codigo,@estado,@tipodocu

Property.Name: HeaderContents

Property.Value: declare @STRquery nvarchar(200) set @STRquery='select NAME from UNITS where ID=@codigo AND STATUS=@estado' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@codigo char(6),@estado char(1)',@codigo,@estado

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value: declare @STRquery nvarchar(1500) declare @tabla nvarchar(80) declare @mondefaultmn char(2) declare @mondefaultus char(2) set @tabla='[tempdb].dbo.'+@moremesingsal set @mondefaultmn='MN' set @mondefaultus='ME' set @STRquery='update D set D.AMOUNT=(case when T.STATUS_VALUE=0 then T.PRECIOPROMEDIO else (case when T.CURRENCY_TYPE=@mondefaultmn then T.AVERAGE_COST else T.AVERAGE_COST*C.CURRENCY_EXCHANGE end) end) , D.AMOUNT_US=(case when T.STATUS_VALUE=0 then T.PRECIOPROMEDIOUSS else (case when T.CURRENCY_TYPE=@mondefaultus then T.AVERAGE_COST ELSE T.AVERAGE_COST/(case when C.CURRENCY_EXCHANGE=0 then 1 else C.CURRENCY_EXCHANGE end)end) end) from WAREHOUSE_TRANS C inner join ( WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE D inner join '+@tabla+ ' T on D.WAREHOUSE_ID=T.WAREHOUSE_ID and D.DOCUMENT_ID=T.DOCUMENT_ID and D.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=T.NUMBER_DOCUMENT and D.ITEM=T.ITEM) on C.WAREHOUSE_ID=D.WAREHOUSE_ID and C.DOCUMENT_ID=D.DOCUMENT_ID and C.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=D.NUMBER_DOCUMENT' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@moremesingsal nvarchar(80),@tabla nvarchar(80), @mondefaultmn char(2),@mondefaultus char(2)', @moremesingsal,@tabla,@mondefaultmn,@mondefaultus

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value: declare @STRquery nvarchar(2000) declare @docmov char(2) declare @tipodoc char(2) set @docmov='TD' set @tipodoc='NI' set @STRquery='update WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE set AVERAGE_COST =D1.AVERAGE_COST,UNIT_PRICE=D1.UNIT_PRICE from (WAREHOUSE_TRANS as C inner join WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE as D on (C.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=D.NUMBER_DOCUMENT) and (C.DOCUMENT_ID=D.DOCUMENT_ID) and (C.WAREHOUSE_ID=D.WAREHOUSE_ID)) inner join (WAREHOUSE_TRANS as C1 inner join WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE as D1 on (C1.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=D1.NUMBER_DOCUMENT) and (C1.DOCUMENT_ID=D1.DOCUMENT_ID) and (C1.WAREHOUSE_ID=D1.WAREHOUSE_ID)) on (D.ITEM=D1.ITEM) and (C.NUM_ID_REF=C1.NUMBER_DOCUMENT) and (C.DOC_ID_REF=C1.DOCUMENT_ID) and (C.WAREHOUSE_REF=C1.WAREHOUSE_ID) where C.TRANS_ID =@docmov AND C.DOCUMENT_ID =@tipodoc' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@docmov char(2),@tipodoc char(2)', @docmov,@tipodoc

declare @STRquery nvarchar(500) declare @tabla nvarchar(80) declare @tabla2 nvarchar(80) declare @tabla3 nvarchar(80)
set @tabla='[tempdb].dbo.'+@moresaux set @tabla2='[tempdb].dbo.'+@mesingsal set @tabla3='[tempdb].dbo.'+@autonum set @STRquery='UPDATE '+@tabla+ ' SET SMMNPREUNI=CONVERT(NUMERIC(19,10),B.PRECIOPROMEDIO), SMUSPREUNI=CONVERT(NUMERIC(19,10),B.PRECIOPROMEDIOUSS) FROM '+@tabla+ ' AS A INNER JOIN ('+@tabla2+ ' AS B INNER JOIN '+@tabla3+ ' AS C ON B.ID=C.IDX) ON (A.SMCODIGO=B.PART_ID) AND (A.SMMESPRO=B.ANOMES)' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@moresaux nvarchar(80),@mesingsal nvarchar(80), @autonum nvarchar(80),@tabla nvarchar(80),@tabla2 nvarchar(80), @tabla3 nvarchar(80)',@moresaux,@mesingsal,@autonum,@tabla, @tabla2,@tabla3

set @tabla='[tempdb].dbo.'+@moresaux set @tabla2='[tempdb].dbo.'+@mesingsal set @STRquery='UPDATE '+@tabla+ ' SET SMSALDOINI = B.SALDOINICIAL FROM '+@tabla+ ' AS A INNER JOIN '+@tabla2+ ' AS B ON (A.IDX=B.ID) AND (A.SMMESPRO=B.ANOMES) AND (A.SMCODIGO=B.PART_ID) AND (A.SMALMA=B.WAREHOUSE_ID) WHERE A.IDX=B.ID' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@moresaux nvarchar(80),@mesingsal nvarchar(80), @tabla nvarchar(80),@tabla2 nvarchar(80)',@moresaux,@mesingsal, @tabla,@tabla2 set @STRquery='alter table '+@tabla+ ' drop column IDX' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@moresaux nvarchar(80),@mesingsal nvarchar(80), @tabla nvarchar(80),@tabla2 nvarchar(80)',@moresaux,@mesingsal, @tabla,@tabla2

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value: declare @STRquery nvarchar(2000) set @STRquery='insert into PART_QTY(WAREHOUSE_ID,PART_ID,LAST_RECEIVED_DATE) (select distinct D.WAREHOUSE_ID as STALMA,D.PART_ID as STCODIGO, min(C.DATE_DOCUMENT) as STKFECULT from WAREHOUSE_TRANS C inner join ((WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE D left join PART_QTY S on D.WAREHOUSE_ID=S.WAREHOUSE_ID and D.PART_ID=S.PART_ID) inner join PART M on D.PART_ID=M.ID) on C.WAREHOUSE_ID=D.WAREHOUSE_ID and C.DOCUMENT_ID=D.DOCUMENT_ID and C.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=D.NUMBER_DOCUMENT where S.WAREHOUSE_ID is null and not (M.IS_STOCKED=@STRafecstock and M.SERIES=@STRserie and M.IS_LOT=@STRlote) group by D.WAREHOUSE_ID,S.PART_ID,D.PART_ID)' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@STRafecstock char(1),@STRserie char(1),@STRlote char(1)', @STRafecstock,@STRserie,@STRlote

DECLARE @pc nvarchar(80) DECLARE @opcion char(1) DECLARE @mes char(2) DECLARE @anyo char(4) DECLARE @codini char(20) DECLARE @codfin char(20) DECLARE @tipoart char(4) DECLARE @anyomesant char(6) DECLARE @anyomes char(6)
SET @pc='QUIMICA1INVENTORY' SET @opcion='0' SET @mes='' SET @anyo='' SET @codini='' SET @codfin='' SET @tipoart='' SET @anyomesant='' SET @anyomes=''
declare @STRquery nvarchar(2500) declare @tabla nvarchar(80) declare @staanul char(1),@guiasal char(2),@guiafac char(2) declare @stafac char(1),@isno char(1),@texto char(5) declare @filtro nvarchar(200)
if @opcion='0' --crea temporal begin if exists(select * from tempdb.dbo.sysobjects where name=@pc) begin set @tabla=N'[tempdb].dbo.'+@pc set @STRquery='drop table '+ @tabla exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@pc nvarchar(80),@opcion char(1)', @pc,@opcion end set @tabla='[tempdb].dbo.'+@pc set @STRquery='create table '+@tabla+ '(ITEM int,PART_ID varchar(20),DOCUMENT_DATE smalldatetime, TIME varchar(8),IS_IN_OUT varchar(1),TRANS_ID varchar(2), TYPE_DOC varchar(2),WAREHOUSE_ID varchar(2), NUMBER_DOC varchar(20),QTY_INITIAL float default 0.00,QTY_IN float, QTY_OUT float,QTY_BALANCE float, UNIT_PRICE float,INIT_VALUE float,IN_VALUE float, OUT_VALUE float,END_VALUE float, AVERAGE_COST float,IS_VALUE bit default(0))' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@pc nvarchar(80),@opcion char(1)', @pc,@opcion end
if @opcion='1' --consulta begin set @staanul='A' set @guiasal='GS' set @guiafac='GF' set @stafac='F' set @isno='N' set @texto='TEXTO'
if len(@tipoart)>0 set @filtro= N' AND M.TYPE_PART=@tipoart order by A.PART_ID,B.DATE_DOCUMENT,B.TYPE_TRANS,B.TRANS_ID,B.WAREHOUSE_ID, B.DOCUMENT_ID,B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,A.ITEM' else set @filtro= N' order by A.PART_ID,B.DATE_DOCUMENT,B.TYPE_TRANS,B.TRANS_ID,B.WAREHOUSE_ID, B.DOCUMENT_ID,B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,A.ITEM'
set @STRquery='select A.*,B.* from WAREHOUSE_TRANS B inner join (WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE A left join PART M on A.PART_ID=M.ID ) on B.WAREHOUSE_ID = A.WAREHOUSE_ID AND B.DOCUMENT_ID=A.DOCUMENT_ID AND B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT where month(B.DATE_DOCUMENT) =@mes and year(B.DATE_DOCUMENT) =@anyo and B.STATUS_GUIA<>@staanul and not (B.DOCUMENT_ID=@guiasal and B.TRANS_ID=@guiafac and B.STATUS_GUIA=@stafac) and not (M.IS_STOCKED=@isno and M.SERIES=@isno and M.IS_LOT=@isno) and (A.PART_ID>=@codini and A.PART_ID<=@codfin) and (A.PART_ID<>@texto)' + @filtro exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@opcion char(1), @mes char(2),@anyo char(4),@codini char(20),@codfin char(20),@tipoart char(4), @staanul char(1),@guiasal char(2),@guiafac char(2),@stafac char(1), @isno char(1),@texto char(5)', @opcion,@mes,@anyo,@codini,@codfin,@tipoart, @staanul,@guiasal,@guiafac,@stafac,@isno,@texto end
if @opcion='2' --consulta agrupada moresmes begin set @STRquery='select PART_ID,YEAR_MONTH,AMOUNT,AMOUNT_US, sum(QTY_INITIAL) as QTY_INITIAL, sum(QTY_ENTER) as QTY_ENTER, sum(QTY_OUT) as QTY_OUT from MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE where YEAR_MONTH >=@anyomesant AND YEAR_MONTH <=@anyomes AND (PART_ID>=@codini AND PART_ID<=@codfin) group by PART_ID,YEAR_MONTH,AMOUNT,AMOUNT_US order by YEAR_MONTH' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@opcion char(1), @anyomesant char(6),@anyomes char(6),@codini char(20),@codfin char(20)', @opcion,@anyomesant,@anyomes,@codini,@codfin end
if @opcion='3' --consulta moresmes begin set @STRquery='select * from MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE where YEAR_MONTH >=@anyomesant AND YEAR_MONTH <=@anyomes AND (PART_ID>=@codini AND PART_ID<=@codfin) ORDER BY YEAR_MONTH' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@opcion char(1), @anyomesant char(6),@anyomes char(6),@codini char(20),@codfin char(20)', @opcion,@anyomesant,@anyomes,@codini,@codfin end
if @opcion='4' --Consulta stock y partes begin if len(@tipoart)>0 set @filtro=N' AND B.TYPE_PART=@tipoart' else set @filtro=N''
set @STRquery='select distinct(A.PART_ID) from PART_QTY A inner join PART B on A.PART_ID=B.ID where (A.PART_ID>=@codini and A.PART_ID<=@codfin)' + @filtro exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@opcion char(1), @codini char(20),@codfin char(20),@tipoart char(4)', @opcion,@codini,@codfin,@tipoart end
if @opcion='5' --Consulta para armar el reporte begin set @tabla=N'[tempdb].dbo.'+@pc set @STRquery='select I.ITEM,I.PART_ID,I.DOCUMENT_DATE,I.TIME,I.IS_IN_OUT,I.TRANS_ID, I.TYPE_DOC,I.WAREHOUSE_ID,I.NUMBER_DOC,I.QTY_INITIAL,I.QTY_IN, I.QTY_OUT,I.QTY_BALANCE,I.UNIT_PRICE,I.INIT_VALUE,I.IN_VALUE, I.OUT_VALUE,I.END_VALUE,I.AVERAGE_COST,I.IS_VALUE, P.DESCRIPTION,P.UNIT_OF_MEASUREMENT,W.CURRENCY_EXCHANGE from '+ @tabla +' I inner join PART P on I.PART_ID=P.ID left join WAREHOUSE_TRANS W on W.WAREHOUSE_ID=I.WAREHOUSE_ID and I.TYPE_DOC=W.DOCUMENT_ID AND I.NUMBER_DOC=W.NUMBER_DOCUMENT' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@pc nvarchar(80),@opcion char(1)', @pc,@opcion end --select * from tempdb.dbo.DEVELOPER03INVENTORY --exec dbo.INV_RPT_INVENTARIO_VAL_MENSUAL 'DEVELOPER03INVENTORY', '5', ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', --' ', ' ', ' ' --select * from inventory where part_id='R0001' --select * from inventory where part_id='E0001'
