Property.Name: QueryScript
Property.Value:
SELECT C.DOCUMENT_ID AS TIP_DOC, C.NUMBER_SERIE AS SERIE, C.NUMBER_DOCUMENT AS NUMERO, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),C.DOCUMENT_DATE,103)AS FECHA_DOC, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),C.CADUCATE_DATE,103)AS FECHA_VENC, CONVERT(NUMERIC(22,2),C.AMOUNT,0) AS IMPORTE_ORIG, C.SALES_REP_ID, S.NAME AS VEND, C.CUSTOMER_ID +' '+C.CUSTOMER_NAME AS CLIENTE, CONVERT(NUMERIC(22,2),(ISNULL(C.AMOUNT,0)/((L.TAX_PERCENT+100)/100))) MON_AFECT, CONVERT(NUMERIC(22,2),ISNULL(L.COMISION,0)) AS COMIS, CONVERT(NUMERIC(22,2),(ISNULL(C.AMOUNT,0)/((L.TAX_PERCENT+100)/100))* ISNULL(L.COMISION,0)/100) AS MON_COMIS FROM DBO.RECEIVABLE C INNER JOIN DBO.RECEIVABLE_LINE L ON C.DOCUMENT_ID=L.DOCUMENT_ID AND C.NUMBER_SERIE=L.NUMBER_SERIE AND C.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=L.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN DBO.SALES_REP S ON S.ID=C.SALES_REP_ID WHERE C.STATUS='V' AND L.COMISION >0 GROUP BY C.DOCUMENT_ID,C.NUMBER_SERIE,C.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,C.DOCUMENT_DATE,C.CADUCATE_DATE, C.AMOUNT,C.SALES_REP_ID,S.NAME,C.CUSTOMER_ID, C.CUSTOMER_NAME,L.TAX_PERCENT ,L.COMISION
--SELECT * FROM LISTADO_VENTAS

Property.Name: HeaderContents
Property.Value: CREATE VIEW LISTADO_VENTAS AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
DECLARE @DOCUMENT_ID VARCHAR(2) DECLARE @NUMBER_DOCUMENT VARCHAR(15) DECLARE @N INT DECLARE @NUMERO INT DECLARE @NUMERO_A_COMPARAR INT DECLARE @NUMERO_FALTA VARCHAR(15) DECLARE @A INT DECLARE @DIFERENCIA INT DECLARE @NUMERO_DOS INT DECLARE @DIFERENCIA_DOS INT
DECLARE CURSOR1 CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT DOCUMENT_ID FROM RECEIVABLE OPEN CURSOR1 FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR1 INTO @DOCUMENT_ID WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN SET @N=1 SET @A=1 DECLARE CURSOR2 CURSOR FOR SELECT NUMBER_DOCUMENT from RECEIVABLE where DOCUMENT_ID=@document_id AND DOCUMENT_DATE BETWEEN @FECHA1 AND @FECHA2 order by number_document OPEN CURSOR2 FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR2 INTO @NUMBER_DOCUMENT WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN IF @N=1 BEGIN SET @NUMERO=CONVERT(INT,@NUMBER_DOCUMENT) SET @N=0 END ELSE IF @N=0 BEGIN SET @NUMERO=@NUMERO+1 SET @NUMERO_A_COMPARAR=CONVERT(INT,@NUMBER_DOCUMENT) IF @NUMERO<>@NUMERO_A_COMPARAR BEGIN SET @DIFERENCIA=@NUMERO_A_COMPARAR-@NUMERO SET @DIFERENCIA_DOS=@DIFERENCIA IF @NUMERO >0 AND @NUMERO<=9 BEGIN SET @NUMERO_FALTA='000000'+CONVERT(VARCHAR,@NUMERO) END ELSE IF @NUMERO>=10 AND @NUMERO<=99 BEGIN SET @NUMERO_FALTA='00000'+CONVERT(VARCHAR,@NUMERO) END ELSE IF @NUMERO>=100 AND @NUMERO<=999 BEGIN SET @NUMERO_FALTA='0000'+CONVERT(VARCHAR,@NUMERO) END ELSE IF @NUMERO>=1000 AND @NUMERO<=9999 BEGIN SET @NUMERO_FALTA='000'+CONVERT(VARCHAR,@NUMERO) END ELSE IF @NUMERO>=10000 AND @NUMERO<=99999 BEGIN SET @NUMERO_FALTA='00'+CONVERT(VARCHAR,@NUMERO) END ELSE IF @NUMERO>=100000 AND @NUMERO<=999999 BEGIN SET @NUMERO_FALTA='0'+CONVERT(VARCHAR,@NUMERO) END ELSE IF @NUMERO>=1000000 AND @NUMERO<=9999999 BEGIN SET @NUMERO_FALTA=CONVERT(VARCHAR,@NUMERO) END
WHILE @DIFERENCIA>0 BEGIN IF @A=1 BEGIN INSERT INTO NUMEROS_DOCUMENTOS_FALTANTES VALUES(@DOCUMENT_ID,@NUMERO_FALTA) SET @DIFERENCIA=@DIFERENCIA-1 SET @A=2 SET @NUMERO_DOS=@NUMERO END ELSE BEGIN SET @NUMERO_DOS=@NUMERO_DOS+1 IF @NUMERO_DOS >0 AND @NUMERO_DOS<=9 BEGIN SET @NUMERO_FALTA='000000'+CONVERT(VARCHAR,@NUMERO_DOS) END ELSE IF @NUMERO_DOS>=10 AND @NUMERO_DOS<=99 BEGIN SET @NUMERO_FALTA='00000'+CONVERT(VARCHAR,@NUMERO_DOS) END ELSE IF @NUMERO_DOS>=100 AND @NUMERO_DOS<=999 BEGIN SET @NUMERO_FALTA='0000'+CONVERT(VARCHAR,@NUMERO_DOS) END ELSE IF @NUMERO_DOS>=1000 AND @NUMERO_DOS<=9999 BEGIN SET @NUMERO_FALTA='000'+CONVERT(VARCHAR,@NUMERO_DOS) END ELSE IF @NUMERO_DOS>=10000 AND @NUMERO_DOS<=99999 BEGIN SET @NUMERO_FALTA='00'+CONVERT(VARCHAR,@NUMERO_DOS) END ELSE IF @NUMERO_DOS>=100000 AND @NUMERO_DOS<=999999 BEGIN SET @NUMERO_FALTA='0'+CONVERT(VARCHAR,@NUMERO_DOS) END ELSE IF @NUMERO_DOS>=1000000 AND @NUMERO_DOS<=9999999 BEGIN SET @NUMERO_FALTA=CONVERT(VARCHAR,@NUMERO_DOS) END INSERT INTO NUMEROS_DOCUMENTOS_FALTANTES VALUES(@DOCUMENT_ID,@NUMERO_FALTA) SET @DIFERENCIA=@DIFERENCIA-1
END END SET @NUMERO=@NUMERO+@DIFERENCIA_DOS SET @A=1 END
END
FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR2 INTO @NUMBER_DOCUMENT END CLOSE CURSOR2 DEALLOCATE CURSOR2
FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR1 INTO @DOCUMENT_ID END CLOSE CURSOR1 DEALLOCATE CURSOR1
SELECT * FROM NUMEROS_DOCUMENTOS_FALTANTES ORDER BY DOCUMENT_ID,NUMBER_DOCUMENT

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
DECLARE @DOCUMENT_ID VARCHAR(2) DECLARE @NUMBER_SERIE VARCHAR(3) DECLARE @NUMBER_DOCUMENT VARCHAR(10) DECLARE @DOCUMENT_REF VARCHAR(2) DECLARE @SERIE_REF VARCHAR(3) DECLARE @NUMBER_REF VARCHAR(10) DECLARE @FECHA DATETIME DECLARE @A VARCHAR(1)
DECLARE CURSOR1 CURSOR FOR SELECT DOCUMENT_ID,NUMBER_SERIE,NUMBER_DOCUMENT,DOCUMENT_REF,SERIE_REF,NUMBER_REF FROM RECEIVABLE WHERE NUMBER_DOCUMENT=@NUM OPEN CURSOR1 FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR1 INTO @DOCUMENT_ID,@NUMBER_SERIE,@NUMBER_DOCUMENT,@DOCUMENT_REF,@SERIE_REF,@NUMBER_REF WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN SELECT @FECHA=DOCUMENT_DATE,@A=1 FROM RECEIVABLE WHERE DOCUMENT_ID=@DOCUMENT_REF AND NUMBER_SERIE=@SERIE_REF AND NUMBER_DOCUMENT=@NUMBER_REF IF @A<>'1' BEGIN SET @FECHA='01/01/2009' UPDATE RECEIVABLE SET CREATE_DATE=@FECHA WHERE DOCUMENT_ID=@DOCUMENT_ID AND NUMBER_SERIE=@NUMBER_SERIE AND NUMBER_DOCUMENT=@NUMBER_DOCUMENT END ELSE BEGIN UPDATE RECEIVABLE SET CREATE_DATE=@FECHA WHERE DOCUMENT_ID=@DOCUMENT_ID AND NUMBER_SERIE=@NUMBER_SERIE AND NUMBER_DOCUMENT=@NUMBER_DOCUMENT END
FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR1 INTO @DOCUMENT_ID,@NUMBER_SERIE,@NUMBER_DOCUMENT,@DOCUMENT_REF,@SERIE_REF,@NUMBER_REF END CLOSE CURSOR1 DEALLOCATE CURSOR1

Property.Name: HeaderContents

Property.Value: SELECT C.DESCRIPTION,F.NAME AS FAMILIA,SUM((D.AMOUNT-D.AMOUNT_TAX)) AS SOLES,SUM(D.AMOUNT_TAX) AS IGV,SUM(D.AMOUNT)AS TOTAL FROM RECEIVABLE A INNER JOIN CUSTOMER B ON A.CUSTOMER_ID=B.ID INNER JOIN MASTER_HELP C ON B.SELL_ZONE=C.ID INNER JOIN RECEIVABLE_LINE D ON A.DOCUMENT_ID=D.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_SERIE=D.NUMBER_SERIE AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=D.NUMBER_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN PART E ON D.PART_ID=E.ID LEFT JOIN FAMILY F ON E.FAMILY=F.ID WHERE DOCUMENT_DATE BETWEEN @fechaini AND @fechafin AND TYPE_ID='28' and f.id between @familiaini and @familiafin and c.id between @zonaini and @zonafin AND A.STATUS='V' GROUP BY C.DESCRIPTION,F.NAME order by 1

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
SET NOCOUNT ON SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER off
DECLARE @ARTICULOS AS VARCHAR(70) DECLARE @ARTICULOS2 AS VARCHAR(70) DECLARE @anomesAnt AS VARCHAR(6) DECLARE @Arti AS VARCHAR(20) DECLARE @Arti2 AS VARCHAR(20) DECLARE @DESCRI AS VARCHAR(64) DECLARE @ALMACEN AS VARCHAR(2) DECLARE @ing AS NUMERIC(15,6) DECLARE @SAL AS NUMERIC(15,6) DECLARE @INGREF AS NUMERIC(15,6) DECLARE @SALREF AS NUMERIC(15,6) DECLARE @SALDO AS varchar(30) DECLARE @SALDOREF AS varchar(30) declare @fecha1 AS varchar(10) declare @fecha2 AS varchar(10) DECLARE @UF VARCHAR(5) declare @STRquery nvarchar(1500) declare @tabla nvarchar(80)
set @fecha1=str(@fechaINI) set @fecha2=str(@fechaFIN)
SET @ARTICULOS=CASE WHEN @TODOS=1 THEN ' AND B.PART_ID>="'+@ART1+'" AND B.PART_ID<="'+@ART2+'" ' WHEN @TODOS=0 THEN ' ' END SET @ARTICULOS2=CASE WHEN @TODOS=1 THEN 'AND SMCODIGO>="'+@ART1+'" AND SMCODIGO<="'+@ART2+'" ' WHEN @TODOS=0 THEN ' ' END
IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tempdb.dbo.SYSOBJECTS WHERE XTYPE='U' AND NAME=''+@IDE+'KARDEXSQL') BEGIN EXEC('DROP TABLE TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'KARDEXSQL') END
EXEC ('CREATE TABLE TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'KARDEXSQL(CODIGO VARCHAR(20),DESCRIPCION VARCHAR(64)NULL, UNIDAD VARCHAR(6)NULL,UMREFERENCIA VARCHAR(6)NULL,CAFECDOC datetime,CAALMA VARCHAR(2)NULL,CATD VARCHAR(2)NULL,CANUMDOC VARCHAR(10)NULL, CATIPMOV VARCHAR(1)NULL,CACODMOV VARCHAR(2)NULL,CARFTDOC VARCHAR(2)NULL,CARFNDOC VARCHAR(10)NULL,CANOMPRO VARCHAR(100)NULL, CANOMCLI VARCHAR(100)NULL,CACODCLI VARCHAR(11)NULL,DECENCOS VARCHAR(10)NULL,DEORDFAB VARCHAR(10)NULL, DELOTE VARCHAR(20)NULL,DESERIE VARCHAR(20)NULL,SALDO NUMERIC(15,6)DEFAULT(0),ENTRADA NUMERIC(15,6)DEFAULT(0), SALIDA NUMERIC(15,6)DEFAULT(0),SALDOREF NUMERIC(15,6)DEFAULT(0),ENTRADAREF NUMERIC(15,6)DEFAULT(0),SALIDAREF NUMERIC(15,6)DEFAULT(0), FAMILY VARCHAR(20)NULL,LINES VARCHAR(20)NULL,FEC_CADUCATE DATETIME)')
IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tempdb.dbo.sysobjects WHERE XTYPE='U' AND NAME=''+@IDE+'saldo') BEGIN EXEC('DROP TABLE TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'saldo') END EXEC (' SELECT B.PART_ID,C.DESCRIPTION,B.WAREHOUSE_ID,SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END)AS INGRESO, SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END)as SALIDA, SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END)AS INGRESOREF, SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END)AS SALIDAREF, SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END)-SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS SALDOMOV, SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END)-SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END) AS SALDOREF, F.NAME AS FAMI,C.DESCRIPTION_OPT AS LINE,L.CADUCATE_DATE AS FV into tempdb.dbo.'+@ide+'saldo from WAREHOUSE_TRANS A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID=B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID=B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN LOT L ON L.LOT_ID=B.NUMBER_LOT INNER JOIN PART C ON B.PART_ID=C.ID INNER JOIN FAMILY F ON F.ID=C.FAMILY WHERE A.WAREHOUSE_ID>= "'+@alma1+'" AND A.WAREHOUSE_ID<= "'+@alma2+'" AND B.NUMBER_LOT>="'+@LOTE1+'" AND B.NUMBER_LOT<="'+@LOTE2+'" AND A.STATUS_GUIA<>"A" AND L.PART_ID="'+@ART1+'" AND NOT (A.DOCUMENT_ID="GS" AND A.TRANS_ID="GF" AND A.STATUS_GUIA="F") AND NOT (C.IS_STOCKED="N" AND C.SERIES="N" AND C.IS_LOT="N") AND (B.PART_ID<>"TEXTO")'+@ARTICULOS+' and A.DATE_DOCUMENT<'+@fecha1+' GROUP BY B.PART_ID,C.DESCRIPTION,B.WAREHOUSE_ID,F.NAME,C.DESCRIPTION_OPT,L.CADUCATE_DATE ORDER BY B.PART_ID ASC')
EXEC ('DECLARE RECORRE_CODIGOS CURSOR FOR select B.PART_ID from WAREHOUSE_TRANS A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID=B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID=B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN PART C ON B.PART_ID=C.ID WHERE A.WAREHOUSE_ID>="'+@alma1+'" AND A.WAREHOUSE_ID<="'+@alma2+'" AND B.NUMBER_LOT>="'+@LOTE1+'" AND B.NUMBER_LOT<="'+@LOTE2+'" AND A.STATUS_GUIA<>"A" AND NOT (A.DOCUMENT_ID="GS" AND A.TRANS_ID="GF" AND A.STATUS_GUIA="F") AND NOT (C.IS_STOCKED="N" AND C.SERIES="N" AND C.IS_LOT="N")AND (B.PART_ID<>"TEXTO")'+@ARTICULOS+' GROUP BY B.PART_ID,C.DESCRIPTION,B.WAREHOUSE_ID ORDER BY B.PART_ID ASC')
OPEN RECORRE_CODIGOS FETCH NEXT FROM RECORRE_CODIGOS INTO @Arti
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS =0 BEGIN EXEC ('INSERT INTO tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'KARDEXSQL (CODIGO,DESCRIPCION,SALDO,SALDOREF,FAMILY,LINES,FEC_CADUCATE) select PART_ID,DESCRIPTION,SALDOMOV,SALDOREF,FAMI,LINE,FV from tempdb.dbo.'+@ide+'saldo where PART_ID="'+@Arti+'" AND(saldomov<>0)')
EXEC ('INSERT INTO tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'KARDEXSQL (CODIGO,DESCRIPCION,UNIDAD,UMREFERENCIA,CAFECDOC,CAALMA,CATD,CANUMDOC,CATIPMOV, CACODMOV,CARFTDOC,CARFNDOC,CANOMPRO,CANOMCLI,CACODCLI,DECENCOS,DEORDFAB,DELOTE,DESERIE,SALDO, ENTRADA,SALIDA,SALDOREF,ENTRADAREF,SALIDAREF,FAMILY,LINES,FEC_CADUCATE)
SELECT B.PART_ID,C.DESCRIPTION,C.UNIT_OF_MEASUREMENT,C.REFERENCE,A.DATE_DOCUMENT,A.WAREHOUSE_ID,A.DOCUMENT_ID,A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,A.TYPE_TRANS, A.TRANS_ID,A.DOC_ID_REF,A.NUM_ID_REF,(CASE WHEN A.DOCUMENT_ID="TD" THEN "ALMACEN"+" "+A.WAREHOUSE_ID ELSE (CASE WHEN B.CCOST_ID<>"" THEN "C.C. "+B.CCOST_ID ELSE (CASE WHEN B.ORDER_MANUFACT_ID<>"" THEN "O.F. "+B.ORDER_MANUFACT_ID ELSE (SELECT NAME FROM VENDOR P WHERE A.VENDOR_ID=P.ID) END) END) END)AS CANOMPROV,M.NAME,A.CUSTOMER_ID,B.CCOST_ID,B.ORDER_MANUFACT_ID,B.NUMBER_LOT,B.NUMBER_SERIE,0, (CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END), (CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END),0, (CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END), (CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END), F.NAME,C.DESCRIPTION_OPT,L.CADUCATE_DATE from WAREHOUSE_TRANS A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID=B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID=B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN LOT L ON L.LOT_ID=B.NUMBER_LOT and l.who_id=a.warehouse_id INNER JOIN PART C ON B.PART_ID=C.ID INNER JOIN FAMILY F ON F.ID=C.FAMILY LEFT JOIN CUSTOMER M ON A.CUSTOMER_ID=M.ID WHERE A.WAREHOUSE_ID>="'+@alma1+'" AND A.WAREHOUSE_ID<="'+@alma2+'" AND B.NUMBER_LOT>="'+@LOTE1+'" AND B.NUMBER_LOT<="'+@LOTE2+'" AND A.STATUS_GUIA<>"A" AND L.PART_ID="'+@ART1+'" AND NOT (A.DOCUMENT_ID="GS" AND A.TRANS_ID="GF" AND A.STATUS_GUIA="F") AND NOT (C.IS_STOCKED="N" AND C.SERIES="N" AND C.IS_LOT="N")AND (B.PART_ID<>"TEXTO") and B.PART_ID="'+@Arti+'" and A.DATE_DOCUMENT>='+@fecha1+' AND A.DATE_DOCUMENT<='+@fecha2+' AND (B.QTY>0)ORDER BY B.PART_ID,A.DATE_DOCUMENT,A.TYPE_TRANS,A.DOCUMENT_ID,A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT ASC')
FETCH NEXT FROM RECORRE_CODIGOS INTO @Arti END
CLOSE RECORRE_CODIGOS DEALLOCATE RECORRE_CODIGOS
IF @TODOSMOV=1 BEGIN EXEC ('INSERT INTO tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'KARDEXSQL (CODIGO,DESCRIPCION,UNIDAD,ENTRADA,SALIDA,ENTRADAREF,SALIDAREF,FAMILY,LINES,FEC_CADUCATE) SELECT B.PART_ID,B.PART_DESCRIPTION,B.UNIT_PART,(CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END), (CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY ELSE 0 END), (CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="I" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END), (CASE WHEN A.TYPE_TRANS="S" THEN B.QTY_REFERENCE ELSE 0 END), F.NAME,P.DESCRIPTION_OPT,L.CADUCATE_DATE from WAREHOUSE_TRANS A INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE B ON A.WAREHOUSE_ID=B.WAREHOUSE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_ID=B.DOCUMENT_ID AND A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN LOT L ON L.LOT_ID=B.NUMBER_LOT INNER JOIN PART_QTY C ON B.PART_ID=C.PART_ID INNER JOIN PART P ON P.ID=B.PART_ID INNER JOIN FAMILY F ON F.ID=P.FAMILY WHERE A.WAREHOUSE_ID>="'+@alma1+'" AND A.WAREHOUSE_ID<="'+@alma2+'" AND B.NUMBER_LOT>="'+@LOTE1+'" AND B.NUMBER_LOT<="'+@LOTE2+'" AND A.STATUS_GUIA<>"A" and B.PART_ID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT CODIGO FROM tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'KARDEXSQL) AND L.PART_ID="'+@ART1+'" and A.DATE_DOCUMENT>="01/"+"'+@mesActual+'"+"/"+"'+@anoAct+'" AND A.DATE_DOCUMENT<='+@fecha1+' ORDER BY B.PART_ID,A.DATE_DOCUMENT,A.TYPE_TRANS,A.DOCUMENT_ID,A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT ASC') END
-- declare @STRquery nvarchar(1500) -- declare @tabla nvarchar(80) set @tabla=N'[tempdb].dbo.'+@IDE+'KARDEXSQL' SET @STRquery='select CODIGO,DESCRIPCION,UNIDAD,UMREFERENCIA,convert(varchar(10),CAFECDOC,103) as CAFECDOC, CAALMA,CATD,CANUMDOC,CATIPMOV,CACODMOV,CARFTDOC, CARFNDOC,CANOMPRO,CANOMCLI,CACODCLI,DECENCOS, DEORDFAB,DELOTE,DESERIE,SALDO,ENTRADA,SALIDA, SALDOREF,ENTRADAREF,SALIDAREF,FAMILY,LINES,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),FEC_CADUCATE,103) AS FV from '+@tabla+' where delote is not null ' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@IDE AS varchar(80)',@IDE

declare @TRAN1 int declare @TRAN2 int declare @TRAN3 int --set @TABLA='tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'FACWORCAB'
BEGIN TRAN INSERT_IMPORT_ORDER EXEC('set quoted_identifier off INSERT INTO IMPORT_ORDER (ID,VENDOR_ID,DOCUMENT_DATE,PROMISE_DATE,AMOUNT,CURRENCY_ID_IMP, EQUIVALENCE_US,CURRENCY_EXCHANGE,SOLIINSP,AMOUNT_BALANCE_LIQ,COMMENT,TYPE_ORDER,NUMBER_LIQ,CURR_EXCHANGE_TYPE,STATUS_ID, NUMBER_IMPORT_INT,USER_ID, CREATE_DATE) VALUES ("'+@NUMERO+'","'+@COD_PROVEE+'",'+@FECHAEMI+','+@FECHAENT+','+@IMPORTE+',"'+@MONEDA+'",'+@EQUIVUS+','+@TIPOCAMBIO+', "'+@SOLINSPECCION+'" ,'+@SALLIQ+',"'+@OBSERVACION+'","'+@TIPOORDEN+'","'+@NROPOLIZA+'","'+@TIPOCONV+'", "'+@ESTADO+'","'+@NUMINT+'", "'+@COD_USUARIO+'",'+@FECHA_CREACION+')')

set quoted_identifier off set nocount on
/* VERIFICO SI EXISTE LA TABLA*/ DECLARE @EXISTE INT DECLARE @TEMPO VARCHAR(50)
SET @TEMPO='##'+@ide+'COS_IMP' EXEC PUR_MANTTEMP @TEMPO,1,'1','',@VALOR=@EXISTE OUTPUT IF @EXISTE=1 EXEC('DROP TABLE [##'+ @ide+'COS_IMP]')
SET @TEMPO='##'+@ide+'COS_IMP_TOTAL' EXEC PUR_MANTTEMP @TEMPO,1,'1','',@VALOR=@EXISTE OUTPUT IF @EXISTE=1 EXEC('DROP TABLE [##'+ @ide+'COS_IMP_TOTAL]') /* FIN */
exec('delete from ['+@emp+'].dbo.HOJA_COSTOS ') exec('set quoted_identifier off SELECT VENDOR_ID AS CDESPROVE,AI.CUSTOMS_ID AS COD_ADU,A.NAME AS NOM_ADU,B.NAME AS NOM_BAN,BI.NUM_FAC NRO_FAC, BI.COB_EXT,DATE_FAC AS FECHA_FAC,BI.DATE_CADUCATE AS FECHA_VTO, G.NUMBER_LIQ AS CNUMLIQUI,IC.ID AS CNUMERO,IC.NUMBER_IMPORT_INT AS CNUMIMP, CURRENCY_ID_IMP AS CCODMONIM,IC.DOCUMENT_DATE AS FEMISION,QTY AS NCANTIDAD, REFERENCE AS UMREFERENCIA,ID.PART_ID AS CCODARTIC,M.DESCRIPTION AS CDESARTIC, (0.00) AS VALOR_FOB, (0.00) AS FLETE, (0.00) AS CCSEGURO, (0.00) AS TOTAL_VALOR_CFR, (CASE WHEN G.COST_ID IN ('+@congen3+') THEN (CASE WHEN TG.SUM_COST=1 THEN G.AMOUNT*-1 ELSE G.AMOUNT END) ELSE 0 END) AS GASTOS_VPE, (0.00) AS AD_VAL, (CASE WHEN G.COST_ID IN ('+@congen5+') THEN (CASE WHEN TG.SUM_COST=1 THEN G.AMOUNT*-1 ELSE G.AMOUNT END) ELSE 0 END) AS GASTOS_AGE, (CASE WHEN G.COST_ID IN ('+@congen6+') THEN (CASE WHEN TG.SUM_COST=1 THEN G.AMOUNT*-1 ELSE G.AMOUNT END) ELSE 0 END) AS INTS_ADU, (CASE WHEN G.COST_ID IN ('+@congen2+') THEN (CASE WHEN TG.SUM_COST=1 THEN G.AMOUNT*-1 ELSE G.AMOUNT END) ELSE 0 END) AS FLETE_CON, (CASE WHEN G.COST_ID IN ('+@congen7+') THEN (CASE WHEN TG.SUM_COST=1 THEN G.AMOUNT*-1 ELSE G.AMOUNT END) ELSE 0 END) AS SEGURO, (CASE WHEN G.COST_ID IN ('+@congen8+') THEN (CASE WHEN TG.SUM_COST=1 THEN G.AMOUNT*-1 ELSE G.AMOUNT END) ELSE 0 END) AS GASTOS_BAN, (CASE WHEN G.COST_ID IN ('+@congen9+') THEN (CASE WHEN TG.SUM_COST=1 THEN G.AMOUNT*-1 ELSE G.AMOUNT END) ELSE 0 END) AS TRANS_DESC, (0.00) AS COSTO_TOTAL, (0.000000) AS COSTO_UNIT INTO ##'+@ide+'COS_IMP FROM ((((['+@emp+']..IMPORT_ORDER IC INNER JOIN (['+@emp+']..COST_IMP_PART ID INNER JOIN ['+@EMP+']..PART M ON PART_ID=M.ID) ON IC.ID=ID.ID AND ID.NUMBER_LIQ="'+@POLIMP+'" AND ID.PART_ID=M.ID) left JOIN (['+@emp+'].dbo.CUSTOMS_IMPORT AI INNER JOIN ['+@emp+'].dbo.CUSTOMS A ON AI.CUSTOMS_ID=A.CUSTOMS_ID) ON IC.ID=AI.NUMBER_IMPORT) LEFT JOIN (['+@emp+']..BANK_IMPORT BI INNER JOIN ['+@emp+']..BANK B ON BI.BANK_ID=B.ID) ON IC.ID=BI.NUMBER_IMPORT) LEFT JOIN ['+@emp+'].dbo.IMPORT_COST_CERTIFICATE_LINE G ON IC.ID=G.ID AND G.NUMBER_LIQ="'+@POLIMP+'") inner join ['+@EMP+']..TYPE_COST TG ON G.COST_ID=TG.ID WHERE IC.ID>="'+@impini+'" AND IC.ID<="'+@impfin+'" ') /* ACTULIZO PARA QUE NO HAIGA DUPLICADO*/ exec('set quoted_identifier off SELECT CNUMERO,CDESPROVE,COD_ADU,NOM_ADU,NOM_BAN,NRO_FAC,COB_EXT,FECHA_FAC,FECHA_VTO,CNUMLIQUI, CNUMIMP,CCODMONIM,FEMISION,NCANTIDAD,UMREFERENCIA,CCODARTIC,CDESARTIC, SUM(VALOR_FOB) AS VALOR_FOB,SUM(FLETE) AS FLETE,SUM(CCSEGURO) AS CCSEGURO,SUM(TOTAL_VALOR_CFR) AS TOTAL_VALOR_CFR,SUM(GASTOS_VPE) AS GASTOS_VPE, SUM(AD_VAL) AS AD_VAL,SUM(GASTOS_AGE) AS GASTOS_AGE,SUM(INTS_ADU) AS INTS_ADU,SUM(FLETE_CON) AS FLETE_CON,SUM(SEGURO) AS SEGURO,SUM(GASTOS_BAN) AS GASTOS_BAN, SUM(TRANS_DESC) AS TRANS_DESC,SUM(COSTO_TOTAL) AS COSTO_TOTAL,SUM(COSTO_UNIT) AS COSTO_UNIT INTO ##'+@ide+'COS_IMP_TOTAL FROM ##'+@ide+'COS_IMP GROUP BY CNUMERO,CDESPROVE,COD_ADU,NOM_ADU,NOM_BAN,NRO_FAC,COB_EXT,FECHA_FAC,FECHA_VTO,CNUMLIQUI, CNUMIMP,CCODMONIM,FEMISION,NCANTIDAD,UMREFERENCIA,CCODARTIC,CDESARTIC ') /* Actualizo la tasa de aranceles*/ exec('set quoted_identifier off UPDATE T SET AD_VAL=CUSTOMS_MEASURE from (##'+@ide+'COS_IMP_TOTAL T inner join ['+@emp+'].dbo.PART M ON CCODARTIC=M.ID) INNER JOIN ['+@emp+'].dbo.CUSTOMS_TARIFF A ON M.CUSTOMS_TARIFF_ID=A.CUSTOMSTARIFF_ID ')
exec('set quoted_identifier off DROP TABLE ##'+@ide+'COS_IMP ') /*ACTUALIZO VALOR FOB EN COS_IMP_TOTAL */ exec('set quoted_identifier off UPDATE C SET VALOR_FOB=AMOUNT_FOB FROM ##'+@ide+'COS_IMP_TOTAL C INNER JOIN ['+@EMP+']..IMPORT_COST_CERTIFICATE I ON C.CNUMERO=I.ID AND C.CNUMLIQUI=I.NUMBER_LIQ ') exec('set quoted_identifier off SELECT T.CNUMERO,T.CDESPROVE,COD_ADU,NOM_ADU,NOM_BAN,NRO_FAC, COB_EXT,FECHA_FAC,FECHA_VTO,T.CNUMLIQUI,T.CNUMIMP,T.CCODMONIM,T.FEMISION,T.NCANTIDAD, UMREFERENCIA,T.CCODARTIC,T.CDESARTIC, CAST(IDE.AMOUNT AS NUMERIC(23,2))- CAST(((T.NCANTIDAD/(SELECT SUM(IDD.QTY) AS CANT_TOT FROM ['+@EMP+']..COST_IMP_PART IDD WHERE IDD.ID=I.ID AND IDD.NUMBER_LIQ="'+@POLIMP+'"))*AMOUNT_FLETE)*(T.VALOR_FOB/I.AMOUNT) AS NUMERIC(23,2)) -CAST(((T.NCANTIDAD/(SELECT SUM(IDD.QTY) AS CANT_TOT FROM ['+@emp+']..COST_IMP_PART IDD WHERE IDD.ID=I.ID AND IDD.NUMBER_LIQ="'+@POLIMP+'"))*ISNULL(I.SECURE,0))*(T.VALOR_FOB/I.AMOUNT) AS NUMERIC(23,2)) AS VALOR_FOB, CAST(((T.NCANTIDAD/(SELECT SUM(IDD.QTY) AS CANT_TOT FROM ['+@emp+']..COST_IMP_PART IDD WHERE IDD.ID=I.ID AND IDD.NUMBER_LIQ="'+@POLIMP+'"))*AMOUNT_FLETE)*(T.VALOR_FOB/I.AMOUNT) AS NUMERIC(23,2)) AS FLETE, CAST(((T.NCANTIDAD/(SELECT SUM(IDD.QTY) AS CANT_TOT FROM ['+@emp+']..COST_IMP_PART IDD WHERE IDD.ID=I.ID AND IDD.NUMBER_LIQ="'+@POLIMP+'"))*ISNULL(I.SECURE,0))*(T.VALOR_FOB/I.AMOUNT) AS NUMERIC(23,2)) AS CCSEGURO, CAST(IDE.AMOUNT AS NUMERIC(23,2)) AS TOTAL_VALOR_CFR, GASTOS_VPE,AD_VAL,GASTOS_AGE, INTS_ADU,FLETE_CON,SEGURO,GASTOS_BAN,TRANS_DESC,COSTO_TOTAL,COSTO_UNIT INTO ##'+@ide+'COS_IMP FROM ##'+@ide+'COS_IMP_TOTAL T INNER JOIN (['+@emp+']..IMPORT_ORDER I INNER JOIN ['+@emp+']..COST_IMP_PART IDE ON I.ID=IDE.ID) ON T.CNUMERO=I.ID AND T.CCODARTIC=IDE.PART_ID AND T.CNUMLIQUI=IDE.NUMBER_LIQ ') exec('set quoted_identifier off DROP TABLE ##'+@ide+'COS_IMP_TOTAL ')
exec('set quoted_identifier off SELECT T.CNUMERO,T.CDESPROVE,COD_ADU,NOM_ADU,NOM_BAN,NRO_FAC, COB_EXT,FECHA_FAC,FECHA_VTO,T.CNUMLIQUI,T.CNUMIMP,T.CCODMONIM,T.FEMISION,NCANTIDAD, UMREFERENCIA,CCODARTIC,CDESARTIC,VALOR_FOB,FLETE,CCSEGURO,TOTAL_VALOR_CFR, CAST(((VALOR_FOB/(SELECT SUM(VALOR_FOB) AS CANT_TOT FROM ##'+@ide+'COS_IMP TT WHERE TT.CNUMERO=T.CNUMERO))*GASTOS_VPE) AS NUMERIC(23,2)) AS GASTOS_VPE,
((TOTAL_VALOR_CFR+CAST(((TOTAL_VALOR_CFR/AMOUNT_FOB)*FLETE_CON) AS NUMERIC(23,2))+CAST(((TOTAL_VALOR_CFR/AMOUNT_FOB)*SEGURO) AS NUMERIC(23,2)))*(AD_VAL/100)) AS AD_VAL,
CAST(((TOTAL_VALOR_CFR/AMOUNT_FOB)*GASTOS_AGE) AS NUMERIC(23,2)) AS GASTOS_AGE, CAST(((TOTAL_VALOR_CFR/AMOUNT_FOB)*INTS_ADU) AS NUMERIC(23,2)) AS INTS_ADU, CAST(((TOTAL_VALOR_CFR/AMOUNT_FOB)*FLETE_CON) AS NUMERIC(23,2)) AS FLETE_CON, CAST(((TOTAL_VALOR_CFR/AMOUNT_FOB)*SEGURO) AS NUMERIC(23,2)) AS SEGURO, CAST(((TOTAL_VALOR_CFR/AMOUNT_FOB)*GASTOS_BAN) AS NUMERIC(23,2)) AS GASTOS_BAN, CAST(((NCANTIDAD/(SELECT SUM(NCANTIDAD) AS CANT_TOT FROM ##'+@ide+'COS_IMP TT WHERE TT.CNUMERO=T.CNUMERO))*TRANS_DESC) AS NUMERIC(23,2)) AS TRANS_DESC, COSTO_TOTAL,COSTO_UNIT, ((TOTAL_VALOR_CFR+CAST(((TOTAL_VALOR_CFR/AMOUNT_FOB)*FLETE_CON) AS NUMERIC(23,2))+CAST(((TOTAL_VALOR_CFR/AMOUNT_FOB)*SEGURO) AS NUMERIC(23,2)))*(AD_VAL/100)) AS xAD_VAL, CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,8),0.000000) AS SUM_ADVALOREM, CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,5),0.00000) AS TAZA_F
INTO ##'+@ide+'COS_IMP_TOTAL FROM ##'+@ide+'COS_IMP T INNER JOIN ['+@emp+']..IMPORT_COST_CERTIFICATE I ON T.CNUMERO=I.ID AND I.NUMBER_LIQ="'+@POLIMP+'" ') /* LE AGREAGO LOS CAMPOS PARA VOLVER A CALCULAR LO QUE GUARDA LA SUMA DEL ADVALOREM DE CAMPO AD_VAL */ exec('set quoted_identifier off UPDATE ##'+@ide+'COS_IMP_TOTAL SET SUM_ADVALOREM=(SELECT SUM(AD_VAL) FROM ##'+@ide+'COS_IMP_TOTAL) ') /* LUEGO ACTUALIZO EL CAMPO AD_VAL CON LA NUEVA FORMUAL */ exec('set quoted_identifier off UPDATE ##'+@ide+'COS_IMP_TOTAL SET TAZA_F=xAD_VAL/SUM_ADVALOREM ') /* LUEGO ACTUALIZO EL CAMPO AD_VAL CON LA NUEVA FORMUAL */ /* FALTA BD */ exec('set quoted_identifier off UPDATE C SET AD_VAL=(IMPGS.AMOUNT)*C.TAZA_F FROM ##'+@ide+'COS_IMP_TOTAL C INNER JOIN ['+@emp+'].DBO.IMPORT_COST_CERTIFICATE_LINE IMPGS ON C.CNUMERO=IMPGS.ID AND C.CNUMLIQUI=IMPGS.NUMBER_LIQ WHERE IMPGS.ID="'+@IMPINI+'" and IMPGS.NUMBER_LIQ="'+@polimp+'" AND IMPGS.COST_ID='+@congen4+' ')
/* PARA EL COSTO TOTAL*/ --COSTO_TOTAL=(TOTAL_VALOR_CFR+GASTOS_VPE+AD_VAL+GASTOS_AGE+INTS_ADU+SEGURO+GASTOS_BAN+TRANS_DESC) exec('set quoted_identifier off UPDATE ##'+@ide+'COS_IMP_TOTAL SET COSTO_TOTAL=TOTAL_VALOR_CFR+GASTOS_VPE+AD_VAL+GASTOS_AGE+INTS_ADU+FLETE_CON+SEGURO+GASTOS_BAN+TRANS_DESC ') /* FIN*/ /* PARA EL COSTO UNITARIO*/ exec('set quoted_identifier off UPDATE ##'+@ide+'COS_IMP_TOTAL SET COSTO_UNIT=(COSTO_TOTAL/NCANTIDAD) ') /* FIN*/ /* Inserto en la tabla HOJA_COSTOS */ exec('set quoted_identifier off insert into ['+@emp+'].dbo.HOJA_COSTOS (HCNUMIMPOR,HCNUMLIQUI,HCTIPO,HCITEM,HCCODARTIC,HCDESARTIC,HCCANTIDAD, HCVALORFOB,HCFLETE,HCCSEGURO,HCTOTALCFR,HCGASTOSVPE,HCADVAL,HCGASAGEN,HCAGADUANA, HFLETECON,HCSEGURO,HCGASBAN,HCTRANSPORTE,HCCOSTOTOT,HCCOSTOUNI) select T.CNUMERO AS CNUMIMPOR,T.CNUMLIQUI,1 as TIPO,ITEM,T.CCODARTIC,T.CDESARTIC,T.NCANTIDAD, VALOR_FOB,FLETE,CCSEGURO,TOTAL_VALOR_CFR,GASTOS_VPE,AD_VAL,GASTOS_AGE,INTS_ADU, FLETE_CON,SEGURO,GASTOS_BAN,TRANS_DESC,COSTO_TOTAL,COSTO_UNIT from ##'+@ide+'COS_IMP_TOTAL T inner join ['+@emp+']..COST_IMP_PART D on T.CNUMERO=D.ID AND T.CCODARTIC=D.PART_ID AND D.NUMBER_LIQ="'+@POLIMP+'" ') /* Fin */ exec('set quoted_identifier off select HCNUMIMPOR,HCNUMLIQUI,HCTIPO,HCITEM,HCCODARTIC,HCDESARTIC,HCCANTIDAD, HCVALORFOB,HCFLETE,HCCSEGURO,HCTOTALCFR,HCGASTOSVPE,HCADVAL,HCGASAGEN,HCAGADUANA, HFLETECON,HCSEGURO,HCGASBAN,HCTRANSPORTE,HCCOSTOTOT,HCCOSTOUNI from ['+@emp+'].dbo.HOJA_COSTOS order by HCITEM ')

declare @STRquery nvarchar(1000) declare @criterio nvarchar(1000) SET @criterio=N' WHERE 1=1' if len(@codigo)>0 set @criterio=@criterio + N' and P.ID=@codigo'
if @opcion='0' --Buscar si existe el código del color set @STRquery='Select id from COLOR P'

SET @ERROR1=0 exec sp_executesql @STRquery1,N'@codigo varchar(20)', @codigo set @ERROR1 = @@Error
if @errores<>0 --AND @ERROR1<>0 BEGIN ROLLBACK TRAN Mant_Articulo END else BEGIN COMMIT TRAN Mant_Articulo END

if @OPCION='1' --Insertar Set @STRquery='INSERT INTO VENDOR (ID,NAME,VAT_REGISTRATION,ADDR,STATE_ID,COUNTRY_ID,PHONE,FAX_NUMBER, EMAIL,WEBSITE,TYPE_VENDOR_ID,STATUS,CONTACT,CONTACT_POSITION,CONTACT_PHONE, CONTACT_EMAIL,REPRESENT,REPRESENT_POSITION,REPRESENT_PHONE,REPRESENT_EMAIL, CREATE_DATE,CREATE_USER,COMMENT,DOCUMENT_TYPE_PERSON_ID,TYPE_COMPANY,ACCOUNT_LOCAL,ACCOUNT_EXTERNAL) VALUES (@CODIGO,@NOMBRE,@RUC,@DIRECCION,@DISTRITO,@PAIS,@TELEFONO,@FAX,@EMAIL,@WEB, @GIRONEGOCIO,@ESTADO,@NOMCONT,@CARGOCONT,@TELCONT,@EMAILCONT,@NOMREP,@CARGOREP, @TELREP,@EMAILREP,@FECCREACION,@USUARIO,@GLOSA,@tipoDoc,@tipoEmp,@cuenta_local,@cuenta_extranjera)' if @OPCION='2' --Modificar Set @STRquery='UPDATE VENDOR SET NAME=@NOMBRE,VAT_REGISTRATION=@RUC,ADDR=@DIRECCION,STATE_ID=@DISTRITO,COUNTRY_ID=@PAIS, PHONE=@TELEFONO,FAX_NUMBER=@FAX, EMAIL=@EMAIL,WEBSITE=@WEB, TYPE_VENDOR_ID=@GIRONEGOCIO,STATUS=@ESTADO,CONTACT=@NOMCONT, CONTACT_POSITION=@CARGOCONT,CONTACT_PHONE=@TELCONT,CONTACT_EMAIL=@EMAILCONT, REPRESENT=@NOMREP, REPRESENT_POSITION=@CARGOREP, REPRESENT_PHONE=@TELREP,REPRESENT_EMAIL=@EMAILREP,MODIFY_DATE=@FECCREACION, COMMENT=@GLOSA,DOCUMENT_TYPE_PERSON_ID=@tipoDoc,TYPE_COMPANY=@tipoEmp,ACCOUNT_LOCAL=@cuenta_local,ACCOUNT_EXTERNAL=@cuenta_extranjera WHERE ID=@CODIGO'
if @OPCION='3' --Eliminar Set @STRquery='DELETE FROM VENDOR WHERE ID=@CODIGO'
Begin Tran Mant_Vendor Set @Errores=0 --Para insertar exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@codigo varchar(11), @nombre varchar(100),@ruc varchar(11), @direccion varchar(100),@distrito varchar(8), @pais varchar(3),@gironegocio varchar(2),@fax varchar(30),@telefono varchar(30),@email varchar(50),@web varchar(50), @estado char(1),@nomRep varchar(70),@CargoRep varchar(30),@TelRep varchar(30),@emailrep varchar(50), @nomCont varchar(70),@CargoCont varchar(30),@TelCont varchar(30),@emailCont varchar(50),@glosa varchar (255),@feccreacion varchar(10), @Usuario varchar(8),@opcion char(1),@tipoDoc varchar(2),@tipoEmp varchar(2),@cuenta_local VARCHAR(50),@cuenta_extranjera VARCHAR(50) ', @codigo, @nombre,@ruc, @direccion,@distrito,@pais,@gironegocio,@fax,@telefono,@email ,@web,@estado,@nomRep,@CargoRep,@TelRep, @emailrep,@nomCont, @CargoCont,@TelCont,@emailCont,@glosa,@fecCreacion,@Usuario,@opcion,@tipoDoc,@tipoEmp,@cuenta_local,@cuenta_extranjera set @Errores = @@Error
Set @ERROR1=0 -- Para eliminar exec sp_executesql @STRquery1,N'@codigo varchar(11)', @codigo set @ERROR1 = @@Error

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
set quoted_identifier off set nocount on
DECLARE @CONT INT SET @EMP=LTRIM(RTRIM(@EMP)) SET @USU=LTRIM(RTRIM(@USU))
IF @OP=1 --EXISTE TEMPORAL BEGIN SELECT @CONT=COUNT(name) FROM tempdb.dbo.sysobjects WHERE name =LTRIM(RTRIM(@NOMTABLA)) IF @CONT=0 BEGIN IF @EMP='' SELECT 0 AS EXISTE ELSE SET @VALOR=0 END ELSE BEGIN IF @EMP='' SELECT 1 AS EXISTE ELSE SET @VALOR=1 END END IF @OP=2 --ELIMINAR DATOS DEL TEMPORAL CORRESPONDIENTE AL USUARIO Y A LA EMPRESA BEGIN SELECT @CONT=COUNT(name) FROM tempdb.dbo.sysobjects WHERE name =LTRIM(RTRIM(@NOMTABLA)) IF @CONT >0 EXEC('SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER OFF DELETE FROM ' + @NOMTABLA + ' WHERE EMP="' + @EMP + '" AND USU="' + @USU + '"' ) END

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
declare @STRquery nvarchar(1500)
set @STRquery='Select C.ID,C.DOCUMENT_DATE,C.VENDOR_ID,V.NAME,V.VAT_REGISTRATION,V.ADDR,V.CONTACT, V.REPRESENT, C.COMMENT,C.CURRENCY_ID,COMMENT_COT,QUOTE_DATE,SCTIPCAM,SCVALIDEZ,SCTIEMENT, SCFORPAG,SCNCOTIZ, PART_ID,PART_DESCRIPTION,UNIT,QTY,D.COMMENT AS GLOSADET, D.PRICE, AMOUNT_TAX, GUARANTEE, MARK, DISCOUNT, DLV_DATE, IS_VAT FROM PURCHASE_QUOTE C INNER JOIN PURCHASE_QUOTE_LINE D ON C.ID=D.ID INNER JOIN VENDOR V ON C.VENDOR_ID=V.ID WHERE (C.ID BETWEEN @NUMINI AND @NUMFIN) AND (C.DOCUMENT_DATE BETWEEN @FECINI AND @FECFIN ) ORDER BY ITEM'
exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@NUMINI varchar(10), @NUMFIN VARCHAR(10),@FECINI NUMERIC(15,6), @FECFIN NUMERIC(15,6)',@NUMINI, @NUMFIN,@FECINI,@FECFIN

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
declare @STRquery nvarchar(4000)
set @STRquery='Select C.ID,C.TYPE,DOCUMENT_DATE, VENDOR_ID,V.NAME,V.VAT_REGISTRATION,V.ADDR,V.CONTACT, V.REPRESENT, PHONE,FAX_NUMBER,NUMBER_ESTIMATING,CURRENCY_TYPE, TERMS_NAME, SELL_RATE, PROMISE_DATE, C.COMMENT, AUTORIZED_ID, BUYER_PURCHASE_ID, ADDR_DLV, C.STATUS_ID, AMOUNT,C.DISCOUNT, C.AMOUNT_TAX, AMOUNT_SALES, UPDATE_DATE, USER_ID, CURR_EXCHANGE_TYPE, NAME_FACT, VAT_REGISTRATION_FACT, ADDR_FACT,REFER_DOCUMENT_TYPE,REFER_DOCUMENT_NUMBER,ITEM,PART_ID, PART_DESCRIPTION,UNIT,UNIT_REFERENCE,FACTOR_REFERENCE, QTY,PRICE,DISCOUNT_PER,D.DISCOUNT AS DISCOUNT2 , D.AMOUNT_TAX AS AMOUNT_TAX2, PERCENT_TAX, PRICE_NET, AMOUNT_TOTAL, AMOUNT_TOTAL_NET,QTY_ENTER, QTY_OUT,D.STATUS_ID AS STATUS_ID2,COMMENT1, TEXT_COMMENT,IS_VAT,PRICE_UNIT,CCOST_ID,c.serie FROM PURCHASE_FACT_SUPPLIER C INNER JOIN PURCHASE_FACT_SUPPLIER_L D ON C.ID=D.ID AND C.TYPE=D.TYPE INNER JOIN VENDOR V ON C.VENDOR_ID=V.ID WHERE C.ID=@NUMERO AND C.TYPE=@TIPO ORDER BY ITEM' /*IF @TIPO='CT' set @STRquery='Select C.ID,C.DOCUMENT_DATE,V.NAME,V.VAT_REGISTRATION,V.ADDR,V.CONTACT, V.REPRESENT, C.COMMENT,C.CURRENCY_ID,COMMENT_COT,QUOTE_DATE,SCTIPCAM,SCVALIDEZ,SCTIEMENT, SCFORPAG,SCNCOTIZ, PART_ID,PART_DESCRIPTION,UNIT,QTY,D.COMMENT AS GLOSADET, D.PRICE, AMOUNT_TAX, GUARANTEE, MARK, DISCOUNT, DLV_DATE, IS_VAT FROM PURCHASE_QUOTE C INNER JOIN PURCHASE_QUOTE_LINE D ON C.ID=D.ID INNER JOIN VENDOR V ON C.VENDOR_ID=V.ID WHERE C.ID=@NUMERO ORDER BY ITEM' */
exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@NUMERO varchar(13),@TIPO varchar(2)',@NUMERO,@TIPO

declare @STRquery nvarchar(4000)
set @STRquery='SELECT V.NAME AS V_NAME,V.VAT_REGISTRATION AS V_VATREGISTRATION, V.ADDR AS V_ADDR,I.VENDOR_ID AS I_VENDOR_ID,I.DOCUMENT_DATE AS I_DOCUMENTDATE, I.PROMISE_DATE AS I_PROMISEDATE,I.AMOUNT AS I_AMOUNT, I.CURRENCY_ID_IMP AS I_CURRENCYIDIMP, I.EQUIVALENCE_US AS I_EQUIVALENCE_US,I.CURRENCY_EXCHANGE AS I_CURRENCY_EXCHANGE, I.SOLIINSP AS I_SOLIINSP,I.GUIATRAN AS I_GUIATRAN,I.AMOUNT_LIQ AS I_AMOUNT_LIQ, I.LLIQREAL AS I_LLIQREAL,I.AMOUNT_BALANCE AS I_AMOUNT_BALANCE,I.AMOUNT_BALANCE_LIQ AS I_AMOUNT_BALANCE_LIQ, I.COMMENT AS I_COMMENT,I.TYPE_ORDER AS I_TYPE_ORDER,I.NUMBER_LIQ AS I_NUMBER_LIQ, I.NADVALOR AS I_NADVALOR,I.ITINERANT AS I_ITINERANT, I.CPACKING AS I_CPACKING, I.CURR_EXCHANGE_TYPE AS I_CURR_EXCHANGE_TYPE,I.TIPPREIMP AS I_TIPPREIMP,I.STATUS_ID AS I_STATUS_ID, I.AMOUNT_FLETE AS I_AMOUNT_FLETE,I.NUMBER_IMPORT_INT AS I_NUMBER_IMPORT_INT,I.SECURE AS I_SECURE, C.ID AS C_ID, C.NUMBER_LIQ AS C_NUMBER_LIQ,C.DOCUMENT_DATE AS C_DOCUMENT_DATE, C.PERCENT_FOB AS C_PERCENT_FOB,C.AMOUNT_FOB AS C_AMOUNT_FOB,C.AMOUNT_TOTAL AS C_AMOUNT_TOTAL, C.NUMBER_PARTE AS C_NUMBER_PARTE,C.WAREHOUSE_ID AS C_WAREHOUSE_ID,D.COST_ID AS D_COST_ID, D.COMMENT_COST AS D_COMMENT_COST,D.AMOUNT AS D_AMOUNT, D.TYPE AS D_TYPE,D.CURRENCY_EXCHANGE AS D_CURRENCY_EXCHANGE, D.EXCHANGE_TYPE AS D_EXCHANGE_TYPE,D.CURRENCY_ID AS D_CURRENCY_ID,D.NUMBER_IMPORT_INT AS D_NUMBER_IMPORT_INT, D.AMOUNT_COST_ORIG AS D_AMOUNT_COST_ORIG,T.DESCRIPTION AS T_DESCRIPTION,T.SUM_COST AS T_SUM_COST,T.ID AS T_ID FROM IMPORT_COST_CERTIFICATE C INNER JOIN IMPORT_COST_CERTIFICATE_LINE D ON C.ID = D.ID AND C.NUMBER_LIQ = D.NUMBER_LIQ INNER JOIN IMPORT_ORDER I ON C.ID = I.ID INNER JOIN TYPE_COST T ON D.COST_ID = T.ID INNER JOIN VENDOR V ON I.VENDOR_ID = V.ID WHERE C.ID=@NUMIMPOR AND C.NUMBER_LIQ=@NUMLIQ '

DECLARE @STRQUERY NVarchar(4000) DECLARE @criterio NVarchar(2000)
IF LEN(@PROV1)<>0 AND LEN(@PROV2)<>0 SET @criterio=' AND A.VENDOR_ID BETWEEN @PROV1 AND @PROV2 order by V.NAME,c.PART_DESCRIPTION, a.ID '
IF LEN(@ART1)<>0 AND LEN(@ART2)<>0 SET @criterio=' AND C.PART_ID BETWEEN @ART1 AND @ART2 ORDER BY c.PART_DESCRIPTION, V.NAME, a.ID '
SET @STRQUERY='select a.ID,a.STATUS_ID,d.DESCRIPTION, a.DOCUMENT_DATE,a.PROMISE_DATE,a.VENDOR_ID, V.NAME,a.CURRENCY_TYPE,a.NUMBER_ESTIMATING, c.ITEM,c.PART_ID,c.PART_DESCRIPTION, c.UNIT,C.PRICE, C.DISCOUNT_PER, C.DISCOUNT, C.AMOUNT_TAX, C.PERCENT_TAX, C.PRICE_NET, C.AMOUNT_TOTAL, C.AMOUNT_TOTAL_NET, C.PRICE_UNIT, c.QTY, c.QTY_ENTER, (c.QTY- c.QTY_ENTER) AS SALDO From PURCHASE_ORDER a INNER JOIN PURCHASE_ORDER_LINE C ON a.ID=c.ID AND C.TYPE=@TIPO INNER JOIN PURCHASE_STATUS d ON a.STATUS_ID=d.ID INNER JOIN VENDOR V ON A.VENDOR_ID=V.ID Where a.STATUS_ID BETWEEN @ESTADO1 AND @ESTADO2 AND DOCUMENT_DATE BETWEEN @FEC1 AND @FEC2 '
set @STRQUERY=@STRQUERY + @criterio exec sp_executesql @STRQUERY,N'@PROV1 CHAR(11),@PROV2 CHAR(11), @ART1 CHAR(20),@ART2 CHAR(20),@ESTADO1 CHAR(2),@ESTADO2 CHAR(2), @TIPO CHAR(2),@FEC1 NUMERIC(15,6),@FEC2 NUMERIC(15,6)',@PROV1,@PROV2,@ART1,@ART2,@ESTADO1, @ESTADO2,@TIPO,@FEC1,@FEC2

DECLARE @STRQUERY NVarchar(4000) DECLARE @criterio NVarchar(2000)
IF LEN(@PROV1)<>0 AND LEN(@PROV2)<>0 SET @criterio=' AND C.VENDOR_ID BETWEEN @PROV1 AND @PROV2 order by V.NAME '
IF LEN(@ART1)<>0 AND LEN(@ART2)<>0 SET @criterio=' AND D.PART_ID BETWEEN @ART1 AND @ART2 ORDER BY D.PART_DESCRIPTION'
SET @STRQUERY='SELECT C.ID AS C_ID,C.STATUS_ID AS C_STATUS_ID,C.VENDOR_ID AS C_VENDOR_ID, C.DOCUMENT_DATE AS C_DOCUMENT_DATE, C.PROMISE_DATE AS C_PROMISE_DATE,C.AMOUNT AS C_AMOUNT,C.CURRENCY_ID_IMP AS C_CURRENCY_ID_IMP, C.EQUIVALENCE_US AS C_EQUIVALENCE_US,C.CURRENCY_EXCHANGE AS C_CURRENCY_EXCHANGE,C.COMMENT AS C_COMMENT, C.NUMBER_IMPORT_INT AS C_NUMBER_IMPORT_INT,D.PART_ID AS D_PART_ID,D.PART_DESCRIPTION AS D_PART_DESCRIPTION, D.ITEM AS D_ITEM, D.UNIT AS D_UNIT, D.QTY AS D_QTY,D.PRICE AS D_PRICE, D.PRICE_NET AS D_PRICE_NET, D.QTY_IN AS D_QTY_IN,D.QTY_BALANCE AS D_QTY_BALANCE,D.RECEIVE AS D_RECEIVE,D.PRICE_REF AS D_PRICE_REF, D.TOTAL_SALES AS D_TOTAL_SALES,D.COMMENT AS D_COMMENT, V.NAME AS V_NAME, V.VAT_REGISTRATION AS V_VAT_REGISTRATION, V.ADDR AS V_ADDR, T.DESCRIPTION AS T_DESCRIPTION FROM IMPORT_ORDER C INNER JOIN IMPORT_ORDER_LINE D ON C.ID = D.ID INNER JOIN TYPE_IMPORT T ON C.TYPE_ORDER = T.ID INNER JOIN VENDOR V ON C.VENDOR_ID = V.ID Where (D.QTY-D.QTY_IN)> 0'

--REFER_DOCUMENT_NUMBER="'+@NRODOCREF+'",SERIE="'+@PSERIE+'",EXPIRATION_DATE='+@PEXPIRATION_DATE+',BUDGET_ID="'+@PBUDGET_ID+', --ORDER_BUY_ID="'+@PORDER_BUY+'",NOTE_IN_ID="'+@PNOTE_IN_ID+'",WAREHOUSE_ID="'+@ALMA+'" WHERE ID= "'+@NUMERO+'" AND TYPE="'+@TIPO+'"')

DECLARE @CUSTOMER_ID VARCHAR(15) DECLARE @DOCUMENT_DATE VARCHAR(10) DECLARE @CUSTOMER_ID_DOS VARCHAR(15) DECLARE @QTY FLOAT DECLARE @AMOUNT FLOAT DECLARE @SUMA_QTY_ENERO FLOAT DECLARE @SUMA_AMOUNT_ENERO FLOAT DECLARE @SUMA_QTY_FEBRERO FLOAT DECLARE @SUMA_AMOUNT_FEBRERO FLOAT DECLARE @SUMA_QTY_MARZO FLOAT DECLARE @SUMA_AMOUNT_MARZO FLOAT DECLARE @SUMA_QTY_ABRIL FLOAT DECLARE @SUMA_AMOUNT_ABRIL FLOAT DECLARE @SUMA_QTY_MAYO FLOAT DECLARE @SUMA_AMOUNT_MAYO FLOAT DECLARE @SUMA_QTY_JUNIO FLOAT DECLARE @SUMA_AMOUNT_JUNIO FLOAT DECLARE @SUMA_QTY_JULIO FLOAT DECLARE @SUMA_AMOUNT_JULIO FLOAT DECLARE @SUMA_QTY_AGOSTO FLOAT DECLARE @SUMA_AMOUNT_AGOSTO FLOAT DECLARE @SUMA_QTY_SETIEMBRE FLOAT DECLARE @SUMA_AMOUNT_SETIEMBRE FLOAT DECLARE @SUMA_QTY_OCTUBRE FLOAT DECLARE @SUMA_AMOUNT_OCTUBRE FLOAT DECLARE @SUMA_QTY_NOVIEMBRE FLOAT DECLARE @SUMA_AMOUNT_NOVIEMBRE FLOAT DECLARE @SUMA_QTY_DICIEMBRE FLOAT DECLARE @SUMA_AMOUNT_DICIEMBRE FLOAT DECLARE @MES VARCHAR(2)
DROP TABLE TABLADECLIENTES
--Select B.DOCUMENT_DATE,B.CUSTOMER_ID,B.CUSTOMER_NAME,A.AMOUNT,A.QTY,A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,A.DOCUMENT_ID --into TABLADECLIENTES --From ([DROG_DANY].dbo.RECEIVABLE_LINE A Inner Join [DROG_DANY].dbo.RECEIVABLE B on A.DOCUMENT_ID = B.DOCUMENT_ID and --A.NUMBER_SERIE = B.NUMBER_SERIE and A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT = B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT) INNER JOIN [DROG_DANY].DBO.PART C ON A.PART_ID=C.ID --Where A.STATUS <> 'A' AND NOT (IS_STOCKED='N' AND SERIES='N' AND IS_LOT='N') AND DOCUMENT_DATE>=@FECHA1 and DOCUMENT_DATE<= @FECHA2 --ORDER BY DOCUMENT_DATE ,A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT
Select DOCUMENT_DATE,CUSTOMER_ID,VAT_REGISTRATION,CUSTOMER_NAME,SUM(QTY)AS QTY,SUM(A.AMOUNT-A.AMOUNT_TAX)AS AMOUNT, SUM(A.AMOUNT_US)AS AMOUNT_US,B.CURRENCY_ID,SUM(A.AMOUNT_TAX)AS AMOUNT_TAX,B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,B.DOCUMENT_ID into TABLADECLIENTES From ([DROG_DANY].dbo.RECEIVABLE_LINE A Inner Join [DROG_DANY].dbo.RECEIVABLE B on A.DOCUMENT_ID = B.DOCUMENT_ID and A.NUMBER_SERIE = B.NUMBER_SERIE and A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT = B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT) INNER JOIN [DROG_DANY].DBO.PART C ON A.PART_ID=C.ID Where B.STATUS <> 'A' AND DOCUMENT_DATE>=@FECHA1 and DOCUMENT_DATE<= @FECHA2 GROUP BY B.DOCUMENT_DATE,B.CUSTOMER_ID,B.VAT_REGISTRATION,B.CUSTOMER_NAME,B.CURRENCY_ID,B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,B.DOCUMENT_ID ORDER BY DOCUMENT_DATE--A.NUMBER_SERIE,A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT
DELETE FROM TABLAFINALDECLIENTES
INSERT INTO TABLAFINALDECLIENTES(CUSTOMER_ID,CUSTOMER_NAME,VAT_REGISTRATION) SELECT DISTINCT CUSTOMER_ID,CUSTOMER_NAME,VAT_REGISTRATION FROM TABLADECLIENTES ORDER BY CUSTOMER_NAME,CUSTOMER_ID
DECLARE CURSOR1 CURSOR FOR SELECT CUSTOMER_ID FROM TABLAFINALDECLIENTES ORDER BY CUSTOMER_ID OPEN CURSOR1 FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR1 INTO @CUSTOMER_ID WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN SET @SUMA_QTY_ENERO=0 SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_ENERO=0 SET @SUMA_QTY_FEBRERO=0 SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_FEBRERO=0 SET @SUMA_QTY_MARZO=0 SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_MARZO=0 SET @SUMA_QTY_ABRIL=0 SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_ABRIL=0 SET @SUMA_QTY_MAYO=0 SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_MAYO=0 SET @SUMA_QTY_JUNIO=0 SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_JUNIO=0 SET @SUMA_QTY_JULIO=0 SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_JULIO=0 SET @SUMA_QTY_AGOSTO=0 SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_AGOSTO=0 SET @SUMA_QTY_SETIEMBRE=0 SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_SETIEMBRE=0 SET @SUMA_QTY_OCTUBRE=0 SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_OCTUBRE=0 SET @SUMA_QTY_NOVIEMBRE=0 SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_NOVIEMBRE=0 SET @SUMA_QTY_DICIEMBRE=0 SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_DICIEMBRE=0 DECLARE CURSOR2 CURSOR FOR SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR,DOCUMENT_DATE,103)AS DOCUMENT_DATE,CUSTOMER_ID,QTY,AMOUNT FROM TABLADECLIENTES WHERE CUSTOMER_ID=@CUSTOMER_ID OPEN CURSOR2 FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR2 INTO @DOCUMENT_DATE,@CUSTOMER_ID_DOS,@QTY,@AMOUNT WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN SET @MES=SUBSTRING(@DOCUMENT_DATE,4,2) IF @MES='01' BEGIN SET @SUMA_QTY_ENERO=@SUMA_QTY_ENERO+@QTY SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_ENERO=@SUMA_AMOUNT_ENERO+@AMOUNT UPDATE TABLAFINALDECLIENTES SET ENERO=@SUMA_AMOUNT_ENERO,ENERO_QTY=@SUMA_QTY_ENERO WHERE CUSTOMER_ID=@CUSTOMER_ID END ELSE IF @MES='02' BEGIN SET @SUMA_QTY_FEBRERO=@SUMA_QTY_FEBRERO+@QTY SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_FEBRERO=@SUMA_AMOUNT_FEBRERO+@AMOUNT UPDATE TABLAFINALDECLIENTES SET FEBRERO=@SUMA_AMOUNT_FEBRERO,FEBRERO_QTY=@SUMA_QTY_FEBRERO WHERE CUSTOMER_ID=@CUSTOMER_ID END ELSE IF @MES='03' BEGIN SET @SUMA_QTY_MARZO=@SUMA_QTY_MARZO+@QTY SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_MARZO=@SUMA_AMOUNT_MARZO+@AMOUNT UPDATE TABLAFINALDECLIENTES SET MARZO=@SUMA_AMOUNT_MARZO,MARZO_QTY=@SUMA_QTY_MARZO WHERE CUSTOMER_ID=@CUSTOMER_ID END ELSE IF @MES='04' BEGIN SET @SUMA_QTY_ABRIL=@SUMA_QTY_ABRIL+@QTY SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_ABRIL=@SUMA_AMOUNT_ABRIL+@AMOUNT UPDATE TABLAFINALDECLIENTES SET ABRIL=@SUMA_AMOUNT_ABRIL,ABRIL_QTY=@SUMA_QTY_ABRIL WHERE CUSTOMER_ID=@CUSTOMER_ID END ELSE IF @MES='05' BEGIN SET @SUMA_QTY_MAYO=@SUMA_QTY_MAYO+@QTY SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_MAYO=@SUMA_AMOUNT_MAYO+@AMOUNT UPDATE TABLAFINALDECLIENTES SET MAYO=@SUMA_AMOUNT_MAYO,MAYO_QTY=@SUMA_QTY_MAYO WHERE CUSTOMER_ID=@CUSTOMER_ID END ELSE IF @MES='06' BEGIN SET @SUMA_QTY_JUNIO=@SUMA_QTY_JUNIO+@QTY SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_JUNIO=@SUMA_AMOUNT_JUNIO+@AMOUNT UPDATE TABLAFINALDECLIENTES SET JUNIO=@SUMA_AMOUNT_JUNIO,JUNIO_QTY=@SUMA_QTY_JUNIO WHERE CUSTOMER_ID=@CUSTOMER_ID END ELSE IF @MES='07' BEGIN SET @SUMA_QTY_JULIO=@SUMA_QTY_JULIO+@QTY SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_JULIO=@SUMA_AMOUNT_JULIO+@AMOUNT UPDATE TABLAFINALDECLIENTES SET JULIO=@SUMA_AMOUNT_JULIO,JULIO_QTY=@SUMA_QTY_JULIO WHERE CUSTOMER_ID=@CUSTOMER_ID END ELSE IF @MES='08' BEGIN SET @SUMA_QTY_AGOSTO=@SUMA_QTY_AGOSTO+@QTY SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_AGOSTO=@SUMA_AMOUNT_AGOSTO+@AMOUNT UPDATE TABLAFINALDECLIENTES SET AGOSTO=@SUMA_AMOUNT_AGOSTO,AGOSTO_QTY=@SUMA_QTY_AGOSTO WHERE CUSTOMER_ID=@CUSTOMER_ID END ELSE IF @MES='09' BEGIN SET @SUMA_QTY_SETIEMBRE=@SUMA_QTY_SETIEMBRE+@QTY SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_SETIEMBRE=@SUMA_AMOUNT_SETIEMBRE+@AMOUNT UPDATE TABLAFINALDECLIENTES SET SETIEMBRE=@SUMA_AMOUNT_SETIEMBRE,SETIEMBRE_QTY=@SUMA_QTY_SETIEMBRE WHERE CUSTOMER_ID=@CUSTOMER_ID END ELSE IF @MES='10' BEGIN SET @SUMA_QTY_OCTUBRE=@SUMA_QTY_OCTUBRE+@QTY SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_OCTUBRE=@SUMA_AMOUNT_OCTUBRE+@AMOUNT UPDATE TABLAFINALDECLIENTES SET OCTUBRE=@SUMA_AMOUNT_OCTUBRE,OCTUBRE_QTY=@SUMA_QTY_OCTUBRE WHERE CUSTOMER_ID=@CUSTOMER_ID END ELSE IF @MES='11' BEGIN SET @SUMA_QTY_NOVIEMBRE=@SUMA_QTY_NOVIEMBRE+@QTY SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_NOVIEMBRE=@SUMA_AMOUNT_NOVIEMBRE+@AMOUNT UPDATE TABLAFINALDECLIENTES SET NOVIEMBRE=@SUMA_AMOUNT_NOVIEMBRE,NOVIEMBRE_QTY=@SUMA_QTY_NOVIEMBRE WHERE CUSTOMER_ID=@CUSTOMER_ID END ELSE IF @MES='12' BEGIN SET @SUMA_QTY_DICIEMBRE=@SUMA_QTY_DICIEMBRE+@QTY SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_DICIEMBRE=@SUMA_AMOUNT_DICIEMBRE+@AMOUNT UPDATE TABLAFINALDECLIENTES SET DICIEMBRE=@SUMA_AMOUNT_DICIEMBRE,DICIEMBRE_QTY=@SUMA_QTY_DICIEMBRE WHERE CUSTOMER_ID=@CUSTOMER_ID END
FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR2 INTO @DOCUMENT_DATE,@CUSTOMER_ID_DOS,@QTY,@AMOUNT END
CLOSE CURSOR2 DEALLOCATE CURSOR2 FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR1 INTO @CUSTOMER_ID END CLOSE CURSOR1 DEALLOCATE CURSOR1
UPDATE TABLAFINALDECLIENTES SET ENERO=(CASE WHEN ENERO IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE ENERO END),ENERO_QTY=(CASE WHEN ENERO_QTY IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE ENERO_QTY END), FEBRERO=(CASE WHEN FEBRERO IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE FEBRERO END),FEBRERO_QTY=(CASE WHEN FEBRERO_QTY IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE FEBRERO_QTY END), MARZO=(CASE WHEN MARZO IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE MARZO END),MARZO_QTY=(CASE WHEN MARZO_QTY IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE MARZO_QTY END), ABRIL=(CASE WHEN ABRIL IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE ABRIL END),ABRIL_QTY=(CASE WHEN ABRIL_QTY IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE ABRIL_QTY END), MAYO=(CASE WHEN MAYO IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE MAYO END),MAYO_QTY=(CASE WHEN MAYO_QTY IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE MAYO_QTY END), JUNIO=(CASE WHEN JUNIO IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE JUNIO END),JUNIO_QTY=(CASE WHEN JUNIO_QTY IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE JUNIO_QTY END), JULIO=(CASE WHEN JULIO IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE JULIO END),JULIO_QTY=(CASE WHEN JULIO_QTY IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE JULIO_QTY END), AGOSTO=(CASE WHEN AGOSTO IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE AGOSTO END),AGOSTO_QTY=(CASE WHEN AGOSTO_QTY IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE AGOSTO_QTY END), SETIEMBRE=(CASE WHEN SETIEMBRE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE SETIEMBRE END),SETIEMBRE_QTY=(CASE WHEN SETIEMBRE_QTY IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE SETIEMBRE_QTY END), OCTUBRE=(CASE WHEN OCTUBRE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE OCTUBRE END),OCTUBRE_QTY=(CASE WHEN OCTUBRE_QTY IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE OCTUBRE_QTY END), NOVIEMBRE=(CASE WHEN NOVIEMBRE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE NOVIEMBRE END),NOVIEMBRE_QTY=(CASE WHEN NOVIEMBRE_QTY IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE NOVIEMBRE_QTY END), DICIEMBRE=(CASE WHEN DICIEMBRE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE DICIEMBRE END),DICIEMBRE_QTY=(CASE WHEN DICIEMBRE_QTY IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE DICIEMBRE_QTY END)

DECLARE @CUSTOMER_ID VARCHAR(15) DECLARE @DOCUMENT_DATE VARCHAR(10) DECLARE @CUSTOMER_ID_DOS VARCHAR(15) DECLARE @QTY NUMERIC(38,12) DECLARE @AMOUNT NUMERIC(38,12) DECLARE @SUMA_QTY_ENERO NUMERIC(38,12) DECLARE @SUMA_AMOUNT_ENERO NUMERIC(38,12) DECLARE @SUMA_QTY_FEBRERO NUMERIC(38,12) DECLARE @SUMA_AMOUNT_FEBRERO NUMERIC(38,12) DECLARE @SUMA_QTY_MARZO NUMERIC(38,12) DECLARE @SUMA_AMOUNT_MARZO NUMERIC(38,12) DECLARE @SUMA_QTY_ABRIL NUMERIC(38,12) DECLARE @SUMA_AMOUNT_ABRIL NUMERIC(38,12) DECLARE @SUMA_QTY_MAYO NUMERIC(38,12) DECLARE @SUMA_AMOUNT_MAYO NUMERIC(38,12) DECLARE @SUMA_QTY_JUNIO NUMERIC(38,12) DECLARE @SUMA_AMOUNT_JUNIO NUMERIC(38,12) DECLARE @SUMA_QTY_JULIO NUMERIC(38,12) DECLARE @SUMA_AMOUNT_JULIO NUMERIC(38,12) DECLARE @SUMA_QTY_AGOSTO NUMERIC(38,12) DECLARE @SUMA_AMOUNT_AGOSTO NUMERIC(38,12) DECLARE @SUMA_QTY_SETIEMBRE NUMERIC(38,12) DECLARE @SUMA_AMOUNT_SETIEMBRE NUMERIC(38,12) DECLARE @SUMA_QTY_OCTUBRE NUMERIC(38,12) DECLARE @SUMA_AMOUNT_OCTUBRE NUMERIC(38,12) DECLARE @SUMA_QTY_NOVIEMBRE NUMERIC(38,12) DECLARE @SUMA_AMOUNT_NOVIEMBRE NUMERIC(38,12) DECLARE @SUMA_QTY_DICIEMBRE NUMERIC(38,12) DECLARE @SUMA_AMOUNT_DICIEMBRE NUMERIC(38,12) DECLARE @MES VARCHAR(2)
DROP TABLE TABLADECLIENTES_VAT_REGISTRATION
--Select B.DOCUMENT_DATE,B.CUSTOMER_ID,B.CUSTOMER_NAME,A.AMOUNT,A.QTY,A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,A.DOCUMENT_ID --into TABLADECLIENTES --From ([DROG_DANY].dbo.RECEIVABLE_LINE A Inner Join [DROG_DANY].dbo.RECEIVABLE B on A.DOCUMENT_ID = B.DOCUMENT_ID and --A.NUMBER_SERIE = B.NUMBER_SERIE and A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT = B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT) INNER JOIN [DROG_DANY].DBO.PART C ON A.PART_ID=C.ID --Where A.STATUS <> 'A' AND NOT (IS_STOCKED='N' AND SERIES='N' AND IS_LOT='N') AND DOCUMENT_DATE>=@FECHA1 and DOCUMENT_DATE<= @FECHA2 --ORDER BY DOCUMENT_DATE ,A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT
Select DOCUMENT_DATE,VAT_REGISTRATION,CUSTOMER_NAME,SUM(QTY)AS QTY,SUM(A.AMOUNT)AS AMOUNT, SUM(A.AMOUNT_US)AS AMOUNT_US,B.CURRENCY_ID,SUM(A.AMOUNT_TAX)AS AMOUNT_TAX,B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,B.DOCUMENT_ID into TABLADECLIENTES_VAT_REGISTRATION From ([DROG_DANY].dbo.RECEIVABLE_LINE A Inner Join [DROG_DANY].dbo.RECEIVABLE B on A.DOCUMENT_ID = B.DOCUMENT_ID and A.NUMBER_SERIE = B.NUMBER_SERIE and A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT = B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT) INNER JOIN [DROG_DANY].DBO.PART C ON A.PART_ID=C.ID Where B.STATUS <> 'A' AND NOT (IS_STOCKED='N' AND SERIES='N' AND IS_LOT='N') AND DOCUMENT_DATE>=@FECHA1 and DOCUMENT_DATE<= @FECHA2 GROUP BY B.DOCUMENT_DATE,B.VAT_REGISTRATION,B.CUSTOMER_NAME,B.CURRENCY_ID,B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,B.DOCUMENT_ID ORDER BY DOCUMENT_DATE--A.NUMBER_SERIE,A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT
DELETE FROM TABLAFINALDECLIENTES_VAT_REGISTRATION
INSERT INTO TABLAFINALDECLIENTES_VAT_REGISTRATION(CUSTOMER_ID,CUSTOMER_NAME) SELECT DISTINCT VAT_REGISTRATION,CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TABLADECLIENTES_VAT_REGISTRATION ORDER BY CUSTOMER_NAME,VAT_REGISTRATION
DECLARE CURSOR1 CURSOR FOR SELECT CUSTOMER_ID FROM TABLAFINALDECLIENTES_VAT_REGISTRATION ORDER BY CUSTOMER_ID OPEN CURSOR1 FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR1 INTO @CUSTOMER_ID WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN SET @SUMA_QTY_ENERO=0 SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_ENERO=0 SET @SUMA_QTY_FEBRERO=0 SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_FEBRERO=0 SET @SUMA_QTY_MARZO=0 SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_MARZO=0 SET @SUMA_QTY_ABRIL=0 SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_ABRIL=0 SET @SUMA_QTY_MAYO=0 SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_MAYO=0 SET @SUMA_QTY_JUNIO=0 SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_JUNIO=0 SET @SUMA_QTY_JULIO=0 SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_JULIO=0 SET @SUMA_QTY_AGOSTO=0 SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_AGOSTO=0 SET @SUMA_QTY_SETIEMBRE=0 SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_SETIEMBRE=0 SET @SUMA_QTY_OCTUBRE=0 SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_OCTUBRE=0 SET @SUMA_QTY_NOVIEMBRE=0 SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_NOVIEMBRE=0 SET @SUMA_QTY_DICIEMBRE=0 SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_DICIEMBRE=0 DECLARE CURSOR2 CURSOR FOR SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR,DOCUMENT_DATE,103)AS DOCUMENT_DATE,VAT_REGISTRATION,QTY,AMOUNT FROM TABLADECLIENTES_VAT_REGISTRATION WHERE VAT_REGISTRATION=@CUSTOMER_ID OPEN CURSOR2 FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR2 INTO @DOCUMENT_DATE,@CUSTOMER_ID_DOS,@QTY,@AMOUNT WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN SET @MES=SUBSTRING(@DOCUMENT_DATE,4,2) IF @MES='01' BEGIN
SET @SUMA_QTY_ENERO=@SUMA_QTY_ENERO+@QTY SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_ENERO=@SUMA_AMOUNT_ENERO+@AMOUNT UPDATE TABLAFINALDECLIENTES_VAT_REGISTRATION SET ENERO=@SUMA_AMOUNT_ENERO,ENERO_QTY=@SUMA_QTY_ENERO WHERE CUSTOMER_ID=@CUSTOMER_ID END ELSE IF @MES='02' BEGIN SET @SUMA_QTY_FEBRERO=@SUMA_QTY_FEBRERO+@QTY SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_FEBRERO=@SUMA_AMOUNT_FEBRERO+@AMOUNT UPDATE TABLAFINALDECLIENTES_VAT_REGISTRATION SET FEBRERO=@SUMA_AMOUNT_FEBRERO,FEBRERO_QTY=@SUMA_QTY_FEBRERO WHERE CUSTOMER_ID=@CUSTOMER_ID END ELSE IF @MES='03' BEGIN SET @SUMA_QTY_MARZO=@SUMA_QTY_MARZO+@QTY SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_MARZO=@SUMA_AMOUNT_MARZO+@AMOUNT UPDATE TABLAFINALDECLIENTES_VAT_REGISTRATION SET MARZO=@SUMA_AMOUNT_MARZO,MARZO_QTY=@SUMA_QTY_MARZO WHERE CUSTOMER_ID=@CUSTOMER_ID END ELSE IF @MES='04' BEGIN SET @SUMA_QTY_ABRIL=@SUMA_QTY_ABRIL+@QTY SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_ABRIL=@SUMA_AMOUNT_ABRIL+@AMOUNT UPDATE TABLAFINALDECLIENTES_VAT_REGISTRATION SET ABRIL=@SUMA_AMOUNT_ABRIL,ABRIL_QTY=@SUMA_QTY_ABRIL WHERE CUSTOMER_ID=@CUSTOMER_ID END ELSE IF @MES='05' BEGIN SET @SUMA_QTY_MAYO=@SUMA_QTY_MAYO+@QTY SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_MAYO=@SUMA_AMOUNT_MAYO+@AMOUNT UPDATE TABLAFINALDECLIENTES_VAT_REGISTRATION SET MAYO=@SUMA_AMOUNT_MAYO,MAYO_QTY=@SUMA_QTY_MAYO WHERE CUSTOMER_ID=@CUSTOMER_ID END ELSE IF @MES='06' BEGIN SET @SUMA_QTY_JUNIO=@SUMA_QTY_JUNIO+@QTY SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_JUNIO=@SUMA_AMOUNT_JUNIO+@AMOUNT UPDATE TABLAFINALDECLIENTES_VAT_REGISTRATION SET JUNIO=@SUMA_AMOUNT_JUNIO,JUNIO_QTY=@SUMA_QTY_JUNIO WHERE CUSTOMER_ID=@CUSTOMER_ID END ELSE IF @MES='07' BEGIN SET @SUMA_QTY_JULIO=@SUMA_QTY_JULIO+@QTY SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_JULIO=@SUMA_AMOUNT_JULIO+@AMOUNT UPDATE TABLAFINALDECLIENTES_VAT_REGISTRATION SET JULIO=@SUMA_AMOUNT_JULIO,JULIO_QTY=@SUMA_QTY_JULIO WHERE CUSTOMER_ID=@CUSTOMER_ID END ELSE IF @MES='08' BEGIN SET @SUMA_QTY_AGOSTO=@SUMA_QTY_AGOSTO+@QTY SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_AGOSTO=@SUMA_AMOUNT_AGOSTO+@AMOUNT UPDATE TABLAFINALDECLIENTES_VAT_REGISTRATION SET AGOSTO=@SUMA_AMOUNT_AGOSTO,AGOSTO_QTY=@SUMA_QTY_AGOSTO WHERE CUSTOMER_ID=@CUSTOMER_ID END ELSE IF @MES='09' BEGIN SET @SUMA_QTY_SETIEMBRE=@SUMA_QTY_SETIEMBRE+@QTY SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_SETIEMBRE=@SUMA_AMOUNT_SETIEMBRE+@AMOUNT UPDATE TABLAFINALDECLIENTES_VAT_REGISTRATION SET SETIEMBRE=@SUMA_AMOUNT_SETIEMBRE,SETIEMBRE_QTY=@SUMA_QTY_SETIEMBRE WHERE CUSTOMER_ID=@CUSTOMER_ID END ELSE IF @MES='10' BEGIN SET @SUMA_QTY_OCTUBRE=@SUMA_QTY_OCTUBRE+@QTY SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_OCTUBRE=@SUMA_AMOUNT_OCTUBRE+@AMOUNT UPDATE TABLAFINALDECLIENTES_VAT_REGISTRATION SET OCTUBRE=@SUMA_AMOUNT_OCTUBRE,OCTUBRE_QTY=@SUMA_QTY_OCTUBRE WHERE CUSTOMER_ID=@CUSTOMER_ID END ELSE IF @MES='11' BEGIN SET @SUMA_QTY_NOVIEMBRE=@SUMA_QTY_NOVIEMBRE+@QTY SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_NOVIEMBRE=@SUMA_AMOUNT_NOVIEMBRE+@AMOUNT UPDATE TABLAFINALDECLIENTES_VAT_REGISTRATION SET NOVIEMBRE=@SUMA_AMOUNT_NOVIEMBRE,NOVIEMBRE_QTY=@SUMA_QTY_NOVIEMBRE WHERE CUSTOMER_ID=@CUSTOMER_ID END ELSE IF @MES='12' BEGIN SET @SUMA_QTY_DICIEMBRE=@SUMA_QTY_DICIEMBRE+@QTY SET @SUMA_AMOUNT_DICIEMBRE=@SUMA_AMOUNT_DICIEMBRE+@AMOUNT UPDATE TABLAFINALDECLIENTES_VAT_REGISTRATION SET DICIEMBRE=@SUMA_AMOUNT_DICIEMBRE,DICIEMBRE_QTY=@SUMA_QTY_DICIEMBRE WHERE CUSTOMER_ID=@CUSTOMER_ID END
FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR2 INTO @DOCUMENT_DATE,@CUSTOMER_ID_DOS,@QTY,@AMOUNT END
CLOSE CURSOR2 DEALLOCATE CURSOR2 FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR1 INTO @CUSTOMER_ID END CLOSE CURSOR1 DEALLOCATE CURSOR1
UPDATE TABLAFINALDECLIENTES_VAT_REGISTRATION SET ENERO=(CASE WHEN ENERO IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE ENERO END),ENERO_QTY=(CASE WHEN ENERO_QTY IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE ENERO_QTY END), FEBRERO=(CASE WHEN FEBRERO IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE FEBRERO END),FEBRERO_QTY=(CASE WHEN FEBRERO_QTY IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE FEBRERO_QTY END), MARZO=(CASE WHEN MARZO IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE MARZO END),MARZO_QTY=(CASE WHEN MARZO_QTY IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE MARZO_QTY END), ABRIL=(CASE WHEN ABRIL IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE ABRIL END),ABRIL_QTY=(CASE WHEN ABRIL_QTY IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE ABRIL_QTY END), MAYO=(CASE WHEN MAYO IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE MAYO END),MAYO_QTY=(CASE WHEN MAYO_QTY IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE MAYO_QTY END), JUNIO=(CASE WHEN JUNIO IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE JUNIO END),JUNIO_QTY=(CASE WHEN JUNIO_QTY IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE JUNIO_QTY END), JULIO=(CASE WHEN JULIO IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE JULIO END),JULIO_QTY=(CASE WHEN JULIO_QTY IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE JULIO_QTY END), AGOSTO=(CASE WHEN AGOSTO IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE AGOSTO END),AGOSTO_QTY=(CASE WHEN AGOSTO_QTY IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE AGOSTO_QTY END), SETIEMBRE=(CASE WHEN SETIEMBRE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE SETIEMBRE END),SETIEMBRE_QTY=(CASE WHEN SETIEMBRE_QTY IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE SETIEMBRE_QTY END), OCTUBRE=(CASE WHEN OCTUBRE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE OCTUBRE END),OCTUBRE_QTY=(CASE WHEN OCTUBRE_QTY IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE OCTUBRE_QTY END), NOVIEMBRE=(CASE WHEN NOVIEMBRE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE NOVIEMBRE END),NOVIEMBRE_QTY=(CASE WHEN NOVIEMBRE_QTY IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE NOVIEMBRE_QTY END), DICIEMBRE=(CASE WHEN DICIEMBRE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE DICIEMBRE END),DICIEMBRE_QTY=(CASE WHEN DICIEMBRE_QTY IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE DICIEMBRE_QTY END)

DECLARE @STRcadena NVARCHAR(300)
SET @STRcadena='SELECT T.CODCLI,T.FECHAMOV,T.TIPDOC,T.NUMDOC,T.CARGOMN,T.CARGOME,T.ABONOME,T.ABONOMN, M.name,M.id,M.addr,M.vat_registration FROM ' + @TABLA +' T INNER JOIN '+ @BASE +' M ON T.CODCLI=M.ID'

Property.Name: HeaderContents

DECLARE @STRcadena NVARCHAR(800) SET @STRcadena='SELECT R.TYPE_DOC AS DETTIP_DOC,R.NUMBER_DOC AS DETNUM_DOC, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),C.DOC_DATE,103) AS CARDOC_DATE,R.DOC_REF AS DETDOC_REF, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),C.CADUCATE_DATE,103) AS CARFECHA_VENCI,R.REC_ID AS DETREC_ID, R.CURRENCY_ID AS DETCURRENCY_ID,R.AMOUNT AS DETAMOUNT , R.SELL_RATE AS DETSELL_RATE,R.BANK_DESCRIPTION AS DETBANK_DESCRIPT, CT.ID AS CUST_ID,RC.ID AS CAB_ID,CT.NAME AS CUST_NAME, R.NUM_REF AS DETNUM_REF,R.SALES_ID AS DET_SALES_ID,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),RC.DATE,103) AS CAB_DATE FROM RECEIVABLE_LIST_LINE_PAY R, CUSTOMER_BALANCE_PAY C,VENDOR CT,RECEIVABLE_LIST_PAY RC WHERE RC.ID=R.ID AND R.TYPE_DOC=C.DOCUMENT_ID AND R.NUMBER_DOC=C.NUMBER_DOC AND C.CUSTOMER_ID=CT.ID'
IF(@TIP=1) BEGIN SET @STRcadena=@STRcadena + ' AND RC.ID=@COD' END
exec SP_EXECUTESQL @STRcadena,N'@COD NVARCHAR(10)',@COD

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
DECLARE @STRcadena NVARCHAR(800) SET @STRcadena='SELECT R.TYPE_DOC AS DETTIP_DOC,R.NUMBER_DOC AS DETNUM_DOC, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),C.DOC_DATE,103) AS CARDOC_DATE,R.DOC_REF AS DETDOC_REF, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),C.CADUCATE_DATE,103) AS CARFECHA_VENCI,R.REC_ID AS DETREC_ID, R.CURRENCY_ID AS DETCURRENCY_ID,R.AMOUNT AS DETAMOUNT , R.SELL_RATE AS DETSELL_RATE,R.BANK_DESCRIPTION AS DETBANK_DESCRIPT, CT.ID AS CUST_ID,RC.ID AS CAB_ID,CT.NAME AS CUST_NAME, R.NUM_REF AS DETNUM_REF,R.SALES_ID AS DET_SALES_ID,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),RC.DATE,103) AS CAB_DATE FROM RECEIVABLE_LIST_LINE R, CUSTOMER_BALANCE C,CUSTOMER CT,RECEIVABLE_LIST RC WHERE RC.ID=R.ID AND R.TYPE_DOC=C.DOCUMENT_ID AND R.NUMBER_DOC=C.NUMBER_DOC AND C.CUSTOMER_ID=CT.ID'
IF(@TIP=1) BEGIN SET @STRcadena=@STRcadena + ' AND RC.ID=@COD' END
exec SP_EXECUTESQL @STRcadena,N'@COD NVARCHAR(10)',@COD

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
DECLARE @STRcadena NVARCHAR(400)
IF(@ORI=1) BEGIN SET @STRcadena='SELECT * FROM CUSTOMER ' IF(@TIPO=1) BEGIN SET @STRcadena=@STRcadena + 'WHERE ID BETWEEN @RANGO1 AND @RANGO2 ORDER BY ID' END IF(@TIPO=2) BEGIN SET @STRcadena=@STRcadena + 'WHERE VAT_REGISTRATION BETWEEN @RANGO1 AND @RANGO2 ORDER BY VAT_REGISTRATION' END IF(@TIPO=0) BEGIN SET @STRcadena=@STRcadena + ' order by id' END
END
IF(@ORI=2)--REC_LIST_GROUP_CUST BEGIN SET @STRcadena='SELECT R.GROUP_ID,C.ADDR,C.VAT_REGISTRATION,C.PHONE,C.NAME,C.ID,CG.ID,CG.NAME FROM RELATION_CUST_GROUP R,CUSTOMER C,CUSTOMER_GROUP CG WHERE R.CUST_ID =C.ID AND R.GROUP_ID=CG.ID '
IF(@TIPO=1) BEGIN SET @STRcadena=@STRcadena + ' AND C.ID BETWEEN @RANGO1 AND @RANGO2 ORDER BY R.GROUP_ID' END IF(@TIPO=0) BEGIN SET @STRcadena=@STRcadena + ' ORDER BY R.GROUP_ID' END END
IF(@ORI=3)--REC_LIST_ZONE_CUST BEGIN SET @STRcadena='SELECT M.*, T.description FROM DROG_PRUEBA.dbo.CUSTOMER M LEFT JOIN DROG_PRUEBA.dbo.MASTER_HELP T ON M.SELL_ZONE = T.ID WHERE T.TYPE_ID=28'
IF(@TIPO=1) BEGIN SET @STRcadena=@STRcadena + ' AND M.SELL_ZONE BETWEEN @RANGO1 AND @RANGO2 ORDER BY NAME' END IF(@TIPO=0) BEGIN SET @STRcadena=@STRcadena + ' ORDER BY NAME' END END
IF(@ORI=4)--REC_LIST_SALES_REP_CUST BEGIN SET @STRcadena='SELECT CUSTOMER_ID AS CUSTID,CUSTOMER_ADDR AS addr,R.VAT_REGISTRATION,CUSTOMER_NAME AS CUSTNAME, SALES_REP_ID AS SALES_ID,S.NAME FROM RECEIVABLE R INNER JOIN SALES_REP S ON R.SALES_REP_ID=S.ID WHERE DOCUMENT_ID=''FT'' '
IF(@TIPO=1) BEGIN SET @STRcadena=@STRcadena + ' AND S.ID BETWEEN @RANGO1 AND @RANGO2 GROUP BY S.NAME,R.CUSTOMER_ID,R.CUSTOMER_ADDR,R.VAT_REGISTRATION,R.CUSTOMER_NAME,R.SALES_REP_ID,S.ID ORDER BY S.ID' END IF(@TIPO=0) BEGIN SET @STRcadena=@STRcadena + ' GROUP BY S.NAME,R.CUSTOMER_ID,R.CUSTOMER_ADDR,R.VAT_REGISTRATION,R.CUSTOMER_NAME,R.SALES_REP_ID,S.ID ORDER BY S.ID' END END
IF(@ORI=5) BEGIN SET @STRcadena='SELECT * FROM CUSTOMER ORDER BY NAME' IF(@TIPO=1) BEGIN SET @STRcadena=@STRcadena + 'WHERE ID BETWEEN @RANGO1 AND @RANGO2' END IF(@TIPO=2) BEGIN SET @STRcadena=@STRcadena + 'WHERE VAT_REGISTRATION BETWEEN @RANGO1 AND @RANGO2' END END
IF(@ORI=6) BEGIN SET @STRcadena='SELECT * FROM CUSTOMER ORDER BY VAT_REGISTRATION' IF(@TIPO=1) BEGIN SET @STRcadena=@STRcadena + 'WHERE ID BETWEEN @RANGO1 AND @RANGO2' END IF(@TIPO=2) BEGIN SET @STRcadena=@STRcadena + 'WHERE VAT_REGISTRATION BETWEEN @RANGO1 AND @RANGO2' END END
EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @STRcadena,N'@RANGO1 NVARCHAR(20),@RANGO2 NVARCHAR(20)', @RANGO1,@RANGO2

IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tempdb.dbo.SYSOBJECTS WHERE XTYPE='U' AND NAME=''+@IDE+'REGLET')
BEGIN EXEC('DROP TABLE TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'REGLET') END EXEC('CREATE TABLE TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'REGLET (PCCNROCANJE VARCHAR(10),PCCFECCAN SMALLDATETIME,CNUMRUC VARCHAR(11), CNOMCLI VARCHAR(70),PCDNUMDOC VARCHAR(10),PCDFECVEN SMALLDATETIME,NUMDOC VARCHAR(10), CDOIMPORTE_MN NUMERIC(15,6) NULL DEFAULT (0),IMPORTE_ME NUMERIC(15,6) NULL DEFAULT (0), CDOTIPCAM FLOAT NULL DEFAULT (0),ALCAMBIO NUMERIC(15,6) NULL DEFAULT(0))')
DECLARE @CANJE AS VARCHAR(6) DECLARE @NUMDOC AS VARCHAR(10)
--declare @fecha1 as varchar(10) --declare @fecha2 as varchar(10) --declare @BASE as varchar(10) --SET @fecha1='01/02/2007' --SET @fecha2='01/02/2007' --set @BASE='demo'
EXEC('DECLARE INSERTA_LETRAS CURSOR FOR SELECT C.ID AS CAID,D.ID AS DEID FROM ['+@BASE+'].dbo.LETTER_EXCHANGE_LINE D INNER JOIN ['+@BASE+'].dbo.LETTER_EXCHANGE C ON D.ID = C.ID WHERE C.DATE_EXCHANGE>='+@fecha1+' AND C.DATE_EXCHANGE<='+@fecha2+'AND D.TYPE_DOC <> ''LT'' order by D.ID')
OPEN INSERTA_LETRAS
FETCH NEXT FROM INSERTA_LETRAS INTO @CANJE,@NUMDOC
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN
EXEC('INSERT INTO TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'REGLET (PCCNROCANJE,PCCFECCAN,CNUMRUC,CNOMCLI,PCDNUMDOC,PCDFECVEN, NUMDOC,CDOIMPORTE_MN,IMPORTE_ME,CDOTIPCAM,ALCAMBIO) SELECT PC.ID AS PCID,PC.DATE_EXCHANGE,M.VAT_REGISTRATION,M.NAME AS CNAME, PD.NUMBER_DOC, PD.CADUCATE_DATE,"'+@NUMDOC+'", (case when PC.CURRENCY_ID="MN" then PD.AMOUNT else 0.00 end)AS MN,(case when PC.CURRENCY_ID="ME" THEN PD.AMOUNT ELSE 0.00 END)as ME,PC.SELL_RATE,(case when PC.CURRENCY_ID="MN" then PD.AMOUNT else PD.AMOUNT * PC.SELL_RATE end) FROM ['+@BASE+'].DBO.LETTER_EXCHANGE PC INNER JOIN ['+@BASE+'].DBO.LETTER_EXCHANGE_LINE PD ON PC.ID=PD.ID left JOIN ['+@BASE+'].DBO.CUSTOMER M ON PC.CUSTOMER_ID=M.ID WHERE PC.ID="'+@CANJE+'" AND PD.TYPE_DOC="LT"')
FETCH NEXT FROM INSERTA_LETRAS INTO @CANJE,@NUMDOC END
CLOSE INSERTA_LETRAS DEALLOCATE INSERTA_LETRAS

Property.Name: BodyScript

DECLARE @STRcadena NVARCHAR(100) SET @STRcadena='SELECT * FROM STATUS_LETTER'

Property.Name: HeaderContents
Property.Value: CREATE PROC [dbo].[REC_STATUS_LETTER] as

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
DECLARE @FAMILY VARCHAR(50) DECLARE @MODEL VARCHAR(50) DECLARE @DESCRIPTION_OPT VARCHAR(50)
DECLARE PRIMER_CURSOR CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT FAMILY,MODEL,DESCRIPTION_OPT FROM TABLA_MEDIADORA_RENTABILIDAD OPEN PRIMER_CURSOR FETCH NEXT FROM PRIMER_CURSOR INTO @FAMILY,@MODEL,@DESCRIPTION_OPT WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN INSERT INTO TABLA_FINAL_RENTABILIDAD(FAMILY,MODEL,DESCRIPTION_OPT) VALUES(@FAMILY,@MODEL,@DESCRIPTION_OPT) FETCH NEXT FROM PRIMER_CURSOR INTO @FAMILY,@MODEL,@DESCRIPTION_OPT END CLOSE PRIMER_CURSOR DEALLOCATE PRIMER_CURSOR
DECLARE @PMODEL VARCHAR(50)
DECLARE SEGUNDO_CURSOR CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT MODEL FROM TABLA_MEDIADORA_RENTABILIDAD OPEN SEGUNDO_CURSOR FETCH NEXT FROM SEGUNDO_CURSOR INTO @PMODEL WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN DECLARE @VALORVENTA NUMERIC(15,9) DECLARE @COSTOMN NUMERIC(15,9) DECLARE @FECHA VARCHAR(10)
DECLARE TERCER_CURSOR CURSOR FOR SELECT VALOR_VENTA,COSTOMN,FECHA FROM TABLA_MEDIADORA_RENTABILIDAD WHERE MODEL=@PMODEL OPEN TERCER_CURSOR FETCH NEXT FROM TERCER_CURSOR INTO @VALORVENTA,@COSTOMN,@FECHA WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN IF LEN(@FECHA)=5 BEGIN IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,1)=1 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_RENTABILIDAD SET VAL1=@VALORVENTA,COSTOMN1=@COSTOMN WHERE MODEL=@PMODEL END ELSE IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,1)=2 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_RENTABILIDAD SET VAL2=@VALORVENTA,COSTOMN2=@COSTOMN WHERE MODEL=@PMODEL END ELSE IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,1)=3 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_RENTABILIDAD SET VAL3=@VALORVENTA,COSTOMN3=@COSTOMN WHERE MODEL=@PMODEL END
ELSE IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,1)=4 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_RENTABILIDAD SET VAL4=@VALORVENTA,COSTOMN4=@COSTOMN WHERE MODEL=@PMODEL END ELSE IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,1)=5 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_RENTABILIDAD SET VAL5=@VALORVENTA,COSTOMN5=@COSTOMN WHERE MODEL=@PMODEL END ELSE IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,1)=6 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_RENTABILIDAD SET VAL6=@VALORVENTA,COSTOMN6=@COSTOMN WHERE MODEL=@PMODEL END ELSE IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,1)=7 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_RENTABILIDAD SET VAL7=@VALORVENTA,COSTOMN7=@COSTOMN WHERE MODEL=@PMODEL END ELSE IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,1)=8 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_RENTABILIDAD SET VAL8=@VALORVENTA,COSTOMN8=@COSTOMN WHERE MODEL=@PMODEL END ELSE IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,1)=9 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_RENTABILIDAD SET VAL9=@VALORVENTA,COSTOMN9=@COSTOMN WHERE MODEL=@PMODEL END
END ELSE IF LEN(@FECHA)=6 BEGIN IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,2)=10 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_RENTABILIDAD SET VAL10=@VALORVENTA,COSTOMN10=@COSTOMN WHERE MODEL=@PMODEL END ELSE IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,2)=11 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_RENTABILIDAD SET VAL11=@VALORVENTA,COSTOMN11=@COSTOMN WHERE MODEL=@PMODEL END ELSE IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,2)=12 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_RENTABILIDAD SET VAL12=@VALORVENTA,COSTOMN12=@COSTOMN WHERE MODEL=@PMODEL END
END FETCH NEXT FROM TERCER_CURSOR INTO @VALORVENTA,@COSTOMN,@FECHA END CLOSE TERCER_CURSOR DEALLOCATE TERCER_CURSOR
FETCH NEXT FROM SEGUNDO_CURSOR INTO @PMODEL END CLOSE SEGUNDO_CURSOR DEALLOCATE SEGUNDO_CURSOR
UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_RENTABILIDAD SET COSTOMN1=(CASE WHEN COSTOMN1 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE COSTOMN1 END),VAL1=(CASE WHEN VAL1 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE VAL1 END), COSTOMN2=(CASE WHEN COSTOMN2 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE COSTOMN2 END),VAL2=(CASE WHEN VAL2 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE VAL2 END), COSTOMN3=(CASE WHEN COSTOMN3 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE COSTOMN3 END),VAL3=(CASE WHEN VAL3 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE VAL3 END), COSTOMN4=(CASE WHEN COSTOMN4 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE COSTOMN4 END),VAL4=(CASE WHEN VAL4 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE VAL4 END), COSTOMN5=(CASE WHEN COSTOMN5 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE COSTOMN5 END),VAL5=(CASE WHEN VAL5 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE VAL5 END), COSTOMN6=(CASE WHEN COSTOMN6 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE COSTOMN6 END),VAL6=(CASE WHEN VAL6 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE VAL6 END), COSTOMN7=(CASE WHEN COSTOMN7 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE COSTOMN7 END),VAL7=(CASE WHEN VAL7 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE VAL7 END), COSTOMN8=(CASE WHEN COSTOMN8 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE COSTOMN8 END),VAL8=(CASE WHEN VAL8 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE VAL8 END), COSTOMN9=(CASE WHEN COSTOMN9 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE COSTOMN9 END),VAL9=(CASE WHEN VAL9 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE VAL9 END), COSTOMN10=(CASE WHEN COSTOMN10 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE COSTOMN10 END),VAL10=(CASE WHEN VAL10 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE VAL10 END), COSTOMN11=(CASE WHEN COSTOMN11 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE COSTOMN11 END),VAL11=(CASE WHEN VAL11 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE VAL11 END), COSTOMN12=(CASE WHEN COSTOMN12 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE COSTOMN12 END),VAL12=(CASE WHEN VAL12 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE VAL12 END)

Property.Name: HeaderContents
Property.Value: CREATE PROCEDURE RENTABILIDAD_POR_FAMILIA_PRINCIPAL AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
--SELECT * FROM PURCHASE_FACT_SUPPLIER --SELECT * from PURCHASE_FACT_SUPPLIER_L --SELECT * FROM VENDOR --SELECT * FROM WAREHOUSE_TRANS
SELECT p.id as num_fac,convert(varchar(20),P.DOCUMENT_DATE) AS FECHA_DOC,P.VENDOR_ID AS COD_PROVE,V.NAME AS NOM_PROVE, P.NOTE_IN_ID AS NOTA_ING,P.CURRENCY_TYPE AS MONEDA, P.AMOUNT_SALES AS MONTO, P.WAREHOUSE_ID AS ALMACEN,convert(varchar(20),W.DATE_DOCUMENT) AS FECHA_ING,P.SELL_RATE AS TC FROM PURCHASE_FACT_SUPPLIER P,VENDOR V,WAREHOUSE_TRANS W WHERE P.VENDOR_ID=V.ID AND W.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=P.NOTE_IN_ID AND DOCUMENT_ID='NI' AND P.DOCUMENT_DATE BETWEEN @FECHA1 AND @FECHA2 AND P.VENDOR_ID BETWEEN @PROVE1 AND @PROVE2 and p.currency_type=@MONEDA
--EXEC REP_FACTPROVE01 '01-05-2008','30-05-2008','2024004553','43619045','MN'

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
--SELECT * FROM PURCHASE_FACT_SUPPLIER --SELECT * from PURCHASE_FACT_SUPPLIER_L --SELECT * FROM VENDOR --SELECT * FROM WAREHOUSE_TRANS --SELECT * FROM PART SELECT P.WAREHOUSE_ID AS ALMACEN,P.NOTE_IN_ID AS NOTA_ING,P.ID AS NUM_FAC,CONVERT(VARCHAR(20),P.DOCUMENT_DATE) AS FECHA_DOC, P.VENDOR_ID AS COD_PROVE,V.NAME AS NOM_PROVE, P.CURRENCY_TYPE AS MONEDA, DP.AMOUNT_TOTAL AS MONTO, P.SELL_RATE AS TC,DP.PART_ID AS COD_ART,DP.PART_DESCRIPTION AS DES_ART, DP.PRICE AS PU,DP.QTY AS CANTIDAD,P.AMOUNT_SALES FROM PURCHASE_FACT_SUPPLIER P,PURCHASE_FACT_SUPPLIER_L DP, VENDOR V,WAREHOUSE_TRANS W WHERE P.ID=DP.ID AND P.VENDOR_ID=V.ID AND W.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=P.NOTE_IN_ID AND DOCUMENT_ID='NI' AND P.DOCUMENT_DATE BETWEEN @FECHA1 AND @FECHA2 AND P.VENDOR_ID BETWEEN @PROVE1 AND @PROVE2 AND P.CURRENCY_TYPE=@MONEDA AND DP.PART_ID BETWEEN @ART1 AND @ART2
--EXEC REP_FACTPROVE02 '01-05-2008','30-05-2008','2024004553','43619045','MN','ACET','TOL'

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value: select DISTINCT PART_ID AS ALM,P.DESCRIPTION,P.UNIT_OF_MEASUREMENT AS UNIDAD, ISNULL(sum(QTY_INITIAL),0) AS [CANTIDAD INICIAL], ISNULL(SUM(QTY_IN),0)AS ENTRADAS, ISNULL(SUM(QTY_OUT),0)AS SALIDAS, ISNULL(SUM(INIT_VALUE),0)[SALDO_INICIAL], ISNULL(SUM(IN_VALUE),0)AS ENTRADAS_VAL, ISNULL(SUM(OUT_VALUE),0)AS SALIDAS_VAL, ISNULL(SUM(AVERAGE_COST),0)AS PROMEDIO from inventory AS I INNER JOIN PART AS P ON I.PART_ID=P.ID GROUP BY PART_ID,P.DESCRIPTION,P.UNIT_OF_MEASUREMENT

Property.Name: HeaderContents
Property.Value: CREATE procedure rep_inventory AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value: Select PLACE_SALES AS VENCODAGE,FC.DOCUMENT_ID AS VENTD,(FC.NUMBER_SERIE+FC.NUMBER_DOCUMENT) AS VENSERDOC, FC.DOCUMENT_DATE AS VENFECDOC,SALES_REP_ID AS VENVENDE,V.NAME AS NAME_VEN, CUSTOMER_ID AS VENCODCLI,C.NAME AS NAME_CUSTOMER ,FD.PART_ID,FD.ITEM,FD.QTY,FD.PRICE_SALES,FD.AMOUNT,FD.UNIT,FD.PART_DESCRIPTION,FC.CURRENCY_ID,FC.SELL_RATE, (FD.AMOUNT_TAX+FD.ISC) AS AMOUNT_TAX,FD.AMOUNT_US From DBO.RECEIVABLE_LINE FD,DBO.RECEIVABLE FC,[IVM].DBO.SALES_REP V, DBO.CUSTOMER C,DBO.PART P Where FD.DOCUMENT_ID = FC.DOCUMENT_ID And FD.NUMBER_SERIE = FC.NUMBER_SERIE And FD.NUMBER_DOCUMENT = FC.NUMBER_DOCUMENT AND FC.SALES_REP_ID=V.ID AND FC.CUSTOMER_ID=C.ID AND FD.PART_ID=P.ID AND DOCUMENT_DATE >= @FECHA_INICIAL and DOCUMENT_DATE <= @FECHA_FINAL and SALES_REP_ID >=@VEN_UNO and SALES_REP_ID <=@VEN_DOS and FC.STATUS = 'V' AND PLACE_SALES >=@PV_UNO AND PLACE_SALES <=@PV_DOS GROUP BY FD.ITEM,FC.PLACE_SALES,FC.DOCUMENT_ID,FC.NUMBER_SERIE,FC.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,FC.DOCUMENT_DATE,FC.SALES_REP_ID, V.NAME,FC.CUSTOMER_ID,C.NAME,FD.PART_ID,FD.QTY,FD.PRICE_SALES,FD.AMOUNT,FD.UNIT,FD.PART_DESCRIPTION,FC.CURRENCY_ID, FC.SELL_RATE,FD.AMOUNT_TAX,FD.AMOUNT_US,FD.ISC ORDER BY VENSERDOC

BodyScript
Property.Value:
SET NOCOUNT ON SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER off
IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tempdb.dbo.SYSOBJECTS WHERE XTYPE='U' AND NAME=''+@IDE+'CANJESPENDIENTES') BEGIN EXEC('DROP TABLE TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'CANJESPENDIENTES') END
EXEC ('CREATE TABLE TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'CANJESPENDIENTES(CODVEN VARCHAR(2),NOMVEN VARCHAR(30) NULL, CODCLIE VARCHAR(11) NULL,NOMCLIE VARCHAR(70) NULL,TIPDOC VARCHAR(2), NUMDOC VARCHAR(10), FECEMI DATETIME, FECVTO DATETIME, MONTO NUMERIC(15,6) DEFAULT(0))')
EXEC ('UPDATE C SET C.TERMS=F.TERMS_ID FROM ['+@BASE+'].dbo.RECEIVABLE F INNER JOIN ['+@BASE+'].dbo.CUSTOMER_BALANCE C ON F.DOCUMENT_ID=C.DOCUMENT_ID AND F.NUMBER_SERIE+F.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=C.NUMBER_DOC AND F.CUSTOMER_ID = C.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE C.TERMS IS NULL')
IF @OPCIONLT='LT' EXEC ('SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER off INSERT INTO tempdb.dbo.'+@ide+'CANJESPENDIENTES select V.ID,V.NAME,C1.CUSTOMER_ID,M.NAME,C1.DOCUMENT_ID,C1.NUMBER_DOC,C1.DOC_DATE,C1.CADUCATE_DATE, (CASE '''+@MONEDA+''' when ''ME'' THEN (CASE C1.CURRENCY_ID WHEN ''ME'' THEN C1.AMOUNT_BALANCE ELSE C1.AMOUNT_BALANCE/(CASE C1.SELL_RATE WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE C1.SELL_RATE END) END) else (CASE C1.CURRENCY_ID WHEN ''MN'' THEN C1.AMOUNT_BALANCE ELSE C1.AMOUNT_BALANCE*C1.SELL_RATE END) END) AS SALDO from ['+@BASE+'].dbo.LETTER_EXCHANGE c INNER join ['+@BASE+'].dbo.LETTER_EXCHANGE_LINE d on c.ID=d.ID LEFT join ['+@BASE+'].dbo.CUSTOMER_BALANCE c1 on c1.DOCUMENT_ID=d.TYPE_DOC and c1.NUMBER_DOC=d.NUMBER_DOC LEFT join ['+@BASE+'].dbo.SALES_REP v on c1.SALES_ID=v.ID LEFT join ['+@BASE+'].dbo.CUSTOMER m on m.ID=c1.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT join ['+@BASE1+'].dbo.FORMAPAGO f on f.CODFP=c1.TERMS where d.IS_ORIG=''S'' AND C.STATUS=''P'' and C1.SALES_ID>='''+@codven1+''' and C1.SALES_ID<='''+@codven2+''' AND C1.CUSTOMER_ID>='''+@codclie1+''' and C1.CUSTOMER_ID<='''+@codclie2+''' ') IF @OPCIONCH ='CH' EXEC ('SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER off INSERT INTO tempdb.dbo.'+@ide+'CANJESPENDIENTES select V.ID,V.NAME,C1.CUSTOMER_ID,M.NAME,C1.DOCUMENT_ID,C1.NUMBER_DOC,C1.DOC_DATE,C1.CADUCATE_DATE, (CASE '''+@MONEDA+''' when ''ME'' THEN (CASE C1.CURRENCY_ID WHEN ''ME'' THEN C1.AMOUNT_BALANCE ELSE C1.AMOUNT_BALANCE/(CASE C1.SELL_RATE WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE C1.SELL_RATE END) END) else (CASE C1.CURRENCY_ID WHEN ''MN'' THEN C1.AMOUNT_BALANCE ELSE C1.AMOUNT_BALANCE*C1.SELL_RATE END) END) AS SALDO from ['+@BASE+'].dbo.CUSTOMER_BALANCE c1 inner join ['+@BASE+'].dbo.SALES_REP v on c1.SALES_ID=v.ID inner join ['+@BASE+'].dbo.CUSTOMER m on m.ID=c1.CUSTOMER_ID inner join ['+@BASE1+'].dbo.FORMAPAGO f on f.CODFP=c1.TERMS where C1.SALES_ID>='''+@codven1+''' and C1.SALES_ID<='''+@codven2+''' AND C1.CUSTOMER_ID>='''+@codclie1+''' and C1.CUSTOMER_ID<='''+@codclie2+''' AND abs(C1.AMOUNT_BALANCE)>0.01 AND F.TIPOFP=''CH'' ')
IF @OPCIONFT ='FT' PRINT ('SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER off INSERT INTO tempdb.dbo.'+@ide+'CANJESPENDIENTES select V.ID,V.NAME,C1.CUSTOMER_ID,M.NAME,C1.DOCUMENT_ID,C1.NUMBER_DOC,C1.DOC_DATE,C1.CADUCATE_DATE, (CASE '''+@MONEDA+''' when ''ME'' THEN (CASE C1.CURRENCY_ID WHEN ''ME'' THEN C1.AMOUNT_BALANCE ELSE C1.AMOUNT_BALANCE/(CASE C1.SELL_RATE WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE C1.SELL_RATE END) END) else (CASE C1.CURRENCY_ID WHEN ''MN'' THEN C1.AMOUNT_BALANCE ELSE C1.AMOUNT_BALANCE*C1.SELL_RATE END) END) AS SALDO from ['+@BASE+'].dbo.CUSTOMER_BALANCE c1 inner join ['+@BASE+'].dbo.SALES_REP v on c1.SALES_ID=v.ID inner join ['+@BASE+'].dbo.CUSTOMER m on m.ID=c1.CUSTOMER_ID inner join ['+@BASE1+'].dbo.formapago f on f.codfp=c1.TERMS where C1.SALES_ID>='''+@codven1+''' and C1.SALES_ID<='''+@codven2+''' AND c1.CUSTOMER_ID>='''+@codclie1+''' and c1.CUSTOMER_ID<='''+@codclie2+''' AND abs(C1.AMOUNT_BALANCE)>0.01 AND F.TIPOFP=''FT'' ')
declare @STRquery nvarchar(1500) SET @STRquery='select * from tempdb.dbo.'+@ide+'CANJESPENDIENTES ORDER BY NOMVEN, TIPDOC,NUMDOC' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@ide AS varchar(80),@codven1 AS varchar(2), @codven2 AS varchar(2), @codclie1 as varchar(11), @codclie2 as varchar(11),@moneda as varchar(2), @BASE1 AS VARCHAR(10),@OPCIONLT AS VARCHAR(2),@OPCIONCH AS VARCHAR(2), @OPCIONFT AS VARCHAR(2)', @IDE,@codven1,@codven2,@codclie1,@codclie2,@moneda,@base1,@opcionlt,@opcionch, @opcionft

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
SET NOCOUNT ON SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER off
IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tempdb.dbo.SYSOBJECTS WHERE XTYPE='U' AND NAME=''+@IDE+'FLUJOCOBRANZA') BEGIN EXEC('DROP TABLE TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'FLUJOCOBRANZA') END
EXEC ('CREATE TABLE TEMPDB.DBO.'+@IDE+'FLUJOCOBRANZA(CODVEN VARCHAR(2),NOMVEN VARCHAR(30) NULL, CODCLIE VARCHAR(11) NULL,NOMCLIE VARCHAR(70) NULL,TIPDOC VARCHAR(2), NUMDOC VARCHAR(10), FECEMI DATETIME, FECVTO SMALLDATETIME, SALDOMN NUMERIC(15,6) DEFAULT(0),SALDOME NUMERIC(15,6) DEFAULT(0), NRODIASLETRAS NUMERIC(15,6) DEFAULT(0),TIPODOCAGRU VARCHAR(2),NROSEMANA NUMERIC(15,0) DEFAULT(0))')
declare @fecha AS varchar(10) declare @Nrodiasletras1 as varchar(10) declare @Nrodiasvencidos1 as varchar(10) set @fecha=str(@fechaactual) set @Nrodiasletras1=str(@Nrodiasletras) set @Nrodiasvencidos1=str(@Nrodiasvencidos)
IF @AGRUPADO='N' exec (' INSERT INTO tempdb.dbo.'+@ide+'FLUJOCOBRANZA select V.ID,V.NAME,C.CUSTOMER_ID,M.NAME,C.DOCUMENT_ID,C.NUMBER_DOC,C.DOC_DATE,C.CADUCATE_DATE, (CASE C.CURRENCY_ID WHEN ''MN'' THEN C.AMOUNT_BALANCE ELSE 0 END) AS SALDOMN, (CASE C.CURRENCY_ID WHEN ''ME'' THEN C.AMOUNT_BALANCE ELSE 0 END) AS SALDOME, 0,'''',cast(cast(year(C.CADUCATE_DATE) as varchar(4))+ (case Len(cast(datepart(week,C.CADUCATE_DATE) as varchar(20))) when 1 then ''0'' + cast(datepart(week,C.CADUCATE_DATE) as varchar(20)) else cast(datepart(week,C.CADUCATE_DATE) as varchar(20)) end) as numeric(15,0)) AS NROSEMANA FROM ['+@BASE+'].dbo.CUSTOMER_BALANCE c inner join ['+@BASE+'].dbo.SALES_REP v on c.SALES_ID=v.ID inner join ['+@BASE+'].dbo.CUSTOMER m on m.ID=c.CUSTOMER_ID where abs(C.AMOUNT_BALANCE)>0.01 and C.SALES_ID>='''+@ven1+''' and C.SALES_ID<='''+@ven2+''' and C.CUSTOMER_ID>='''+@clie1+''' and C.CUSTOMER_ID<='''+@clie2+''' ') ELSE BEGIN IF @TIPODOCCH='CH' exec (' INSERT INTO tempdb.dbo.'+@ide+'FLUJOCOBRANZA select V.ID,V.NAME,C.CUSTOMER_ID,M.NAME,C.DOCUMENT_ID,C.NUMBER_DOC,C.DOC_DATE,C.CADUCATE_DATE, (CASE C.CURRENCY_ID WHEN ''MN'' THEN C.AMOUNT_BALANCE ELSE 0 END) AS SALDOMN, (CASE C.CURRENCY_ID WHEN ''ME'' THEN C.AMOUNT_BALANCE ELSE 0 END) AS SALDOME, 0,''CH'',cast(cast(year(C.CADUCATE_DATE) as varchar(4))+ (case Len(cast(datepart(week,C.CADUCATE_DATE) as varchar(20))) when 1 then ''0'' + cast(datepart(week,C.CADUCATE_DATE) as varchar(20)) else cast(datepart(week,C.CADUCATE_DATE) as varchar(20)) end) as numeric(15,0)) AS NROSEMANA FROM ['+@BASE+'].dbo.CUSTOMER_BALANCE c inner join ['+@BASE+'].dbo.SALES_REP v on c.SALES_ID=v.ID inner join ['+@BASE+'].dbo.CUSTOMER m on m.ID=c.CUSTOMER_ID where abs(C.AMOUNT_BALANCE)>0.01 AND C.DOCUMENT_ID=''CH'' AND C.CADUCATE_DATE +'+@NRODIASVENCIDOS1+'>'+@fecha+' and C.SALES_ID>='''+@ven1+''' and C.SALES_ID<='''+@ven2+''' and C.CUSTOMER_ID>='''+@clie1+''' and C.CUSTOMER_ID<='''+@clie2+'''')
IF @TIPODOCLT='LT' exec (' INSERT INTO tempdb.dbo.'+@ide+'FLUJOCOBRANZA select V.ID,V.NAME,C.CUSTOMER_ID,M.NAME,C.DOCUMENT_ID,C.NUMBER_DOC,C.DOC_DATE,C.CADUCATE_DATE, (CASE C.CURRENCY_ID WHEN ''MN'' THEN C.AMOUNT_BALANCE ELSE 0 END) AS SALDOMN, (CASE C.CURRENCY_ID WHEN ''ME'' THEN C.AMOUNT_BALANCE ELSE 0 END) AS SALDOME, '+@NRODIASLETRAS1+',''LT'',cast(cast(year(C.CADUCATE_DATE) as varchar(4))+ (case Len(cast(datepart(week,C.CADUCATE_DATE) as varchar(20))) when 1 then ''0'' + cast(datepart(week,C.CADUCATE_DATE) as varchar(20)) else cast(datepart(week,C.CADUCATE_DATE) as varchar(20)) end) as numeric(15,0)) AS NROSEMANA FROM ['+@BASE+'].dbo.CUSTOMER_BALANCE c inner join ['+@BASE+'].dbo.SALES_REP v on c.SALES_ID=v.ID inner join ['+@BASE+'].dbo.CUSTOMER m on m.ID=c.CUSTOMER_ID where abs(C.AMOUNT_BALANCE)>0.01 AND C.DOCUMENT_ID=''LT'' AND C.CADUCATE_DATE +'+@NRODIASLETRAS1+'+'+@NRODIASVENCIDOS1+'>'+@fecha+' and C.SALES_ID>='''+@ven1+''' and C.SALES_ID<='''+@ven2+''' and C.CUSTOMER_ID>='''+@clie1+''' and C.CUSTOMER_ID<='''+@clie2+'''')
IF @TIPODOCFT='FT' exec (' INSERT INTO tempdb.dbo.'+@ide+'FLUJOCOBRANZA select V.ID,V.NAME,C.CUSTOMER_ID,M.NAME,C.DOCUMENT_ID,C.NUMBER_DOC,C.DOC_DATE,C.CADUCATE_DATE, (CASE C.CURRENCY_ID WHEN ''MN'' THEN C.AMOUNT_BALANCE ELSE 0 END) AS SALDOMN, (CASE C.CURRENCY_ID WHEN ''ME'' THEN C.AMOUNT_BALANCE ELSE 0 END) AS SALDOME, 0,''FT'',cast(cast(year(C.CADUCATE_DATE) as varchar(4))+ (case Len(cast(datepart(week,C.CADUCATE_DATE) as varchar(20))) when 1 then ''0'' + cast(datepart(week,C.CADUCATE_DATE) as varchar(20)) else cast(datepart(week,C.CADUCATE_DATE) as varchar(20)) end) as numeric(15,0)) AS NROSEMANA FROM ['+@BASE+'].dbo.CUSTOMER_BALANCE c inner join ['+@BASE+'].dbo.SALES_REP v on c.SALES_ID=v.ID inner join ['+@BASE+'].dbo.CUSTOMER m on m.ID=c.CUSTOMER_ID where abs(C.AMOUNT_BALANCE)>0.01 AND C.DOCUMENT_ID<>''CH'' AND C.DOCUMENT_ID<>''LT'' AND C.CADUCATE_DATE +'+@NRODIASVENCIDOS1+'>'+@fecha+' and C.SALES_ID>='''+@ven1+''' and C.SALES_ID<='''+@ven2+''' and C.CUSTOMER_ID>='''+@clie1+''' and C.CUSTOMER_ID<='''+@clie2+'''')
IF @TIPOVENCIDOS='VE' EXEC (' INSERT INTO tempdb.dbo.'+@ide+'FLUJOCOBRANZA select V.ID,V.NAME,C.CUSTOMER_ID,M.NAME,C.DOCUMENT_ID,C.NUMBER_DOC,C.DOC_DATE,C.CADUCATE_DATE, (CASE C.CURRENCY_ID WHEN ''MN'' THEN C.AMOUNT_BALANCE ELSE 0 END) AS SALDOMN, (CASE C.CURRENCY_ID WHEN ''ME'' THEN C.AMOUNT_BALANCE ELSE 0 END) AS SALDOME, (CASE C.DOCUMENT_ID WHEN ''LT'' THEN '+@NRODIASLETRAS1+' ELSE 0 END),''VE'',cast(cast(year(C.CADUCATE_DATE) as varchar(4))+ (case Len(cast(datepart(week,C.CADUCATE_DATE) as varchar(20))) when 1 then ''0'' + cast(datepart(week,C.CADUCATE_DATE) as varchar(20)) else cast(datepart(week,C.CADUCATE_DATE) as varchar(20)) end) as numeric(15,0)) AS NROSEMANA FROM ['+@BASE+'].dbo.CUSTOMER_BALANCE c inner join ['+@BASE+'].dbo.SALES_REP v on c.SALES_ID=v.ID inner join ['+@BASE+'].dbo.CUSTOMER m on m.ID=c.CUSTOMER_ID where abs(C.AMOUNT_BALANCE)>0.01 AND C.CADUCATE_DATE + (CASE C.DOCUMENT_ID WHEN ''LT'' THEN '+@NRODIASLETRAS1+'+'+@NRODIASVENCIDOS1+' ELSE '+@NRODIASVENCIDOS1+' END)<='+@fecha+' and C.SALES_ID>='''+@ven1+''' and C.SALES_ID<='''+@ven2+''' and C.CUSTOMER_ID>='''+@clie1+''' and C.CUSTOMER_ID<='''+@clie2+'''')
/* IF NOT(@TIPODOCCH='CH' AND @TIPODOCLT='LT' AND @TIPODOCFT='FT') PRINT (' INSERT INTO ['+@BASE+'].dbo.cartera c select cod_ven,des_ven,cdocodcli,cnomcli,cdotipdoc,cdonrodoc,cdofecdoc,cdofecven, (CASE CDOTIPMON WHEN ''MN'' THEN cdosaldo ELSE 0 END) AS SALDOMN, (CASE CDOTIPMON WHEN ''ME'' THEN cdosaldo ELSE 0 END) AS SALDOME, 0,''VE'',cast(cast(year(cdofecven) as varchar(4))+ (case Len(cast(datepart(week,cdofecven) as varchar(20))) when 1 Then ''0'' + cast(datepart(week,cdofecven) as varchar(20)) else cast(datepart(week,cdofecven) as varchar(20)) end) as numeric(15,0)) AS NROSEMANA FROM ['+@BASE+'].dbo.cartera c inner join ['+@BASE+'].dbo.vendedor v on c.cdocodven=v.cod_ven inner join ['+@BASE+'].dbo.maecli m on m.ccodcli=c.cdocodcli where abs(CDOSALDO)>0.01 AND CDOFECVEN + (CASE CDOTIPDOC WHEN ''LT'' THEN '+@NRODIASLETRAS1+'+'+@NRODIASVENCIDOS1+' ELSE '+@NRODIASVENCIDOS1+' END)<'+@fecha+'') ELSE EXEC (' UPDATE T SET TIPODOCAGRU=''VE'' FROM tempdb.dbo.'+@ide+'FLUJOCOBRANZA T where FECVTO +'+@NRODIASLETRAS1+'+'+@NRODIASVENCIDOS1+'<'+@fecha+'') */ END
declare @STRquery nvarchar(4000) SET @STRquery='select * from tempdb.dbo.'+@ide+'FLUJOCOBRANZA' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@ide AS varchar(80),@NRODIASLETRAS AS INT,@base as varchar(10), @NRODIASVENCIDOS AS INT,@fecha AS VARCHAR(10), @ven1 as varchar(2), @ven2 as varchar(2), @clie1 as varchar(11), @clie2 as varchar(11)', @IDE,@NRODIASLETRAS,@base,@NRODIASVENCIDOS,@fecha,@ven1,@ven2,@clie1,@clie2
