Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
DROP TABLE TABLA_DE_STOCK
select P.ID,P.DESCRIPTION,F.NAME,P.DESCRIPTION_OPT,N.WAREHOUSE_ID, CONVERT(decimal(15,4),N.QTY_ON_HAND)AS STOCK,P.UNIT_OF_MEASUREMENT, P.ID_FAB, --CONVERT(decimal(15,4),N.COST_AVG)AS COSTO_PROMEDIO round(CONVERT(decimal(15,4),N.COST_AVG)+(CONVERT(decimal(15,4),N.COST_AVG)*0.19),4)AS COSTO_PROMEDIO INTO TABLA_DE_STOCK from PART P INNER JOIN PART_QTY N ON P.ID =N.PART_ID INNER JOIN family f ON p.family=f.id where N.QTY_ON_HAND<>'0' ORDER BY P.ID
DELETE FROM TABLA_FINAL_DE_STOCK INSERT INTO TABLA_FINAL_DE_STOCK(ID,DESCRIPTION,NAME,DESCRIPTION_OPT,UNIT_OF_MEASUREMENT,ID_FAB,COSTO_PROMEDIO) SELECT DISTINCT ID,DESCRIPTION,NAME,DESCRIPTION_OPT,UNIT_OF_MEASUREMENT,ID_FAB,COSTO_PROMEDIO FROM TABLA_DE_STOCK
DECLARE @ID VARCHAR(15) DECLARE @WAREHOUSE_ID VARCHAR(2) DECLARE @STOCK FLOAT
DECLARE CURSOR1 CURSOR FOR SELECT ID FROM TABLA_FINAL_DE_STOCK ORDER BY ID OPEN CURSOR1 FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR1 INTO @ID WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN
DECLARE CURSOR2 CURSOR FOR SELECT WAREHOUSE_ID FROM TABLA_DE_STOCK WHERE ID=@ID OPEN CURSOR2 FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR2 INTO @WAREHOUSE_ID WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN SELECT @STOCK=STOCK FROM TABLA_DE_STOCK WHERE ID=@ID AND WAREHOUSE_ID=@WAREHOUSE_ID IF @WAREHOUSE_ID='01' BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_DE_STOCK SET ALMACEN1=@STOCK WHERE ID=@ID END ELSE IF @WAREHOUSE_ID='02' BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_DE_STOCK SET ALMACEN2=@STOCK WHERE ID=@ID END ELSE IF @WAREHOUSE_ID='03' BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_DE_STOCK SET ALMACEN3=@STOCK WHERE ID=@ID END
ELSE IF @WAREHOUSE_ID='04' BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_DE_STOCK SET ALMACEN4=@STOCK WHERE ID=@ID END
ELSE IF @WAREHOUSE_ID='05' BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_DE_STOCK SET ALMACEN5=@STOCK WHERE ID=@ID END
FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR2 INTO @WAREHOUSE_ID END CLOSE CURSOR2 DEALLOCATE CURSOR2
FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR1 INTO @ID END CLOSE CURSOR1 DEALLOCATE CURSOR1
UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_DE_STOCK SET ALMACEN1=(CASE WHEN ALMACEN1 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE ALMACEN1 END),ALMACEN2=(CASE WHEN ALMACEN2 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE ALMACEN2 END), ALMACEN3=(CASE WHEN ALMACEN3 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE ALMACEN3 END),ALMACEN4=(CASE WHEN ALMACEN4 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE ALMACEN4 END), ALMACEN5=(CASE WHEN ALMACEN5 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE ALMACEN5 END)

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value: Select PART_ID AS VENCODIGO,DESCRIPTION,UNIT_OF_MEASUREMENT,PLACE_SALES AS VENCODAGE,B.DOCUMENT_ID AS VENTD, (B.NUMBER_SERIE+B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT) AS VENSERDOC,DOCUMENT_DATE AS VENFECDOC,SALES_REP_ID AS VENVENDE, V.NAME,(CASE WHEN B.CURRENCY_ID='MN' THEN B.AMOUNT_TAX ELSE Round(B.AMOUNT_TAX * SELL_RATE, 2) END) AS VENIGV, (CASE WHEN TYPE_PART= '' THEN '' ELSE TYPE_PART END) AS VENTIPO, (CASE WHEN PART_SERIE Is Not Null And PART_SERIE<>'' THEN PART_SERIE ELSE '' END) AS VENSERIE, --(CASE WHEN CUSTOMER_ID= '' THEN ' ' ELSE CUSTOMER_ID END) AS VENCODCLI, --C.NAME AS NAME_CUSTOMER, QTY AS VENCANTID,A.AMOUNT_US AS VENIMPUS,A.AMOUNT AS VENIMPMN, (CASE WHEN B.CURRENCY_ID Is Not Null And B.CURRENCY_ID<> '' THEN B.CURRENCY_ID ELSE ' ' END) AS VENMONEDA, SELL_RATE AS VENTIPCAM,(' ')AS VENCODVEN,DOCUMENT_REF AS VENRFTD,(SERIE_REF+NUMBER_REF) AS VENDOCREF,A.PRICE_ORI INTO T_2_VENDEDOR FROM ([DROG_DANY].DBO.RECEIVABLE B INNER JOIN [DROG_DANY].DBO.RECEIVABLE_LINE A ON B.DOCUMENT_ID = A.DOCUMENT_ID And B.NUMBER_SERIE = A.NUMBER_SERIE And B.NUMBER_DOCUMENT = A.NUMBER_DOCUMENT)INNER JOIN [DROG_DANY].DBO.PART M ON A.PART_ID = M.ID LEFT JOIN [DROG_DANY].DBO.SALES_REP V ON B.SALES_REP_ID=V.ID WHERE M.ID<>'TEXTO' AND A.PART_ID >= @part1 and A.PART_ID <= @part2 AND B.STATUS <> 'A' and SALES_REP_ID >= @vendedor1 and SALES_REP_ID <= @vendedor2 AND DOCUMENT_DATE >= @fecha1 and DOCUMENT_DATE <= @fecha2 AND PLACE_SALES >= @punto_de_venta1 AND NOT (IS_STOCKED='N' AND SERIES='N' AND IS_LOT='N') AND PLACE_SALES <= @punto_de_venta2 ORDER BY VENSERDOC

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value: declare @STRquery nvarchar(2000) declare @estado char(1) set @estado='A' set @STRquery='select C.CUSTOMER_ID,convert(varchar(10),C.DOCUMENT_DATE,103) as DOCUMENT_DATE , C.DOCUMENT_ID,C.NUMBER_SERIE, C.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,C.CUSTOMER_NAME, D.PART_ID,D.PART_DESCRIPTION,M.UNIT_OF_MEASUREMENT, D.SHIPPER_QTY,M.WEIGHT from RECEIVABLE C inner join RECEIVABLE_LINE D on C.DOCUMENT_ID=D.DOCUMENT_ID and C.NUMBER_SERIE=D.NUMBER_SERIE and C.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=D.NUMBER_DOCUMENT inner join PART M on D.PART_ID=M.ID where D.SHIPPER_QTY<>0.00 and C.STATUS<>@estado and C.DOCUMENT_DATE>=@fecini and C.DOCUMENT_DATE<=@fecfin and C.CUSTOMER_ID>=@cliini and C.CUSTOMER_ID<=@clifin' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@fecini int,@fecfin int,@cliini char(20),@clifin char(20), @estado char(1)',@fecini,@fecfin,@cliini,@clifin,@estado

declare @STRquery nvarchar(2000) declare @STRfiltro nvarchar(1000) if @opcion='0' set @STRfiltro=N' and W.WAREHOUSE_ID=@almacen' if @opcion='1' set @STRfiltro=N' and W.WAREHOUSE_ID=@almacen and W.TYPE_TRANS=@tipomov and (W.TRANS_ID>=@movini and W.TRANS_ID<=@movfin)'
set @STRquery='select W.DOCUMENT_ID,W.NUMBER_DOCUMENT, convert(varchar(10),W.DATE_DOCUMENT,103) as DATE_DOCUMENT,W.TRANS_ID, W.DOC_ID_REF,W.NUM_ID_REF,W.VENDOR_ID,W.CUSTOMER_ID, W.CURRENCY_TYPE,WL.PART_ID,WL.QTY,WL.AVERAGE_COST, WL.NUMBER_SERIE,WL.NUMBER_LOT,P.DESCRIPTION,P.UNIT_OF_MEASUREMENT from WAREHOUSE_TRANS W inner join WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE WL on W.WAREHOUSE_ID=WL.WAREHOUSE_ID and W.DOCUMENT_ID=WL.DOCUMENT_ID and W.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=WL.NUMBER_DOCUMENT inner join PART P on WL.PART_ID=P.ID where W.DATE_DOCUMENT between @fecini and @fecfin '+@STRfiltro exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@fecini int,@fecfin int,@almacen char(3), @tipomov char(3),@movini char(20),@movfin char(20)', @fecini,@fecfin,@almacen,@tipomov,@movini,@movfin

declare @STRquery nvarchar(2000) declare @guia char(2),@boleta char(2),@factura char(2)
set @guia='GS' set @boleta='BV' set @factura='FT'
if @opcion='0' begin set @STRquery='select * from WAREHOUSE_TRANS where WAREHOUSE_ID=@almacen AND DOCUMENT_ID IN (@guia,@boleta,@factura) AND DATE_DOCUMENT between @fecini and @fecfin order by NUMBER_DOCUMENT' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@fecini int,@fecfin int,@almacen char(3), @opcion char(1),@guia char(2),@boleta char(2),@factura char(2)', @fecini,@fecfin,@almacen,@opcion,@guia,@boleta,@factura end
if @opcion='1' begin set @STRquery='select convert(varchar(10),C.DATE_DOCUMENT,103) as DATE_DOCUMENT, C.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,C.DOC_ID_REF,C.NUM_ID_REF, D.PART_ID,D.PART_DESCRIPTION, D.QTY,C.STATUS_GUIA,C.CARRIER_ID,C.NUMBER_REGISTRATION from WAREHOUSE_TRANS C inner join WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE D on C.DOCUMENT_ID=D.DOCUMENT_ID and C.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=D.NUMBER_DOCUMENT and C.WAREHOUSE_ID=D.WAREHOUSE_ID where C.WAREHOUSE_ID=@almacen and C.DATE_DOCUMENT between @fecini and @fecfin' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@fecini int,@fecfin int,@almacen char(3), @opcion char(1)',@fecini,@fecfin,@almacen,@opcion end

Property.Value: declare @STRquery nvarchar(2000) declare @guia char(2) set @guia='GS' set @STRquery='select W.DOCUMENT_ID,W.NUMBER_DOCUMENT, convert(varchar(10),W.DATE_DOCUMENT,103) as DATE_DOCUMENT, W.DOC_ID_REF,W.NUM_ID_REF,W.CUSTOMER_ID,W.CUSTOMER_NAME,W.STATUS_GUIA, WL.PART_ID,WL.QTY,P.DESCRIPTION,P.UNIT_OF_MEASUREMENT,P.WEIGHT from WAREHOUSE_TRANS W inner join WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE WL on W.WAREHOUSE_ID=WL.WAREHOUSE_ID and W.DOCUMENT_ID=WL.DOCUMENT_ID and W.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=WL.NUMBER_DOCUMENT inner join PART P on WL.PART_ID=P.ID where W.WAREHOUSE_ID=@almacen and ((W.DOC_ID_REF=@tipodoc) and W.DOCUMENT_ID=@guia) and (W.NUM_ID_REF>=@docini AND W.NUM_ID_REF<=@docfin)' exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@almacen char(3),@tipodoc char(3), @docini char(20),@docfin char(20),@guia char(2)', @almacen,@tipodoc,@docini,@docfin,@guia

if len(ISNULL(@codigo,''))=0 and len(ISNULL(@descripcion,''))=0 begin Select PART.ID,PART.DESCRIPTION,PART.UNIT_OF_MEASUREMENT, PART_QTY.QTY_ON_HAND from PART LEFT JOIN PART_QTY ON PART.ID = PART_QTY.PART_ID where (WAREHOUSE_ID=@almacen OR WAREHOUSE_ID IS NULL) AND STATUS='V' AND NOT (PART.IS_STOCKED='N' AND PART.IS_LOT='N' AND PART.SERIES='N') order by part.ID
end

if ISNULL(@codigo,'')<>'' begin select id,name from SALES_REP where id like '%' + @codigo + '%' end
if ISNULL(@nombre,'')='' begin select id,name from SALES_REP where name like '%' + @nombre + '%' end

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
SET NOCOUNT ON
/*SET @COD_CLI='01' SET @TIPO='FT' SET @NUM_DOC='0010100100' SET @FECHA='36541' SET @FECHA_VEN='36541' SET @TD_REF='GS' SET @NUM_REF='0010100102' SET @VENDEDOR='01' SET @MONTO='100.25' SET @SALDO='100.25' SET @SALDO_INI='100.25' SET @MONEDA='MN' SET @TIPO_CAMBIO='3.2' SET @DH='D' SET @USER='1' SET @TIPO_FAC='FT' SET @PAGO='00' SET @PTOVTA='01'*/
DECLARE @TRANSA1 INT DECLARE @TRANSA2 INT DECLARE @TRANSA3 INT DECLARE @TRANSA4 INT DECLARE @TRANSA5 INT DECLARE @CUENTA VARCHAR(18)
SET @TRANSA1=0 SET @TRANSA2=0 SET @TRANSA3=0 SET @TRANSA4=0 SET @TRANSA5=0 SET @CANT_ERROR=0
SELECT @CUENTA=(CASE WHEN @MONEDA='MN' THEN ACOUNT ELSE ACOUNT_US END)FROM PARAMETERS_ACOUNT WHERE TYPE_DOC=@TIPO
BEGIN TRAN UPDATE_CARTERA EXEC('set quoted_identifier off Insert Into CUSTOMER_BALANCE (CUSTOMER_ID,DOCUMENT_ID,NUMBER_DOC,DOC_DATE,CADUCATE_DATE, DOCUMENT_REF,NUMBER_REF,SALES_ID,AMOUNT,AMOUNT_BALANCE,AMOUNT_BALANCE_INI,CURRENCY_ID,SELL_RATE,IS_DR_CR,STATUS, CREATE_DATE,LAST_MODIFIED,USER_ID,TYPE_REC,ACCOUNT ,TERMS,PLACE_SALES) VALUES("'+@COD_CLI+'","'+@TIPO+'","'+@NUM_DOC+'",'+@FECHA+','+@FECHA_VEN+',"'+@TD_REF+'","'+@NUM_REF+'", "'+@VENDEDOR+'","'+@MONTO+'","'+@SALDO+'","'+@SALDO_INI+'","'+@MONEDA+'","'+@TIPO_CAMBIO+'","'+@DH+'","V", GETDATE(),GETDATE(),"'+@USER+'","'+@TIPO_FAC+'","'+@CUENTA+'","'+@PAGO+'","'+@PTOVTA+'")') SET @TRANSA2=@@ERROR
IF @MONEDA='MN' BEGIN EXEC('set quoted_identifier off Update CUSTOMER set BALANCE = BALANCE + '+@MONTO+' Where ID = "'+@COD_CLI+'" ') SET @TRANSA3=@@ERROR END ELSE BEGIN EXEC('set quoted_identifier off Update CUSTOMER set BALANCE_US = BALANCE_US + '+@MONTO+' Where ID = "'+@COD_CLI+'" ') SET @TRANSA3=@@ERROR END
EXEC('set quoted_identifier off INSERT INTO INVOICE (INVOICE_ID,STATUS,LAST_STATUS) VALUES("'+@NUM_DOC+'","CR","CR")') SET @TRANSA4=@@ERROR
EXEC ('set quoted_identifier off INSERT INTO HISTORY_RECEIVABLE (INVOICE_ID,STATUS,AMOUNT,DATE) VALUES("'+@NUM_DOC+'","CR",'+@MONTO+','+@FECHA+')') SET @TRANSA5=@@ERROR
IF (@TRANSA1<>0 OR @TRANSA2<>0 OR @TRANSA3<>0 OR @TRANSA4<>0 OR @TRANSA5<>0) BEGIN SET @CANT_ERROR=1 ROLLBACK TRAN UPDATE_CARTERA END ELSE BEGIN COMMIT TRAN UPDATE_CARTERA END

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
declare @STRquery nvarchar(1500) declare @filtro nvarchar(1500)
if @todos='1' set @filtro=N' WHERE M.STATE_ID = T.ID AND TYPE_ID="13" ORDER BY M.STATE_ID ASC,M.ID ASC' if @todos='0' set @filtro=N' WHERE M.STATE_ID = T.ID and TYPE_ID="13" AND M.STATE_ID BETWEEN @dis1 AND @dis2 ORDER BY M.STATE_ID ASC,M.ID ASC'
set @STRquery=' SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER OFF SELECT M.ID, M.NAME, M.ADDR, M.PHONE, M.VAT_REGISTRATION, M.STATE_ID, T.TYPE_ID, T.ID as ID_MASTER_HELP, T.DESCRIPTION FROM CUSTOMER M,MASTER_HELP T ' set @STRquery=@STRquery + @filtro exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@todos char(1),@dis1 char(2),@dis2 char(2)',@todos,@dis1,@dis2

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
declare @STRquery nvarchar(1500) declare @filtro nvarchar(1500)
if @todos='1' set @filtro=N' WHERE G.CUST_ID = M.ID AND G.GROUP_ID = C.ID ORDER BY G.GROUP_ID ASC' if @todos='0' set @filtro=N' WHERE G.CUST_ID = M.ID AND G.GROUP_ID = C.ID AND GROUP_ID BETWEEN @group1 AND @group2 ORDER BY G.GROUP_ID ASC '
set @STRquery='SELECT G.GROUP_ID,M.ID, M.NAME, M.ADDR, M.PHONE, M.VAT_REGISTRATION,C.ID AS ID_CUST_GROUP, C.NAME AS NAME_GROUP FROM RELATION_CUST_GROUP G,CUSTOMER M,CUSTOMER_GROUP C' set @STRquery=@STRquery + @filtro exec sp_executesql @STRquery,N'@todos char(1),@group1 char(2),@group2 char(2)',@todos,@group1,@group2

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value: select r.DOCUMENT_ID,r.NUMBER_SERIE,r.NUMBER_DOCUMENT, r.DOCUMENT_DATE,r.CADUCATE_DATE, r.CUSTOMER_ID,r.CUSTOMER_NAME,r.CUSTOMER_ADDR, r.VAT_REGISTRATION,r.AMOUNT,r.SELL_RATE,r.CURRENCY_ID, r.DOCUMENT_REF,r.SERIE_REF,r.NUMBER_REF, r.NUMBER_ORDER,r.COMMENT,r.AMOUNT_TAX, (r.DOCUMENT_ID + r.NUMBER_SERIE + r.NUMBER_DOCUMENT) ID_CAB, r.PLACE_SALES,r.STATUS from receivable r where convert(varchar(10),R.CREATE_DATE,103) between @fecha_ini and @fecha_fin order by r.CREATE_DATE

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value: select r.DOCUMENT_ID,r.NUMBER_SERIE,r.NUMBER_DOCUMENT, rl.ITEM,rl.PART_ID,rl.PART_DESCRIPTION, rl.QTY,rl.PRICE_SALES,rl.PRICE_ORI, rl.AMOUNT_TAX,rl.TAX_PERCENT,rl.AMOUNT_US,rl.AMOUNT, rl.UNIT,(r.DOCUMENT_ID + r.NUMBER_SERIE + r.NUMBER_DOCUMENT) ID_DET from receivable r inner join RECEIVABLE_LINE rl on r.DOCUMENT_ID=rl.DOCUMENT_ID and r.NUMBER_SERIE=rl.NUMBER_SERIE and r.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=rl.NUMBER_DOCUMENT where convert(varchar(10),R.CREATE_DATE,103) between @fecha_ini and @fecha_fin order by r.CREATE_DATE

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
/*SET NOCOUNT ON SET @TIPO='FT' SET @SERIE='001' SET @NUMERO='0100100' SET @FECHA='39186' SET @DH='D' SET @VENDEDOR='01' SET @PTOVTA='01' SET @COD_CLI='00000000011' SET @RUC='121345678912' SET @ALMA='01' SET @RAZONSOCIAL='MARCO' SET @DIRECCION='DRGDRGDFGDF' SET @PAGO='00' SET @MONTO='500.25' SET @MONEDA='MN' SET @TIPCAMB='3.22' SET @TD_REF='' SET @SER_REF='' SET @NUM_REF='' SET @TIPFAC='FT' SET @COD_TARJ='01' SET @NUM_TARJ='11111111' SET @MONTO_TARJ_DOL='150' SET @MONTO_TARJ_SOL='500.25' SET @BANCO='' SET @NUM_BANCO='' SET @MONTO_CHK_DOL='' SET @MONTO_CHK_SOL='' SET @MONTOIGV='100' SET @COTIZACION='3216549877' SET @ORDENCOMPRA='43165498732165498777' SET @PEDIDO='12345678' SET @GLOSA='GHFGHFGHF' SET @IDE='DEVELOPER6' SET @DIAS_CREDITO='0' SET @FLAG_REF='0' SET @HORA='12:38:06' SET @USER='NovaQ' SET @SER_GUIA='001' SET @NUM_GUIA='0100102' SET @DESCCLI='10' SET @DESCESP='20' SET @TRANS='01' SET @ANOMES='200704'*/
declare @TABLA_cab varchar(50) declare @TABLA_det varchar(50) declare @TRAN1 int declare @TRAN2 int declare @TRAN3 int declare @TRAN4 int declare @TRAN5 int declare @TRAN6 int declare @TRAN7 int declare @TRAN8 int
declare @NUMBER_REF varchar(10) declare @NUMBER_DOC varchar(10)
SET @TRAN1=0 SET @TRAN2=0 SET @TRAN3=0 SET @TRAN4=0 SET @TRAN5=0 SET @TRAN6=0 SET @TRAN7=0 SET @TRAN8=0
set @TABLA_cab='tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'FACWORCAB' set @TABLA_det='tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'FACWORDET' SET @NUMBER_REF=@SER_REF+@NUM_REF SET @NUMBER_DOC=@SERIE+@NUMERO
BEGIN TRAN UPDATE_DOCUMENT_SALES EXEC('set quoted_identifier off INSERT INTO RECEIVABLE (DOCUMENT_ID,NUMBER_SERIE,NUMBER_DOCUMENT,DOCUMENT_DATE, DR_CR,SALES_REP_ID,PLACE_SALES,CUSTOMER_ID,VAT_REGISTRATION,WAREHOUSE_ID,CUSTOMER_NAME,CUSTOMER_ADDR,TERMS_ID,AMOUNT, CURRENCY_ID,BALANCE,CADUCATE_DATE,SELL_RATE,USER_ID,STATUS,DOCUMENT_REF,SERIE_REF,NUMBER_REF,RECEIVABLE_TYPE, DISCOUNT_PERCENT,DISCOUNT_PERCENT_SP,CARD_ID,NUMBER_CARD,AMOUNT_CARD_US,AMOUNT_CARD,BANK_CHECK,NUMBER_CHECK, AMOUNT_CH_US,AMOUNT_CH,AMOUNT_TAX,DISCOUNT_RECIVABLE,LIST_GUIA,NUMBER_QUOTE,NUMBER_ORDER_PUR,NUMBER_ORDER,COMMENT,ISC) SELECT "'+@TIPO+'","'+@SERIE+'","'+@NUMERO+'",'+@FECHA+',"'+@DH+'","'+@VENDEDOR+'","'+@PTOVTA+'","'+@COD_CLI+'","'+@RUC+'","'+@ALMA+'", "'+@RAZONSOCIAL+'","'+@DIRECCION+'","'+@PAGO+'",'+@MONTO+',"'+@MONEDA+'",(CASE WHEN "'+@DIAS_CREDITO+'">0 THEN cfIMPORTE ELSE 0 END), cfFECVEN,"'+@TIPCAMB+'","'+@USER+'","V","'+@TD_REF+'","'+@SER_REF+'","'+@NUM_REF+'","'+@TIPFAC+'",CFPORDESCL, CFPORDESES,"'+@COD_TARJ+'","'+@NUM_TARJ+'","'+@MONTO_TARJ_DOL+'","'+@MONTO_TARJ_SOL+'","'+@BANCO+'","'+@NUM_BANCO+'", "'+@MONTO_CHK_DOL+'","'+@MONTO_CHK_SOL+'","'+@MONTOIGV+'",CFDESVAL,CFTEXGUIA,"'+@COTIZACION+'","'+@ORDENCOMPRA+'","'+@PEDIDO+'","'+@GLOSA+'" ,CFISC FROM '+@TABLA_cab+'')
SET @TRAN1 =@@ERROR
IF @FLAG_REF=1 BEGIN EXEC('set quoted_identifier off Insert Into RECEIVABLE_LINE (DOCUMENT_ID,NUMBER_SERIE,NUMBER_DOCUMENT,ITEM, PART_ID,PART_DESCRIPTION,TEXT_DESCRIPTION,PRICE_ORI,PRICE_SALES,QTY,DISCOUNT_CUSTOMER,DISCOUNT_SP, DISCOUNT_PERCENT,DISCOUNT,STOCK,STATUS,AMOUNT_TAX,TAX_PERCENT,AMOUNT_US,AMOUNT,PART_SERIE,PART_LOT,WAREHOUSE_ID, DFTR,PART_TAX,PRICE_LIST_ID,UNIT,BUDGET_ID,ORDER_ID,UMREFERENCIA,CANTREFERENCIA,COMISION,TIPOISC,ISCPOR,ISC) SELECT "'+@TIPO+'","'+@SERIE+'","'+@NUMERO+'",DFSECUEN,dfCODIGO,DFDESCRI,dfTEXTO,DFPREC_ORI,DFPREC_VEN, dfCANTID,DFDESCLI,DFDESESP,DFPORDES,dfDESCTO,dfstock,"V",DFIGV,DFIGVPOR,dfIMPUS,dfIMPMN,DFSERIE,DFLOTE, "'+@ALMA+'",dfTR,DFARTIGV,DFCODLIS,DFUNIDAD,DFPRESU,DFORD,UMREFERENCIA,CANTREFERENCIA,COMISION ,TIPOISC,ISCPOR,ISC FROM '+@TABLA_det+'') SET @TRAN2=@@ERROR END ELSE BEGIN EXEC('set quoted_identifier off Insert Into RECEIVABLE_LINE (DOCUMENT_ID,NUMBER_SERIE,NUMBER_DOCUMENT,ITEM, PART_ID,PART_DESCRIPTION,TEXT_DESCRIPTION,PRICE_ORI,PRICE_SALES,QTY,DISCOUNT_CUSTOMER,DISCOUNT_SP, DISCOUNT_PERCENT,DISCOUNT,STOCK,STATUS,AMOUNT_TAX,TAX_PERCENT,AMOUNT_US,AMOUNT,PART_SERIE,PART_LOT,WAREHOUSE_ID, DFTR,PART_TAX,PRICE_LIST_ID,UNIT,BUDGET_ID,ORDER_ID,COMISION,TIPOISC,ISCPOR,ISC) SELECT "'+@TIPO+'","'+@SERIE+'","'+@NUMERO+'",DFSECUEN,dfCODIGO,DFDESCRI,dfTEXTO,DFPREC_ORI,DFPREC_VEN, dfCANTID,DFDESCLI,DFDESESP,DFPORDES,dfDESCTO,dfstock,"V",DFIGV,DFIGVPOR,dfIMPUS,dfIMPMN,DFSERIE,DFLOTE, "'+@ALMA+'",dfTR,DFARTIGV,DFCODLIS,DFUNIDAD,DFPRESU,DFORD,COMISION,TIPOISC,ISCPOR,ISC FROM '+@TABLA_det+'') SET @TRAN2=@@ERROR END
EXEC SAL_UPGRADE_WHO_TRANS_SALES @TIPO,@ALMA,@NUMBER_DOC,@FECHA,@TIPCAMB,@TD_REF,@NUMBER_REF,@USER,@COD_CLI,@RUC,@RAZONSOCIAL,@PAGO,@MONEDA,@MONTO,@HORA,@ORDENCOMPRA,@COTIZACION,@PEDIDO,@GLOSA,@IDE,@FLAG_REF,@ANOMES,@TRAN3 OUTPUT IF ISNULL(@SER_GUIA,' ')<>' ' BEGIN EXEC SAL_UPGRADE_GUIA_TRANS @ALMA,@TIPO,@SERIE,@NUMERO,@FECHA,@VENDEDOR,@COD_CLI,@RUC,@RAZONSOCIAL,@DIRECCION,@PAGO,@MONTO, @MONEDA,@TIPCAMB,@USER,@TD_REF,@NUMBER_REF,@DESCCLI,@DESCESP,@HORA,@TRANS,@ORDENCOMPRA,@COTIZACION,@PEDIDO,@GLOSA,@SER_GUIA,@NUM_GUIA,@FLAG_REF,@IDE,@TRAN4 OUTPUT END
IF @DIAS_CREDITO>0 BEGIN EXEC SAL_INSERT_CARTERA @COD_CLI,@TIPO,@NUMBER_DOC,@FECHA,@FECHA_VEN,@TD_REF,@NUMBER_REF,@VENDEDOR,@MONTO,@MONTO,@MONTO, @MONEDA,@TIPCAMB,@DH,@USER,@TIPFAC,@PAGO,@PTOVTA,@TRAN5 OUTPUT
UPDATE CUSTOMER_BALANCE SET SERIE_AUX=@SERIE,NUM_DOC_AUX=@NUMERO WHERE DOCUMENT_ID=@TIPO AND NUMBER_DOC=@NUMBER_DOC END
EXEC('set quoted_identifier off Update WAREHOUSE_TRANS set STATUS_GUIA="F" where WAREHOUSE_ID = "'+@ALMA+'" and DOCUMENT_ID = "GS" and SUBSTRING(NUMBER_DOCUMENT,1,3) = "'+@SER_GUIA+'" and SUBSTRING(NUMBER_DOCUMENT,4,7) = "'+@NUM_GUIA+'"') SET @TRAN6=@@ERROR
IF @TD_REF='CT' BEGIN EXEC('set quoted_identifier off Update QUOTE set STATUS="F" Where NUMBER_QUOTE = "'+@NUM_REF+'" and PLACE_SALES="'+@PTOVTA+'"') SET @TRAN7=@@ERROR END IF @TD_REF='PD' BEGIN EXEC('set quoted_identifier off Update ORDERS set STATUS="F" Where ID = "'+@NUM_REF+'" and PLACE_SALES="'+@PTOVTA+'"') SET @TRAN8=@@ERROR END
IF (@TRAN1<>0 OR @TRAN2<>0 OR @TRAN3<>0 OR @TRAN4<>0 OR @TRAN5<>0 OR @TRAN6<>0 OR @TRAN7<>0 OR @TRAN8<>0) BEGIN ROLLBACK TRAN UPDATE_DOCUMENT_SALES END ELSE BEGIN COMMIT TRAN UPDATE_DOCUMENT_SALES END

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
SET NOCOUNT ON /*SET @ALMA='01' SET @NUMFACWOR='0000232' SET @NUMERO='0010100100' SET @FLAG_REF='1' SET @MONEDA='MN' SET @TIPCAM='3.23' SET @IDE='DEVELOPER6'*/
DECLARE @TABLA VARCHAR(50) set @TABLA='tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'FACWORDET' SET @CANT_ERROR=0 BEGIN TRAN UPDATE_GUIA_LINE
IF @FLAG_REF=1 BEGIN EXEC('set quoted_identifier off INSERT INTO WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE (WAREHOUSE_ID,DOCUMENT_ID,NUMBER_DOCUMENT,TRANS_ID,ITEM,PART_ID, PART_DESCRIPTION,AMOUNT_SALES,AVERAGE_COST,QTY,DISCOUNT_CUST,DISCOUNT_SP,DISCOUNT_PERCENT,DISCOUNT,STATUS, AMOUNT_TAX,TAX_PERCENT,AMOUNT_US,AMOUNT,NUMBER_SERIE,NUMBER_LOT,TEXT_COMMENT,CURRENCY_ID,TYPE_EXCHANGE,UNIT_PART )SELECT "'+@ALMA+'","GS","'+@NUMERO+'","GV",DFSECUEN,DFCODIGO, (CASE WHEN DFCODIGO="TEXTO" THEN DFTEXTO ELSE DFDESCRI END),DFPREC_ORI,DFPREC_VEN,DFCANTID,DFDESCLI,DFDESESP, DFPORDES,DFDESCTO,"S",DFIGV,DFIGVPOR,DFIMPUS,DFIMPMN,DFSERIE,DFLOTE,DFTR,"'+@MONEDA+'","'+@TIPCAM+'",DFUNIDAD,DFCANTID, DFPRESU FROM '+@TABLA+' where DFSISTEM = "F" and DFNUMPED = "'+@NUMFACWOR+'"') SET @CANT_ERROR=@@ERROR END ELSE BEGIN EXEC('set quoted_identifier off INSERT INTO WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE (WAREHOUSE_ID,DOCUMENT_ID,NUMBER_DOCUMENT,TRANS_ID,ITEM,PART_ID, PART_DESCRIPTION,AMOUNT_SALES,AVERAGE_COST,QTY,DISCOUNT_CUST,DISCOUNT_SP,DISCOUNT_PERCENT,DISCOUNT,STATUS, AMOUNT_TAX,TAX_PERCENT,AMOUNT_US,AMOUNT,NUMBER_SERIE,NUMBER_LOT,TEXT_COMMENT,CURRENCY_ID,TYPE_EXCHANGE,UNIT_PART, QTY_REF,REFERENCE)SELECT "'+@ALMA+'","GS","'+@NUMERO+'","GV",DFSECUEN,DFCODIGO, (CASE WHEN DFCODIGO="TEXTO" THEN DFTEXTO ELSE DFDESCRI END),DFPREC_ORI,DFPREC_VEN,DFCANTID,DFDESCLI,DFDESESP, DFPORDES,DFDESCTO,"S",DFIGV,DFIGVPOR,DFIMPUS,DFIMPMN,DFSERIE,DFLOTE,DFTR,"'+@MONEDA+'","'+@TIPCAM+'",DFUNIDAD,DFCANTID, DFPRESU,REFERENCE,CANTREFERENCIA FROM '+@TABLA+' where DFSISTEM = "F" and DFNUMPED = "'+@NUMFACWOR+'"') SET @CANT_ERROR=@@ERROR END
COMMIT TRAN UPDATE_GUIA_LINE

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
SET NOCOUNT ON /*SET @ALMA='01' set @TIPO='FT' SET @SERIE='001' SET @NUMERO='0100100' SET @FECHA='11/12/2007' SET @VENDEDOR='01' SET @COD_CLI='01' SET @RUC='12345678912' SET @RAZONSOCIAL='MARCO ANTONIO JESUS VARGAS GALLO' SET @DIRECCION='FTH FTGHDFGH FTGHDGF' SET @FORMA_PAG='00' SET @MONTO='1000' SET @MONEDA='MN' SET @TIPO_CAMBIO='3.265' SET @USER='1' SET @TD_REF=' ' SET @NUM_REF=' ' SET @DESC_CLI='10' SET @DESC_ESP='20' SET @HORA='03:05:15' SET @TRANS='01' SET @ORDEN_COMPRA='32165498732165498732' SET @COTIZA='3216547' SET @PEDIDO='3216547' SET @GLOSA='KGKGKJ' SET @SER_GUIA='001' SET @NUM_GUIA='0100100' SET @FLAG_REF='0' SET @IDE='DEVELOPER6'*/
DECLARE @ERROR1 INT DECLARE @ERROR2 INT DECLARE @ERROR3 INT DECLARE @TABLA_det VARCHAR(50) SET @ERROR1=0 SET @ERROR2=0 SET @ERROR3=0 SET @CANT_ERROR=0 set @TABLA_det='tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'FACWORDET'
BEGIN TRAN UPDATE_GUIA_TRANS EXEC('set quoted_identifier off Insert Into WAREHOUSE_TRANS (WAREHOUSE_ID,DOCUMENT_ID,NUMBER_DOCUMENT,TRANS_ID, TYPE_TRANS,TYPE_GUIA, STATUS_GUIA,DATE_DOCUMENT,SALES_ID,CUSTOMER_ID,VAT_REGISTRATION,CUSTOMER_NAME,ADDR_DLV, SALES_TERM,AMOUNT,CURRENCY_TYPE,CURRENCY_EXCHANGE,USER_ID,DOC_ID_REF,NUM_ID_REF,DISCOUNT_PER_CUST,DISCOUNT_PER_SP, UPDATE_DATE,HOUR,RECEIVABLE_GUIA,CARRIER_ID,NUMBER_PURCHASE,NUMBER_ESTIMATING, NUMBER_ORDER, COMMENT) VALUES("'+@ALMA+'","GS","'+@SER_GUIA+@NUM_GUIA+'","GF","S","GF","F",'+@FECHA+',"'+@VENDEDOR+'","'+@COD_CLI+'","'+@RUC+'", "'+@RAZONSOCIAL+'","'+@DIRECCION+'","'+@FORMA_PAG+'","'+@MONTO+'","'+@MONEDA+'","'+@TIPO_CAMBIO+'","'+@USER+'", "'+@TD_REF+'","'+@NUM_REF+'","'+@DESC_CLI+'","'+@DESC_ESP+'",getdate(),"'+@HORA+'","N","'+@TRANS+'","'+@ORDEN_COMPRA+'", "'+@COTIZA+'","'+@PEDIDO+'","'+@GLOSA+'")') SET @ERROR1=@@ERROR
IF @FLAG_REF=1 BEGIN EXEC('set quoted_identifier off INSERT INTO WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE (WAREHOUSE_ID,DOCUMENT_ID,NUMBER_DOCUMENT,TRANS_ID,ITEM,PART_ID, PART_DESCRIPTION,AMOUNT_SALES,AVERAGE_COST,QTY,DISCOUNT_CUST,DISCOUNT_SP,DISCOUNT_PERCENT,DISCOUNT,STATUS, AMOUNT_TAX,TAX_PERCENT,AMOUNT_US,AMOUNT,NUMBER_SERIE,NUMBER_LOT,TEXT_COMMENT,CURRENCY_ID,TYPE_EXCHANGE,UNIT_PART QTY_REF,REFERENCE,UNIT_REFERENCE,QTY_REFERENCE)SELECT "'+@ALMA+'","GS","'+@SER_GUIA+@NUM_GUIA+'","GV",DFSECUEN,DFCODIGO, (CASE WHEN DFCODIGO="TEXTO" THEN DFTEXTO ELSE DFDESCRI END),DFPREC_ORI,DFPREC_VEN,DFCANTID,DFDESCLI,DFDESESP, DFPORDES,DFDESCTO,"S",DFIGV,DFIGVPOR,DFIMPUS,DFIMPMN,DFSERIE,DFLOTE,DFTR,"'+@MONEDA+'","'+@TIPO_CAMBIO+'",DFUNIDAD,DFCANTID, DFPRESU,REFERENCE,CANTREFERENCIA FROM '+@TABLA_det+'') SET @ERROR2=@@ERROR END ELSE BEGIN EXEC('set quoted_identifier off INSERT INTO WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE (WAREHOUSE_ID,DOCUMENT_ID,NUMBER_DOCUMENT,TRANS_ID,ITEM,PART_ID, PART_DESCRIPTION,AMOUNT_SALES,AVERAGE_COST,QTY,DISCOUNT_CUST,DISCOUNT_SP,DISCOUNT_PERCENT,DISCOUNT,STATUS, AMOUNT_TAX,TAX_PERCENT,AMOUNT_US,AMOUNT,NUMBER_SERIE,NUMBER_LOT,TEXT_COMMENT,CURRENCY_ID,TYPE_EXCHANGE,UNIT_PART, QTY_REF,REFERENCE)SELECT "'+@ALMA+'","GS","'+@SER_GUIA+@NUM_GUIA+'","GV",DFSECUEN,DFCODIGO, (CASE WHEN DFCODIGO="TEXTO" THEN DFTEXTO ELSE DFDESCRI END),DFPREC_ORI,DFPREC_VEN,DFCANTID,DFDESCLI,DFDESESP, DFPORDES,DFDESCTO,"S",DFIGV,DFIGVPOR,DFIMPUS,DFIMPMN,DFSERIE,DFLOTE,DFTR,"'+@MONEDA+'","'+@TIPO_CAMBIO+'",DFUNIDAD,DFCANTID, DFPRESU FROM '+@TABLA_det+'') SET @ERROR2=@@ERROR END
EXEC('set quoted_identifier off Update RECEIVABLE Set DOCUMENT_REF = "GS",SERIE_REF = "'+@SER_GUIA+'",NUMBER_REF = "'+@NUM_GUIA+'",LIST_GUIA = "'+@SER_GUIA+@NUM_GUIA+'" Where DOCUMENT_ID = "'+@TIPO+'" and NUMBER_SERIE = "'+@SERIE+'" and NUMBER_DOCUMENT = "'+@NUMERO+'"')
SET @ERROR3=@@ERROR
IF (@ERROR1<>0 OR @ERROR2<>0 OR @ERROR3<>0) BEGIN SET @CANT_ERROR=1 ROLLBACK TRAN UPDATE_GUIA_TRANS END ELSE BEGIN COMMIT TRAN UPDATE_GUIA_TRANS END

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
SET NOCOUNT ON /*SET @NUMERO='0000015' SET @PTOVTA='01' SET @USER='1' SET @MONTO='1000' SET @MONTOIGV='190' SET @IDE='DEVELOPER6'*/
declare @TABLA varchar(50) declare @TRAN1 int declare @TRAN2 int set @TABLA='tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'FACWORCAB'
BEGIN TRAN UPDATE_ORDERS EXEC('set quoted_identifier off Insert Into ORDERS (ID,ORDER_DATE,CADUCATE_DATE,SALES_ID,PLACE_SALES,CUSTOMER_ID,VAT_REGISTRATION,CUSTOMER_NAME, CUSTOMER_ADDR,DISCOUNT_CUSTOMER,DISCOUNT_SP,TERMS,SELL_RATE,CURRENCY_ID,USER_ID,DOCUMENT_REF,SERIE_REF,NUMBER_REF, STATUS,AMOUNT,AMOUNT_VAT,DISCOUNT_VAL,STATUS_ORDER) SELECT "'+@NUMERO+'",CFFECDOC,CFFECVEN,cfVENDE,"'+@PTOVTA+'",CFCODCLI,ISNULL(CFRUC," "),CFNOMBRE,ISNULL(CFDIRECC," "),CFPORDESCL,CFPORDESES,CFFORVEN, CFTIPCAM,CFCODMON,"'+@USER+'",ISNULL(CFRFTD," "),ISNULL(CFRFNUMSER," "),ISNULL(CFRFNUMDOC," "),"V","'+@MONTO+'","'+@MONTOIGV+'",CFDESVAL,"AUTORIZADO" FROM '+@TABLA+'') SET @TRAN1 =@@ERROR
EXEC SAL_UPGRADE_ORDERS_LINE @NUMERO,@IDE,@TRAN2 OUTPUT
IF (@TRAN1<>0 OR @TRAN2<>0) BEGIN ROLLBACK TRAN UPDATE_ORDERS END ELSE BEGIN COMMIT TRAN UPDATE_ORDERS END

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
declare @TABLA varchar(50)
SET NOCOUNT ON set @TABLA='tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'FACWORDET' SET @CANT_ERROR=0

SET NOCOUNT ON /*SET @NUMERO='0000015' SET @USER='1' SET @MONTO='1000' SET @MONTOIGV='190' SET @IDE='DEVELOPER6' SET @EXPIRES_DATE='rr' SET @PLACE_SHIPPER='ereeee' SET @TIME_SHIPPER='33'*/
declare @TABLA varchar(50) declare @TRAN1 int declare @TRAN2 int set @TABLA='tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'FACWORCAB'
BEGIN TRAN UPDATE_QUOTE exec('set quoted_identifier off Insert Into QUOTE (NUMBER_QUOTE,QUOTE_DATE,CADUCATE_DATE,SALES_ID,PLACE_SALES, CUSTOMER_ID,VAT_REGISTRATION,CUSTOMER_NAME,CUSTOMER_ADDR,DISCOUNT,DISCOUNT_SP,TERMS,SELL_RATE,CURRENCY_ID,USER_ID, REFERENCE_DOC,REFERENCE_SERIE,REFERENCE_NUMBER,STATUS,COMMENT,AMOUNT,AMOUNT_TAX,AMOUNT_DISCOUNT,EXPIRES_DATE, PLACE_SHIPPER,TIME_SHIPPER) SELECT "'+@NUMERO+'",CFFECDOC,CFFECVEN,cfVENDE,cfPUNVEN,CFCODCLI,ISNULL(CFRUC," "),CFNOMBRE,ISNULL(CFDIRECC," "), CFPORDESCL,CFPORDESES,CFFORVEN,CFTIPCAM,CFCODMON,"'+@USER+'",ISNULL(CFRFTD," "),ISNULL(CFRFNUMSER," "), ISNULL(CFRFNUMDOC," "),"V",cfglosa,"'+@MONTO+'","'+@MONTOIGV+'",CFDESVAL, "'+@EXPIRES_DATE+'","'+@PLACE_SHIPPER+'","'+@TIME_SHIPPER+'" FROM '+@TABLA+'') SET @TRAN1 =@@ERROR

IF (@TRAN1<>0 OR @TRAN2<>0) BEGIN ROLLBACK TRAN UPDATE_QUOTE END ELSE BEGIN COMMIT TRAN UPDATE_QUOTE END

declare @TABLA varchar(50) set @TABLA='tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'FACWORDET' SET @CANT_ERROR=0

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
/*SET @TD='FT' SET @ALMA='01' SET @NUMERO='0010100100' SET @FECHA='39186' SET @TIPO_CAMBIO='3.35' SET @TD_REF='' SET @NUM_REF='' SET @USER='NovaQ' SET @COD_CLI='32165498712' SET @RUC='12345678912' SET @NOM_CLI='marco' SET @PAGO='00' SET @MONEDA='MN' SET @MONTO='500.25' SET @HORA='12:38:06' SET @ORDENCOMPRA='32165498732165498732' SET @COTIZACION='3216549877' SET @PEDIDO='3216547' SET @GLOSA='FGTHFTGHF' SET @IDE ='DEVELOPER6' SET @FLAG_REF='0' SET @ANOMES='200704'*/
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @TABLA_det AS VARCHAR(50) DECLARE @TRANS_CAB INT DECLARE @TRANS_DET INT DECLARE @TRANS_PEDDET INT DECLARE @MORES_INSERT INT DECLARE @MORES_UPDATE INT DECLARE @UPDATE_COST INT
set @TABLA_det='tempdb.dbo.'+@IDE+'FACWORDET' SET @TRANS_CAB=0 SET @TRANS_DET=0 SET @TRANS_PEDDET=0 SET @MORES_INSERT=0 SET @MORES_UPDATE=0 SET @UPDATE_COST=0 SET @CANT_ERROR=0
BEGIN TRAN UPGRADE_WHOTRANS_SALES
IF @TD<>'NC' BEGIN EXEC('set quoted_identifier off INSERT INTO WAREHOUSE_TRANS (WAREHOUSE_ID,DOCUMENT_ID,NUMBER_DOCUMENT,DATE_DOCUMENT, CURRENCY_EXCHANGE,TYPE_TRANS,STATUS_GUIA,DOC_ID_REF,NUM_ID_REF,USER_ID,CUSTOMER_ID,VAT_REGISTRATION,CUSTOMER_NAME, SALES_TERM,CURRENCY_TYPE,AMOUNT,TRANS_ID,HOUR,NUMBER_PURCHASE, NUMBER_ESTIMATING, NUMBER_ORDER, COMMENT) VALUES("'+@ALMA+'","'+@TD+'","'+@NUMERO+'",'+@FECHA+',"'+@TIPO_CAMBIO+'","S","F","'+@TD_REF+'","'+@NUM_REF+'", "'+@USER+'","'+@COD_CLI+'","'+@RUC+'","'+@NOM_CLI+'","'+@PAGO+'","'+@MONEDA+'","'+@MONTO+'","FT","'+@HORA+'", "'+@ORDENCOMPRA+'","'+@COTIZACION+'","'+@PEDIDO+'","'+@GLOSA+'")') SET @TRANS_CAB=@@ERROR END ELSE BEGIN EXEC('set quoted_identifier off INSERT INTO WAREHOUSE_TRANS (WAREHOUSE_ID,DOCUMENT_ID,NUMBER_DOCUMENT,DATE_DOCUMENT, CURRENCY_EXCHANGE,TYPE_TRANS,STATUS_GUIA,DOC_ID_REF,NUM_ID_REF,USER_ID,CUSTOMER_ID,VAT_REGISTRATION,CUSTOMER_NAME, SALES_TERM,CURRENCY_TYPE,AMOUNT,TRANS_ID,HOUR,NUMBER_ORDER) VALUES("'+@ALMA+'","'+@TD+'","'+@NUMERO+'",'+@FECHA+','+@TIPO_CAMBIO+',"I","F","'+@TD_REF+'","'+@NUM_REF+'", "'+@USER+'","'+@COD_CLI+'","'+@RUC+'","'+@NOM_CLI+'","'+@PAGO+'","'+@MONEDA+'","'+@MONTO+'","FT","'+@HORA+'","'+@PEDIDO+'")') SET @TRANS_CAB=@@ERROR END
--ACTUALIZO EL ULTIMO COSTO PROMEDIO AL TEMPORAL EXEC('set quoted_identifier off UPDATE T SET T.DFCOSTO=(CASE WHEN "'+@MONEDA+'"="MN" THEN S.COST_AVG ELSE S.COST_AVG_US END) FROM '+@TABLA_det+' T INNER JOIN PART_QTY S ON T.dfALMA=S.WAREHOUSE_ID AND T.dfCODIGO=S.PART_ID') SET @UPDATE_COST=@@ERROR
IF @FLAG_REF=1 BEGIN EXEC('set quoted_identifier off Insert Into WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE (WAREHOUSE_ID,DOCUMENT_ID,NUMBER_DOCUMENT,ITEM,PART_ID,PART_DESCRIPTION,QTY, AVERAGE_COST,AMOUNT_SALES,UNIT_PART,NUMBER_SERIE,NUMBER_LOT, QTY_REF,REFERENCE,UNIT_REFERENCE,QTY_REFERENCE) SELECT dfALMA,"'+@TD+'","'+@NUMERO+'",DFSECUEN,dfCODIGO,DFDESCRI,abs(dfCANTID),DFCOSTO, (CASE WHEN DFARTIGV=1 THEN DFPREC_ORI/1+(DFIGVPOR/100) ELSE DFPREC_ORI END),DFUNIDAD,DFSERIE,DFLOTE,abs(DFCANTID),DFPRESU, UMREFERENCIA,abs(CANTREFERENCIA) FROM '+@TABLA_det+'') SET @TRANS_DET=@@ERROR END ELSE BEGIN EXEC('set quoted_identifier off Insert Into WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE (WAREHOUSE_ID,DOCUMENT_ID,NUMBER_DOCUMENT,ITEM,PART_ID,PART_DESCRIPTION,QTY, AVERAGE_COST,AMOUNT_SALES,UNIT_PART,NUMBER_SERIE,NUMBER_LOT, QTY_REF,REFERENCE) SELECT dfALMA,"'+@TD+'","'+@NUMERO+'",DFSECUEN,dfCODIGO,DFDESCRI,abs(dfCANTID),DFCOSTO, (CASE WHEN DFARTIGV=1 THEN DFPREC_ORI/1+(DFIGVPOR/100) ELSE DFPREC_ORI END),DFUNIDAD,DFSERIE,DFLOTE,abs(DFCANTID),DFPRESU FROM '+@TABLA_det+'') SET @TRANS_DET=@@ERROR END
IF @TD_REF='PD' BEGIN EXEC('set quoted_identifier off UPDATE P SET WAREHOUSE_ID="'+@ALMA+'",BALANCE=BALANCE-dfCANTID FROM ORDER_LINE P INNER JOIN '+@TABLA_det+' T ON P.PART_ID=T.dfCODIGO') SET @TRANS_PEDDET=@@ERROR END
--CONTROLA ENTRADA Y SALIDAS DE MORESMES IF @TD='NC' BEGIN EXEC('set quoted_identifier off Update M set QTY_OUT =QTY_OUT ,QTY_ENTER = QTY_ENTER+dfCANTID FROM MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE M INNER JOIN '+@TABLA_det+' T ON M.PART_ID=T.dfCODIGO AND M.WAREHOUSE_ID=T.dfALMA WHERE YEAR_MONTH ="'+@ANOMES+'"') SET @MORES_UPDATE=@@ERROR END ELSE BEGIN EXEC('set quoted_identifier off Update M set QTY_OUT =QTY_OUT-dfCANTID ,QTY_ENTER = QTY_ENTER FROM MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE M INNER JOIN '+@TABLA_det+' T ON M.PART_ID=T.dfCODIGO AND M.WAREHOUSE_ID=T.dfALMA WHERE YEAR_MONTH ="'+@ANOMES+'"') SET @MORES_UPDATE=@@ERROR END
IF @TD='NC' BEGIN EXEC('set quoted_identifier off INSERT INTO MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE(WAREHOUSE_ID,PART_ID,YEAR_MONTH,QTY_ENTER,QTY_OUT) SELECT dfALMA,dfCODIGO,"'+@ANOMES+'",dfCANTID,0 FROM '+@TABLA_det+' T LEFT JOIN MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE M ON T.dfALMA=M.WAREHOUSE_ID AND T.dfCODIGO=M.PART_ID AND "'+@ANOMES+'"=YEAR_MONTH WHERE PART_ID IS NULL') SET @MORES_INSERT=@@ERROR END ELSE BEGIN EXEC('set quoted_identifier off INSERT INTO MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE(WAREHOUSE_ID,PART_ID,YEAR_MONTH,QTY_ENTER,QTY_OUT) SELECT dfALMA,dfCODIGO,"'+@ANOMES+'",0,-dfCANTID FROM '+@TABLA_det+' T LEFT JOIN MONTHLY_SUMMARIZE M ON T.dfALMA=M.WAREHOUSE_ID AND T.dfCODIGO=M.PART_ID AND "'+@ANOMES+'"=YEAR_MONTH WHERE PART_ID IS NULL') SET @MORES_INSERT=@@ERROR END
/*CONTROLA ERROR*/ IF (@TRANS_CAB<>0 OR @TRANS_DET<>0 OR @TRANS_PEDDET<>0 OR @UPDATE_COST<>0 OR @MORES_INSERT<>0 OR @MORES_UPDATE<>0) BEGIN SET @CANT_ERROR=1 ROLLBACK TRAN UPGRADE_WHOTRANS_SALES END ELSE BEGIN COMMIT TRAN UPGRADE_WHOTRANS_SALES END

begin if len(ISNULL(@VENDEDOR_INI,''))=0 begin select @VENDEDOR_INI=MIN(id),@VENDEDOR_FIN=MAX(id) from SALES_REP end
if LEN(ISNULL(@CLIENTE_INI,''))=0 begin select @CLIENTE_INI=MIN(id),@CLIENTE_FIN=MAX(id) from CUSTOMER end
if LEN(isnull(@PRODUCTO_INI,''))=0 begin select @PRODUCTO_INI=MIN(id),@PRODUCTO_FIN=MAX(id) from part end end
begin select r.DOCUMENT_ID,r.NUMBER_SERIE,r.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,r.DOCUMENT_DATE, r.SALES_REP_ID,r.PLACE_SALES,r.CUSTOMER_ID,r.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.VAT_REGISTRATION,rl.WAREHOUSE_ID,r.TERMS_ID, r.SELL_RATE,r.CURRENCY_ID,r.NUMBER_ORDER,rl.PART_ID,rl.PART_DESCRIPTION,rl.QTY,UNIT,rl.PRICE_ORI, rl.AMOUNT_TAX,rl.TAX_PERCENT,rl.AMOUNT_US,rl.AMOUNT,PART_LOT from receivable r inner join RECEIVABLE_LINE rl on r.DOCUMENT_ID=rl.DOCUMENT_ID and r.NUMBER_SERIE=rl.NUMBER_SERIE and r.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=rl.NUMBER_DOCUMENT inner join SALES_REP sr on r.SALES_REP_ID=sr.ID where convert(varchar(10),r.DOCUMENT_DATE,103) between @FECHA_INI and @FECHA_FIN and r.SALES_REP_ID between @VENDEDOR_INI and @VENDEDOR_FIN and r.CUSTOMER_ID between @CLIENTE_INI and @CLIENTE_FIN and rl.PART_ID between @PRODUCTO_INI and @PRODUCTO_FIN order by r.DOCUMENT_DATE end

,ITEM, PART_ID, REF_ID, QTY, QTY_DLV, QTY_REF, QTY_INVOICED, NUM_ORDER, D.UNIT_PRICE, AVERAGE_COST, AMOUNT_SALES, D.DISCOUNT, STOCK, AMOUNT_TAX, D.AMOUNT, AMOUNT_US, NUMBER_SERIE, STATUS_DOC, DATE_DOC, D.CCOST_ID, D.WAREHOUSE_REF, TEXT_COMMENT, D.STATUS, D.TRANS_ID, VAL_AMOUNT, NUM_VOUCHER, D.CURRENCY_ID AS CURRENCY_LINE, TYPE, TYPE_EXCHANGE, PRICE_SALES, TOTAL_SALES, D.DATE_CADUCATE AS DATE_CADUCATE_LINE, RETURN_AMOUNT, AUTHORIZED, PART_DESCRIPTION, D.DISCOUNT_PERCENT AS DISCOUNT_PERCENT_LINE, TAX_PERCENT, DISCOUNT_CUST, DISCOUNT_SP, NUMBER_INVOICE, NUMBER_LOT, UNIT_PART, ORDER_MANUFACT_ID, EQUIP_ID, FREIGTH, ITEMI, QTY_BRUTE, DISCOUNT_PER_QTY, STATUS_VALUE, UNIT_REFERENCE, QTY_REFERENCE, D.COMMENT AS COMMENT_LINE, D.REFERENCE AS REFERENCE_LINE, D.ACCOUNT AS ACCOUNT_LINE

,R.ID AS COD_CARRIER, NAME_CARRIER, R.ADDR AS ADDR_CARRIER, R.PHONE, R.VAT_REGISTRATION AS VAT_REG_CARRIER, R.STATUS AS STATUS_CARRIER, R.CREATE_DATE AS CREATE_DATE_CARRIER, R.NAME AS NAME_CARRIER, VAT_REGISTRATION_COMP, ADDR_COMP, PHONE_COMP, R.NUMBER_REGISTRATION AS NUMBER_REG_CARRIER, NUMBER_LICENSE, MODEL_VEH, NUMBER_INSCRIP, R.NUMBER_DOCUMENT AS NUMBER_DOCUMENT_CARRIER
,T.ID AS COD_TERM, T.NAME AS NAME_TERM, NET_DAYS, REGISTER_DATE, EFFECTIVE_DATE

,ITEM, PART_ID, PART_DESCRIPTION, QTY, PRICE_SALES, PRICE_ORI, D.DISCOUNT AS DISCOUNT_LINE, AMOUNT_TAX, DISCOUNT_CUST, D.DISCOUNT_SP AS DISCOUNT_SP_LINE, PERCENT_TAX, PERCENT_DISCOUNT, AMOUNT_US, D.AMOUNT AS AMOUNT_MN, D.STATUS AS STATUS_LINE, SERIE, WAREHOUSE_ID, TEXT_COMMENT, QTY_REF, LOT, D.BALANCE, IS_PART_TAX, LIST_ID, UNIT

Property.Value: SELECT AC_IDSUBDIARIO + '-'+cast(AC_NUM_VOUCHER as varchar(5))as 'AC_NUM_VOUCHER', AC_FEC_VOUCHER , AC_GLOSA_VOU, AD_CUENTA, PC_DES_CTA, AD_DEBE, AD_HABER, AD_TDOC, AD_SDOC, AD_NDOC FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_CAB a INNER JOIN CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET d ON d.AD_IDCAB = a.AC_ID INNER JOIN CO_TB_PLANCTAS b ON d.AD_CUENTA = b.PC_NUM_CTA WHERE AC_ANHO = @P_ANHO AND AC_MES = @P_MES AND AC_IDSUBDIARIO IN (SELECT CODIGO FROM CO_TB_CODIGOS_TMP where PC = @P_PC) ORDER BY AC_NUM_VOUCHER

END) AS MONEDA,AD_TCAM AS TC, (CASE WHEN AD_TCAM > 0 THEN A.AD_MONTO_ORI ELSE 0 END) AS DOL, A.AD_DEBE,A.AD_HABER FROM CO_TB_ASIENTO_DET A INNER JOIN CO_TB_PLANCTAS B ON A.AD_CUENTA = B.PC_NUM_CTA WHERE A.AD_IDCAB = @P_IDCAB AND PC_PERIODO = @P_PERIODO

Property.Value: update p set p.qty_on_hand=l.suma from part_qty as p inner join (select sum(qty_on_hand) as suma,part_id,who_id from lot where part_id=@part_id group by part_id,who_id)l on l.who_id=p.warehouse_id and p.part_id=l.part_id where l.part_id=@part_id AND L.who_id=@who_id

select s.IdSeg ,s.NomProT , s.LocalOcu , s.DirecOcu , s.FecOcu , s.MovSol , s.MovDol , s.Stado, s.EmailAddress , s.Phone , s.Fax , d.Contac1 , d.Contac2 , d.Contac3 , d.DesConsultor , d.DesGeneral , d.Phone , d.Phone1 , d.Phone2 , d.movil , d.movil1 , d.movil2 , d.EmailAddress3 , d.EmailAddress1 , d.EmailAddress2 , d.EmailAddress, o.Descri, (u.FirstName + ' ' + u.LastName) as FirstName, u.LastName ,c.VAT_REGISTRATION,c.NAME
from Ocurrencia_Cli o inner join Seguimiento s on s.IdOcu=o.IdOcu inner join User_Seguimientos u on s.IdUser=u.IdUser inner join Detalle_Contac d on d.IdSeg=s.IdSeg inner join CUSTOMER c on s.ID=c.VAT_REGISTRATION where s.FecOcu between @fecini and @fecfin and s.Stado='Vigente' --where s.FecOcu between '06/10/2008' and GETDATE() and s.Stado='Vigente'
IF @@ERROR <> 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION ELSE COMMIT TRANSACTION

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
/* SET @EMP='BDNOVAQ' SET @DOC ='' SET @MON ='ME' SET @CLI_INI ='001' SET @CLI_FIN ='002' SET @OPT='0' SET @VEN_INI='01' SET @VEN_FIN='01' SET @PC='DEVELOPER02' SET @FECHA='24/04/2008' */ DECLARE @CADENA VARCHAR(2000) IF @OPT='1' SET @CADENA='AND C.DOCUMENT_ID IN (''' + @DOC+ ''')' ELSE SET @CADENA=''
IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM sysobjects WHERE name=@PC+'CARTERAX') --EXEC('TRUNCATE TABLE '+@PC+'') EXEC('DROP TABLE '+@PC+'CARTERAX')
IF @MON='ME' EXEC(' SELECT C.CUSTOMER_ID,M.NAME,C.DOCUMENT_ID,C.NUMBER_DOC,C.DOC_DATE,C.CADUCATE_DATE,C.AMOUNT_BALANCE AS SALDO, C.CURRENCY_ID,C.SELL_RATE,C.AMOUNT_BALANCE_INI AS SALDOINI,V.ID,V.NAME AS NAME_V,(0) AS CHEQUE INTO '+ @PC + 'CARTERAX FROM ['+ @EMP+ '].DBO.CUSTOMER_BALANCE C INNER JOIN ['+ @EMP + '].DBO.CUSTOMER M ON C.CUSTOMER_ID=M.ID INNER JOIN ['+ @EMP + '].DBO.SALES_REP V ON C.SALES_ID=V.ID WHERE C.CUSTOMER_ID>='''+@CLI_INI +''' AND C.CUSTOMER_ID<='''+@CLI_FIN+''' AND C.SALES_ID>='''+@VEN_INI +''' AND C.SALES_ID<='''+@VEN_FIN+''' AND (C.AMOUNT_BALANCE>0.01 OR C.AMOUNT_BALANCE<-0.01)'+@CADENA+' AND C.DOC_DATE<=''' + @FECHA + ''' ')
IF @MON='MN' EXEC(' SELECT C.CUSTOMER_ID,M.NAME,C.DOCUMENT_ID,C.NUMBER_DOC,C.DOC_DATE,C.CADUCATE_DATE,C.AMOUNT_BALANCE*C.SELL_RATE AS SALDO, C.CURRENCY_ID,C.SELL_RATE,C.AMOUNT_BALANCE_INI*C.SELL_RATE AS SALDOINI,V.ID,V.NAME AS NAME_V,(0) AS CHEQUE INTO '+ @PC + 'CARTERAX FROM ['+ @EMP+ '].DBO.CUSTOMER_BALANCE C INNER JOIN ['+ @EMP + '].DBO.CUSTOMER M ON C.CUSTOMER_ID=M.ID INNER JOIN ['+ @EMP + '].DBO.SALES_REP V ON C.SALES_ID=V.ID WHERE C.CUSTOMER_ID>='''+@CLI_INI +''' AND C.CUSTOMER_ID<='''+@CLI_FIN+''' AND C.SALES_ID>='''+@VEN_INI +''' AND C.SALES_ID<='''+@VEN_FIN+''' AND (C.AMOUNT_BALANCE>0.01 OR C.AMOUNT_BALANCE<-0.01)'+@CADENA+' AND C.DOC_DATE<=''' + @FECHA + ''' ')
--CREO UN CURSOR PARA ACTUALIZAR EL CAMPO DE CHEQUE DECLARE @TIPO VARCHAR(2),@NUMERO VARCHAR(15)
EXEC(' DECLARE ACT_CHEQUE CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT PD.TYPE_DOC,PD.NUMBER_DOC FROM ['+ @EMP + '].dbo.RECEIVABLE_LIST_LINE PD INNER JOIN ['+ @EMP + '].dbo.CUSTOMER_BALANCE C ON C.DOCUMENT_ID=PD.TYPE_DOC AND C.NUMBER_DOC=PD.NUMBER_DOC INNER JOIN ['+ @EMP + '].dbo.CHECKS CH ON CH.CHECK_ID=PD.NUM_REF AND CH.STATUS=''D'' AND PD.DOC_REF=''CH''') OPEN ACT_CHEQUE FETCH NEXT FROM ACT_CHEQUE INTO @TIPO,@NUMERO
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN EXEC('UPDATE '+ @PC +'CARTERAX SET CHEQUE=1 WHERE DOCUMENT_ID='''+@TIPO+''' AND NUMBER_DOC='''+@NUMERO+'''') FETCH NEXT FROM ACT_CHEQUE INTO @TIPO,@NUMERO END
CLOSE ACT_CHEQUE DEALLOCATE ACT_CHEQUE
--Realizo sellecion de documentos EXEC('SELECT * FROM '+ @PC+'CARTERAX')

Property.Value: EXEC(' SELECT C.WAREHOUSE_ID, C.DOCUMENT_ID,C.TYPE_TRANS,C.NUMBER_DOCUMENT, C.DATE_DOCUMENT, C.TRANS_ID, C.DOC_ID_REF, C.NUM_ID_REF,C.VENDOR_ID, C.CURRENCY_TYPE, C.CURRENCY_EXCHANGE, C.VENDOR_NAME, D.PART_ID, D.PART_DESCRIPTION, D.UNIT_PART, D.QTY, D.AVERAGE_COST,P.ID, P.NAME,M.DESCRIPTION, M.UNIT_OF_MEASUREMENT ,M.WEIGHT,M.REFERENCE FROM ['+@EMP+'].DBO.WAREHOUSE_TRANS C INNER JOIN ['+@EMP+'].DBO.WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE D ON C.WAREHOUSE_ID=D.WAREHOUSE_ID AND C.DOCUMENT_ID=D.DOCUMENT_ID AND C.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=D.NUMBER_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN ['+@EMP+'].DBO.VENDOR P ON C.VENDOR_ID=P.ID INNER JOIN ['+@EMP+'].DBO.PART M ON D.PART_ID=M.ID WHERE (C.DOCUMENT_ID=NI OR C.DOCUMENT_ID=NS) AND (C.TRANS_ID='+ @TRANS1 +' OR C.TRANS_ID='+ @TRANS2 +' OR C.TRANS_ID='+ @TRANS3 +' OR C.TRANS_ID='+ @TRANS4 +' OR C.TRANS_ID='+ @TRANS5 +' OR C.TRANS_ID='+ @TRANS6 +') AND D.PART_ID>='+ @CODART1 +' AND D.PART_ID<='+ @CODART2 +' AND C.DATE_DOCUMENT>='+@FECHA1+' AND C.DATE_DOCUMENT<='+ @FECHA2 +' ORDER BY C.DATE_DOCUMENT,C.TYPE_TRANS,C.NUMBER_DOCUMENT')

Property.Name: HeaderContents
BodyScript
Property.Value:
DECLARE @DOCUMENT_ID VARCHAR(2) DECLARE @NUMBER_SERIE VARCHAR(3) DECLARE @NUMBER_DOCUMENT VARCHAR(7) DECLARE @ISC FLOAT
SET @ISC=0
DECLARE CURSORA CURSOR FOR SELECT DOCUMENT_ID, NUMBER_SERIE, NUMBER_DOCUMENT FROM dbo.RECEIVABLE WHERE STATUS<>'A' ORDER BY DOCUMENT_ID, NUMBER_SERIE, NUMBER_DOCUMENT OPEN CURSORA FETCH NEXT FROM CURSORA INTO @DOCUMENT_ID,@NUMBER_SERIE,@NUMBER_DOCUMENT WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN SELECT @ISC=SUM(ISC) FROM dbo.RECEIVABLE_LINE WHERE DOCUMENT_ID=@DOCUMENT_ID AND NUMBER_SERIE=@NUMBER_SERIE AND NUMBER_DOCUMENT=@NUMBER_DOCUMENT
UPDATE dbo.RECEIVABLE SET ISC=@ISC WHERE DOCUMENT_ID=@DOCUMENT_ID AND NUMBER_SERIE=@NUMBER_SERIE AND NUMBER_DOCUMENT=@NUMBER_DOCUMENT
SET @ISC=0
FETCH NEXT FROM CURSORA INTO @DOCUMENT_ID,@NUMBER_SERIE,@NUMBER_DOCUMENT END CLOSE CURSORA DEALLOCATE CURSORA

DECLARE @TRANS_ID VARCHAR(5)
DECLARE CURSOR1_INGRESO CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT TRANS_ID FROM TABLA_SEGUNDA_MEDIADORA_TRANSSACCIONES_DE_INVENTARIOS WHERE IS_IN_OUT='I' OPEN CURSOR1_INGRESO FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR1_INGRESO INTO @TRANS_ID WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN DECLARE @FECHA VARCHAR(10) DECLARE @IN_VALUE NUMERIC(15,9) DECLARE @OUT_VALUE NUMERIC(15,9)
DECLARE CURSOR2_INGRESO CURSOR FOR SELECT FECHA,IN_VALUE,OUT_VALUE FROM TABLA_SEGUNDA_MEDIADORA_TRANSSACCIONES_DE_INVENTARIOS WHERE TRANS_ID=@TRANS_ID AND IS_IN_OUT='I' OPEN CURSOR2_INGRESO FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR2_INGRESO INTO @FECHA,@IN_VALUE,@OUT_VALUE WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN IF LEN(@FECHA)=5 BEGIN IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,1)=1 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_TRANSACCIONES_DE_INVENTARIOS SET INGRESO_CAN1=@IN_VALUE WHERE TRANS_ID=@TRANS_ID AND IS_IN_OUT='I' END ELSE IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,1)=2 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_TRANSACCIONES_DE_INVENTARIOS SET INGRESO_CAN2=@IN_VALUE WHERE TRANS_ID=@TRANS_ID AND IS_IN_OUT='I' END ELSE IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,1)=3 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_TRANSACCIONES_DE_INVENTARIOS SET INGRESO_CAN3=@IN_VALUE WHERE TRANS_ID=@TRANS_ID AND IS_IN_OUT='I' END ELSE IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,1)=4 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_TRANSACCIONES_DE_INVENTARIOS SET INGRESO_CAN4=@IN_VALUE WHERE TRANS_ID=@TRANS_ID AND IS_IN_OUT='I' END ELSE IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,1)=5 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_TRANSACCIONES_DE_INVENTARIOS SET INGRESO_CAN5=@IN_VALUE WHERE TRANS_ID=@TRANS_ID AND IS_IN_OUT='I' END ELSE IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,1)=6 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_TRANSACCIONES_DE_INVENTARIOS SET INGRESO_CAN6=@IN_VALUE WHERE TRANS_ID=@TRANS_ID AND IS_IN_OUT='I' END ELSE IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,1)=7 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_TRANSACCIONES_DE_INVENTARIOS SET INGRESO_CAN7=@IN_VALUE WHERE TRANS_ID=@TRANS_ID AND IS_IN_OUT='I' END ELSE IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,1)=8 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_TRANSACCIONES_DE_INVENTARIOS SET INGRESO_CAN8=@IN_VALUE WHERE TRANS_ID=@TRANS_ID AND IS_IN_OUT='I' END ELSE IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,1)=9 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_TRANSACCIONES_DE_INVENTARIOS SET INGRESO_CAN9=@IN_VALUE WHERE TRANS_ID=@TRANS_ID AND IS_IN_OUT='I' END
END ELSE IF LEN(@FECHA)=6 BEGIN IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,2)=10 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_TRANSACCIONES_DE_INVENTARIOS SET INGRESO_CAN10=@IN_VALUE WHERE TRANS_ID=@TRANS_ID AND IS_IN_OUT='I' END ELSE IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,2)=11 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_TRANSACCIONES_DE_INVENTARIOS SET INGRESO_CAN11=@IN_VALUE WHERE TRANS_ID=@TRANS_ID AND IS_IN_OUT='I' END IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,2)=12 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_TRANSACCIONES_DE_INVENTARIOS SET INGRESO_CAN12=@IN_VALUE WHERE TRANS_ID=@TRANS_ID AND IS_IN_OUT='I' END
END FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR2_INGRESO INTO @FECHA,@IN_VALUE,@OUT_VALUE END CLOSE CURSOR2_INGRESO DEALLOCATE CURSOR2_INGRESO
FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR1_INGRESO INTO @TRANS_ID END CLOSE CURSOR1_INGRESO DEALLOCATE CURSOR1_INGRESO

DECLARE CURSOR2_INGRESO CURSOR FOR SELECT FECHA,IN_VALUE,OUT_VALUE FROM TABLA_SEGUNDA_MEDIADORA_TRANSSACCIONES_DE_INVENTARIOS WHERE TRANS_ID=@TRANS_ID AND IS_IN_OUT='S' OPEN CURSOR2_INGRESO FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR2_INGRESO INTO @FECHA,@IN_VALUE,@OUT_VALUE WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN IF LEN(@FECHA)=5 BEGIN IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,1)=1 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_TRANSACCIONES_DE_INVENTARIOS SET SALIDAS_CAN1=@OUT_VALUE WHERE TRANS_ID=@TRANS_ID AND IS_IN_OUT='S' END ELSE IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,1)=2 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_TRANSACCIONES_DE_INVENTARIOS SET SALIDAS_CAN2=@OUT_VALUE WHERE TRANS_ID=@TRANS_ID AND IS_IN_OUT='S' END ELSE IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,1)=3 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_TRANSACCIONES_DE_INVENTARIOS SET SALIDAS_CAN3=@OUT_VALUE WHERE TRANS_ID=@TRANS_ID AND IS_IN_OUT='S' END ELSE IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,1)=4 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_TRANSACCIONES_DE_INVENTARIOS SET SALIDAS_CAN4=@OUT_VALUE WHERE TRANS_ID=@TRANS_ID AND IS_IN_OUT='S' END ELSE IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,1)=5 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_TRANSACCIONES_DE_INVENTARIOS SET SALIDAS_CAN5=@OUT_VALUE WHERE TRANS_ID=@TRANS_ID AND IS_IN_OUT='S' END ELSE IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,1)=6 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_TRANSACCIONES_DE_INVENTARIOS SET SALIDAS_CAN6=@OUT_VALUE WHERE TRANS_ID=@TRANS_ID AND IS_IN_OUT='S' END ELSE IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,1)=7 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_TRANSACCIONES_DE_INVENTARIOS SET SALIDAS_CAN7=@OUT_VALUE WHERE TRANS_ID=@TRANS_ID AND IS_IN_OUT='S' END ELSE IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,1)=8 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_TRANSACCIONES_DE_INVENTARIOS SET SALIDAS_CAN8=@OUT_VALUE WHERE TRANS_ID=@TRANS_ID AND IS_IN_OUT='S' END ELSE IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,1)=9 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_TRANSACCIONES_DE_INVENTARIOS SET SALIDAS_CAN9=@OUT_VALUE WHERE TRANS_ID=@TRANS_ID AND IS_IN_OUT='S' END
END ELSE IF LEN(@FECHA)=6 BEGIN IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,2)=10 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_TRANSACCIONES_DE_INVENTARIOS SET SALIDAS_CAN10=@OUT_VALUE WHERE TRANS_ID=@TRANS_ID AND IS_IN_OUT='S' END ELSE IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,2)=11 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_TRANSACCIONES_DE_INVENTARIOS SET SALIDAS_CAN11=@OUT_VALUE WHERE TRANS_ID=@TRANS_ID AND IS_IN_OUT='S' END IF SUBSTRING(@FECHA,5,2)=12 BEGIN UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_TRANSACCIONES_DE_INVENTARIOS SET SALIDAS_CAN12=@OUT_VALUE WHERE TRANS_ID=@TRANS_ID AND IS_IN_OUT='S' END
END FETCH NEXT FROM CURSOR2_INGRESO INTO @FECHA,@IN_VALUE,@OUT_VALUE END CLOSE CURSOR2_INGRESO DEALLOCATE CURSOR2_INGRESO

UPDATE TABLA_FINAL_TRANSACCIONES_DE_INVENTARIOS SET INGRESO_CAN1=(CASE WHEN INGRESO_CAN1 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE INGRESO_CAN1 END),SALIDAS_CAN1=(CASE WHEN SALIDAS_CAN1 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE SALIDAS_CAN1 END), INGRESO_CAN2=(CASE WHEN INGRESO_CAN2 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE INGRESO_CAN2 END),SALIDAS_CAN2=(CASE WHEN SALIDAS_CAN2 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE SALIDAS_CAN2 END), INGRESO_CAN3=(CASE WHEN INGRESO_CAN3 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE INGRESO_CAN3 END),SALIDAS_CAN3=(CASE WHEN SALIDAS_CAN3 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE SALIDAS_CAN3 END), INGRESO_CAN4=(CASE WHEN INGRESO_CAN4 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE INGRESO_CAN4 END),SALIDAS_CAN4=(CASE WHEN SALIDAS_CAN4 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE SALIDAS_CAN4 END), INGRESO_CAN5=(CASE WHEN INGRESO_CAN5 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE INGRESO_CAN5 END),SALIDAS_CAN5=(CASE WHEN SALIDAS_CAN5 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE SALIDAS_CAN5 END), INGRESO_CAN6=(CASE WHEN INGRESO_CAN6 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE INGRESO_CAN6 END),SALIDAS_CAN6=(CASE WHEN SALIDAS_CAN6 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE SALIDAS_CAN6 END), INGRESO_CAN7=(CASE WHEN INGRESO_CAN7 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE INGRESO_CAN7 END),SALIDAS_CAN7=(CASE WHEN SALIDAS_CAN7 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE SALIDAS_CAN7 END), INGRESO_CAN8=(CASE WHEN INGRESO_CAN8 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE INGRESO_CAN8 END),SALIDAS_CAN8=(CASE WHEN SALIDAS_CAN8 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE SALIDAS_CAN8 END), INGRESO_CAN9=(CASE WHEN INGRESO_CAN9 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE INGRESO_CAN9 END),SALIDAS_CAN9=(CASE WHEN SALIDAS_CAN9 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE SALIDAS_CAN9 END), INGRESO_CAN10=(CASE WHEN INGRESO_CAN10 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE INGRESO_CAN10 END),SALIDAS_CAN10=(CASE WHEN SALIDAS_CAN10 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE SALIDAS_CAN10 END), INGRESO_CAN11=(CASE WHEN INGRESO_CAN11 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE INGRESO_CAN11 END),SALIDAS_CAN11=(CASE WHEN SALIDAS_CAN11 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE SALIDAS_CAN11 END), INGRESO_CAN12=(CASE WHEN INGRESO_CAN12 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE INGRESO_CAN12 END),SALIDAS_CAN12=(CASE WHEN SALIDAS_CAN12 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE SALIDAS_CAN12 END)

BEGIN TRANSACTION
--****** I N S E R T A N D O L O S D A T O S *****-- IF @SW = 1
INSERT INTO dbo.NUMBER_DOCUMENT_PURCHASE( ID , DESCRIPTION , NUMBER_INI , NUMBER_FIN , NUMBER , USER_ID , NAME_FORMAT) VALUES ( @ID , @DESCRIPTION , @NUMBER_INI , @NUMBER_FIN , @NUMBER , @USER_ID , @NAME_FORMAT)

--***** E L I M I N A N D O L O S D A T O S *****-- IF @SW = 3 DELETE FROM dbo.NUMBER_DOCUMENT_PURCHASE WHERE ID = @ID
IF @@ERROR <> 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION ELSE COMMIT TRANSACTION

Property.Name: HeaderContents
Property.Value: create procedure VEN_RPT_AREAS as

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
DECLARE @NUMBER_DOCUMENT VARCHAR(15) DECLARE @AMOUNT_TAX NUMERIC(22,9) DECLARE @IGV NUMERIC(22,9) DECLARE @INDICE_UNO INT DECLARE @INDICE_DOS INT DECLARE @EXTRA_UNO VARCHAR(10) DECLARE @EXTRA_DOS VARCHAR(10) DECLARE @REDONDEADO NUMERIC(22,9)
DECLARE VER CURSOR FOR
SELECT NUMBER_DOCUMENT,AMOUNT_TAX FROM RECEIVABLE WHERE STATUS<>'A' AND YEAR(DOCUMENT_DATE)='2010' and month(document_date)='08' ORDER BY NUMBER_DOCUMENT
OPEN VER FETCH NEXT FROM VER INTO @NUMBER_DOCUMENT,@AMOUNT_TAX WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN SELECT @IGV=SUM(AMOUNT_TAX) FROM RECEIVABLE_LINE WHERE NUMBER_DOCUMENT=@NUMBER_DOCUMENT SET @INDICE_UNO=CHARINDEX('.',CONVERT(VARCHAR,@AMOUNT_TAX)) SET @INDICE_DOS=CHARINDEX('.',CONVERT(VARCHAR,@IGV)) SET @EXTRA_UNO=SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,@AMOUNT_TAX),1,@INDICE_UNO-1) SET @EXTRA_DOS=SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,@IGV),1,@INDICE_UNO-1)
IF @EXTRA_DOS=0 BEGIN SET @REDONDEADO=ROUND(@IGV,2) END IF @EXTRA_UNO<>@EXTRA_DOS BEGIN PRINT @NUMBER_DOCUMENT END
FETCH NEXT FROM VER INTO @NUMBER_DOCUMENT,@AMOUNT_TAX END CLOSE VER DEALLOCATE VER

Property.Name: HeaderContents
Property.Value: CREATE VIEW dbo.vwPlanillaChe AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tempdb.dbo.sysobjects WHERE NAME='COSTOS'+@PC) EXEC('DROP TABLE [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+'')
IF @OPC='0' EXEC ('SELECT FD.PART_ID,FD.PART_DESCRIPTION,FC.DOCUMENT_ID,FC.NUMBER_SERIE,FC.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,FC.CUSTOMER_ID,FC.CUSTOMER_NAME, FC.DOCUMENT_DATE,FD.QTY,FD.UNIT,FC.CURRENCY_ID,FD.PRICE_ORI, FD.PART_TAX,FC.SELL_RATE AS CFTIPCAM,FD.DISCOUNT,FD.DISCOUNT_CUSTOMER,FD.DISCOUNT_SP, FC.IS_GUIA_REC,V.ID,V.NAME,FC.DOCUMENT_REF,FC.SERIE_REF,FC.NUMBER_REF INTO [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' FROM RECEIVABLE FC INNER JOIN SALES_REP V ON FC.SALES_REP_ID=V.ID INNER JOIN RECEIVABLE_LINE FD ON FC.DOCUMENT_ID=FD.DOCUMENT_ID AND FC.NUMBER_SERIE=FD.NUMBER_SERIE AND FC.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=FD.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN PART MA ON MA.ID=FD.PART_ID WHERE FD.PART_ID>=''' + @ARTINI + ''' AND FD.PART_ID<=''' + @ARTFIN + ''' AND FC.DOCUMENT_DATE>=''' + @FECHAINI + ''' AND FC.DOCUMENT_DATE<=''' + @FECHAFIN + ''' AND (FC.CUSTOMER_ID>=''' + @CLIINI + ''' AND FC.CUSTOMER_ID<=''' + @CLIFIN + ''') AND V.ID>=''' + @INI + ''' AND V.ID<=''' + @FIN + ''' AND NOT(MA.IS_STOCKED=''N'' AND MA.SERIES=''N'' AND MA.IS_LOT=''N'') AND FC.STATUS<>''A'' AND FD.PART_ID<>''CILIN '' ORDER BY FD.PART_ID ')
IF @OPC='1' EXEC ('SELECT FD.PART_ID,FD.PART_DESCRIPTION,FC.DOCUMENT_ID,FC.NUMBER_SERIE,FC.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,FC.CUSTOMER_ID,FC.CUSTOMER_NAME, FC.DOCUMENT_DATE,FD.QTY,FD.UNIT,FC.CURRENCY_ID,FD.PRICE_ORI, FD.PART_TAX,TC.SELL_RATE AS CFTIPCAM,FD.DISCOUNT,FD.DISCOUNT_CUSTOMER,FD.DISCOUNT_SP, FC.IS_GUIA_REC,V.ID,V.NAME,FC.DOCUMENT_REF,FC.SERIE_REF,FC.NUMBER_REF INTO [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' FROM RECEIVABLE FC INNER JOIN SALES_REP V ON FC.SALES_REP_ID=V.ID INNER JOIN RECEIVABLE_LINE FD ON FC.DOCUMENT_ID=FD.DOCUMENT_ID AND FC.NUMBER_SERIE=FD.NUMBER_SERIE AND FC.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=FD.NUMBER_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN CURRENCY_EXCHANGE TC ON TC.CURRENCY_DATE=FC.DOCUMENT_DATE INNER JOIN PART MA ON MA.ID=FD.PART_ID WHERE FD.PART_ID>=''' + @ARTINI + ''' AND FD.PART_ID<=''' + @ARTFIN + ''' AND FC.DOCUMENT_DATE>=''' + @FECHAINI + ''' AND FC.DOCUMENT_DATE<=''' + @FECHAFIN + ''' AND (FC.CUSTOMER_ID>=''' + @CLIINI + ''' AND FC.CUSTOMER_ID<=''' + @CLIFIN + ''') AND V.ID>=''' + @INI + ''' AND V.ID<=''' + @FIN + ''' AND NOT(MA.IS_STOCKED=''N'' AND MA.SERIES=''N'' AND MA.IS_LOT=''N'') AND FC.STATUS<>''A'' AND FD.PART_ID<>''CILIN '' ORDER BY FD.PART_ID ')
EXEC ('ALTER TABLE [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' ADD COSTOMN numeric(15,9)') EXEC ('ALTER TABLE [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' ADD COSTOME numeric(15,9)') EXEC ('ALTER TABLE [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' ADD COSTOMN_REAL numeric(15,9)')
EXEC ('UPDATE C SET C.COSTOMN = (CASE WHEN C.CURRENCY_ID=''MN'' THEN MD.AVERAGE_COST ELSE MD.AVERAGE_COST * CFTIPCAM END), C.COSTOME = (CASE WHEN C.CURRENCY_ID=''ME'' THEN MD.AVERAGE_COST ELSE MD.AVERAGE_COST / CFTIPCAM END) FROM [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' C INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE MD ON C.PART_ID=MD.PART_ID AND C.DOCUMENT_ID=MD.DOCUMENT_ID AND C.NUMBER_SERIE=LEFT(MD.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,3) AND C.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=RIGHT(MD.NUMBER_DOCUMENT,7) WHERE C.IS_GUIA_REC IS NULL OR C.IS_GUIA_REC<>''S'' OR C.IS_GUIA_REC='''' OR C.IS_GUIA_REC='' ''')
EXEC ('UPDATE C SET C.COSTOMN = (CASE WHEN C.CURRENCY_ID=''MN'' THEN MD.AVERAGE_COST ELSE MD.AVERAGE_COST * CFTIPCAM END), C.COSTOME = (CASE WHEN C.CURRENCY_ID=''ME'' THEN MD.AVERAGE_COST ELSE MD.AVERAGE_COST / CFTIPCAM END) FROM [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' C INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS MC INNER JOIN WAREHOUSE_TRANS_LINE MD ON MC.DOCUMENT_ID=MD.DOCUMENT_ID AND MC.WAREHOUSE_ID=MD.WAREHOUSE_ID AND MC.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=MD.NUMBER_DOCUMENT ON C.DOCUMENT_ID=MC.DOC_ID_REF AND C.NUMBER_SERIE=LEFT(MC.NUM_ID_REF,3) AND C.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=RIGHT(MC.NUM_ID_REF,7) WHERE C.PART_ID=MD.PART_ID AND C.IS_GUIA_REC=''S''')
EXEC ('UPDATE [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' SET QTY=(CASE WHEN QTY IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE QTY END), PRICE_ORI=(CASE WHEN PRICE_ORI IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE PRICE_ORI END), PART_TAX=(CASE WHEN PART_TAX IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE PART_TAX END), CFTIPCAM=(CASE WHEN CFTIPCAM IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE CFTIPCAM END), DISCOUNT=(CASE WHEN DISCOUNT IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE DISCOUNT END), DISCOUNT_CUSTOMER=(CASE WHEN DISCOUNT_CUSTOMER IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE DISCOUNT_CUSTOMER END), DISCOUNT_SP=(CASE WHEN DISCOUNT_SP IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE DISCOUNT_SP END), IS_GUIA_REC=(CASE WHEN IS_GUIA_REC IS NULL THEN '''' ELSE IS_GUIA_REC END), COSTOMN=(CASE WHEN COSTOMN IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE COSTOMN END), COSTOME=(CASE WHEN COSTOME IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE COSTOME END)')
--ACTUALIZO EL COSTO REAL EN SOLES EXEC('UPDATE C SET COSTOMN_REAL=AVERAGE_COST FROM [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' C LEFT JOIN [tempdb].dbo.'+@PC+'INVENTORY I ON C.DOCUMENT_ID=I.TYPE_DOC AND C.NUMBER_SERIE+C.NUMBER_DOCUMENT=I.NUMBER_DOC AND C.PART_ID=I.PART_ID')
--NUEVA ACTUALIZACION PARA CASO DE GUIAS EXEC(' UPDATE C SET COSTOMN_REAL=AVERAGE_COST FROM [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' C INNER JOIN [tempdb].dbo.'+@PC+'INVENTORY I ON C.DOCUMENT_REF=I.TYPE_DOC AND C.SERIE_REF+C.NUMBER_REF=I.NUMBER_DOC AND C.PART_ID=I.PART_ID AND IS_GUIA_REC=''S'' ')
--HAGO SELECT A TEMPORAL EXEC('SELECT * FROM [tempdb].dbo.COSTOS'+@PC+' ORDER BY PART_ID,DOCUMENT_ID,NUMBER_SERIE,NUMBER_DOCUMENT')
